📘 **Grammar Rule**: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: इस वाक्य में व्याकरण का कोई दोष नहीं है। सभी संज्ञा, क्रिया और सहायक शब्द नियमानुसार सही प्रयुक्त हैं (No error / No improvement required)।

questionText: Mr. Abhilash and his family / have received / no informations / about the incident.
explanation:
no informations 'Informations' must be replaced with 'information' as 'information' is an uncountable noun and its plural cannot be formed. Hence, 'no information' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'no informations' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Every students in the hostel decided to travel to Delhi to witness the Republic Day parade.
explanation:
Every students in the hostel 'Everyone/each/ every/ nothing/ everything/ anything/ either/ neither' represents a singular noun. Therefore, 'students' must be replaced with the singular noun 'student'. Hence, 'Every student in the hostel' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Every students in the hostel' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: By this time next year / I will had graduated from college / and starting my first job / in the field of marketing.
options: I will had graduated from college
explanation:
I will had graduated from college 'Subject + will have + V 3 ' is the correct grammatical structure for a sentence which is in the future perfect tense. Therefore, 'will had' must be replaced with 'will have'. Hence, 'I will have graduated from college' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I will had graduated from college' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I are dancing with my husband at my sister's wedding.
explanation:
I are dancing 'Am' is the correct helping verb to use with 'I' in present continuous tense. Hence, 'I am dancing' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I are dancing' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: After the concert was over, / they go to a restaurant, / had dinner together / and talked until midnight.
explanation:
they go to a restaurant, The given sentence is in the past tense, so it must have the verb in the past form (V 2 ), not the present form (go). Hence, 'they went to a restaurant' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'they go to a restaurant,' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Renewable energy / sources like solar and wind power / will replaced traditional fossil fuels / and help reduce carbon emissions.
options: sources like solar and wind power
explanation:
will replaced traditional fossil fuels 'Modal verbs' are auxiliary verbs(also called helping verbs) like can, will, could, shall, must, would, might, and should. However, after a modal verb, we generally use the first form of the verb (V 1 ). Hence, 'will replace(V 1 ) traditional fossil fuels' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'will replaced traditional fossil fuels' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: No other place in this country is so better as Gulmarg, Kashmir.
explanation:
so better as Positive degree adjective is used in the structure 'as'…as' or 'so'…as' to make a comparison. Therefore, 'better' must be replaced with 'good'. Hence, 'so good as' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'so better as' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Our family is planning / a trip to Europe next summer / where we should visit several famous / landmarks and enjoy local cuisine.
options: where we should visit several famous
a trip to Europe next summer
explanation:
where we should visit several famous 'Should' must be replaced with 'will' as the action of visiting several famous landmarks will happen in the future (next summer). Hence, 'where we will visit several famous' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'where we should visit several famous' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: It is he who work for the company for more than a decade.
explanation:
who work 'Who work' must be replaced with 'who has been working' as we use the perfect continuous tense with 'for/since' to indicate time period. Hence, 'who has been working' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'who work' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The windows / violent banged / during the / storm yesterday.
explanation:
violent banged 'Violent' must be replaced with 'violently' as the given sentence needs an adverb to modify the verb 'banged'. Hence, 'violently banged' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'violent banged' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Neither my brother nor my brothers-in-law / attended the meeting / as his health is not more good.
options: Neither my brother nor my brothers-in-law
as his health is not more good
explanation:
as his health is not more good 'More' must be removed as we use comparative degree adjective to make a comparison but there is no comparison between the health of two people. The first part of the sentence is in the past tense, so the verb in the second clause will also be in the past tense(V 2 ). Hence, 'as his health was not good' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'as his health is not more good' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Rahul thinks he is as smarter as his friends in the class.
explanation:
he is as smarter as 'As + adjective/adverb + as' is a comparative structure in which we always use positive degree. Therefore, 'smarter' must be replaced with 'smart'. Hence, 'he is as smart as' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'he is as smarter as' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Solutions to the country's interior problems are still a long way away.
explanation:
the country's interior The correct word to use in this sentence is 'internal', not 'interior'. 'Internal' means occurring inside a country. Hence, the country's internal is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the country's interior' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: They secret / decided / to leave / the town.
explanation:
They secret The given sentence needs an adverb 'secretly' to modify the verb 'decided', not the noun 'secret'. Hence, 'They secretly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'They secret' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He ran quick to catch the bus.
explanation:
quickly The given sentence needs an adverb 'quickly' to modify the verb 'ran', not the adjective 'quick'. Hence, 'quickly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'quickly' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Mrs. Sreelakshmi's / musical intelligence / is superior than / Mrs. Suma's.
explanation:
is superior than There are some words that take the preposition 'to' after them. For example:- superior to, inferior to, prior to, elder to, junior to, senior to, etc. Hence 'is superior to' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is superior than' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The employees were comfortable / with me and they talked about / their problems since / I has worked there as a manager.
options: I has worked there as a manager.
with me and they talked about
explanation:
I has worked there as a manager. The given sentence is in the past tense, so it must have the verb of past tense. 'Had' will be used instead of 'has'. Hence, 'I had worked there as a manager' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I has worked there as a manager.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Mr. Arun / will pay dear / for his / financial mistake.
explanation:
will pay dear The given sentence needs an adverb 'dearly' to modify the verb 'pay', not the adjective 'dear'. Hence, 'will pay dearly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'will pay dear' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: My brother received / his MBA degree into / the university last year.
explanation:
his MBA degree into 'Into' must be replaced with 'from' as we use 'from' to indicate the source of something. Hence, 'his MBA degree from' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'his MBA degree into' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He replied / in a dry tone, / "Ouch! I will not work / for you any more
explanation:
Ouch! I will not work 'Ouch!' is used to express pain. However, in the given sentence, the speaker replied in a dry tone. So, the correct interjection to use is 'Ugh!'. Hence, 'Ugh! I will not work for you anymore' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Ouch! I will not work' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Mr. Surya / have no interior / motive in offering / you support.
explanation:
have no interior 'Have no interior' must be replaced with 'has no ulterior'. 'Mr. Surya' is a singular subject that will take 'has' as a singular verb. Also, the correct word to use here is 'ulterior'. 'Ulterior motive' means a secret reason for doing something. Hence, 'has no ulterior' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'have no interior' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: By the end of / this month, he / will been working / for five years.
explanation:
will been working 'Will been' must be replaced with 'will have been'. Future perfect continuous tense (will have been + V ing ) is used to talk about the duration of an action that has happened until some point in the future and will still be happening. Hence, 'will have been working' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'will been working' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I have the hundred reasons to not attend the meeting tomorrow.
explanation:
I have the hundred reasons The reasons given in the sentence are not specific and we use indefinite article for a non-specific noun. Article 'a' will be used as the word 'hundred' begins with a consonant sound. Hence, 'I have a hundred reasons' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I have the hundred reasons' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: After I retire, I started a second career / as a writer and published several books / which allowed me to share my stories / and insights with a wider audience.
options: and insights with a wider audience
After I retire, I started a second career
as a writer and published several books
which allowed me to share my stories
explanation:
After I retire, I started a second career If two actions took place in the past then the 1st action must be in the Past perfect tense(Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). However, the V 3 form of 'retire' is 'retired'. Hence, 'After I had retired (V 3 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'After I retire, I started a second career' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Although the team had trained diligently for months, they had still overwhelmed by the opponent's unexpected tactics.
explanation:
had still overwhelmed 'Had' must be replaced with 'were' as the given sentence is an example of a passive voice of simple past tense and 'Plural subject (they) + were + V 3 ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'were still overwhelmed(V 3 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'had still overwhelmed' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Due to the pandemic, / the prices of / medicines increased / every day since / last December.
explanation:
medicines increased We use present continuous tense with 'for/since' to show that something has been happening for a period of time. 'Plural subject (prices) + have been + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'medicines have been increasing' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'medicines increased' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: UNESCO works to / strengthen an intellectual / and moral solidarity / of human kind.
explanation:
strengthen an intellectual Indefinite article 'a/an' is not used for an abstract noun(solidarity). The definite article 'the' is used before a specific or particular noun. The given sentence is referring to a specific type of solidarity. Hence, 'strengthen the intellectual and moral solidarity' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'strengthen an intellectual' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Dr. Sinha has / brought about a new / book on social / impact of child labour.
explanation:
brought about a new 'Brought out' is the correct phrasal verb here, which means 'published'. The given sentence is talking about publishing a new book. Hence, 'brought out a new' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'brought about a new' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Select the sentence that contains a grammatical error from the options below:
options: It is said that Joseph was not ready to go to war.
Karl Marx was a renowned social scientist.
Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity.
It is impossible to wake Christine up in the morning.
explanation:
Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity. 'Forces' will be used instead of 'force' according to the plural verb 'are' and the plural adjective 'their'. Hence, the correct sentence is: "Indian forces are known for their loyalty and integrity.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Indian force are known for their loyalty and integrity.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Brr, the city view from the Eiffel Tower is amazing!
explanation:
Brr An interjection is a word or phrase used to express a sudden feeling. 'Brr' is used to express the sensation of cold. 'Wow' is used to express a sudden feeling of amazement. Hence, 'Wow' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Brr' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Having known that / the train was already on the platform, / they ran fastly / to catch it.
options: the train was already on the platform
explanation:
they ran fastly 'Fast' is already an adverb. The word 'fastly' does not exist. Hence, 'they ran fast' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'they ran fastly' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Deepa and Seema are both good with running, but Deepa is also good at catching the ball and throwing it to the right corner in time.
explanation:
good with running Preposition 'at' is used to show that someone is good at doing something. 'Good + at + V ing ' is the correct structure. Hence, 'good at running' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CHSL 02/07/2024 (4th Shift)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'good with running' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: People admired him, for / he lived by the same principals / that he preached.
options: he lived by the same principals
explanation:
he lived by the same principals 'Principals' must be replaced with 'principles' as the given sentence talks about a kind of belief or idea that guides you. Hence, 'he lived by the same principles' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'he lived by the same principals' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: We were on the way / to the party; / suddenly, there / will a heavy downpour.
explanation:
will a heavy downpour. The given sentence is in the past tense, not in the future tense, so it must have the verb in the past form 'was',. Hence, 'was a heavy downpour' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'will a heavy downpour.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He never talks / for any body / He is alone / all day.
explanation:
for anybody 'To' is used to denote the person to whom someone is talking. Hence, 'to anybody' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'for anybody' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The police told the agitators to back in, else they would lathi-charge.
explanation:
the agitators to back in 'Back out' is the correct phrasal verb to use here. 'Back out' means to withdraw or decide not to do something that was planned to do. Hence, 'the agitators to back out' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the agitators to back in' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: We took dinner in a Chinese restaurant and were amazed to see the interior of a restaurant.
explanation:
the interior of a restaurant Article 'the' is used when we refer to the same noun again because it becomes specific. Hence, 'the interior of the restaurant' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the interior of a restaurant' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Mr. Ali's shop / is further to / the hospital.
explanation:
is further to 'Farther than' will be used instead of 'further to'. 'Further' is used for metaphorical distance where 'farther' is used for physical distance. The given sentence is talking about the physical distance between Mr. Ali's shop and the hospital. Hence, 'farther than' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is further to' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She sings good.
explanation:
well The given sentence needs an adverb(well) to modify the verb (sings) and not an adjective(good). Hence, 'Rahul sings well' is the most appropriate answer. Corrected Sentence: She sings well

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'well' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: In some countries, you are not able to drink until you are 21
explanation:
able to drink The correct word to use here is 'allowed' instead of 'able'. The given sentence states that you are not allowed to drink until you are 21. Hence, 'allowed to drink' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'able to drink' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Two of the world's / best forwards / has played along side / David Beckham.
explanation:
has played alongside According to the "Subject-Verb Agreement Rule", a plural subject always takes a plural verb. In the given sentence, 'Two of the world's best forwards' is a plural subject that will take 'have' as a plural verb. Hence, 'have played alongside' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'has played alongside' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Ourselves should not boast of one's knowledge.
explanation:
Ourselves 'Ourselves' must be replaced with 'We' as we use a subjective case pronoun (I/we/you) as the subject of a sentence. Hence, 'We' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Hurray! Here is the toy / what I was looking for / as my birthday gift.
explanation:
what I was looking for 'What' must be replaced with 'that' as when we introduce a relative clause that provides more information about a noun, we typically use "that" or "which" instead of "what". Hence, 'that i was looking for' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The politician was accused / of accepting bribes / and lied about it / to the public.
explanation:
and lied about it According to the 'Rule of Parallelism', two or more verbs must be in the same form if they are connected with one another. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'and' connects two verbs 'accepting(V ing )' and 'lied'. Therefore, 'lying(V ing )' must be used in place of 'lied'. Hence, 'and lying about it' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'and lied about it' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Her family lost their way on Daman.
explanation:
in The preposition 'on' must be replaced with 'in' as 'In' is used to indicate location or position within a place or area. Similarly, in the sentence, 'Daman' is a location and we need to use the preposition 'in' before it. Hence, 'in' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'in' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I am sure that / the postman would be / coming shortly / to deliver the letter.
explanation:
the postman would be 'Would be' must be replaced with 'will be'. Modal 'would' is used to talk about the future as seen from the past. Modal 'will' is used to talk about the future as seen from the present moment. As the first part of the sentence is in Present Tense, modal 'will' will be used. Hence, 'the postman will be' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the postman would be' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Maruti likes / adventure / stories, especially / an adventures of Tarzan.
explanation:
an adventures of Tarzan 'An' must be replaced with 'the. The word "adventures" is plural, so it should not be preceded by the singular article "an". We generally use the definite article with a specific noun or a particular noun (adventures of Tarzan). Hence, 'the adventures of Tarzan' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'an adventures of Tarzan' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She is in / an hurry / to meet / her brother.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'He was always been' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Notwithstanding we were / all busy that weekend / we had to / cancel the outing.
explanation:
Notwithstanding we were "Notwithstanding" means "despite or in spite of something" . It is used to indicate an aspect of contrast. So, 'Notwithstanding' will be replaced by 'as' to make the sentence grammatically correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Notwithstanding we were' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Every participant gave so outstanding performance that it became difficult to choose the winner.
explanation:
so outstanding performance Such is used for emphasizing the degree of something. The given sentence tells about a performance of outstanding degree. Hence, 'so outstanding performance' will be replaced by 'such an outstanding performance' to grammatically correct the given sentence.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'so outstanding performance' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The need today is for both sides / to intro spec t and re-examine the issue carefully / and resolve it amicably.
options: to intro spec t and re-examine the issue carefully
The need today is for both sides
explanation:
📘 **Grammar Rule**: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: इस वाक्य में व्याकरण का कोई दोष नहीं है। सभी संज्ञा, क्रिया और सहायक शब्द नियमानुसार सही प्रयुक्त हैं (No error / No improvement required)।

questionText: Only five minutes / are allowed / for each speaker / during the function.
explanation:
are allowed The compound nouns (numerical + noun) are not used as the plural if a noun does the work as an adjective. Here replace 'are' with 'is' to make the sentence grammatically correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'are allowed' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: You need to sign / these important documents / by ink.
explanation:
by ink There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'by' must be replaced with 'in' because we generally write 'in ink' for example fill the form in blue ink, sign the cheque in ink, etc. Similarly, in the given sentence, the documents need to be signed in ink. Hence, 'in ink' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'by ink' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She speaks / very highly / of both her / daughter-in-laws.
explanation:
daughter-in-laws We can never write '-in-laws' because adding 's' in the suffix(in-law) is wrong. However, we write daughter-in-law for a single female and daughters-in-law for more than two females. Similarly, the given sentence talks about two daughters-in-law. Hence, 'daughters-in-law' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'daughter-in-laws' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: His loyalty / and honesty / are above / suspect.
explanation:
suspect The phrase ' above suspicion ' is used to describe someone who would never be suspected of doing anything wrong. Similarly, the given sentence states that his honesty and loyalty are above suspicion. Hence, 'suspicion' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'suspect' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Parul is / ten years / elder than / her sibling.
explanation:
elder than The comparative degree 'elder' will not be used with 'than' because it will become a case of superfluous ness(not necessary). Hence, 'than' will be replaced with 'to' and 'elder to' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'elder than' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He is / afraid from / all insects / that crawl.
explanation:
afraid from Afraid generally takes the preposition 'of' and not 'from'. Hence, 'afraid of' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'afraid from' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He wanted to know / the reason / why his low score / in Mathematics.
explanation:
why his low score If an Interrogative sentenc e(in which a question is asked) is written in the Indirect form(speech), then " Wh-word(why, when, where ) + Subject + Verb " is grammatically the correct structure for it. Hence, 'why his(subject) score was(verb) low' is the most appropriate structure.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'why his low score' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: This is / only mistake / he has made / in the dictation.
explanation:
only mistake The article 'the' is used to refer to specific or particular nouns '& articles 'a/an' are used to modify

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'only mistake' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I am hearing a strange noise now.
explanation:
I am hearing Stative verbs are those verbs which express a state of condition. They do not refer to a physical action. Sense and emotions like hear, smell, see, love, hate etc are different types of stative verbs. However, these verbs can't be used in (-ing form) for example, Hear, Smell(Correct) and Hearing, Smelling(Incorrect). Hence, 'I hear a strange noise' will be the answer. (d)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I am hearing' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: All of us were a little nervous when we came into this room today.
options: when we came into this room today
explanation:
📘 **Grammar Rule**: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: इस वाक्य में व्याकरण का कोई दोष नहीं है। सभी संज्ञा, क्रिया और सहायक शब्द नियमानुसार सही प्रयुक्त हैं (No error / No improvement required)।

questionText: Do you earn so much to make both ends meet?
explanation:
so much to The phrase 'so much' is used to mention a definite unknown quantity and 'much' is used with uncountable nouns. However, when we ask about someone's earning, we usually ask how much you earn and not how 'so much' you earn. Hence, 'Do you earn much' will be the correct sentence structure. (b)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'so much to' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: You cannot lead a healthy life although you stop smoking.
explanation:
although you It is a conditional sentence which has two conditions and starts with a negative sense(cannot). It says one cannot lead a healthy life, one does not quit smoking. Unless is a negative conditional conjunction which means 'Ifnot' and it is used to combine these two conditions. Hence, Unless will replace although. (b)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'although you' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I had to hold on to the wall to steady itself or I could have fallen.
explanation:
to steady itself According to the context of the sentence, the reflexive pronoun 'myself' will replace 'itself' because the subject(noun)/the narrator is a human being and for living things we use 'myself'. Hence, 'to steady myself' will be the correct sentence structure. (b)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'to steady itself' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The jury are from different parts of the country.
explanation:
are from Jury/Team/Committee are considered as a singular subject and will take a singular verb, until they are divided in their opinion/views. For example, the Jury(Singular subject) has given its decision(United), the committee(Plural subject) are divided in their opinion(Divided). Similarly in the given question, 'the jury is(singular verb) from different parts of the country' is the most appropriate structure. (b)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'are from' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She picked up the books lie on the table and put them on the shelf.
explanation:
lie on the table Lying is a non-finite verb which is acting as an adjective for the books in the given sentence. Hence, 'Books lying on the table' will be the correct sentence structure. (a)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'lie on the table' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He is over eighty and dare not read without glasses.
explanation:
dare not read Dare means to challenge someone for something. According to the context of the sentence, we have to show the inability of the person to see and for ability/inability, we will use 'can' and not dare. Hence, 'cannot read' will be the correct sentence structure. (d)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'dare not read' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual decision in unprejudiced way.
options: I have known her for many years. This time, she took an
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)
I have known her for many years. This time, she took a
I have known her for many years. This time, she took unusual
explanation:
I have known her for many years. This time, she took an unusual decision in an unprejudiced way. Article 'an' is used before words starting with a vowel sound (an apple, an umbrella, an American). Similarly, in the given sentence, the words 'unusual' and 'unprejudiced' start with a vowel sound. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'I have known her for many years. This time, she took an (alt)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: My mom made her muffins, but she didn't eat none.
explanation:
she didn't eat any 'None' is not used in a negative sentence. 'None' must be replaced with 'any' as we use 'any' in a negative sentence. Hence, "she didn't eat any" is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'she didn't eat any' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: A tide pool is a isolated pocket of water that is formed when
A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when
Tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea
The tide pool is isolated pocket of water that is formed when
explanation:
A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when sea water becomes trapped as the tide goes out. Indefinite article 'a/an' is used when we talk about a noun in general. Similarly, the given sentence talks about 'tide pool' and 'isolated pocket' in a general sense. We will use article 'a' before 'tide' (consonant sound) and article 'an' before 'isolated'(vowel sound). Article 'the' will be used before the 2 nd 'tide'. Hence, the sentence given in option(b) is correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'A tide pool is an isolated pocket of water that is formed when' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He behaves if he were a king.
explanation:
behaves as if 'As if' is used to talk about a situation that may not be true but that is possible. Similarly, in the given sentence, the person may not be a king but he behaves like a king. Hence, 'behaves as if' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'behaves as if' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: What do you like to do on your free days other than to watching movies?
explanation:
watching movies We use a noun, pronoun or a gerund(V ing ) after the phrase 'other than'. Therefore, 'to' will be removed. Hence, 'watching(V ing ) movies' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'watching movies' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: He would be meets us next week.
He would not be met us next week.
He will be meet us next week.
He will be meeting us next week.
explanation:
He will be meeting us next week. The given sentence is in the future continuous tense and follows the structure, "Third person pronoun + will + be + V ing ". Hence, the sentence given in option(d) is correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'He will be meeting us next week.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: While I was waiting for Asha for shopping, I spilled lemonade on my new trousers
explanation:
to shop Infinitive(to + V 1 ) is used after the verb 'wait'. Therefore, 'for shopping' must be replaced with 'to shop(V 1 )'. Hence, 'to shop' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'to shop' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Whether she wishes to relocate to Mumbai or continues to live here are her personal decisions.
explanation:
is her personal decision 'Whether '… or' is a pair of conjunctions. According to the "Rule of Proximity", the verb is supplied according to the subject closest to the verb. In the given sentence, the close subject is a verb phrase 'continues to live', which denotes a single action. Therefore, singular verb 'is' will be used. Hence, 'is her personal decision' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is her personal decision' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He gave his heart and soul to make the entire show a success.
explanation:
Heart and soul- entire energy and effort.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'entire energy and effort' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I look forward (see) you soon.
explanation:
to seeing There are some phrases that are always followed by a gerund(V ing ). Such phrases are 'with a view to, looking forward to, in addition to, accustomed to, habituated to, be used to, prone to, etc.' Hence, 'look forward to seeing' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CHSL 2024 Tier - 2

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'to seeing' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Harish is clever than wise.
explanation:
more clever than When we compare two qualities of the same person, the comparative degree is formed by adding 'more', not by adding '-er'. Hence, 'more clever than' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'more clever than' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The firefighters tried their best to extinguish the fire.
explanation:
Put out- to extinguish fire.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'put out' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Research in Social Sciences is plagued nowadays on gloomy definitions and measurements.
explanation:
nowadays by gloomy definitions 'By' is used in passive voice to indicate the doer or agent of the action. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'by' has been used to indicate the doer of the action 'plagued'. Hence, 'nowadays by gloomy definitions' is the most appropriate answer. SSC MTS 2024 Tier - 1

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'nowadays by gloomy definitions' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Raghav, who studies tourism at present, is planning to go abroad after his graduation.
explanation:
is studying Present continuous tense is used to indicate an action that is in progress in the present. 'Singular Subject + is + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure for it. Hence, 'is studying' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is studying' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Placing a huge magnet atop the temple pose to being the biggest hurdle for the masons.
explanation:
posed to be 'To + V 1 ', also known as infinitive, is the correct grammatical structure. The given sentence is in the past tense, therefore, the past form(V 2 ) of the verb will be used. Hence, 'posed to be' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'posed to be' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: One of the most horrified serials of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago.
explanation:
most horrifying serials 'Horrifying' means causing a feeling of horror. The given sentence states that one of the most horrifying serials of the Indian television industry was broadcast twenty years ago. Hence, 'most horrifying serials' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'most horrifying serials' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Monika said to her mother that, 'I have passed the examination.
options: Monika said to her mother that, "I am passed
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed
Monika said to her mother that, "she has passed
explanation:
Monika said to her mother, "I have passed If the reported speech is given in inverted commas(" " ), it is called direct speech. However, in the direct speech, we do not use any conjunctions ('that', 'if', 'whether') after the reporting verb (say). Therefore, 'that' will be removed from the given sentence. Hence, option(b) is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Monika said to her mother, "I have passed' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: If she had gone to the party, she could have met Amit.
explanation:
No substitution required. The given sentence is grammatically correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'No substitution required' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Heba dropped of the club unexpectedly to say hello and catch up.
explanation:
dropped by the club unexpectedly The phrasal verb 'drop by' means to pay a brief casual visit. The given sentence states that Heba dropped by the club unexpectedly to say hello and catch up. Hence, 'dropped by the club unexpectedly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'dropped by the club unexpectedly' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Solving the riddle given by our teacher is farther beyond our capacity.
explanation:
far Positive degree 'far' will be used in this sentence as there is no comparison. Hence, 'far' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'far' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Rohit Sharma is better than more other batsman in the world.
options: as good as the most other batsmen
explanation:
better than most other batsmen 'More other' must be replaced with 'most other', indicating the majority of other batsmen. Plural noun is used with the adjective 'other'. The given sentence states that Rohit Sharma is better than the majority of other batsmen in the world. Hence, 'better than most other batsmen' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'better than most other batsmen' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: There have been numerous attempts made by the citizens to restore parity.
explanation:
No substitution The given sentence is grammatically correct.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'No substitution' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The given sentence has an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error. India is not on war with Pakistan.
explanation:
not at 'At war with' is the correct phrase, which means to be in a situation of war with an enemy nation. Hence, 'not at' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'not at' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The robbers stabbed him by a sharp knife and he started bleeding profusely on the spot.
explanation:
with a sharp knife 'With' is used when there is a physical contact between two things. When a person is stabbed with a knife, the knife enters a person's body, indicating a physical contact. Hence, 'with a sharp knife' is the most appropriate answer.

explanation:
apparent in endeavours to guarantee 'Endeavour' means an attempt to achieve a goal. 'Guarantee' means to ensure that something will happen. questionText: After the heavy rains last Thursday, the water in the river raised another three feet.

rose another three feet 'Raised' must be replaced with 'rose'. 'Raise' means to cause something to move upwards. 'Rose' means to go upwards or higher. 'Rose' is the past form of 'rise', indicating simple past tense. Hence, 'rose another three feet' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'rose another three feet' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Ramgopal is having a very big house in Mumbai.

has 'Have' is a stative verb denoting possession. Stative verbs are generally not used in the continuous tense. Rather, we use simple present tense to talk about the present state. questionText: I have never had and never will be dependent on him.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'never been' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Not a word didn't they speak to the others about the sad turn of events.

questionText: Before she began, she asked the teacher whether she write with a pen or a pencil.

questionText: The Sumo wrestler seemed to be incapable in being tired.

questionText: He is feeding a male dog and female dog

questionText: What flavour ice cream do you want?

flavour of ice cream 'Of' is used to show one thing related to another. Similarly, flavour is related to ice cream. Hence, 'flavour of ice cream' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The quality of students of an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point

questionText: The serenity of the river was a sight to behold. Sentence Improvement

pleasant to see The phrase 'a sight to behold' means a person is extremely pleased to see it. Hence, 'pleasant to see' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Inspite mother's milk is vital to a child's health, a number of FMCG companies wrongly advertise artificially prepared infant formulas as being the best for the child.

questionText: She asked me where my home town is and where I worked.

hometown was The given sentence is in the past tense, therefore, we will use the helping verb of past tense. 'Is' must be replaced with 'was'. Hence, 'hometown was' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Ice melts fastly in the sun.
explanation:
melts fast 'Fastly' is an incorrect word. 'Fast' is an adverb which modifies the verb 'melts'. Hence, 'melts fast' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: You have hurt so many people. Now, it is time to get a taste of your own medicine.

questionText: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what is expected out of me.

questionText: I have been yet to go to the flower exhibition at Delhi University.
explanation:
have yet The given sentence is in the active voice as the subject 'I' is the being considered the doer of the action. Therefore, 'been' will be removed from the sentence. 'Have to' is a semi-modal and takes the first form of the verb(go) after it. Hence, 'have yet' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'have yet' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: You all need to (get into) the books prescribed in your syllabus.
explanation:
go through 'Go through' is a phrasal verb which means to study something in detail. The given sentence states that you all need to go through the books prescribed in your syllabus. Hence, 'go through' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'go through' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She faced a session of abuse after insisting that she was too beautiful to be liked.
explanation:
tirade of abuse 'Tirade of abuse' is the correct phrase to use here. It means a long angry speech in which someone criticies a person. The given sentence states that she faced a tirade of abuse after insisting that she was too beautiful to be liked. Hence, 'tirade of abuse' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'tirade of abuse' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: This secret will remain between you and I.
explanation:
between you and me A preposition takes an objective case pronoun after it. 'Between' is a preposition that will take 'me' instead of 'I'. Hence, 'between you and me' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'between you and me' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The plot of the story effects the character and their growth.
explanation:
affects the character The given sentence needs a verb, not the noun 'effects' for the subject 'the plot of the story'. 'The plot of the story' is a singular subject that will take 'affects' as a singular verb. Hence, 'affects the character' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'affects the character' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The enigma of quantum mechanics remains inscrutably elusive despite of decades of intensive research by the world's leading physicists.
explanation:
despite decades of 'Despite' does not take 'of'. Therefore, 'of' will be removed. Hence, 'despite decades of' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'despite decades of' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The train left before I reached the station.
explanation:
had left before I reached If two actions took place in the past then the 1st action must be in the Past perfect tense (Had + V 3 ) and the 2nd action must be in the Simple Past tense(V 2 ). In the given sentence, 'train leaving' is the first action, so it will be written in past perfect tense. Hence, 'had left(V 3 ) before I reached(V 2 )' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'had left before I reached' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She met my cousin, whose she later married.
explanation:
whom she later married 'Whom' is a relative pronoun used for the object in a relative clause. In the underlined part, 'whom' has been used for the person she married. Hence, 'whom she later married' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CHSL 2023 Tier - 2

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'whom she later married' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I decided to call out to various bookstores in the area to see if any of them had the book I needed.

call around The phrasal verb 'call around' means to phone different people or places. The given sentence states that I decided to make phone calls to various bookstores in the area to see if any of them had the book I needed. Hence, 'call around' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'call around' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: This lesser known heritage building is so beautiful as the Red Fort.

This heritage building is as beautiful as the Red Fort.
This lesser known heritage building is very much beautiful as
This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as
explanation:
This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as the Red Fort. 'So'…as' is used with 'not' to show that two things are not equal. 'As'…as' or 'As much… as' is used to show that two things are equal in certain respects. According to option(d), the lesser known building and the Red fort are equally beautiful. 💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'This lesser known heritage building is as much beautiful as' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer. It was the home minister of the country who took the decision to change a laws pertaining to migration of people from one state to another.
explanation:
the laws pertaining Article 'a' must be replaced with 'the'. The 'laws' mentioned in the given sentence are specific and we generally use the definite article 'the' before any specific or particular noun. Hence, 'the laws pertaining' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the laws pertaining' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error. The film received critical acclaim for being a more innovative movie of the year.

questionText: I will definitely return your notes at Saturday .

return your notes by Preposition 'by' is used to indicate a deadline or a specific time before which the action will be completed. The given sentence states that the notes will be returned by evening. Hence, 'return your notes by' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: My sister resembles to my mother a lot in looks and in temperament.

resembles The verb 'resembles' does not take the preposition 'to' after it. Hence, 'resembles' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Effective communication is a skill that can significant enhance your personal and professional life.
explanation:
which can significantly enhance The given sentence needs an adverb(significantly) to modify the verb (enhance) and not an adjective (significant). Hence, 'which can significantly enhance' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: We have received no in form at i on so far to the main island.
explanation:
so far from 'From' is used with 'receive' to indicate the source destination or sender. In the given sentence, 'the main island' is the source destination from which no information has been received so far. Hence, 'so far from' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'so far from' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She is married with a rich business man and has enough money to splurge on luxuries.

is married to 'To' is used after the verb 'married' in the passive voice. Hence, 'is married to' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: Sherpas have prospered and come along the way from being just porters to becoming mountaineers.

come a long way The phrase 'come a long way' means to make significant progress or improvement. The given sentence states that Sherpas have prospered and made significant progress from being just porters to becoming mountaineers. Hence, 'come a long way' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'come a long way' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: You have a lot of coconut trees in your village, do you?
explanation:
don't you? According to the "Question Tag rule", if the statement is positive, the question tag will be negative & Vice-versa. However, the sentence and the question tag must be in the same tense. Similarly, the given sentence is positive so the question tag will be negative(don't). Hence, 'don't you?' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'don't you?' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: By next summer, I will have completed my internship and will have returned to school.
explanation:
returned to school If two or more verbs are of the same tense then the helping verb is written only once before the first verb. In the given sentence, 'will have' is a helping verb of future perfect tense and has been used for both verbs ('completed' and 'returned'). Hence, 'returned to school' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'returned to school.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Tomorrow, they will be take a flight to their dream vacation destination.
explanation:
will be taking a flight 'Will be / shall be + V ing ' is the correct grammatical structure of Future continuous tense. Hence, 'will be taking (V ing ) a flight' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'will be taking a flight' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: As bombs keep falling on Gaza, hundreds of thousands of children have been order to flee their homes.
explanation:
have been ordered to flee 'Subject + has/have + been + V 3 ' is the correct grammatical structure for passive voice of Present perfect tense. 'Ordered' is the correct third form of 'order'. Hence, 'have been ordered(V 3 ) to flee' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'have been ordered to flee' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The pollution level ought to keep under control.
explanation:
ought to be kept under Passive voice is used when the action is performed upon the subject, not by the subject. 'Ought to + be + V 3 ' is the correct passive form. Hence, 'ought to be kept(V 3 ) under' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'ought to be kept' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: This is the challenge task I have ever encountered.
explanation:
most challenging Definite article 'the' is used for a specific or particular thing and before a superlative degree adjective. 'Most challenging' is the correct superlative degree of 'challenging'. Hence, 'most challenging' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'most challenging' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Ashoka was not only a great warrior but also a very wiser ruler.
explanation:
wise 'Very' is a positive adverb and takes a positive degree adjective after it. Hence, 'wise' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'wise' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Cinema provides the most universal entertainment.
explanation:
a universal There are some adjectives that can not be written in comparative or superlative degree. These adjectives are called absolute or non-gradable adjectives. Some examples are universal, absolute, complete, perfect, empty, full, etc. Hence, 'a universal' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'a universal' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He is taller and most hand some than his friend.
explanation:
more If two or more adjectives are joined with a conjunction, these adjectives are written in the same degree. questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

explanation:
We generally use the indefinite article 'a' before the words starting with a consonant sound and article 'an' before words starting with a vowel sound. Similarly, in the given sentence, 'noun', 'person', 'hobby', 'job' are some words that are starting with a consonant sound & 'activity' is the only word that starts with a vowel sound. Hence, 'Amateur' is a noun which refers to a person who takes part in an activity as a hobby or for pleasure and not as a job' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'An amateur is a person who takes part in an activity for pleasure.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'significant role in enduring the trends' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: All his bones could be counted because his body was totally shrivelled and wrinkled with age.
explanation:
Wizened - shrivelled and wrinkled with age. 
• Shrunken - having become smaller or made smaller than before, and possibly less attractive 
• Dried - with all the liquid removed from it 
• Bony - so thin that you can see the shape of the bones

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'wizened' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: My sincerity and patience drove me through all odds and problems of life
explanation:
Drove me' means to motivate, compel, or impel one to do something. Whereas, 'carry me' means to escort or accompany someone to a particular place or location. Similarly, the given sentence states that sincerity and patience accompanied the narrator through all odds and problems of life. Hence, ' carried me ' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'carried me' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The teacher said, " The sun raises in the east every day".
options: the sun will rise in the east
the sun rises in the east
the sun rises at the east
explanation:
The word 'raise' means to elevate something to a higher level/position. However, the word 'rise' means to get up or go to a higher position from a lower position. Similarly, the given sentence states that the sun goes to a higher position from a lower position in the east every day. Hence, 'the sun rises in the east' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the sun rises in the east' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I was carried by her rapturous song.
explanation:
Carried away' means to be so excited that one is no longer in control of one's behavior as one gets emotionally charged. The given sentence states that the narrator got excited by her rapturous song. Hence, 'carried away' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'carried away' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The Ukranian soldiers passed in for several weeks.
explanation:
Held out' means to continue in a situation that is dangerous or difficult. Similarly, the given sentence states that the Ukrainian soldiers continued to be in a difficult situation for several weeks. Hence, 'held out' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'held out' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I told Pooja that she could have use my car to get around while she is in my home town
options: that she could have use my car to get around with
that she can use my car to get around
that she could have use my car to get away
that she can use my car to get away with
explanation:
Either the structure 'have + used(V 3 )' is correct for the given sentence or the modal verb 'can' & the verb 'use' must be in the same present tense. Hence, 'that she can use my car to get around' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'that she can use my car to get around' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Life is hard, unpredictable, but though manageable.
explanation:
There is an adverb error in the given sentence. The adverb 'though' must be replaced with 'still'. Hence, 'still controllable' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'still controllable' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Nowadays, many doctors advise to live in the country side.
options: to have live in the countryside
explanation:
The given sentence needs a gerund(V-ing) and not an infinitive(preposition 'to' + V 1 ). Hence, 'living(V-ing) in the countryside' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'living in the countryside' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: It is a bad habit to talk in while someone is speaking.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'cut in' means to interrupt someone while they are speaking. The given sentence states that it is a bad habit to cut in while someone is speaking. Hence, 'cut in' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'cut in' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: It was apparent that the girl was heading into a serious disaster.
explanation:
There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'into' must be replaced with 'for'. Hence, 'heading for' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'heading for' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: One must care as for family members as possible.
explanation:
The phrase 'as much as possible' means to a feasible extent. The given sentence states that one must care for family members to a feasible extent. Hence, 'as much for family members as possible' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'as much for family members' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The delegates talked of the matter for an hour but without any result.
explanation:
talked over There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'of' must be replaced with 'over' because 'talk over' is the correct phrase that means to discuss something thoroughly. Hence, 'over' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'talked over' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Reena got embarrassed and started crying.
explanation:
The verbs 'em barras ed' & 'crying' must be replaced with 'humiliated' & 'weeping' because they are grammatically more suitable in the context of the sentence. Hence, 'humiliated and started weeping' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'humiliated and started weeping' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Some politicians turn up their face at the hard life of downtrodden people.
explanation:
Turn up one's nose' is an idiom that means to refuse to take or accept something because it is not good enough. The given sentence states that some politicians refuse to take or accept the hard life of downtrodden people. Hence, 'turn up their nose' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'turn up their nose' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He was bereft of hope after the tragedy struck.
explanation:
Devoid - not having a particular quality 
• Filled - to make something full or to become full 
• Bereft - completely lacking something 
• Roused - to make somebody wake up

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Devoid' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The organization had set up for a Free Mandela Committee and launched a lively campaign with the slogan 'Free Mandela'.
explanation:
Set up is a phrasal verb. It means to build something or put something somewhere. So the word 'for' is incorrect. The sentence is in past tense so had will be used. Hence option 'a' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: The minor project put forward by the government is now moving around into its third year.
explanation:
The word around and into has been used together incorrectly. Remove the word around. The correct sentence will be- The minor project put forward by the government is now moving into its third year. So (a) is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is now moving into' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I cannot sit up with this sort of insult in office.
explanation:
Put up with - It is a phrasal verb which means to bear or tolerate something.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'put up with' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Don't provoke Harsha, otherwise, she will give you a slap.
explanation:
Provoke means to stimulate or arouse some feelings esp anger. Exasperate means to irritate and frustrate (someone) intensely. So option b is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Do not exasperate Harsha' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Upon hearing the great achievements of the historic character, he was in a state of awed admiration and respect.
explanation:
A state of awed admiration and respect - wonderment

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'wonderment' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: After wearing the complete sports gear, he looked lean, tough, and sinewy.
explanation:
lean, tough, and sinewy - wiry Sinewy is used (of a person or animal) lean and muscular.

questionText: Though Mr. Swami ran in debt, he did not stop wasting money.
explanation:
To 'ran into' means to experience a difficult situation or a problem. In the given question Mr Swami ran into a debt

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'ran into' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Shanti heard the children who were shouting outside.

who were flaying in the open air
explanation:
Outdoors means outside a building or shelter. So option a will be the most appropriate answer. SSC CGL 2021 Tier - 1

questionText: The student apologised the teacher for the delay in submitting the assignment.
options: is a polo gi sing the teacher
explanation:
The preposition 'to' is missing in the given sentence. Hence, 'apologised to the teacher' is the most appropriate answer.

questionText: I have been wondering at taking skating as a hobby
explanation:
There is a prepositional error in the given sentence. The preposition 'at' must be replaced with 'about' as we generally use the preposition 'about' with 'wonder'. Hence, 'about taking up' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'about taking up' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: He's not so friendly like she is
explanation:
As' is used for comparing people or things '& 'like' is used for giving examples. However, in the given sentence, two persons are being compared on the basis of friendliness. Hence, 'so friendly as' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'so friendly as' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: We might as well watch a film on TV as there's nothing much to do.
explanation:
📘 **Grammar Rule**: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

questionText: I imagine you have learnt a valuable lesson from this experience, didn't you?
explanation:
According to the " Question Tag rule ", if the statement is positive, the question tag will be negative but in the contracted form('t) & Vice-versa. However, the sentence and the question tag must be in the same tense. Similarly, the given sentence is positive so the question tag will be negative(haven't). Hence, 'haven't you?' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'haven't you?' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: My father was always ordering about my sister.
explanation:
The position of the preposition 'about' is incorrect in the given sentence it must be placed after the noun 'sister'. Hence, 'ordering my sister about' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'ordering my sister about' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: None of the boys was willing to admit that he was in the wrong.
explanation:
No substitution required. The sentence is grammatically correct.

questionText: You are welcome to partake this light refreshment.
explanation:
The phrase 'partake of' means to experience something along with others or to have a portion. The given sentence states that you are welcome to have a portion of this light refreshment. Hence, 'to partake of' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'to partake of' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: In s p ite of my niece's dog Casper is very mischievous, he is lovable.
explanation:
The phrase 'In spite of' will be replaced with 'although' which means 'and yet'. However, the given sentence states that the narrator's niece's dog Casper is very mischievous, and yet he is lovable. Hence, 'Although my niece's' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Although my niece's' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: They each listened carefully to what each other said.
explanation:
We will remove 'each' to grammatically correct the given sentence. Hence, 'the other' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'the other' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The dress may pleasantly be delivered to us at the earliest.
explanation:
We will replace 'pleasantly' with 'kindly' to grammatically correct the given sentence. Hence, 'may kindly' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'may kindly' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Since settin g u p, the charity has raised a million dollars.
explanation:
The initial part of the given sentence is incomplete as it requires a gerund(being). Hence, 'since being set up' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Since being set up' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I can't make ou t my mind about taking a vacation in winter.
explanation:
Make up one's mind' is a phrase that means to make a decision. Similarly in the given sentence, the narrator is unable to decide about taking a vacation. Hence, 'make up' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'make up' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: There are a bit nice shops in the town centre.
explanation:
We cannot use the article 'a' before shops(plural) '& we cannot write 'more' with a comparative degree 'nicer'. Hence, 'far nicer' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'far nicer' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Would you have been so kind as to close the window?
explanation:
We generally use the modal verb 'would' when we want to politely request someone for something. Similarly in the given sentence, someone is asking politely to close the window. Hence, 'Would you be' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Would you be' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Often it makes one wonder at the sights you see.
explanation:
One' means any person, but not any particular person. However, when we use 'one' in a sentence we always use 'one' as a pronoun not pronouns like you, him, he, etc. Moreover, 'one' is a singular subject so it will take 'sees' as a singular verb. Hence, 'one sees' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'one sees' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: It is quite difficult to make on what this doctor writes.
explanation:
Make out' is a phrasal verb which means to see, hear or understand something with difficulty. The given sentence states that it is difficult to understand what this doctor writes. Hence, 'make out' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'make out' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Whom was the p erson that you wanted me to contact there?
explanation:
If the relative pronoun is followed by a 'verb', then the relative pronoun must be 'Who' and if it is followed by a 'noun or pronoun', then the relative pronoun must be 'Whom'. Similarly, in the given sentence, the relative pronoun is followed by a 'verb(was)'. Hence, 'Who is the person' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Who is the person' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: I don't fancy to g o out t his .
explanation:
The sentence will have a bare infinitive(without the preposition 'to'). Hence, 'going out' is the most appropriate answer. SSC CGL 2020 Tier - 2

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'going out' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Do I need finish this work today itself?
explanation:
Need I " Modal + Subject + V 1 ( first form of the verb )" is the correct grammatical structure for the given interrogative sentence. Hence, 'Need(modal) I(subject)' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Need I' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The show flopped miserably to the utter disappointment of every body.
explanation:
📘 **Grammar Rule**: The given sentence is grammatically sound with correct subject-verb agreement, appropriate tense, and proper modifier placement.

questionText: The news about the surge in Covid-19 cases is broadcasted every .
explanation:
is broadcast We can't make the past form of some verbs(forecast, cost, broadcast, etc) by simply adding 'ed' to them. It means the past form of these verbs remains the same as the present form like the past form of 'broadcast' is 'broadcast' and not broadcasted. However, we always use a singular verb after an uncountable noun(news). Hence, 'is broadcast' is the most appropriate answer.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'is broadcast' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

Tedious is boring and tiresome. Exciting means causing great enthusiasm and eagerness. So option 'd' exciting is the most appropriate answer. Slack means loose. Abstract means existing in thought only as an idea. Gallant is brave. (d)

questionText: SIEGE
explanation:

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelt word.

explanation:

questionText: Which of the following words is spelt CORRECTLY?
explanation:

उदा. 'Embarrass' में दो बार 'r' और दो बार 's' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Identify the CORRECTLY spelt word.
explanation:
