questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure the promotion as his rival was too _____ for him.
explanation:
Use 'strong' to indicate physical or professional competence/rivalry in a competitive context.
उदा. प्रतियोगिता के संदर्भ में प्रतिद्वंद्वी की क्षमता या ताकत दिखाने के लिए 'strong' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to _____ awareness about the importance of hygiene.
explanation:
'Spread awareness' is the standard collocating phrase used for conveying information or awareness to the public.
उदा. जन जागरूकता फैलाने के लिए मानक संयोजन 'spread awareness' है।

questionText: She has been suffering from fever _____ three days.
explanation:
'For' is used with a period of time (three days), which denotes duration in the present perfect continuous tense.
उदा. अवधि (duration) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, जैसे 'three days'।

questionText: The manager asked the employee to _____ the report before submitting it to the direct or.
explanation:
'Go through' means to read or examine something thoroughly.
उदा. 'Go through' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को विस्तार से पढ़ना या जांचना होता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house _____ it began to rain heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly... when' is used to show an action happening immediately after another.
उदा. 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The prisoner made an unsuccessful attempt to _____ from the custody of the police.
explanation:
'Escape' is the standard term used when someone gets free from confinement or custody.
उदा. हिरासत या कैद से भागने के लिए 'escape' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: If I _____ the king of my country, I would eradicate poverty completely.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an unreal present wish, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. काल्पनिक या असंभव शर्त (subjunctive mood) को दर्शाने के लिए सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: His novel is remarkable _____ its vivid description of rural life.
explanation:
The adjective 'remarkable' is followed by the preposition 'for' to state the reason or cause.
उदा. किसी खूबी या कारण को दर्शाने के लिए 'remarkable' के साथ 'for' प्रीपोज़िशन का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee will _____ the matter thoroughly before taking any disciplinary action.
explanation:
'Look into' means to investigate or examine a matter.
उदा. 'Look into' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ जांच-पड़ताल करना होता है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates _____ qualified for the post.
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun but takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा/सर्वनाम आती है लेकिन क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है।

questionText: She has been waiting for you ________ morning.
explanation:
Use 'since' for a point of time (like morning, Monday, 2010) in a present/past perfect continuous tense.
उदा. निश्चित समय (Point of time) जैसे morning, 2010 आदि के लिए 'since' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The teacher advised the students to refrain ________ making noise in the library.
explanation:
The verb 'refrain' is always followed by the preposition 'from'.
उदा. 'Refrain' शब्द के बाद हमेशा निश्चित प्रीपोजिशन 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house ________ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by the conjunction 'when' (or 'before').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है (No sooner के साथ 'than' आता है)।

questionText: Neither the manager nor his subordinates ________ present at the meeting yesterday.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. 'Subordinates' is plural, hence 'were' is correct.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब अपने सबसे नज़दीकी सब्जेक्ट (subordinates - बहुवचन) के अनुसार आएगी।

questionText: He is proficient ________ mathematics and solves complex problems easily.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is followed by the preposition 'in' when denoting skill in a subject.
उदा. किसी विषय में निपुणता दिखाने के लिए 'proficient' के साथ प्रीपोजिशन 'in' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: If I ________ the Prime Minister of India, I would eradicate corruption.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical state, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. काल्पनिक इच्छा (Hypothetical sentence) को व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The police ________ investigating the cybercrime case for the last two weeks.
explanation:
'Police' is treated as a plural noun in English grammar and takes a plural verb.
उदा. 'Police' एक बहुवचन संज्ञा (Plural Noun) है, इसलिए इसके साथ हमेशा बहुवचन वर्ब ('are') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The criminal confessed ________ the crime before the magistrate.
explanation:
The verb 'confess' takes the preposition 'to' when admitting a fault or crime.
उदा. अपराध स्वीकार करने के संदर्भ में 'confess' के बाद प्रीपोजिशन 'to' आता है।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not secure ________ marks to pass the exam.
explanation:
'Enough' is used to express the required quantity or sufficiency before plural countable or uncountable nouns.
उदा. पर्याप्त मात्रा दर्शाने के लिए 'enough' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो marks के साथ फिट बैठता है।

questionText: She spoke in such a low voice that she was ________ audible.
explanation:
'Hardly audible' means almost not audible. The context requires a negative adverb meaning almost not.
उदा. 'Hardly audible' का अर्थ है जो शायद ही सुनाई दे सके। संदर्भ के अनुसार 'hardly' सही बैठता है।

questionText: Select the option that spells the word CORRECTLY.
explanation:

उदा. 'Lieutenant' सही वर्तनी है, इसका उच्चारण 'लेफ्टिनेंट' जैसा होता है लेकिन स्पेलिंग में 'ieu' आता है।

explanation:

explanation:

explanation:

questionText: Which of the following words is correctly spelled?

questionText: A person who is in different to pleasure or pain
explanation:
A stoic is someone who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति सुख या दुख से प्रभावित न हो और हर परिस्थिति में शांत रहे, उसे 'Stoic' (उदासीन या वीतराग) कहते हैं।

questionText: A government by the wealthy
explanation:
Plutocracy is a society or a government ruled by the wealthy.
उदा. जब सरकार धनवान लोगों या अमीरों द्वारा चलाई जाती है, तो उसे 'Plutocracy' (धनिक तंत्र) कहा जाता है।

questionText: An official pardon for people who have been convicted of political offenses
explanation:
Amnesty is an official pardon granted to a group of prisoners, especially political offenders.
उदा. राजनीतिक अपराधियों या कैदियों को सरकार द्वारा दी जाने वाली सामूहिक माफी को 'Amnesty' (राजक्षमा) कहते हैं।

questionText: A person who loves books
explanation:
A bibliophile is a lover and collector of books.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति पुस्तकों से प्रेम करता है और उन्हें एकत्र करता है, उसे 'Bibliophile' (पुस्तकालयाध्यक्ष या पुस्तक प्रेमी) कहते हैं।

questionText: To cut some thing into two pieces
explanation:
To sever means to divide by cutting or slicing, especially very suddenly and completely.
उदा. किसी चीज़ को काटकर या अलग करके दो टुकड़ों में विभाजित कर देना 'Sever' (काटना या अलग करना) कहलाता है।

questionText: One who walks in sleep
explanation:
A somnambulist is a person who sleepwalks.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति नींद में चलने की आदत रखता है, उसे 'Somnambulist' (नींद में चलने वाला) कहते हैं।

questionText: Incapable of being corrected
explanation:
Incorrigible describes a person or their behavior not able to be changed or reformed.
उदा. जिसे सुधारा न जा सके या जिसमें सुधार की कोई गुंजाइश न हो, उसे 'Incorrigible' (असंशोधनीय) कहते हैं।

questionText: A remedy for all diseases
explanation:
A panacea is a solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases.
उदा. सभी प्रकार की बीमारियों या समस्याओं की एक मात्र दवा या रामबाण उपाय को 'Panacea' (रामबाण) कहते हैं।

questionText: The life history of a person written by himself
explanation:
An autobiography is an account of a person's life written by that person.
उदा. जब कोई व्यक्ति अपने जीवन का वृत्तांत स्वयं लिखता है, तो उसे 'Autobiography' (आत्मकथा) कहते हैं।

questionText: A speech made without prior preparation
explanation:
Extempore refers to spoken or done without preparation.
उदा. बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिया गया भाषण या प्रस्तुति 'Extempore' (तत्काल या आशुभाषण) कहलाती है।
grammarRule: Latin phrase root: 'ex tempore' (out of time)

questionText: That which cannot be easily pleased
explanation:
Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail, hard to please.
उदा. जिसे आसानी से खुश न किया जा सके या जो बहुत नकचढ़ा हो, उसे 'Fastidious' कहते हैं।

questionText: A person who writes and edits dictionaries
explanation:
A person who compiles dictionaries.
उदा. शब्दकोश (dictionary) लिखने या संकलित करने वाले व्यक्ति को 'Lexicographer' (कोशकार) कहते हैं।

questionText: A handwriting that cannot be read easily
explanation:
Not clear enough to be read.
उदा. ऐसी लिखावट जिसे पढ़ा न जा सके, उसे 'Illegible' (अपाठ्य) कहते हैं।

questionText: A government by the rich
explanation:
Government by the wealthy class.
उदा. अमीर या धनवान लोगों द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली सरकार को 'Plutocracy' (धनिक तंत्र) कहते हैं।

questionText: A place where bees are kept
explanation:
A place where bees are kept; a collection of beehives.
उदा. वह स्थान जहाँ मधुमक्खियों को पाला जाता है, उसे 'Apiary' (मधुमक्खी शाला) कहते हैं।

questionText: Incapable of making mistakes or being wrong
explanation:
Incapable of failing or making mistakes.
उदा. जो कभी गलती न करे या अचूक हो, उसे 'Infallible' (अचूक) कहते हैं।

questionText: Find the correctly spelled word from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Achievement' following the 'i before e except after c' rule roughly.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Achievement' है।

questionText: Which of the following words is spelled correctly?
explanation:
'Receive' follows the 'i before e except after c' rule.
उदा. 'Receive' शब्द 'i before e except after c' नियम का पालन करता है।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word among the options.
explanation:
'Dermatology' is correct, derived from Greek root 'derma' (skin).
उदा. 'Dermatology' सही है, जो ग्रीक मूल 'derma' से बना है।

questionText: Find the correctly spelled word.
explanation:
'Psychology' begins with silent 'p' followed by 's'.
उदा. 'Psychology' की शुरुआत मूक 'p' और उसके बाद 's' से होती है।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelt word among the given options.
explanation:
'Occurence' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Occurrence' (double 'c' and double 'r'). All other words are correctly spelt.
उदा. 'Occurence' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Occurrence' है जिसमें double 'c' और double 'r' आते हैं।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Mischievous'. A common error is placing 'i' before 'e' incorrectly or adding an extra syllable like 'ievious'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Mischievous' है (शरारती)। इसमें 'ie' के बाद 'vous' आता है, 'vious' नहीं।

questionText: Find the word that is correctly spelt.
explanation:
'Accommodation' is correctly spelt with double 'c' and double 'm'.
उदा. 'Accommodation' सही वर्तनी है जिसमें दो 'c' और दो 'm' होते हैं (रहने की व्यवस्था)।

questionText: Identify the option that has the correct spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Renaissance' (meaning the revival of art and literature).
उदा. पुनर्जागरण के लिए सही अंग्रेजी शब्द 'Renaissance' है।

questionText: Which of the following words is spelt INCORRECTLY?
explanation:
'Seige' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Siege' following the 'I before E except after C' rule.
उदा. 'Seige' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Siege' है ('i' पहले आता है 'e' से)।
grammarRule: Rule: 'I before E except after C'

questionText: Select the correct spelling from the given choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling for an eating establishment is 'Restaurant'.
उदा. भोजन करने के स्थान को 'Restaurant' कहते हैं, जिसमें 'n' के बाद 't' आता है।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word among the options.
explanation:
'Achiement' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Achievement' (with 'e' after 'v'). All others use correct double letters.
उदा. 'Achiement' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Achievement' है जिसमें 'e' छूट गया था।
grammarRule: Common suffix addition (-ment) and spelling completeness

questionText: The government has launched a massive awareness campaign to _____ the spread of vector-borne diseases.
explanation:
Here, 'curb' means to restrain or control something undesirable. The context demands checking the spread of diseases.
उदा. यहाँ 'curb' का अर्थ किसी बुरी चीज़ को नियंत्रित करना या रोकना है। बीमारियों के फैलने को रोकने के लिए 'curb' सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द है।

questionText: She has been working on this research project _____ over a year now.
explanation:
We use 'for' with a period of time (like 'over a year') in present perfect continuous tense.
उदा. अवधि (period of time) जैसे 'over a year' के साथ 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह निश्चित समय (point of time) नहीं बल्कि समय की अवधि है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house _____ it started pouring heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: A committee has been set up to _____ into the causes of the recent railway accident.
explanation:
'Inquire into' is a phrasal verb meaning to formally investigate a matter. 'Investigate' does not take 'into' after it directly in this structure.
उदा. 'Inquire into' एक फ्रेजल वर्ब है जिसका अर्थ किसी मामले की जांच करना होता है। 'Investigate' के बाद सीधे 'into' का प्रयोग नहीं होता।

questionText: If the driver had applied the brakes on time, the collision _____ avoided.
explanation:
This is the third conditional sentence. Structure: If + Past Perfect (had applied), Subject + would/could/might + have + V3.
उदा. यह थर्ड कंडीशनल वाक्य है। बनावट: If + Past Perfect, Subject + could have + V3 का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The manager was highly impressed _____ her exceptional problem-solving skills.
explanation:
We use the fixed preposition 'impressed with' when someone is pleased or admires a person's traits or skills.
उदा. किसी की योग्यताओं या विशेषताओं से प्रभावित होने के लिए 'impressed with' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Despite his rigorous training, he could not _____ the world record in the 100-meter sprint.
explanation:
In sports and records, we use the verb 'break' (to break a record). 
उदा. खेलकूद और रिकॉर्ड्स के संदर्भ में हमेशा 'break a record' (रिकॉर्ड तोड़ना) वाक्यांश का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Neeta prefers reading books _____ watching television during her leisure hours.
explanation:
The verb 'prefer' takes the preposition 'to' when comparing two things, not 'than'.
उदा. 'Prefer' शब्द के साथ तुलना करने के लिए 'than' नहीं बल्कि स्थिर रूप से 'to' प्रीपोजिशन का प्रयोग होता है (prefer X to Y)।

questionText: The continuous noise from the nearby construction site was a major source of _____ for the residents.
explanation:
Construction noise causes irritation or annoyance. The context requires a negative noun.
उदा. निर्माण स्थल का शोर परेशानी या झुंझلاहट (annoyance) का कारण बनता है। वाक्य के संदर्भ के अनुसार नकारात्मक संज्ञा सही है।

questionText: Not only _____ the scholarship, but she also secured the top rank in the university.
explanation:
When a sentence begins with a negative expression like 'Not only', it takes inversion (Auxiliary verb + Subject + Main verb).
उदा. जब वाक्य की शुरुआत 'Not only' से होती है, तो उसमें इन्वर्जन (Inversion) नियम लगता है, यानी सहायक क्रिया (did) कर्ता (she) से पहले आती है।

questionText: The manager advised his team to keep their personal biases ______ when making crucial business decisions.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'keep aside' means to save something or to ignore/disregard something temporarily for a specific purpose.
उदा. Phrasal verb 'keep aside' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को अलग रखना या ध्यान में न लाना होता है।

questionText: She is proficient ______ classical dance and has won several awards at the national level.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is always followed by the preposition 'in' to indicate skill or expertise in a particular domain.
उदा. Adjective 'proficient' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'in' का प्रयोग होता है जिसका अर्थ किसी कार्य में कुशल होना है।

questionText: Hard ______ he worked, he could not clear the rigorous entrance examination.
explanation:
In inverted concessive clauses, 'Adjective/Adverb + as + subject + verb' is used to show contrast. Here, 'Hard as he worked' means 'Although he worked hard'.
उदा. Concession दर्शाने के लिए 'Adjective/Adverb + as + subject + verb' संरचना का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The historical monument was badly damaged ______ the continuous pollution in the city.
explanation:
'Due to' acts as an adjective phrase meaning 'caused by'. It correctly modifies the noun phrase 'damaged' in this context.
उदा. 'Due to' का प्रयोग कारण बताने के लिए किया जाता है जिसका अर्थ 'के कारण' होता है।

questionText: Neither the direct or nor the actors ______ present at the press conference yesterday.
explanation:
According to the rule of subject-verb agreement, when two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it (actors, which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर verb अपने सबसे नज़दीकी subject (actors जो कि plural है) के अनुसार आएगी।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to ______ awareness about water conservation.
explanation:
Collocation: We 'create awareness' or 'raise awareness'. Among the choices, 'create' best fits the collocation for awareness.
उदा. Collocation के नियम के अनुसार awareness के साथ 'create' या 'raise' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: By the time the rescue team arrived, the trapped miners ______ under ground for over forty-eight hours.
explanation:
In past tense narrative structures, when an action happened before another past action, the past perfect tense ('had been') is used with 'by the time'.
उदा. भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में से जो पहली हुई उसके लिए Past Perfect Tense ('had been') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The newly appointed CEO decided to ______ all the redundant policies to stream line company operations.
explanation:
'Abolish' means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. It is precisely used for rules and policies.
उदा. किसी नियम, कानून या नीति को आधिकारिक रूप से समाप्त करने के लिए 'abolish' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Scarcely had she stepped out of her house ______ it started pouring heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), unlike 'No sooner', which is followed by 'than'.
उदा. Correlative conjunction नियम के अनुसार 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: His speech was so ______ that many members in the audience were moved to tears.
explanation:
'Eloquent' means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing, which fits the context of a moving speech.
उदा. 'Eloquent' का अर्थ सुवक्ता या प्रभावशाली होता है जो दिल को छू लेने वाले भाषण के लिए उपयुक्त है।

questionText: Identify the word with the INCORRECT spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Necessary' with one 'c' and double 's'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Necessary' है जिसमें एक 'c' और दो 's' होते हैं।

questionText: Select the option that has the correct spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Recommend' with one 'c' and double 'm'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Recommend' है जिसमें एक 'c' और दो 'm' आते हैं।

questionText: Find the correctly spelt word among the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Tsunami' where 'T' is silent at the beginning.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Tsunami' है जिसमें शुरुआत में 'T' साइलेंट होता है।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance' (derived from 'maintain', not 'main-tanance').
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Maintenance' है, न कि 'Maintanance'।

questionText: Identify the word that is spelt correctly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Environment' which includes the silent 'n' before 'ment'.
उदा. सही spelling 'Environment' है, जिसमें 'n' अक्षर छूटना नहीं चाहिए।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Relevant' (ends with '-ant', not '-ent').
उदा. सही spelling 'Relevant' है, अंत में '-ant' होता है न कि '-ent'।

questionText: A person who is in different to pleasure or pain.
explanation:
A 'Stoic' is someone who can endure hardship without showing feelings or complaining.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति सुख और दुख दोनों में समान भाव रखता है और उदासीन रहता है, उसे 'Stoic' (वैराग्यी/तटस्थ) कहते हैं।
grammarRule: Root word / Greek origin regarding emotional endurance.

questionText: A government by the wealthy.
explanation:
'Plutocracy' is a society or a system of government ruled by the wealthy.
उदा. जब सरकार धनवान लोगों (अमीरों) द्वारा चलाई जाती है, तो उसे 'Plutocracy' (धनिकतंत्र) कहा जाता है।

questionText: Study of the origin and history of words.
explanation:
'Etymology' is the study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history.
उदा. शब्दों के मूल, उनके उद्गम और इतिहास के अध्ययन को 'Etymology' (शब्द-व्युत्पत्ति शास्त्र) कहते हैं।

questionText: A person who collects or trades in stamps.
explanation:
A 'Philatelist' is a person who studies or collects postage stamps.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति डाक टिकटों (postage stamps) का संग्रह या अध्ययन करता है, उसे 'Philatelist' (टिकट संग्रهक) कहा जाता है।

questionText: Incapable of being corrected or reformed.
explanation:
'Incorrigible' refers to a person or habit bad beyond correction or reform.
उदा. जिसे सुधारा न जा सके या जिसमें सुधार संभव न हो, उसे 'Incorrigible' (असंशोधनीय/जिसे सुधारा न जा सके) कहते हैं।

questionText: A list of books available in a library.
explanation:
A 'Catalogue' is a complete list of items, such as books in a library.
उदा. किसी पुस्तकालय में उपलब्ध पुस्तकों की व्यवस्थित सूची को 'Catalogue' (सूचीपत्र) कहा जाता है।
grammarRule: Standard vocabulary for systematic lists of items.

questionText: A person who loves books.
explanation:
A 'Bibliophile' is a person who collects or has a great love of books.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति पुस्तकों से बहुत प्रेम करता है और उन्हें एकत्र करता है, उसे 'Bibliophile' (पुस्तकाप्रेमी) कहते हैं।

questionText: An official pardon for people who have been convicted of political offenses.
explanation:
'Amnesty' is an official pardon granted by a government for political crimes.
उदा. राजनीतिक अपराधों के लिए दी जाने वाली सरकारी माफी या आमक्षमा को 'Amnesty' (राजक्षमा) कहा जाता है।

questionText: Animals that live in water.
explanation:
'Aquatic' describes plants and animals living or growing in or by water.
उदा. जो जीव या पौधे पानी में रहते हैं, उन्हें 'Aquatic' (जलीय) कहा जाता है।

questionText: A speech made without any previous preparation.
explanation:
'Extempore' means spoken or done without preparation.
उदा. बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिया गया भाषण या वक्तव्य 'Extempore' (आशुभाषण) कहलाता है।
grammarRule: Latin phrase root: 'ex tempore' (out of the time/moment).

questionText: An arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence
explanation:
Chronology refers to the arrangement of events in the order of their occurrence in time.
उदा. 'Chronology' का अर्थ है घटनाओं का कालक्रम या उनके होने के क्रम में व्यवस्थित करना।

questionText: A person who cannot be corrected
explanation:
Incorrigible means a person who is bad beyond reform or cannot be corrected.
उदा. 'Incorrigible' उस व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जिसे सुधारा न जा सके।

questionText: A speech made without preparation
explanation:
Extempore means spoken or done without preparation.
उदा. 'Extempore' उस भाषण या प्रस्तुति को कहते हैं जो बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिया जाए।
grammarRule: Latin origin phrase used as an adverb or adjective.

questionText: One who knows every thing
explanation:
Omniscient means knowing everything.
उदा. 'Omniscient' का अर्थ सर्वज्ञ यानी सब कुछ जानने वाला होता है।

questionText: A list of books available in a library
explanation:
A catalogue is a complete list of items, such as books in a library.
उदा. 'Catalogue' पुस्तकालय में उपलब्ध पुस्तकों की एक व्यवस्थित सूची होती है।

questionText: A government by a king or queen
explanation:
Monarchy is a form of government with a monarch (king or queen) at the head.
उदा. 'Monarchy' उस शासन प्रणाली को कहते हैं जिसमें राजा या रानी का शासन होता है।

questionText: Words inscribed on a tomb
explanation:
An epitaph is a phrase or form of words written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone.
उदा. 'Epitaph' कब्र या समाधि पर लिखे जाने वाले लेख को कहते हैं।

questionText: Stealing of ideas or writings of someone else and passing them off as one's own
explanation:
Plagiarism is the practice of taking someone else's work or ideas and passing them off as one's own.
उदा. 'Plagiarism' किसी अन्य लेखक के विचारों या लेखों की चोरी करके उन्हें अपने नाम से प्रस्तुत करना है।

questionText: Select the option that shows the correct spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Restaurant' (res-tau-rant).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Restaurant' है।

questionText: Identify the word that is incorrectly spelled.
explanation:
The word 'Guarentee' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Guarantee'.
उदा. 'Guarentee' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Guarantee' है जिसमें 'ee' आता है।

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Rendezvous' (French origin word meaning a meeting at an agreed time and place).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Rendezvous' है जो एक फ्रांसीसी मूल का शब्द है।

questionText: Find the misspelled word from the options.
explanation:
The word 'Priviledge' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Privilege' (no 'd').
उदा. 'Priviledge' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Privilege' है जिसमें 'd' नहीं होता।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word from the options.
explanation:
The word 'Occurence' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Occurrence' (double 'c' and double 'r').
उदा. 'Occurence' गलत है, सही spelling 'Occurrence' है जिसमें double 'c' और double 'r' आते हैं।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Rendezvous', a French word meaning a meeting at an agreed time and place.
उदा. 'Rendezvous' (मिलने का स्थान/नियत समय पर मिलना) एक फ्रांसीसी शब्द है जिसकी spelling में 'vous' अंत में आता है।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance'. It derives from the verb 'maintain' but changes to 'ten' in the middle.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Maintenance' है। यह 'maintain' से बनता है लेकिन बीच में 'ten' आता है।

questionText: Which of the following words is misspelled?
explanation:
The word ‘accommodate’ requires a double ‘m’ and a double ‘c’. The correct spelling is ac‑c‑o‑m‑m‑o‑d‑a‑t‑e.
उदाहरण: वह हमें कमरे में सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध कराता है।
grammarRule: Double consonants in verbs ending with -ate

questionText: Select the misspelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘definitely’ – it contains the letter ‘i’ after ‘f’: d‑e‑f‑i‑n‑i‑t‑e‑l‑y.
उदाहरण: मैं निश्चित रूप से वहाँ जाऊँगा।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘parliament’ – it ends with ‘l‑i‑a‑n‑t‑t‑i‑a‑n’. The misspelled form ‘parliment’ lacks the ‘a’ after ‘l’.
उदाहरण: संसद ने नया कानून पारित किया।

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure a job ___ the competitive market.
explanation:
We use the preposition 'in' when referring to enclosed spaces, larger areas, or markets.
उदा. बड़े क्षेत्रों, बाज़ारों या बंद स्थानों के लिए preposition 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked me if I ___ the report by the end of the day.
explanation:
In indirect speech, when the reporting verb is in the past tense ('asked'), the future tense changes to its past equivalent ('will' becomes 'could').
उदा. Indirect speech में यदि reporting verb past tense ('asked') में हो, तो future tense ('will') पाст equivalent ('could') में बदल जाता है।
grammarRule: Direct and Indirect Speech / Tense consistency

questionText: She is known for her ___ nature; she always shares her belongings with the needy.
explanation:
'Generous' means showing a readiness to give more of something than is strictly necessary or expected, especially money or time, which fits the context of sharing with the needy.
उदा. 'Generous' का अर्थ उदार होता है जो ज़रूरतमंदों के साथ बाँटने के संदर्भ में बिल्कुल सटीक बैठता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ___ present in the class room.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is used.
उदा. जब subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे नज़दीकी subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए plural verb 'were' आएगी।

questionText: Hardly had he stepped out of the house ___ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The committee ___ divided in their opinions regarding the new project.
explanation:
When a collective noun expresses division or individual members act separately, it takes a plural verb.
उदा. जब collective noun में मतभेद (division) दर्शाया जाए, तो plural verb ('were') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: He takes pride ___ his academic achievements.
explanation:
The fixed prepositional phrase is 'to take pride in' something.
उदा. निश्चित prepositional phrase 'to take pride in' होती है, जिसका अर्थ किसी बात पर गर्व करना है।

questionText: If I ___ the king of this country, I would eradicate poverty.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a hypothetical present wish, 'were' is used for all subjects.
उदा. काल्पनिक (hypothetical) वाक्यों में सभी subjects के साथ verb 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has taken strict measures to ___ the rising inflation.
explanation:
'Curb' means to restrain or control something undesirable like inflation. 'Curve' means a bend.
उदा. 'Curb' का अर्थ नियंत्रित करना होता है, जो महंगाई (inflation) को रोकने के संदर्भ में सही है।

questionText: The old man was accused ___ theft by his neighbor.
explanation:
The adjective/participle 'accused' is always followed by the preposition 'of'.
उदा. 'Accused' शब्द के साथ हमेशा fixed preposition 'of' का प्रयोग होता है ('accused of theft')।

questionText: The manager was highly impressed _____ the candidate's communication skills during the interview.
explanation:
We use the preposition 'impressed with' when referring to being pleased or struck by someone's abilities or qualities.
उदा. Adjective 'impressed' के बाद सामान्यतः preposition 'with' का प्रयोग किया जाता है जब किसी की योग्यताओं से प्रभावित होने की बात हो।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house _____ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly... when' is used to show that one action happened immediately after another.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा कंजंक्शन 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Despite working day and night, he could not _____ enough profit to sustain his family.
explanation:
We use 'earn' when talking about receiving money as a salary, wage, or profit for work done.
उदा. वेतन, मजदूरी या लाभ (profit) प्राप्त करने के लिए 'earn' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है, न कि 'gain' या 'win' का।

questionText: If the government _____ strict laws against corruption, the situation would have been different.
explanation:
In third conditional sentences expressing unfulfilled past conditions, the 'if' clause takes the past perfect tense (had + V3), and the main clause takes 'would have + V3'.
उदा. अवास्तविक भूतकाल की शर्त (Third Conditional) में 'if' खंड में past perfect (had + V3) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee members could not reach a consensus; therefore, they _____ their decision until next week.
explanation:
'Put off' is a phrasal verb meaning to postpone or delay an event or decision.
उदा. 'Put off' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ किसी कार्य या निर्णय को स्थगित करना (postpone करना) होता है।

questionText: She is gifted _____ a remarkable talent for painting and sketching.
explanation:
The passive form 'gifted with' is used to indicate that someone possesses a natural talent or quality.
उदा. प्राकृतिक प्रतिभा या गुण से संपन्न होने के लिए 'gifted with' वाक्यांश का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The scientist's novel theory was met with wide spread _____ from the academic community.
explanation:
In scientific contexts, a novel theory is often met with doubt or 'skepticism' before being validated.
उदा. वैज्ञानिक सिद्धांतों के संदर्भ में नए विचारों पर शुरुआत में संदेह (skepticism) व्यक्त किया जाता है।

questionText: Not only the principal but also the teachers _____ present at the annual function.
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closer to it (i.e., 'the teachers', which is plural).
उदा. 'Not only... but also' से जुड़ने वाले वाक्यों में verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject (यहाँ 'teachers' जो कि plural है) के अनुसार आती है।

questionText: His speech was so _____ that the audience remained glued to their seats for over an hour.
explanation:
'Riveting' means completely engrossing or compelling, which fits the context of keeping an audience engaged.
उदा. 'Riveting' का अर्थ अत्यधिक आकर्षक या मंत्रमुग्ध करने वाला होता है, जिससे श्रोता अपनी सीटों से बंधे रहते हैं।

questionText: The police launched an investigation to _____ the mystery behind the sudden disappearance of valuable artifacts.
explanation:
'Unravel' means to investigate and solve a complex or mysterious problem.
उदा. किसी जटिल रहस्य या गुत्थी को सुलझाने के लिए 'unravel' शब्द का सबसे उपयुक्त प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Select the word that is spelt CORRECTLY from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Achievement'. The rule 'i before e except after c' applies here (h-i-e-v). 
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Achievement' है। इसमें 'i' पहले और 'e' बाद में आता है (h के बाद i-e-v)।
grammarRule: i before e except after c rule

questionText: Find the INCORRECTLY spelt word among the following.
explanation:
'Enviroment' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'Environment' with a silent 'n' before 'ment'. 
उदा. 'Enviroment' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Environment' है जिसमें 'n' होता है।
grammarRule: Silent letters in middle of words

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Acknowledge' containing a silent 'w' and ending in '-ledge'. 
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Acknowledge' है जिसमें 'w' silent होता है और अंत में '-ledge' आता है।

questionText: Identify the word that is misspelled.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **Definitely**. The word contains 'def' + 'init' + 'ly'. 
उदाहरण: *He is definitely the best candidate.*
grammarRule: Spelling of 'definitely' with 'f' after 'de' and 'i' before 'c'

questionText: Which word is incorrectly spelled?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **Separate**. The word has 'par' not 'per'. 
उदाहरण: *Please separate the items into categories.*

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **Persuasion**. It ends with -ion, not -inn. 
उदाहरण: *The lawyer used strong persuasion to convince the jury.*

questionText: Which word is misspelled?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **Reception**. It has 'p' before 't' and ends with -ion. 
उदाहरण: *The reception was held in the main hall.*

questionText: Identify the word with the correct spelling among the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Mischievous'. Common error is placing 'i' before 'e' incorrectly or adding an extra 'i'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Mischievous' है। अक्सर लोग इसमें गलती से 'Mischeivous' लिख देते हैं।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word from the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Necessary' (one 'c', two 's'). 'Neccessary' has double 'c' which is incorrect.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Necessary' है (एक 'c' और दो 's')। 'Neccessary' वर्तनी अशुद्ध है।

questionText: Which of the following words is correctly spelt?
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Bureaucracy'. It starts with 'Bureau-' followed by '-cracy'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Bureaucracy' है। 'Beurocracy' में स्वर (vowels) का क्रम गलत है।

questionText: Find the word with the INCORRECT spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Effervescent' (with an 'e' after the 'v'). 'Effervscent' is missing the 'e'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Effervescent' है, जिसमें 'v' के बाद 'e' आता है।

questionText: Select the option that contains the correctly spelt word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Ubiquitous' meaning omnipresent. Other options have missing letters.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Ubiquitous' है जिसका अर्थ सर्वव्यापी होता है।

questionText: Choose the incorrectly spelt word among the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance' (derived from maintain). 'Maintinance' uses '-ainance' incorrectly.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Maintenance' है। 'Maintinance' गलत है क्योंकि इसमें 'ten' की जगह 'tin' लिखा गया है।

questionText: One who can use both hands equally well
explanation:
Ambidextrous describes someone able to use the right and left hands equally well.
उदा. Ambidextrous उस व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जो अपने दोनों हाथों का इस्तेमाल समान रूप से कर सकता है।

questionText: Fear of heights
explanation:
Acrophobia is an extreme or irrational fear of heights.
उदा. Acrophobia ऊंचाइयों से लगने वाला अत्यधिक और तर्कहीन डर है।

questionText: A person who does not believe in the existence of God
explanation:
An atheist is a person who disbelieves or lacks belief in the existence of God or gods.
उदा. Atheist वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं रखता (नास्तिक)।

questionText: Some thing that cannot be avoided
explanation:
Inevitable means certain to happen; unavoidable.
उदा. Inevitable का अर्थ है जो निश्चित रूप से घटेगा और टाला न जा सके (अनिवार्य)।

questionText: Fear of being in enclosed spaces.
explanation:
'Claustrophobia' is the extreme or irrational fear of confined places. 
उदा. 'Claustrophobia' बंद या संकीर्ण स्थानों से अत्यधिक डरने की स्थिति को कहते हैं।

questionText: A place where government or public records are kept.
explanation:
An 'Archive' is a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people. 
उदा. 'Archive' वह स्थान है जहाँ सरकारी या ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज और रिकॉर्ड सुरक्षित रखे जाते हैं।

questionText: One who walks on ropes.
explanation:
A 'Funambulant' or funambulist is a tightrope walker. 
उदा. 'Funambulant' उस व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जो रस्सी पर चलना जानता है या रस्सी पर करतब दिखाता है।

questionText: Capable of being understood in either of two or more possible senses.
explanation:
'Ambiguous' refers to something open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning. 
उदा. 'Ambiguous' उसे कहते हैं जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ निकल सकते हों और जो स्पष्ट न हो।

questionText: A person who recovers from illness.
explanation:
A 'Convalescent' is a person recovering from an illness or medical operation. 
उदा. 'Convalescent' वह व्यक्ति है जो किसी बीमारी या ऑपरेशन के बाद स्वास्थ्य लाभ कर रहा हो।

questionText: Government by a small group of all-powerful people.
explanation:
'Oligarchy' is a small group of people having control of a country or organization. 
उदा. 'Oligarchy' उस शासन प्रणाली को कहते हैं जिसमें सत्ता कुछ ही शक्तिशाली लोगों के हाथ में होती है।

questionText: A word formed from the initial letters of other words.
explanation:
An 'Acronym' is an abbreviation formed from the initial components of the words of a phrase. 
उदा. 'Acronym' किसी वाक्यांश के शुरुआती अक्षरों से मिलकर बनने वाला एक नया शब्द होता है (जैसे- NASA)।

questionText: That which cannot be corrected.
explanation:
'Incorrigible' describes a person or their behavior not able to be changed or reformed. 
उदा. 'Incorrigible' उस बुराี या व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग होता है जिसे सुधारा न जा सके।

questionText: a person who has the ability to understand and share the feelings of others
explanation:
The phrase describes someone who feels or understands the emotions of others – an "empath".  Altruist and philanthropist refer to self‑lessness, while empathic is an adjective.
उदाहरण: She is an empath, understanding everyone's pain.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is knowledgeable about many different subjects
explanation:
A polymath has knowledge across various fields.  Expert and specialist denote depth in one area, and guru is a revered teacher.
उदाहरण: He is a true polymath, fluent in science, art, and literature.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: A person who enjoys making jokes, especially in a condescending way
explanation:
A satirist uses humor to ridicule and criticize.  Sarcastic is an adjective, joker a general comedian, and parodist imitates.
उदाहरण: He is a renowned satirist, mocking politics with wit.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who takes pleasure in confusing others by using double meanings
explanation:
Wordplay refers to playful use of language, often with double meanings.  Ambiguity is the quality, puzzler is a person who puzzles, eccentric is odd.
उदाहरण: The writer’s wordplay delighted readers.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is excessively fond of eating sweets
explanation:
A glutton is someone who overindulges in food, especially sweets.  Sugary is an adjective, sweetsman is not standard, cakey is adjective.
उदाहरण: He is a glutton for desserts, never turning down cake.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: A person who has a deep understanding of the moral and spiritual aspects of life
explanation:
A mystic deeply explores spiritual truths.  Philosopher studies philosophy, moralist focuses on morality, ethicist studies ethics.
उदाहरण: She considered herself a mystic, seeking enlightenment.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is known for being extremely cautious and meticulous
explanation:
Punctilious describes someone extremely careful about details.  Precise is accurate, cautious is careful, meticulous is careful but not as formal.
उदाहरण: She was punctilious, never missing a single detail.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is very fond of watching the movement of birds in the sky
explanation:
A birdwatcher enjoys observing birds.  Avian is adjective, skyseer is not standard, floral relates to flowers.
उदाहरण: He was a dedicated birdwatcher, always in the park.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: A person who enjoys telling true stories about people in a dramatic way
explanation:
Storyteller is someone who narrates stories, especially dramatic ones.  Novelist writes novels, narrator narrates, documentarian documents.
उदाहरण: He was a famous storyteller, captivating audiences with real-life tales.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is very good at inventing new gadgets and ideas
explanation:
An innovator creates new ideas or devices.  Creator is generic, inventor is more about invention, thinker is a thinker.
उदाहरण: She is an innovator, constantly designing eco‑friendly gadgets.
grammarRule: One‑word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper school uniform.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
जब दो subjects 'neither...nor' से जुड़ते हैं, तो verb अपने पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: No sooner did / the train arrived / at the station / than the passengers rushed.
explanation:
'Did' is a helping verb and is always followed by the first form of the verb (V1). Therefore, 'arrived' must be replaced with 'arrive'.
'did' के साथ ہمیشہ verb की base form (V1) का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'arrived' की जगह 'arrive' होगा।

questionText: The direct or and producer / have given / his consent for / the new project.
explanation:
When two nouns refer to the same person and take a single article ('The director and producer'), the pronoun used for them must be singular ('his' is correct here, but the verb must also be singular - 'has'). Wait, actually 'have' is in part B, so 'have' must be 'has' because only one person is meant. Let's correct the focus to the verb or pronoun. Here 'have' should be 'has' or 'his' should align. Let's fix option B/C. If one article is used, verb is singular. So 'have' -> 'has'.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'his consent for' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Each of the students / in the computer lab / are working on / their practical assignments.
explanation:
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun but takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular आती है। इसलिए 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I / stepped out of the house / when a heavy shower / drenched me completely.
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is correctly followed by 'when' (or 'before'). The sentence is grammatically correct as there is no error. Wait, let's make an error: 'than' instead of 'when'. Let's change C to 'than a heavy shower'.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'when a heavy shower' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Hardly had I / stepped out of the house / than a heavy shower / drenched me completely.
explanation:
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.
'Hardly' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का ('than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।

questionText: One of my friends / are going / to London / next month.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Hence, 'are' should be replaced with 'is'.
संरचना 'One of + plural noun' के साथ verb हमेशा singular होती है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।

questionText: She is more taller / than her younger sister / who works as / a software engineer.
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already comparative, so 'more' should not be used with it.
English में दो comparative words एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं होते। 'taller' खुद comparative है, इसलिए 'more' का प्रयोग गलत है।

questionText: Sunita is / senior than / me in this / office.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like senior, junior, superior, inferior) are followed by 'to' instead of 'than'.
'-or' पर समाप्त होने वाले adjectives (senior, junior आदि) के बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Scarcely had the minister / arrived at the function / than the rain / started falling heavily.
explanation:
'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' must be followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
'Scarcely' के साथ जोड़ी 'when' की बनती है न कि 'than' की।

questionText: Hardly had I arrived / at the station than / the train left / without me.
explanation:
The conjunction 'hardly/scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Therefore, 'than' in part (B) should be replaced with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। अतः (B) भाग में 'than' के स्थान पर 'when' होगा।

questionText: One of the most important task / in agriculture is / the timely harvesting / of crops.
options: One of the most important task
explanation:
The phrase 'one of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' should be pluralized to 'tasks'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा plural noun का प्रयोग किया जाता है। अतः 'task' की जगह 'tasks' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students was / present in the class / for the special lecture.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'was' must be replaced with 'were'.
उदा. जब दो subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे नजदीक वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' आएगा।

questionText: She told me that / she is watching / the movie since / two hours.
explanation:
In indirect speech, past tense in the reporting verb ('told') changes the reported speech tense. Also, for duration with a point of time/period, 'for' is used instead of 'since', and the tense should be past perfect continuous ('had been watching').
उदा. वाक्य past tense में है, अतः 'is watching' गलत है। साथ ही समय की अवधि के लिए 'since' की जगह 'for' का प्रयोग होता है और tense 'had been watching' होगा।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring / when the students / rushed out of / their classrooms.
options: No sooner did the bell ring
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Therefore, 'when' in part (B) is incorrect. 
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। अतः (B) भाग में 'when' की जगह 'than' होगा।

questionText: The government has announced / a new scheme for / economically weaker section / of the society.
explanation:
The noun 'section' is countable and singular here without an article, which is grammatically incorrect. It should be 'the economically weaker sections' or 'an economically weaker section'.
उदा. 'economically weaker section' एक countable noun है, यहाँ या तो 'sections' (plural) होना चाहिए या 'an economically weaker section' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Despite of his hard work, / he failed to secure / the first rank in / the competitive examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by the preposition 'of'. (In place of 'Despite of', we use either 'Despite' or 'In spite of').
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'In spite of' लिखा जा सकता है या केवल 'Despite' लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Each of the suspected men / were arrested by / the local police / late last night.
explanation:
The phrase 'Each of' takes a singular verb because 'Each' is the main subject. Therefore, 'were' must be replaced with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद plural noun आता है, लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'Each' होता है। 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: The principal along with / all the teachers have / gone to attend / an urgent meeting.
explanation:
When subjects are connected by 'along with', 'as well as', 'with', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The principal' is singular, so 'have' must be replaced with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'along with' से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject ('The principal') के अनुसार आती है। अतः 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had we stepped / out of the house / when it starts / raining heavily.
explanation:
The sentence is in the past tense ('Scarcely had we stepped'), so the subsequent clause must also be in the past tense. 'starts' should be replaced with 'started'.
उदा. वाक्य का पहला हिस्सा past tense में है ('had we stepped'), इसलिए आगे की क्रिया भी past tense में होनी चाहिए। 'starts' की जगह 'started' होगा।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelt word from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Boulevard'. 'Boulvard' is misspelled.
उदा. सही शब्द 'Boulevard' (चौड़ी सड़क) है, यहाँ 'e' गायब है।

questionText: Find the word that is spelt incorrectly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant'. 'Luitenant' is incorrect.
उदा. 'Lieutenant' (लेफ्टिनेंट) की सही वर्तनी में 'ieu' आता है।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Millennium' with double 'l' and double 'n'.
उदा. 'Millennium' (सहस्राब्दी) में double 'l' और double 'n' होते हैं।

questionText: Select the word that is correctly spelt.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Hemorrhage' (meaning escape of blood from a ruptured blood vessel).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Hemorrhage' है जिसका अर्थ रक्तस्राव होता है।

questionText: Find the correctly spelt word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Guarantee' (ends with -ee and has 'u' after 'g').
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Guarantee' है जो -ee पर समाप्त होती है।

questionText: Identify the word that is correctly spelled.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Athlete' without an extra 'e' in the middle.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Athlete' है, बीच में कोई अतिरिक्त 'e' नहीं आता।

questionText: Choose the incorrectly spelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *Mischievous*.
उदाहरण: ‘mischievous’ का सही रूप ‘mischievous’ है, ‘Mischevious’ गलत है।

questionText: Choose the word that is spelled incorrectly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *Embarrass* with double 'r' and double 's'.
उदाहरण: ‘embarrass’ में दो 'r' और दो 's' होते हैं, ‘Embarras’ गलत है।
grammarRule: Double consonant rule for verbs ending in -ss

questionText: Which word is spelled correctly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is *Maintenance*.
उदाहरण: ‘maintenance’ में ‘i’ के बाद ‘n’ आता है, ‘Maintanence’ गलत है।

questionText: She has been working on this project ______ three months.
explanation:
Use 'for' to denote a period of time (duration like three months). 'Since' is used for a point of time.
उदा. निश्चित समय (point of time) के लिए 'since' और समय की अवधि (period of time) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The manager ______ the proposal before making a final decision.
explanation:
'Look over' means to examine something carefully. 'Look into' means to investigate.
उदा. 'Look over' का अर्थ किसी दस्तावेज़ या प्रस्ताव को सरसरी तौर पर या ध्यान से जाँच करना होता है।

questionText: Hardly had he stepped out of the house ______ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'hardly/scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not ______ the target set by the company.
explanation:
We use the collocation 'meet a target/goal/deadline'.
उदा. लक्ष्य, डेडलाइन या आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के लिए 'meet' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है ('meet the target')।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ present in the class yesterday.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject (students, which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे नज़दीकी कर्ता के अनुसार आती है, यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है इसलिए 'were' आएगा।

questionText: The government has taken strict measures to ______ inflation.
explanation:
'Bring down' means to reduce or lower something like prices or inflation.
उदा. 'Bring down' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को कम करना (जैसे महँगाई या कीमतें) होता है।

questionText: Honesty is the ______ policy for long-term success.
explanation:
Superlative degree ('best') is required with the definite article 'the' when comparing more than two.
उदा. यहाँ सुपरलेटिव डिग्री 'best' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'the' के बाद superlative adjective आता है।

questionText: If I ______ the king, I would help all the poor people.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical situation, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. काल्पनिक इच्छा (Hypothetical sentence) को व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The criminal was found guilty ______ murder and sentenced to life imprisonment.
explanation:
The adjective 'guilty' is always followed by the preposition 'of'.
उदा. 'Guilty' के बाद निश्चित रूप से preposition 'of' का प्रयोग होता है (guilty of a crime)।

questionText: She is proficient ______ playing the piano.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is typically followed by the preposition 'in' (or 'at', but 'in' is standard for skills/fields).
उदा. किसी कार्य या कला में निपुण होने के लिए 'proficient in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to ________ awareness about road safety.
explanation:
To-infinitive takes the base form of the verb. 'To spread' is grammatically correct after 'to'.
उदा. 'To' के बाद हमेशा verb की base form (V1) का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'spread' सही है।

questionText: She is proficient ________ both French and German.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is always followed by the preposition 'in'.
उदा. Adjective 'proficient' के बाद निश्चित preposition 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not achieve the desired ________.
explanation:
In this context, 'success' fits best as an uncountable noun representing the attainment of a goal.
उदा. यहाँ लक्ष्य प्राप्त करने के संदर्भ में 'success' (सफलता) सबसे उपयुक्त noun है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ present in the class today.
explanation:
According to the rule of subject-verb agreement, when subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('students', which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर verb अपने पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है, यहाँ 'students' plural है इसलिए plural verb 'were' आएगी।

questionText: The manager asked me ________ I could complete the project by Friday.
explanation:
In indirect speech for interrogative sentences (yes/no questions), 'if' or 'whether' is used.
उदा. Yes/No type interrogative sentences के indirect speech में conjunction के रूप में 'if' या 'whether' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The manager looked ________ the complaints submitted by the employees.
explanation:
'Look into' is a phrasal verb meaning to investigate or examine carefully.
उदा. 'Look into' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ 'जाँच पड़ताल करना' होता है।

questionText: Had the driver been alert, the accident ________ averted.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence in inversion form: Had + subject + V3, subject + would/could/should + have + V3.
उदा. यह Third Conditional का inversion है, जिसमें past unreal condition के लिए 'could have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The aroma of freshly baked bread always makes my mouth ________.
explanation:
The causative verb 'make' takes a bare infinitive (V1 without 'to').
उदा. Causative verb 'make' के बाद bare infinitive (बिना 'to' वाली verb) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: She spoke in such a low voice that she was barely ________.
explanation:
'Audible' means loud enough to be heard. 'Legible' is for handwriting, and 'eligible' is for qualifications.
उदा. 'Audible' का अर्थ है जो सुनाई दे सके। 'Legible' लिखावट के लिए और 'eligible' योग्यताबद्ध के लिए होता है।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelled word among the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Occurrence' ending with 'ce', not 'se', and has a double 'r'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Occurrence' है जिसमें अंत में 'nce' आता है और दो बार 'r' होता है।

questionText: Find the word with the correct spelling among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Idiosyncrasy' (a mode of behavior peculiar to an individual).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Idiosyncrasy' है, जिसमें बीच में 'syncrasy' आता है।

questionText: Which of the following words is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
Rule: The word 'accommodate' has a double 'c' and double 'm'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – accommodate.
grammarRule: Double consonants after a short vowel

questionText: Which of the following is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
Rule: The word 'embarrass' contains double 'r' and double 's'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – embarrass.
grammarRule: Double consonants after a short vowel

questionText: Identify the word with the correct spelling among the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Mischievous' (following the 'i before e except after c' rule contextually: M-I-S-C-H-I-E-V-O-U-S).
उदा. सही spelling 'Mischievous' है (शैतान/नटखट)।
grammarRule: I before E rule / Silent vowels

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Gauge' (meaning an instrument to measure). 'Guage' is a common typo.
उदा. 'Gauge' की सही spelling G-A-U-G-E होती है, 'guage' गलत है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelt word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Athlete' (A-T-H-L-E-T-E). People often mispronounce and misspell it as 'athelete'.
उदा. 'Athlete' (खिलाड़ी) में बीच में कोई अतिरिक्त 'e' नहीं होता।

questionText: One who possesses many talents
explanation:
A 'Versatile' person is able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities. 
उदा. 'Versatile' (बहुमुखी) वह व्यक्ति है जिसमें कई तरह की योग्यताएं या प्रतिभाएं होती हैं।

questionText: The study of birds
explanation:
'Ornithology' is the scientific study of birds. 
उदा. 'Ornithology' विज्ञान की वह शाखा है जिसके अंतर्गत पक्षियों का अध्ययन किया जाता है (पक्षीविज्ञान)।

questionText: One who hates human kind
explanation:
A 'Misanthrope' is a person who dislikes humankind and avoids human society. 
उदा. 'Misanthrope' (मानवद्वेषी) वह व्यक्ति होता है जो मानव जाति से नफरत करता है।

questionText: An inscription on a tombstone written in memory of the deceased
explanation:
An 'Epitaph' is a phrase or form of words written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone. 
उदा. 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) उस लेख या पंक्ति को कहते हैं जो किसी मृतक की याद में उसकी कब्र या स्मारक पर खुदी होती है।

questionText: Incapable of being corrected or reformed
explanation:
Incorrigible describes a person or their behavior not able to be changed or reformed.
उदा. जिसे सुधारा न जा सके (जिसे ठीक करना असंभव हो), उसे 'Incorrigible' (असंशोधनीय) कहा जाता है।

questionText: An extreme fear of heights
explanation:
Acrophobia is an abnormal or extreme fear of heights.
उदा. ऊँचाई से अत्यधिक डर लगने की स्थिति को 'Acrophobia' (उच्चताभीति) कहते हैं।

questionText: That which cannot be satisfied
explanation:
Insatiable means (of an appetite or desire) impossible to satisfy.
उदा. जिसकी इच्छा या भूख कभी संतुष्ट न की जा सके, उसे 'Insatiable' (अतृप्य / जो संतुष्ट न हो) कहते हैं।

questionText: Find the word that is correctly spelled.
explanation:
'Lieutenant' is the correct spelling, derived from French meaning place-holder.
उदा. 'Lieutenant' सही वर्तनी है, जिसकी शुरुआत 'Lieu-' से होती है।

questionText: Identify the option with the correct spelling.
explanation:
'Pronunciation' is correct. Note that the verb is 'pronounce', but the noun drops the 'o' in the second syllable.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Pronunciation' है। क्रिया 'pronounce' होती है लेकिन संज्ञा में 'o' हट जाता है।
grammarRule: Noun and Verb derivative spelling changes

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is "Separate". The word uses "a" not "e" after "s".
उदाहरण: "Please separate the documents."

questionText: Hardly had I arrived at the station / than the train left / without waiting for me. / No error
options: Hardly had I arrived at the station
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when', not 'than'. Therefore, 'than' should be replaced by 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)। अतः भाग (B) में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students was in their proper uniform. / No error
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'was' should be replaced by 'were'.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: One of my friends / are going to the United States / for higher studies next month. / No error
options: are going to the United States
explanation:
The phrase 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Here, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद Noun हमेशा Plural होता है लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: She is more taller / than her sister / who lives in Mumbai. / No error
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative form, so 'more' is redundant and incorrect.
उदा. एक साथ दो Comparative Adjectives ('more' और 'taller') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। 'Taller' अपने आप में comparative है, इसलिए 'more' को हटाना होगा।

questionText: The principal and the manager / has given their approval / for the new project. / No error
explanation:
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' and both have articles ('the') preceding them, they refer to two different persons, taking a plural verb ('have' instead of 'has').
उदा. यदि दो Nouns से पहले अलग-अलग Article ('the') लगा हो, तो वे दो अलग व्यक्तियों को दर्शाते हैं और उनके साथ Plural verb ('have') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring / when the students / rushed out of their classes. / No error
options: No sooner did the bell ring
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'when' का नहीं। अतः भाग (B) में 'when' के स्थान पर 'than' होगा।

questionText: Each of the players / were given a medal / for their outstanding performance. / No error
explanation:
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun but takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद Noun Plural होता है लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: He told me that / he is reading a book / since morning. / No error
explanation:
Since the main clause ('He told me') is in the past tense, the subordinate clause must also be in the past. Also, with 'since morning', Present/Past Perfect Continuous tense is used. Hence, 'is reading' should be 'was reading'.
उदा. यदि मुख्य वाक्य Past Tense में है, तो आगे का वाक्य भी Past Tense में होगा। 'since morning' के साथ Continuous tense में 'was reading' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Unless you do not work hard / you will not be able / to clear the examination. / No error
options: Unless you do not work hard
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative conditional word and inherently contains 'not'. Therefore, 'do not' should not be used with 'unless'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ होता है 'यदि नहीं', इसलिए इसके साथ दोबारा 'not' (do not) का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता। सही खंड 'Unless you work hard' होगा।

questionText: The committee are / unanimous in their decision / regarding this matter. / No error
explanation:
When a collective noun like 'committee' is unanimous (in agreement), it takes a plural verb and plural pronoun ('are', 'their'). The sentence is grammatically correct. 
उदा. जब Collective Noun ('committee') किसी मत पर एकमत (unanimous) होती है, तो उसके साथ Plural Verb और Plural Pronoun का प्रयोग होता है। वाक्य बिल्कुल सही है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students was / in their class room / when the principal visited / the school today.
options: Neither the teacher nor the students was
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, अतः 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' होगा।

questionText: The manager told us that / he will discuss the matter / with his colleagues / in the meeting tomorrow.
explanation:
The main clause is in the past tense ('told'), so the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense. 'will' must be changed to 'would'.
उदा. मुख्य उपवाक्य (main clause) भूतकाल में ('told') है, इसलिए आश्रित उपवाक्य भी भूतकाल में होना चाहिए। 'will' को 'would' में बदला जाना चाहिए।

questionText: No sooner had I / opened the door / than a gust of wind / blew away my papers.
explanation:
No error in this sentence. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'had + subject + V3' और संयोजन 'than' का सही प्रयोग किया गया है।

questionText: She is one of those persons / who does not care / what others say / about her personal life.
options: She is one of those persons
explanation:
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the plural antecedent ('persons'). Therefore, 'do' should be used instead of 'does'.
उदा. 'one of those + बहुवचन संज्ञा + relative pronoun' के बाद आने वाली क्रिया पूर्ववर्ती बहुवचन संज्ञा ('persons') के अनुसार बहुवचन ('do') होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Despite of working hard / for the competitive exam, / he could not clear / the preliminary stage.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Use either 'Despite working hard' or 'In spite of working hard'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। सही प्रयोग 'Despite working hard' या 'In spite of working hard' होगा।

questionText: Each of the players / were given a medal / for their outstanding performance / in the championship.
explanation:
'Each of', 'Every of', 'Either of' take a singular verb. Therefore, 'was' should be used instead of 'were'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है लेकिन क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है। अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out / of the house when / it started raining heavily / without any warning.
explanation:
No error in this sentence. 'Hardly/Scarcely' is correctly paired with 'when' (or 'before') and uses inversion (had + subject + V3).
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'Hardly/Scarcely' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है और वाक्य की संरचना (inversion) बिल्कुल सही है।

questionText: The company has appointed / a new consultant to / review their financial strategies / for the upcoming year.
explanation:
'The company' is a singular collective noun treated as a single unit here, so the pronoun should be 'its' instead of 'their'.
उदा. 'The company' एक एकवचन संज्ञा के रूप में प्रयुक्त है, इसलिए इसके लिए 'their' के स्थान पर सर्वनाम 'its' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।

questionText: It is high time / the government takes / strict action against / the corrupt officials.
explanation:
Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' must be followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाला उपवाक्य हमेशा भूतकाल (Simple Past / V2) में होता है। 'takes' की जगह 'took' होना चाहिए।
grammarRule: Tense Usage after 'It is high time'

questionText: Not only the principal / but also the teachers was / involved in organizing / the annual day function.
explanation:
When subjects are connected by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the second subject ('the teachers', which is plural). Therefore, use 'were' instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब कर्ता 'not only... but also' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया दूसरे कर्ता ('the teachers', जो बहुवचन है) के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: ABUNDANT
explanation:
'Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities; the exact opposite is 'scanty', which means small or insufficient in quantity.
उदा. 'Abundant' का अर्थ प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है, इसका विलोम शब्द 'scanty' (अल्प या कम) है।

questionText: TRANSITORIERS
explanation:
'Transitory' means lasting for a short time; its exact opposite is 'Permanent', which means lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.
उदा. 'Transitory' का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है, जिसका विपरीत शब्द 'Permanent' (स्थाई) है।

questionText: MITIGATE
explanation:
'Mitigate' means to make less severe or painful. Its antonym is 'Aggravate', which means to make a problem or bad situation worse.
उदा. 'Mitigate' का अर्थ कम करना होता है, जबकि 'Aggravate' का अर्थ स्थिति को और बदतर या गंभीर बनाना है।

questionText: CANDID
explanation:
'Candid' means truthful and straightforward; frank. The opposite is 'Secretive', meaning inclined to conceal thoughts and feelings.
उदा. 'Candid' का अर्थ स्पष्टवादी होता है, इसका विलोम शब्द 'Secretive' (गुप्त रखने वाला) होगा।

questionText: BENEVOLENT
explanation:
'Benevolent' means well meaning and kindly. Its antonym is 'Malevolent', which means having or showing a wish to do evil to others.
उदा. 'Benevolent' का अर्थ दयालु होता है, जबकि 'Malevolent' का अर्थ द्वेषपूर्ण या बुरा चाहने वाला होता है।

questionText: GREGARIOUS
explanation:
'Gregarious' means fond of company; sociable. The opposite is 'Reclusive', meaning avoiding the company of other people; solitary.
उदा. 'Gregarious' का अर्थ मिलनसार होता है, इसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'Reclusive' (एकांतप्रिय) है।

questionText: PRUDENT
explanation:
'Prudent' means acting with or showing care for the future. Its antonym is 'Rash', meaning acting or tending to act too hastily or without consideration.
उदा. 'Prudent' का अर्थ समझदार और दूरदर्शी होता है, जबकि 'Rash' का अर्थ जल्दबाज या अविवेकी होता है।

questionText: OBSCURE
explanation:
'Obscure' means not discovered or known about; uncertain. The exact opposite is 'Clear', meaning easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.
उदा. 'Obscure' का अर्थ अस्पष्ट होता है, जबकि 'Clear' का अर्थ स्पष्ट होता है।

questionText: FASTIDIOUS
explanation:
'Fastidious' means very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. Its antonym is 'Sloppy', meaning careless and disorganized.
उदा. 'Fastidious' का अर्थ बहुत अधिक बारीकी या नखरे दिखाने वाला होता है, जबकि 'Sloppy' का अर्थ लापरवाह होता है।

questionText: ZENITH
explanation:
'Zenith' means the time at which something is most powerful or successful (highest point). Its antonym is 'Nadir', which means the lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization.
उदा. 'Zenith' का अर्थ सर्वोच्च बिंदु होता है, और इसका विलोम 'Nadir' (सबसे निचला स्तर) है।

questionText: ABUNDANCE
explanation:
Abundance means a very large quantity of something. Its opposite is Scarcity, which means a shortage or insufficiency.
उदा. Abundance का अर्थ प्रचुरता होता है और इसका विलोम शब्द Scarcity (कमी) है।

questionText: TRANSIENT
explanation:
Transient means lasting for only a short time. Its antonym is Permanent, meaning lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.
उदा. Transient का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है, और इसका विपरीत Permanent (स्थाई) है।

questionText: CANDID
explanation:
Candid means truthful and straightforward; frank. Its antonym is Secretive, meaning inclined to conceal thoughts and feelings.
उदा. Candid का अर्थ स्पष्टवादी होता है, जिसका विपरीत Secretive (गुप्त या बात छिपाने वाला) है।

questionText: MITIGATE
explanation:
Mitigate means to make less severe, serious, or painful. Its antonym is Aggravate, which means to make a problem or bad situation worse.
उदा. Mitigate का अर्थ कम करना है, और Aggravate का अर्थ बढ़ाना या बदतर करना है।

questionText: GAINSAY
explanation:
Gainsay means to deny or contradict (a fact or statement). Its antonym is Confirm, which means to establish the truth or correctness of something.
उदा. Gainsay का अर्थ खंडन करना होता है, जबकि Confirm का अर्थ पुष्टि करना है।

questionText: ALACRITY
explanation:
Alacrity means brisk and cheerful readiness. Its antonym is Apathy, which means lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
उदा. Alacrity का अर्थ तत्परता है, और Apathy इसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द है जिसका अर्थ उदासीनता होता है।

questionText: VERBOSE
explanation:
Verbose means using or expressed in more words than needed. Its antonym is Concise, meaning brief and to the point.
उदा. Verbose का अर्थ जरूरत से ज्यादा शब्दों का प्रयोग करने वाला होता है, जबकि Concise संक्षिप्त होता है।

questionText: HOSTILE
explanation:
Hostile means unfriendly or antagonistic. Its antonym is Friendly, showing kind and pleasant qualities.
उदा. Hostile का अर्थ शत्रुतापूर्ण होता है, और Friendly (मित्रवत) इसका सही विलोम है।

questionText: BOISTEROUS
explanation:
Boisterous means noisy, energetic, and cheerful. Its antonym is Quiet, making little or no noise.
उदा. Boisterous का अर्थ कोलाहलपूर्ण या उमंग से भरा होता है, और Quiet इसका विपरीत शब्द है।

questionText: ARTIFICIAL
explanation:
Artificial means made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally. Its antonym is Natural.
उदा. Artificial का अर्थ कृत्रिम होता है, जिसका विलोम Natural (प्राकृतिक) है।

questionText: four words are given, out of which only one word is correctly spelt. Find the correctly spelt word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' (with double 'c' and double 'm').
सही वर्तनी 'Accommodation' है (दोहरे 'c' और दोहरे 'm' के साथ)।
grammarRule: Double consonants: ac + com + mo + da + tion

questionText: scarce
explanation:
Scarce means not many in number. Its opposite is abundant, which means plentiful or in large quantity.
स्कार्स का मतलब कम मात्रा या कम उपलब्धता होता है। इसका विपरीत शब्द abundant (अद्भुत या प्रचुर मात्रा में) है।
grammarRule: Antonyms are words that express opposite meanings.

questionText: frequent
explanation:
Frequent means occurring often. Sporadic means occurring at irregular intervals or rarely.
फ्रीक्वेंट का मतलब बार-बार होता है। स्पॉडिक का मतलब अनियमित रूप से या कम ही होता है।

questionText: generous
explanation:
Generous means willing to give or share. Stingy means reluctant to give or spend.
जेनरस का मतलब उदार या देने वाला होता है। स्टिंगी का मतलब कंजूस या कम देने वाला होता है।

questionText: invisible
explanation:
Invisible means not seen. Visible means able to be seen.
इनविजिबल का मतलब नज़र नहीं आता है। विजिबल का मतलब दिखाई देने वाला होता है।
grammarRule: Antonyms are used to express contrast in visibility.

questionText: deteriorate
explanation:
Deteriorate means to become worse. Improve means to become better.
डिसटिरियरेट का मतलब बिगड़ना है। इम्प्रूव का मतलब बेहतर होना है।
grammarRule: Antonyms often indicate change in condition.

questionText: elevate
explanation:
Elevate means to lift up. Lower means to bring down.
इलेवेट का मतलब ऊपर उठाना है। लोअर का मतलब नीचे लाना है।

questionText: reliable
explanation:
Reliable means dependable. Untrustworthy means not dependable.
रिलायबल का मतलब भरोसेमंद होता है। अनट्रस्टवर्थी का मतलब अविश्वसनीय होता है।
grammarRule: Antonyms for reliability indicate trust levels.

questionText: progressive
explanation:
Progressive means forward-moving or advancing. Regressive means moving backward.
प्रोग्रेसिव का मतलब आगे बढ़ना है। रिग्रेसिव का मतलब पीछे जाना है।

questionText: empty
explanation:
Empty means containing nothing. Full means containing something or not empty.
इम्प्टी का मतलब खाली होता है। फुल का मतलब भरा हुआ होता है।

questionText: temporary
explanation:
Temporary means lasting for a limited time. Permanent means lasting indefinitely.
टेम्पोररी का मतलब अस्थायी होता है। पर्मानेंट का मतलब स्थायी होता है।

questionText: Identify the word which is spelt correctly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Supersede' ending in '-sede'. It is the only English word ending in '-sede'.
उदा. 'Supersede' एकमात्र ऐसा अंग्रेजी शब्द है जो '-sede' पर समाप्त होता है (न कि '-cede' या '-seed' पर)।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word from the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Business' (b-u-s-i-n-e-s-s).
