उदा. 'Business' की सही वर्तनी में 'u' के बाद 's-i-n-e-s-s' आता है, विकल्प में 'buisness' दिया गया है जो गलत है।

questionText: Select the word that is correctly spelt among the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant' (l-i-e-u-t-e-n-a-n-t).
उदा. 'Lieutenant' (लेफ्टिनेंट) बहुत बार परीक्षाओं में पूछा जाने वाला कठिन शब्द है, जिसकी सही वर्तनी में 'lieu-' और फिर '-tenant' आता है।

questionText: The players was excited about the upcoming match.
options: The players was excited about the upcoming match.
The players were excited about the upcoming match.
The player was excited about the upcoming match.
The players were excited about upcoming match.
explanation:
Subject‑verb agreement.
उदाहरण: "The team was winning." (टीम जीत रही थी।)

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'The players were excited about the upcoming match.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She has completed her assignment yesterday.
options: She has completed her assignment yesterday.
She have completed her assignment yesterday.
explanation:
Correct use of simple past tense for completed action.
उदाहरण: "He finished the book yesterday." (उसने कल किताब समाप्त की।)

questionText: Neither the manager nor the employees were ready for the meeting.
options: Neither the manager nor the employees were ready for the meeting.
Neither the manager nor the employees was ready for the meeting.
explanation:
When two singular nouns are joined by ‘nor’, the verb is singular.
उदाहरण: "Neither the teacher nor the student was present." (न तो शिक्षक न ही छात्र उपस्थित था।)

questionText: The book that I read yesterday is very informative.
options: The book that I read yesterday is very informative.
explanation:
Correct placement of adverbial phrase; no comma needed before ‘yesterday’.
उदाहरण: "I finished the task last night." (मैंने कार्य कल रात समाप्त किया।)

questionText: They will attend the conference next week.
options: They will attend the conference next week.
explanation:
Future simple tense formation with ‘will’ + base verb.
उदाहरण: "She will go to the market." (वह बाजार जाएगी।)

questionText: The students are working on their projects.
options: The students are working on their projects.
explanation:
Present continuous tense; ‘are’ + verb+ing.
उदाहरण: "They are studying for exams." (वे परीक्षाओं के लिए पढ़ रहे हैं।)

questionText: If I will have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
options: If I will have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
If I have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
explanation:
Conditional clause uses present simple; ‘if I have’.
उदाहरण: "If it rains, we stay home." (अगर बारिश होती है, तो हम घर में रहते हैं।)

questionText: The best solution is to reduce waste.
options: The best solution is to reduce waste.
explanation:
Correct infinitive form after ‘is’.
उदाहरण: "The key to success is hard work." (सफलता की कुंजी कठिन परिश्रम है।)

questionText: He can run faster than me.
options: He can run faster than me.
explanation:
Comparative form of adverb ‘faster’ correctly used.
उदाहरण: "She sings beautifully." (वह सुंदर गाती है।)

questionText: The lawyer was explaining his case to the jury.
options: The lawyer was explaining his case to the jury.
explanation:
Past continuous tense with ‘was explaining’.
उदाहरण: "They were watching a movie." (वे फिल्म देख रहे थे।)

questionText: scarce
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that have opposite meanings.
उदा. 'scarce' (कम) का विपरीत 'abundant' (अधिक) है।

questionText: disperse
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms express opposite actions or states.
उदा. 'disperse' (फैलाना) का विपरीत 'gather' (इकट्ठा करना) है।

questionText: permanent
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms represent contrary permanence.
उदा. 'permanent' (स्थायी) का विपरीत 'temporary' (अस्थायी) है।

questionText: increase
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms reflect opposite changes.
उदा. 'increase' (बढ़ना) का विपरीत 'decrease' (घटना) है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words with opposite abundance.
उदा. 'abundant' (समृद्ध) का विपरीत 'scarce' (कम) है।

questionText: earnest
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms express contrast in seriousness.
उदा. 'earnest' (गंभीर) का विपरीत 'casual' (अनौपचारिक) है।

questionText: progressive
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms indicate opposite development.
उदा. 'progressive' (उन्नत) का विपरीत 'regressive' (पिछड़ना) है।

questionText: honest
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms show contrast in truthfulness.
उदा. 'honest' (सच्चा) का विपरीत 'deceitful' (धोखेबाज़) है।

questionText: vulnerable
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms represent opposite susceptibility.
उदा. 'vulnerable' (संवेदनशील) का विपरीत 'invulnerable' (असुरक्षित) है।

questionText: optimistic
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms reflect opposite outlooks.
उदा. 'optimistic' (आशावादी) का विपरीत 'pessimistic' (निराशावादी) है।

questionText: One who walks in one's sleep.
explanation:
A 'Somnambulist' is a person who walks about while asleep.
उदा. 'Somnambulist' वह व्यक्ति होता है जो नींद में चलने की बीमारी से ग्रस्त होता है।

questionText: Words inscribed on a tomb.
explanation:
An 'Epitaph' is a phrase or form of words written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone.
उदा. 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) कब्र या समाधि पर लिखे गए शब्दों को कहते हैं।

questionText: An extreme fear of heights.
explanation:
'Acrophobia' is an extreme or irrational fear of heights.
उदा. ऊंचाइयों से अत्यधिक डरने की फोबिया या मानसिक स्थिति को 'Acrophobia' कहा जाता है।

questionText: A person who loves man kind
explanation:
A 'Philanthropist' is a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
उदा. मानवता से प्रेम करने वाला और समाज की भलाई करने वाला व्यक्ति 'Philanthropist' (परोपकारी) कहलाता है।

questionText: A remedy for all diseases.
explanation:
A 'Panacea' is a solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases.
उदा. सभी प्रकार की बीमारियों या समस्याओं के एक मात्र इलाज को 'Panacea' (रामबाण) कहते हैं।

questionText: Capable of being understood in either of two or more senses.
explanation:
Something that is 'Ambiguous' is open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning.
उदा. जिस बात या कथन के एक से अधिक अर्थ निकल सकें और जो अस्पष्ट हो, उसे 'Ambiguous' (अनेकार्थी/अस्पष्ट) कहते हैं।

questionText: A person who cannot be conquered or defeated
explanation:
Invincible means too powerful to be defeated or conquered. 
उदा. Invincible का अर्थ है जिसे हराया न जा सके या अजय।

questionText: A person who knows every thing
explanation:
Omniscient means knowing everything or having infinite awareness. 
उदा. Omniscient का अर्थ है सर्वज्ञ (जो सब कुछ जानता हो)।

questionText: One who eats human flesh
explanation:
A cannibal is a person who eats the flesh of other human beings. 
उदा. Cannibal का अर्थ नर-भक्षी या आदमखोर होता है।

questionText: A speech delivered without any previous preparation
explanation:
Extempore refers to spoken or done without preparation. 
उदा. Extempore का अर्थ है तत्कालिक भाषण (बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिया गया)।

questionText: Animals that live in water
explanation:
Aquatic animals are those that live in water either freshwater or marine. 
उदा. Aquatic का अर्थ है जलीय (पानी में रहने वाले जीव)।

questionText: An official pardon for political offenses
explanation:
Amnesty is an official pardon granted for political offenses. 
उदा. Amnesty का अर्थ है राजनैतिक क्षमादान या सर्वक्षमा।

questionText: A person who looks at the bright side of things
explanation:
An optimist is a person who tends to be hopeful and confident about the future or the success of things. 
उदा. Optimist का अर्थ है आशावादी (जो हर चीज का सकारात्मक पहलू देखता हो)।

questionText: She was filled with a sense of ____ when she saw the sun rise
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single word that conveys the meaning of a longer phrase.
उदाहरण: "a sense of awe" को "awe" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The company had to ____ the issue before it spread further.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long clause with a concise verb.
उदाहरण: "address the issue" को "address" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: He had a ____ attitude towards the new policy.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use an adjective that summarizes a complex description.
उदाहरण: "a sense of indifference" को सिर्फ "indifferent" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The scientist's work is a ____ of all previous studies.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a noun that encapsulates a lengthy phrase.
उदाहरण: "the culmination of all studies" को सिर्फ "culmination" से व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

questionText: She felt a ____ of relief after the exam.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a descriptive phrase with a single word that captures the same idea.
उदाहरण: "a surge of relief" को सिर्फ "surge" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The project was a ____ of her efforts.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a concise noun that conveys the meaning of a longer phrase.
उदाहरण: "a testament to her efforts" को सिर्फ "testament" से व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

questionText: The city was known for its ____ of cultures.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a descriptive phrase with a single word.
उदाहरण: "a tapestry of cultures" को सिर्फ "tapestry" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The athlete's performance was a ____ of his training.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single noun that replaces a lengthy description.
उदाहरण: "a manifestation of his training" को सिर्फ "manifestation" से व्यक्त किया जा सकता है।

questionText: The painting is a ____ of his emotions.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long phrase with a single descriptive word.
उदाहरण: "a depiction of his emotions" को सिर्फ "depiction" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The new law is a ____ of the people’s demands.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a concise word that replaces a longer explanatory phrase.
उदाहरण: "a response to the demands" को सिर्फ "response" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: Choose the INCORRECTLY spelled word from the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Conscious' (not 'Concious'). The 's' before 'c' is pronounced /ʃ/.
सही वर्तनी 'Conscious' है। 's' को /ʃ/ (श) की तरह उच्चारित किया जाता है।

questionText: Select the word that is spelled correctly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Rhythm'. It is an unusual word with no vowels.
सही वर्तनी 'Rhythm' है। यह एक अनोखा शब्द है जिसमें कोई स्वर नहीं है।

questionText: The long and tedious process can be replaced by ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'drudgery' to replace 'long and tedious process'.
उदाहरण: The drudgery of the task was exhausting.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The sudden and unexpected event was a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'surprise' to replace 'sudden and unexpected event'.
उदाहरण: The surprise startled everyone.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: Her brief and concise description was a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'summary' to replace 'brief and concise description'.
उदाहरण: The summary captured the essence.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The vast and extensive area became an ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'expanse' to replace 'vast and extensive area'.
उदाहरण: The expanse of the desert was breathtaking.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The old and worn-out building looked ___.
explanation:
Use of adjective 'shabby' to replace 'old and worn-out building'.
उदाहरण: The shabby structure looked neglected.
grammarRule: Use of adjective as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The cheerful and bright atmosphere created a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'mood' to replace 'cheerful and bright atmosphere'.
उदाहरण: The mood was uplifting.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The strict and rigid rules were called ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'regulations' to replace 'strict and rigid rules'.
उदाहरण: The regulations were strictly enforced.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The smooth and seamless transition was a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'glide' to replace 'smooth and seamless transition'.
उदाहरण: The glide between scenes was flawless.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The rare and extraordinary occurrence was a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'phenomenon' to replace 'rare and extraordinary occurrence'.
उदाहरण: The phenomenon amazed scientists.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: The painful and distressing experience was a ___.
explanation:
Use of noun 'trauma' to replace 'painful and distressing experience'.
उदाहरण: The trauma left lasting scars.
grammarRule: Use of noun as a concise synonym for a descriptive phrase.

questionText: a person who is always late
explanation:
The phrase describes a person who habitually arrives late. The single word that captures this meaning is "latecomer".
उदाहरण: वह हमेशा देर से आता है, इसलिए वह एक latecomer है।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: to carry a heavy load over a long distance
explanation:
"Haul" is a verb meaning to transport a heavy load over a distance.
उदाहरण: वह भारी सामान को लम्बी दूरी तक haul करता है।
grammarRule: Verb substitution for a verbal phrase

questionText: the quality of being able to produce physical movement
explanation:
"Agility" denotes quick and light movement, fitting the described quality.
उदाहरण: खिलाड़ी की agility उसे तेज बनाती है।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: the process of removing or eliminating an employee from a job
explanation:
"Termination" refers to ending an employment relationship.
उदाहरण: कंपनी ने उसकी termination की घोषणा की।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is overly concerned with the appearance of themselves
explanation:
"Vain" describes someone excessively proud of their appearance.
उदाहरण: वह बहुत vain है और अपनी दिखावट पर ध्यान देता है।
grammarRule: Adjective substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: the state of being angry
explanation:
"Anger" directly denotes the emotional state described.
उदाहरण: उसके चेहरे पर anger स्पष्ट था।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: the act of refusing to comply with a request
explanation:
"Noncompliance" means refusing to follow instructions.
उदाहरण: उसका noncompliance स्पष्ट था।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who has a tendency to be dishonest
explanation:
"Liar" is a noun for someone who lies or is dishonest.
उदाहरण: वह एक liar है।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: the action of giving money to someone in need
explanation:
"Charity" refers to the act of giving aid to those in need.
उदाहरण: उसने एक charity की।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: a person who is extremely knowledgeable about a particular subject
explanation:
"Expert" denotes someone highly skilled or knowledgeable in a field.
उदाहरण: वह एक expert है।
grammarRule: Noun substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: Find the word with the correct spelling among the misspelled options.
explanation:
'Government' is correctly spelt. The other three are misspelled: Environment, Temperature, Grammar.
उदा. 'Government' सही है। अन्य अशुद्ध शब्द: Environment, Temperature, Grammar।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word from the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Secretary' (s-e-c-r-e-t-a-r-y).
उदा. 'Secretary' की सही स्पेलिंग में 't-a-r-y' आता है, 't-a-r-y' से पहले 'a' होता है।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word among the given options.
explanation:
The word 'Gaurantee' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Guarantee' (g-u-a-r-a-n-t-e-e). 
उदा. 'Gaurantee' गलत है, सही शब्द 'Guarantee' है जिसमें 'a' के बाद 'r' और फिर 'antee' आता है।

questionText: Find the word that is spelt CORRECTLY.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Receive'. It follows the 'i before e except after c' rule (c-e-i-v-e). 
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Receive' है। चूंकि यह 'c' के बाद आया है, इसलिए 'e' पहले और 'i' बाद में आता है।

questionText: Identify the word with correct spelling among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Siege' (s-i-e-g-e). 
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Siege' है जिसका अर्थ घेराबंदी होता है।
grammarRule: Exceptions to the 'I before E' rule

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure a promotion because he lagged ________ his peers in performance.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'lag behind' means to fail to maintain the same pace or progress as others.
उदा. 'Lag behind' का अर्थ दूसरों से पिछड़ जाना होता है।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to create ________ about the importance of water conservation.
explanation:
Contextually, a government campaign aims to spread positive knowledge, which is 'awareness'.
उदा. संदर्भ के अनुसार, सरकारी अभियान का उद्देश्य जागरूकता फैलाना है।

questionText: She is proficient ________ painting and has won several national awards.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is followed by the preposition 'in' when denoting skill in an activity or subject.
उदा. किसी कला या विषय में निपुणता दर्शाने के लिए 'proficient' के बाद प्रीपोजिशन 'in' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employees to ________ their differences and work together for the project.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'set aside' means to ignore or save something for a particular purpose (here, ignoring differences).
उदा. 'Set aside' का अर्थ मतभेदों को नजरअंदाज करना या भुलाना होता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ present in the class yesterday.
explanation:
According to the rule of Subject-Verb Agreement, when two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students', which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में वर्ब पास वाले सब्जेक्ट (students) के अनुसार प्लुरल (were) होगी।

questionText: The committee examined the proposal thoroughly before arriving ________ a final decision.
explanation:
The fixed expression is 'arrive at a decision' or 'arrive at a conclusion'.
उदा. सही वाक्यांश 'arrive at a decision' (निर्णय पर पहुँचना) होता है।

questionText: She speaks English so fluently that it is difficult to believe she is a ________ speaker.
explanation:
In contrast to her fluency, the logical word is 'non-native' speaker.
उदा. उसकी फ्लुएन्सी के विपरीत यहाँ 'non-native' (गैर-मूल) वक्ता शब्द एकदम सटीक है।

questionText: If I ________ the king of the country, I would eradicate poverty completely.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical situation, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक इच्छा वाले वाक्यों में सभी विषयों के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The athlete was disqualified from the race because he was found using a banned ________.
explanation:
In sports terminology, performance-enhancing drugs or prohibited chemicals are referred to as 'substances'.
उदा. खेल शब्दावली में प्रतिबंधित दवाओं या रसायनों को 'banned substance' कहा जाता है।

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure the promotion because he lacked the necessary ______ for the higher post.
explanation:
'Qualifications' refers to official credentials, educational background, or skills required for a job. Here, career promotion requires specific credentials.
उदा. किसी पद के लिए आवश्यक आधिकारिक योग्यता या क्रेडेंशियल को 'qualifications' कहा जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employees to ______ their differences and work together as a team.
explanation:
Phrasal verb 'put aside' means to ignore or forget something (like differences) for a specific purpose.
उदा. 'Put aside' एक फ्रेजल वर्ब है जिसका अर्थ अपने मतभेदों को भुलाकर एक तरफ रखना होता है।

questionText: She has been suffering ______ a severe headache since morning.
explanation:
The verb 'suffer' is invariably followed by the preposition 'from' when referring to an illness or pain.
उदा. बीमारी या दर्द से पीड़ित होने के लिए 'suffer' के साथ हमेशा 'from' प्रीपोजिशन का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Had the authorities taken timely action, the disaster ______.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure (Past Unreal). Structure: If + Past Perfect (Had + V3), Subject + would/could/might + have + V3.
उदा. यह थर्ड कंडीशनल वाक्य है। यदि मुख्य खंड में 'Had + V3' हो, तो परिणाम खंड में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee reached a consensus after hours of ______ discussion.
explanation:
'Protracted' means lasting for a long time or longer than usual, which fits the context of hours of discussion leading to consensus.
उदा. 'Protracted' का अर्थ है बहुत लंबी अवधि तक चलने वाला (लंबी चर्चा)।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house ______ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly / Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before' (not 'than').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग होता है ('than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।

questionText: The scientist explained the complex theory in simple terms so that every one could ______ it.
explanation:
'Comprehend' means to grasp mentally or understand fully. The context requires understanding a complex theory.
उदा. 'Comprehend' का अर्थ किसी बात या सिद्धांत को पूरी तरह से समझना होता है।

questionText: He is proficient ______ mathematics and can solve any problem within minutes.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is typically followed by the preposition 'in' when denoting skill in a subject or activity.
उदा. किसी विषय या क्षेत्र में निपुण होने के लिए 'proficient' के बाद 'in' प्रीपोजिशन का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ______ present in the class room today.
explanation:
According to the Subject-Verb Agreement rule, when two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it (here, 'students', which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में वर्ब अपने सबसे पास वाले सब्जेक्ट (यहाँ 'students' जो कि बहुवचन है) के अनुसार आती है।

questionText: The government has implemented new policies to ______ economic growth in the rural sectors.
explanation:
'Stimulate' means to encourage or spur activity or growth. 'Simulate' means to imitate. Context demands boosting growth.
उदा. 'Stimulate' का अर्थ किसी गतिविधि या आर्थिक विकास को प्रोत्साहित करना या बढ़ावा देना होता है।

questionText: The manager was ________ the new policy.
explanation:
The phrase "be aware of" is the correct collocation.
उदाहरण: वह नई नीति के बारे में जागरूक था।

questionText: They have been ________ since morning.
explanation:
Present perfect continuous tense requires the –ing form.
उदाहरण: वे सुबह से काम कर रहे हैं।

questionText: Please put the documents ________ the file.
explanation:
The object "file" is a container; we use "in" for inside.
उदाहरण: दस्तावेज़ फ़ाइल में रखें।
grammarRule: Preposition for location inside a container

questionText: He is very ________ the exam.
explanation:
"Prepared for" is the correct preposition with "prepared".
उदाहरण: वह परीक्षा के लिए तैयार है।

questionText: The children were ________ the class room.
explanation:
Present continuous requires the –ing form.
उदाहरण: बच्चे कक्षा में प्रवेश कर रहे थे।

questionText: She has been studying English ________ five years.
explanation:
"For" is used with a duration of time.
उदाहरण: वह पाँच साल से अंग्रेज़ी पढ़ रही है।

questionText: The company is known ________ its excellent customer service.
explanation:
"Known for" is the correct collocation.
उदाहरण: कंपनी अपनी उत्कृष्ट ग्राहक सेवा के लिए जानी जाती है।

questionText: He was accused ________ stealing the money.
explanation:
The phrase "accused of" is the correct collocation.
उदाहरण: उसे पैसे चुराने के लिए आरोपित किया गया।

questionText: The painting is ________ 19th century.
explanation:
"From" indicates the period of origin.
उदाहरण: पेंटिंग 19वीं शताब्दी से है।

questionText: The report will be submitted ________ Friday.
explanation:
"By" indicates the deadline.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट शुक्रवार तक जमा की जानी है।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'by'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: She has been living ____ Germany for five years.
explanation:
The preposition "in" is used with countries and cities. In English: She has been living **in Germany**.
हिंदी: "in" शब्द का प्रयोग देशों के साथ होता है।

questionText: He ____ a book when I called him.
explanation:
The past continuous tense is used for an action that was in progress at a specific time. In English: He **was reading** a book.
हिंदी: 'was reading' का प्रयोग जारी क्रिया के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: The company ______ the new product last month.
explanation:
The past simple form is needed for a completed action in the past. In English: The company **launched** the new product.
हिंदी: भूतकाल के लिए 'launched' सही है।

questionText: The verdict was reached ____ the panel's recommendation.
explanation:
The preposition "on" is used after 'reach' when referring to a recommendation or advice. In English: The verdict was reached **on** the panel's recommendation.
हिंदी: 'reach on' का प्रयोग सुझाव के लिये होता है।

questionText: There are ____ people in the auditorium.
explanation:
The quantifier "many" is used with countable nouns. In English: There are **many** people in the auditorium.
हिंदी: गिनती योग्य संज्ञा के लिए "many" प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The book is worth ____ dollars.
explanation:
When a noun is singular and countable, use the indefinite article "a". In English: The book is worth **a** dollar.
हिंदी: एकवचन संज्ञा के लिये "a" का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The team will be ready ____ the night.
explanation:
"By" indicates a deadline. In English: The team will be ready **by** the night.
हिंदी: समय सीमा बताने के लिये "by" का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The law was passed ____ the parliament.
explanation:
"By" is used after 'pass' to indicate the entity that enacted the law. In English: The law was passed **by** the parliament.
हिंदी: 'pass by' का प्रयोग विधेय के लिये होता है।

questionText: She is known ____ her generosity.
explanation:
"Known for" expresses the reason or attribute. In English: She is known **for** her generosity.
हिंदी: किसी गुण के लिये "known for" का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: We need to finish the project ____ Friday.
explanation:
"By Friday" denotes a deadline. In English: We need to finish the project **by** Friday.
हिंदी: समय सीमा बताने के लिये "by" का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: He has been working here ____ 2010.
explanation:
"Since" is used with a specific point in time. In English: He has been working here **since** 2010.
हिंदी: किसी विशिष्ट समय के लिये "since" प्रयोग होता है।
grammarRule: Use of 'since' for a point in time

questionText: The student was praised ____ his hard work.
explanation:
"Praised for" indicates the reason of praise. In English: The student was praised **for** his hard work.
हिंदी: प्रशंसा के कारण बताने के लिये "praised for" इस्तेमाल होता है।

questionText: He has been studying English ___________ he was 10 years old.
explanation: The preposition 'since' is used with the present perfect tense to indicate the starting point of an action. उदाहरण: He has been studying English since he was 10 years old.

questionText: She was ___________ her friends when she received the good news.
explanation: The present participle 'meeting' is used after 'was' to form a past continuous tense. उदाहरण: She was meeting her friends when she received the good news.

questionText: The manager asked the employees to submit their reports ___________ Friday.
explanation: The preposition 'by' is used to indicate a deadline. उदाहरण: Submit your reports by Friday.

questionText: The article was published in the journal ___________ the year 2020.
explanation:
The preposition 'in' is used with years. उदाहरण: Published in 2020.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'in'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: We should be careful ___________ the fragile vase.
explanation: The phrase 'be careful to' is used to indicate precaution. उदाहरण: Be careful to avoid breaking the vase.

questionText: The team won the match by a margin of ___________ points.
explanation: The adjective 'several' is used to indicate more than two but not many. उदाहरण: The team won by several points.

questionText: He has never seen a _________ bird.
explanation: Adjectives like 'beautiful' are used before nouns. उदाहरण: He has never seen a beautiful bird.

questionText: The student is _________ to finish the assignment before the dead line
explanation: The adjective 'eager' describes a feeling; the adverb form is 'eagerly' (used with verbs). उदाहरण: She is eager to finish the assignment.
grammarRule: Adjective before noun or verb phrase

questionText: I will ___________ you at the station tomorrow.
explanation: The simple future 'will' is followed by the base form of the verb. उदाहरण: I will meet you tomorrow.

questionText: The teacher asked the students to write their names ___________ the paper.
explanation: The preposition 'on' is used for writing on a surface. उदाहरण: Write your name on the paper.

questionText: The doctor advised him to stop smoking ___________ he feels ill again.
explanation: The conjunction 'when' indicates a future time or condition. उदाहरण: Stop smoking when you feel ill again.

questionText: Identify the wrongly spelt word from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant' (L-I-E-U-T-E-N-A-N-T).
उदा. 'Lieutenant' की सही spelling में बीच में 'tenant' जैसा हिस्सा आता है, इसे अक्सर गलत लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Find the correctly spelt word among the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Achievement' following the 'i before e except after c' rule.
उदा. सही spelling 'Achievement' है ('achieve' + 'ment')।
grammarRule: I before E except after C rule

questionText: Which of the following words is incorrectly spelt?
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Embarrass' with double 'r' and double 's'.
उदा. 'Embarrass' में double 'r' और double 's' दोनों आते हैं।

questionText: Select the option that has the correctly spelt word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant'. It is pronounced as 'left-tenant' but spelt with 'ieu'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Lieutenant' है, जिसे 'left-tenant' बोला जाता है लेकिन स्पेलिंग में 'ieu' आता है।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word among the given options.
explanation:
The word 'Diffeerence' is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is 'Difference'.
उदा. शब्द 'Diffeerence' गलत है, सही स्पेलिंग 'Difference' है।

questionText: Identify the word which is spelt INCORRECTLY.
explanation:
The word 'Enviroment' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'Environment' (retaining the first 'n').
उदा. 'Enviroment' गलत है, सही स्पेलिंग 'Environment' है जिसमें 'n' छूट गया था।

questionText: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word among the options.
explanation:
The word 'Neccessary' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'Necessary' (one 'c', double 's').
उदा. 'Neccessary' गलत है, सही स्पेलिंग 'Necessary' है जिसमें एक 'c' और दो 's' आते हैं।

questionText: Select the word that is misspelled.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *separate*.
Rule: The word *separate* has a single 'p' and single 'r'.
उदाहरण: "दो अलग-अलग समूह" – separate.
The options *seperate* misspell the root *separate*.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "She recieved a letter from her friend.
explanation:
The word should be spelled as 'received'. Rule: Past tense of 'receive' ends with '-ieved'. 
उदाहरण: "वह letter received करती है"

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word in the following list.
explanation:
Correct: 'Accommodate' with two 'c's and two 'm's. Rule: Double consonants after a short vowel. 
उदाहरण: "उसने हमें accommodate किया"

questionText: A blessing in disguise
options: A misfortune that eventually leads to something good
A hidden treasure found by chance
explanation:
A blessing in disguise means something that seems bad or unlucky at first, but results in something good happening later.
उदा. 'A blessing in disguise' का अर्थ है कोई ऐसी घटना जो शुरुआत में बुरी लगे, लेकिन बाद में बहुत फायदेमंद साबित हो।

questionText: Spill the beans
options: To plant seeds in a field
To reveal a secret carelessly or unintentionally
To create a mess in the kitchen
explanation:
To spill the beans means to disclose a secret, often unintentionally.
उदा. 'Spill the beans' का अर्थ अनजाने में या गलती से किसी गुप्त बात (secret) को उजागर कर देना है।

questionText: Burn the midnight oil
options: To waste fuel during the night
To work or study late into the night
To set fire to a lamp carelessly
To cook food late at night
explanation:
To burn the midnight oil means to work or study late into the night.
उदा. 'Burn the midnight oil' का अर्थ है रात में देर तक जागकर काम करना या पढ़ाई करना।

questionText: At the eleventh hour
options: Just before the deadline of morning
explanation:
At the eleventh hour means at the last possible moment before it is too late.
उदा. 'At the eleventh hour' का अर्थ है बिल्कुल अंतिम समय पर या ऐन वक्त पर।

questionText: Hit the nail on the head
options: To do or say something exactly right
explanation:
To hit the nail on the head means to find the exact answer or do something in the exact right way.
उदा. 'Hit the nail on the head' का अर्थ है किसी बात या समस्या के मूल कारण को बिल्कुल सही पहचानना या सटीक बात कहना।

questionText: Bite the bullet
options: To shoot a weapon during a war
To face a difficult situation with courage
To eat something hard and bitter
explanation:
To bite the bullet means to force yourself to do something difficult or unpleasant, or to be brave in a difficult situation.
उदा. 'Bite the bullet' का अर्थ है किसी कठिन या अप्रिय स्थिति का हिम्मत के साथ सामना करना।

questionText: Under the weather
explanation:
Under the weather means feeling slightly sick, ill, or low in energy.
उदा. 'Under the weather' का अर्थ है अस्वस्थ या तबीयत खराब महसूस करना।

questionText: Cut corners
options: To take a shorter route while driving
To do something perfunctorily to save time or money
To trim the edges of a paper
To reduce the staff in a company
explanation:
To cut corners means to perform tasks hastily or poorly to save time or money.
उदा. 'Cut corners' का अर्थ समय या पैसा बचाने के लिए काम को घटिया तरीके से करना या शॉर्टकट अपनाना है।

questionText: A piece of cake
options: A delicious dessert served at parties
explanation:
A piece of cake refers to a task that is extremely easy to accomplish.
उदा. 'A piece of cake' का अर्थ है कोई ऐसा काम जो बहुत अधिक सरल या आसान हो।

questionText: Break the ice
options: To start a quarrel in a group
To melt frozen water in a glass
To initiate conversation in a social gathering
explanation:
To break the ice means to initiate conversation or relieve tension in a tense or unfamiliar social situation.
उदा. 'Break the ice' का अर्थ है बातचीत की शुरुआत करना या झिझک/तनाव को दूर करना।

questionText: Call it a day
options: To predict the weather for tomorrow
To schedule a meeting for tomorrow
explanation:
To call it a day means to stop working on a task or conclude the day's activities.
उदा. 'Call it a day' का अर्थ है काम बंद करना या आज के लिए कार्य समाप्त घोषित करना।
grammarRule: Idioms related to work and closure

questionText: Through thick and thin
options: During good times and bad times alike
By following strict rules and regulations
Through dense forests and narrow paths
explanation:
Through thick and thin means under all circumstances, no matter how difficult; through good and bad times.
उदा. 'Through thick and thin' का अर्थ है हर परिस्थिति में, चाहे अच्छा समय हो या बुरा समय।

questionText: Select the word that is spelt INCORRECTLY from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Believe'. The rule 'i before e except after c' is applied here.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Believe' है, 'Beleive' गलत है।
grammarRule: Common Spelling Errors (i before e rule)

questionText: Find the word with the correct spelling among the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance'. It is derived from the verb 'maintain'.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Maintenance' है जिसका अर्थ रखरखाव होता है।

questionText: Identify the CORRECTLY spelt word among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Aesthetic' (also spelled esthetic in US, but Aesthetic is standard British/SSC English).
उदा. मानक वर्तनी 'Aesthetic' (सौंदर्यशास्त्रीय) सही है।

questionText: ABOMINATE
explanation:
'Abominate' means to detest or hate intensely. 'Despise' is the most appropriate synonym as it also means to look down on with contempt or hatred.
उदा. 'Abominate' का अर्थ घृणा करना होता है। 'Despise' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ भी नफरत करना है।

questionText: CANDID
explanation:
'Candid' means truthful and straightforward; frank. Therefore, 'frank' is the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Candid' का अर्थ स्पष्टवादी या खुलकर बोलने वाला होता है। इसलिए 'Frank' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. 'Transient' shares the exact same meaning of temporary existence.
उदा. 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है। 'Transient' भी उसी अर्थ को दर्शाता है जो कुछ समय के लिए हो।

questionText: GARRULOUS
explanation:
'Garrulous' means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. 'Talkative' is the direct synonym.
उदा. 'Garrulous' का अर्थ बातूनी होता है। 'Talkative' इसका सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द है।

questionText: INGENUOUS
explanation:
'Ingenuous' means innocent and unsuspecting. 'Guileless' means innocent and without deception, making it the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Ingenuous' का अर्थ भोला-भाला होता है। 'Guileless' का अर्थ भी बिना किसी छल-कपट के होता है।

questionText: LETHARGIC
explanation:
'Lethargic' means affected by lethargy; sluggish and apathy-ridden. 'Sluggish' is the closest synonym.
उदा. 'Lethargic' का अर्थ सुस्त या आलसी होता है। 'Sluggish' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: MITIGATE
explanation:
'Mitigate' means to make less severe, serious, or painful. 'Alleviate' means to lessen severity, making it a synonym.
उदा. 'Mitigate' का अर्थ कम करना या राहत देना है। 'Alleviate' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: OBSTINATE
explanation:
'Obstinate' means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action. 'Stubborn' is its exact synonym.
उदा. 'Obstinate' का अर्थ जिद्दी होता है। 'Stubborn' इसका सही पर्यायवाची शब्द है।

questionText: PRUDENT
explanation:
'Prudent' means acting with or showing care for the future; wise. 'Judicious' means having, showing, or done with good judgement.
उदा. 'Prudent' का अर्थ समझदार या विवेकपूर्ण होता है। 'Judicious' इसका सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द है।

questionText: ZEAL
explanation:
'Zeal' means great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective. 'Enthusiasm' is the direct synonym.
उदा. 'Zeal' का अर्थ जोश या उत्साह होता है। 'Enthusiasm' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the word that is most similar in meaning to the given word: ABANDON
explanation:
Abandon means to completely give up a course of action, a practice, or a person. 'Forsake' is a direct synonym as it also means to abandon or give up.
उदा. Abandon (त्यागना) का पर्यायवाची शब्द Forsake (छोड़ देना या त्यागना) है। Continue, Keep और Cherish इसके विपरीत अर्थ वाले शब्द हैं।

questionText: COPIOUS
explanation:
Copious means abundant in supply or quantity. 'Abundant' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Copious का अर्थ प्रचुर या बहुत अधिक मात्रा में होता है। Abundant इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Scanty, Sparse और Meagre का अर्थ 'कम या अपर्याप्त' होता है।

questionText: DILIGENT
explanation:
Diligent means having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties. 'Industrious' means hardworking, making it the right synonym.
उदा. Diligent का अर्थ मेहनती या परिश्रमी होता है। Industrious इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Lazy, Indolent और Sluggish का अर्थ आलसी होता है।

questionText: Choose the correct synonym for: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time. 'Transient' shares the same meaning of temporary existence.
उदा. Ephemeral का अर्थ क्षणिक या अल्पकालिक होता है। Transient भी इसी अर्थ को दर्शाता है। Permanent, Eternal और Perpetual का अर्थ 'शाश्वत या स्थाई' होता है।

questionText: FRUGAL
explanation:
Frugal means sparing or economical with regard to money or food. 'Thrifty' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Frugal का अर्थ मितव्ययी (कम खर्च करने वाला) होता है। Thrifty इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Extravagant और Wasteful का अर्थ खर्चीला होता है।

questionText: GARRULOUS
explanation:
Garrulous means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. 'Loquacious' is the exact synonym.
उदा. Garrulous का अर्थ बातूनी या बहुत अधिक बोलने वाला होता है। Loquacious इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Taciturn, Reticent और Quiet का अर्थ कम बोलने वाला होता है।

questionText: HOSTILE
explanation:
Hostile means showing or feeling opposition or hostility; unfriendly. 'Aggressive' is the closest in meaning among the options.
उदा. Hostile का अर्थ शत्रुतापूर्ण या आक्रामक होता है। Aggressive इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Friendly, Welcoming और Amiable मित्रवत शब्दों के अंतर्गत आते हैं।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of: OBSTINATE
explanation:
Obstinate means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action. 'Stubborn' is the direct synonym.
उदा. Obstinate का अर्थ जिद्दी या अडिग होता है। Stubborn इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Flexible, Yielding और Compliant इसके विलोम (Antonyms) हैं।

questionText: ZENITH
explanation:
Zenith means the time at which something is most powerful or successful (the highest point). 'Apex' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Zenith का अर्थ शिखर या सर्वोच्च बिंदु होता है। Apex इसका सही पर्यायवाची है। Nadir, Base और Bottom का अर्थ निचला सिरा होता है।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following list
explanation:
The word "accomodate" is misspelled. The correct spelling is "accommodate" with a double 'c' and double 'm' after the short vowel. 
उदाहरण: "She needs to accommodate the guests."
grammarRule: Double consonant after a short vowel

questionText: Choose the misspelled word.
explanation:
"seperate" is misspelled. The correct spelling is "separate" with an 'a' before the 't'. 
उदाहरण: "Please separate the items into two piles."
grammarRule: Correct vowel placement in the root word

questionText: Which of these words is misspelled?
explanation:
"goverment" is missing an 'n'. The correct spelling is "government". 
उदाहरण: "The government announced new policies."

questionText: Which word is spelled wrongly?
explanation:
"wich" is a common misspelling. The correct spelling is "which". 
उदाहरण: "Which book do you prefer?"
grammarRule: Correct root spelling of interrogative pronoun

questionText: break the ice
options: To start a conversation in a hesitant manner
To initiate interaction and ease tension
To physically crack ice into pieces
explanation: The idiom "break the ice" means to initiate conversation or activity that reduces tension. It is used when someone wants to make others feel comfortable.\nउदा. "He told a joke to break the ice at the meeting."

questionText: spill the beans
options: To accidentally drop beans on the floor
To reveal a secret or confidential information
explanation: "Spill the beans" refers to unintentionally disclosing a secret or confidential information. It is commonly used when someone reveals something they were supposed to keep hidden.\nउदा. "He spilled the beans about the surprise party."

questionText: barking up the wrong tree
options: To chase a dog that is not yours
To pursue a mistaken or misguided course of action
To bark loudly in a forest
To search for something that is easily found
explanation: "Barking up the wrong tree" indicates that someone is pursuing a mistaken or incorrect line of reasoning or action. It comes from hunting dogs mistakenly chasing a prey in the wrong tree.\nउदा. "She blamed me for the error, but I’m barking up the wrong tree."

questionText: the ball is in your court
options: You have a basketball in your hand
It is now your turn to take action
You need to play a game of ball
You are responsible for a court case
explanation: "The ball is in your court" means the decision or responsibility now lies with you. It originates from tennis or basketball where the ball is in the opponent’s court.\nउदा. "I’ve done all I can; the ball is in your court."

questionText: cost an arm and a leg
options: To require a lot of physical effort
To need to lose limbs to pay
explanation: "Cost an arm and a leg" means something is very expensive or costly in price. It does not refer to actual limbs.\nउदा. "The new smartphone costs an arm and a leg."

questionText: hit the nail on the head
options: To physically hit a nail with a hammer
To describe something accurately or correctly
To work on a construction site
explanation: "Hit the nail on the head" indicates that one has described a situation or problem accurately. It comes from carpentry where striking the nail directly on the head is ideal.\nउदा. "Your analysis really hit the nail on the head."

questionText: under the weather
options: To be feeling ill or unwell
To be in a rainy environment
To be physically under the weather forecast
To be influenced by global climate
explanation: "Under the weather" means feeling sick or unwell. It is used to express poor health or a slight illness.\nउदा. "I’m feeling under the weather, so I’ll skip the meeting."

questionText: once in a blue moon
explanation: "Once in a blue moon" refers to something happening very rarely. It is used to describe uncommon events.\nउदा. "He visits us once in a blue moon."

questionText: let the cat out of the bag
options: To release a cat from a bag
To sell a bag of cats
explanation: "Let the cat out of the bag" is used when a secret is unintentionally revealed. It indicates disclosure of information that was meant to stay confidential.\nउदा. "He let the cat out of the bag during the interview."

questionText: beat around the bush
options: To avoid giving a direct answer
To cut a bush with a hammer
explanation: "Beat around the bush" means to avoid the main point or to speak indirectly. It is often used when someone is evasive.\nउदा. "Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you want."

questionText: Select the option with the correctly spelled word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' — double 'c' and double 'm'.
सही वर्तनी 'Accommodation' है — इसमें 'c' और 'm' दोनों दोहराए जाते हैं।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word from the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Entrepreneur' — remember the sequence 'pren-eu-r'.
सही वर्तनी 'Entrepreneur' है — इसमें 'pren' के बाद 'eu' और फिर 'r' आता है।

questionText: Find the word that is spelled incorrectly.
explanation:
'Consciance' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Conscience' (silent 'c' before 'i').
'Consciance' गलत है; सही वर्तनी 'Conscience' है जिसमें 'i' से पहले वाला 'c' silent रहता है।

questionText: Choose the word that is spelled correctly.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Pavilion' — single 'l' and ends with '-ion'.
सही वर्तनी 'Pavilion' है — इसमें एक ही 'l' होता है और अंत '-ion' होता है।

questionText: Get out of hand
explanation:
Get out of hand means to become uncontrolled or unmanageable.
उदा. 'Get out of hand' का अर्थ है - स्थिति का नियंत्रण से बाहर हो जाना।

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag
options: To disclose a secret carelessly or by mistake
To release an animal into the wild
explanation:
Let the cat out of the bag means to reveal a secret, often without intending to.
उदा. 'Let the cat out of the bag' का अर्थ है - अनजाने में या गलती से कोई गुप्त बात उजागर कर देना।

questionText: Piece of cake
options: A task that is extremely easy to do
A delicious dessert served at parties
explanation:
Piece of cake means something very easy to accomplish.
उदा. 'Piece of cake' का अर्थ है - बहुत ही आसान काम।

questionText: To spill the beans
options: To drop groceries on the kitchen floor
To plant seeds in a disorganized manner
To reveal a secret carelessly or unintentionally
To waste food items during a feast
explanation:
To spill the beans means to disclose a secret, often by accident.
उदा. 'To spill the beans' का अर्थ किसी गुप्त बात को अनजाने में या गलती से उजागर कर देना होता है।

questionText: Beat around the bush
options: To hit plants with a stick angrily
To avoid talking about the main topic directly
To search for animals hiding in the bushes
To trim the garden plants neatly
explanation:
To beat around the bush means to avoid answering a question or to talk around the main point without coming straight to it.
उदा. 'Beat around the bush' का अर्थ मुद्दे की बात न करके इधर-उधर की बातें करना या घुमा-फिराकर बात करना है।

questionText: To cut corners
options: To take a geometric shortcut on a map
To do something perfunctorily to save time or money
To trim the edges of a paper carefully
To reduce the size of a building design
explanation:
To cut corners means to do something perfunctorily or use cheaper methods to save time or money, often compromising quality.
उदा. 'To cut corners' का अर्थ समय या धन बचाने के लिए शॉर्टकट अपनाना या घटिया तरीका इस्तेमाल करना है।

questionText: Which word is correctly spelled?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **accommodate** with two 'c's and two 'm's. The other options miss one of the double letters.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: accommodate
grammarRule: Rule: Words derived from Latin often contain double consonants (e.g., accommodate, committee).

questionText: Hardly had I / arrived at the station / than the train / left the platform.
explanation:
The conjunction 'hardly' or 'scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। अतः 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper uniform.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb must be 'were' instead of 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर वर्బ్ पास वाले Subject ('students' जो कि plural है) के अनुसार लगेगी, अतः 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: One of my friends / are going to / the United States / next month.
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद Noun तो Plural होता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: She is more taller / than her younger sister / who works in / a multinational bank.
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative, so using 'more' before it is redundant. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative words ('more taller') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। 'taller' अपने आप में comparative है, इसलिए 'more' हटा दें।

questionText: No sooner did / the sun rise / when we set out / on our journey.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'Noesser' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। अतः 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

questionText: Each of the players / were given / a medal for / their outstanding performance.
explanation:
'Each' takes a singular verb. Therefore, replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. वाक्य का subject 'Each' है जो singular है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb 'was' का प्रयोग होगा न कि 'were' का।

questionText: She asked me / that why I was / late for the / important meeting.
explanation:
In indirect speech, interrogative sentences starting with 'wh-' words do not take 'that' before them. Remove 'that'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में Wh-word वाले interrogative sentences से पहले 'that' कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग नहीं होता। अतः 'that' को हटा दें।

questionText: Despite of working / hard, he failed / to secure the / desired rank.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (Note: 'In spite of' is correct, but 'despite' takes no preposition). Remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है ('In spite of' सही होता है)। अतः 'of' को हटा दें।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: The manager as well as / his subordinates / have attended / the annual conference.
explanation:
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', singular). Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो Subjects 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb हमेशा पहले Subject ('The manager') के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had I reached / the office than / it started raining / heavily outside.
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' takes 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। अतः 'than' को 'when' से रिप्लेस करें।

questionText: Neither the principal / nor the teachers / was present / in the meeting. /
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'teachers' is plural, so 'were' should replace 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'teachers' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होना चाहिए।

questionText: The direct or as well as his staff members / were present / at the annual day function / held yesterday. /
options: The director as well as his staff members
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The director' is singular, so 'was' should replace 'were'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता के अनुसार होती है। यहाँ 'The director' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: No sooner did the train / arrive at the station / then the passengers / rushed towards it. /
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when' or 'then'. Replace 'then' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' का नहीं। अतः 'then' के स्थान पर 'than' होगा।

questionText: One of the most important task / in agriculture is / to ensure timely supply / of fertilizers to farmers. /
options: One of the most important task
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' must be replaced by 'tasks'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा बहुवचन संज्ञा (plural noun) का प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसलिए 'task' की जगह 'tasks' होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had I stepped / out of my house when a heavy shower / of rain caught me / and drenched me completely. /
options: out of my house when a heavy shower
explanation:
No error in this sentence. 'Scarcely...when' is correctly used, and tense structures are accurate.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'Scarcely...when' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है और काल (tense) भी सही है।

questionText: Hardly had the mechanic / opened the bonnet / than he spotted / the engine trouble. /
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'than' को 'when' से बदलें।

questionText: Each of the suspected men / were arrested / by the local police / late last night. /
explanation:
'Each of' takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was' to maintain correct subject-verb agreement.
उदा. 'Each of' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया (singular verb) का प्रयोग होता है। 'were' को 'was' से बदलें।

questionText: It is high time / the government takes / strict measures against / corrupt officials. /
explanation:
After 'It is high time' / 'It is time', if a clause follows, it must be in the Simple Past Tense. Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद यदि कोई क्लॉज आए, तो वह Simple Past Tense (V2) में होना चाहिए। 'takes' की जगह 'took' होगा।

questionText: If I was you, / I would not tolerate / such kind of insult / from anyone. /
explanation:
In hypothetical (imaginary) sentences starting with 'If', 'were' is used for all subjects, even singular ones. Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों में 'If' के साथ सभी विषयों के लिए 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग करें।

questionText: He walked as fastly / as he could so that / he would not miss / the morning train. /
explanation:
The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard English. The adverb form of fast is 'fast'. Replace 'fastly' with 'fast'.
उदा. अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता। fast का एडवर्ब रूप 'fast' ही होता है। 'fastly' को 'fast' करें।

questionText: Identify the word with INCORRECT spelling among the following.
explanation:
The misspelled word is 'Acheive'. The correct spelling is 'Achieve' (i before e except after c).
उदा. गलत spelling 'Acheive' है। सही spelling 'Achieve' है ('c' के अलावा 'i' पहले और 'e' बाद में आता है)।
grammarRule: I before E except after C

questionText: Identify the INCORRECT spelt word from the given choices.
explanation:
The misspelled word is 'Seige'. The correct spelling is 'Siege' (follows the 'i before e' rule after 's').
उदा. गलत spelling 'Seige' है। सही spelling 'Siege' है ('s' के बाद 'i' पहले और 'e' बाद में आता है)।

questionText: The research paper was submitted by Dr. Sharma, who had completed her field work in the last quarter, the results were published in the journal, as the research was considered significant.
explanation:
The error is in segment (D): "as the research was considered significant." The word "as" is incorrectly used here; it should be "because" or "since" to explain the reason. Rule: Correct use of subordinating conjunctions. Example: Because the research was significant, it was published.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option D' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
grammarRule: Adverbial clause: Correct use of subordinating conjunctions

questionText: The students were amazed, that the professor would allow them to submit the assignment late, however, they still finished on time, the professor was also pleased.
explanation:
Segment (B) contains the error: "that the professor would allow them to submit the assignment late" is a clause that should be introduced by "when" or "if" instead of "that". Rule: Proper use of subordinating clauses. Example: When the professor allowed them late submission, they finished on time.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option B' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The committee has decided to extend the dead line the members were informed via email, and the project is expected to be completed by next month, the client will be notified there after.
explanation:
Segment (C) has an error: "and the project is expected to be completed by next month" uses a comma splice; it should be connected with a semicolon or a coordinating conjunction. Rule: Avoiding comma splices. Example: The committee has decided to extend the deadline; the project is expected to be completed by next month.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option C' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The new policy will be implemented after the meeting, the employees will receive training, the benefits will be increased, the company will see a rise in productivity.
explanation:
Segment (B) contains the error: "the employees will receive training" is a non‑restrictive relative clause but it is missing the relative pronoun "who". Rule: Correct use of relative clauses. Example: The employees, who will receive training, will improve their skills.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option B' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The chair man who has served for ten years, is known for his strict policies, the board decided to hire a new manager, this decision was welcomed by all.
explanation:
Segment (C) has a comma splice: "the board decided to hire a new manager" should be joined with a semicolon or a conjunction. Rule: Avoiding comma splices. Example: The chairman, who has served for ten years, is known for his strict policies; the board decided to hire a new manager.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option C' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She was praised for her creativity, the project was successful, she also received a promotion, the company thanked her for her dedication.
explanation:
Segment (B) contains the error: "the project was successful" is a subject‑verb agreement mistake in context; it should be part of a compound sentence with "and". Rule: Correct coordination of clauses. Example: She was praised for her creativity, and the project was successful.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option B' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The report indicates a decline in sales, due to the economic down turn, the company is implementing new strategies, the sales figures are expected to recover next quarter.
explanation:
Segment (D) has an error: "the sales figures are expected to recover next quarter" should use "will" for future expectation. Rule: Use of future tense with modal verbs. Example: The sales figures will recover next quarter.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option D' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The manager explained that the budget had been approved, the team was excited, however, the project was delayed, the stakeholders were concerned.
explanation:
Segment (C) has a comma splice: "however, the project was delayed" should be connected with a semicolon or a coordinating conjunction. Rule: Avoiding comma splices. Example: The manager explained that the budget had been approved; however, the project was delayed.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option C' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The new policy will be effective from next month, employees will be required to complete training, the benefits will increase, the policy has already been approved by the board.
explanation:
Segment (B) contains an error: "employees will be required to complete training" is missing the article "the" before "employees". Rule: Use of definite article before plural nouns when specific. Example: The employees will be required to complete training.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Option B' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Break the ice
options: To break ice in a lake
explanation:
The idiom "Break the ice" means to initiate conversation in a social setting.
उदा. "कई दोस्त मिलने के बाद मैंने बातचीत शुरू करने के लिए आइस तोड़ दिया."

questionText: A blessing in disguise
explanation:
"A blessing in disguise" refers to something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good.
उदा. "जॉब छोड़ना एक परेशानी थी, पर बाद में नई नौकरी मिली, यह एक 'ब्लेसिंग इन डिस्गाइज़' थी."

questionText: Hit the books
options: To put books on a table
explanation:
"Hit the books" means to start studying seriously.
उदा. "समीक्षा के लिए मुझे किताबों पर हाथ डालना होगा."

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag
options: Release a cat from a bag
Hide a cat inside a bag
Keep a cat in a bag
explanation:
"Let the cat out of the bag" means to disclose a secret.
उदा. "उसने राज़ खोल दिया, और सब लोग चौंक गए."

questionText: On the fence
explanation:
"On the fence" refers to being uncertain or undecided.
उदा. "वह दोनों विकल्पों पर फंसा हुआ है, अभी निर्णय नहीं लिया."

questionText: Bite the bullet
explanation:
"Bite the bullet" means to face a painful or difficult situation with courage.
उदा. "उसे परीक्षा की चिंता थी, पर उसने बाइट द बुलेट किया."

questionText: Cost an arm and a leg
explanation:
"Cost an arm and a leg" indicates something is very expensive.
उदा. "नई कार का किराया एक हाथ और पैर का खर्चा है."

questionText: Under the weather
explanation:
"Under the weather" refers to feeling unwell or sick.
उदा. "आज मैं थोड़ा बीमार महसूस कर रहा हूँ, शायद मैं घर पर रहूँ."

questionText: The ball is in your court
options: The ball is in the court
It is your turn to act
explanation:
"The ball is in your court" indicates that the next action or decision is up to you.
उदा. "मैंने प्रस्ताव दिया, अब गेंद आपकी कोर्ट में है."

questionText: Keep your fingers crossed
explanation:
"Keep your fingers crossed" is a wish for good luck or a positive result.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: The committee has reached a decision on the new policy.
The committee had reached a decision on the new policy.
The committee will reached a decision on the new policy.
The committee are reaching a decision on the new policy.
explanation:
The correct verb form for a collective noun in English is *are* when the emphasis is on the members acting individually, but here the action is a single decision. Therefore the correct form is *has reached* (present perfect) – Option A.

हिंदी: "committee" (समूह) के लिए यहाँ एक ही निर्णय लिया गया है, अतः क्रिया को *has reached* (present perfect) होना चाहिए।
grammarRule: Subject–verb agreement with collective noun; correct tense

questionText: In the following sentence, He / has been working / in this company / since five years.
explanation:
Rule: 'Since' is used with a point of time (since 2019, since Monday), while 'For' is used with a period of time (for five years, for two months).
उदा. 'Since' का प्रयोग निश्चित समय बिंदु के साथ होता है, जबकि 'For' का प्रयोग समयावधि के साथ होता है। यहाँ 'five years' एक अवधि है, इसलिए 'for' का प्रयोग होगा।
grammarRule: Since vs For - Since + Point of Time; For + Period of Time

questionText: In the following sentence, Neither of the students / have completed / their assignments / before the dead line
explanation:
Rule: 'Neither of' is followed by a singular verb because it refers to 'neither one nor the other' taken singly.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद singular verb का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' होगा।
grammarRule: Neither of + Singular Verb (Neither of the boys has / Neither of the boys have - formal singular)

questionText: In the following sentence, The sceneries / of Kashmir / are so beautiful / that they attract tourists from all over the world.
explanation:
Rule: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and remains the same in both singular and plural form. It is never used as 'sceneries'.
उदा. 'Scenery' एक अगणनीय संज्ञा है, इसका बहुवचन नहीं बनता। यहाँ 'The sceneries' के स्थान पर 'The scenery' होगा।
grammarRule: Uncountable Nouns - Scenery, furniture, luggage, information, advice (no plural form)

questionText: In the following sentence, If I / was a bird, / I would fly / across the blue sky.
explanation:
Rule: In conditional sentences with 'If' expressing an unreal/unlikely condition (Subjunctive mood), 'were' is used for all subjects (I, he, she, it).
उदा. असंभव/काल्पनिक शर्त वाले वाक्यों में 'If + I/He/She/It + were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' नहीं। यहाँ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' होगा।
grammarRule: Subjunctive Mood - If I were / If he were (use 'were', not 'was')

questionText: In the following sentence, Each of the boys / were given / a certificate / for their outstanding performance.
explanation:
Rule: 'Each of' is always followed by a singular verb because 'each' emphasizes individuality.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद हमेशा singular verb का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' होगा।
grammarRule: Each of + Singular Verb (Each of the students is / Each of the boys was)

questionText: In the following sentence, He is / one of the best player / who has ever played / for the Indian cricket team.
explanation:
Rule: After 'one of the', the noun should always be in plural form because it refers to one among many.
उदा. 'One of the' के बाद संज्ञा हमेशा बहुवचन (plural) में आती है। यहाँ 'player' के स्थान पर 'players' होगा।
grammarRule: One of the + Plural Noun (one of the best players / one of the tallest buildings)

questionText: In the following sentence, The teacher asked / the students to open / their books on / page number thirty.
explanation:
Rule: When referring to a specific page number, the article 'the' is used before the number (the + page + number), or simply 'page thirty' is fine, but 'page number thirty' is incorrect. The correct usage is 'page thirty' or 'page no. 30'.
उदा. पृष्ठ संख्या बताते समय 'page thirty' या 'page no. 30' कहा जाता है, 'page number thirty' नहीं।
grammarRule: Page/Chapter/Class + Number (no 'number' word) - page five, chapter three, class ten

questionText: In the following sentence, She is / more smarter / than her elder sister / in the family.
explanation:
Rule: 'Smarter' is already a comparative degree. Double comparatives ('more + comparative') are grammatically incorrect.
उदा. Comparative degree में 'more' और '-er' दोनों का एक साथ प्रयोग गलत है। यहाँ 'more smarter' के स्थान पर 'smarter' होगा।
grammarRule: No Double Comparative - Use either -er/more, not both (more better → better; more smarter → smarter)

questionText: In the following sentence, The police / has arrested / the smugglers / near the border area.
explanation:
Rule: 'Police' is a collective noun and is always treated as plural, taking a plural verb.
उदा. 'Police' सामूहिक संज्ञा (collective noun) है और इसके साथ हमेशा बहुवचन क्रिया (plural verb) का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'has' के स्थान पर 'have' होगा।
grammarRule: Police/Cattle/People/Poultry - Always Plural Verb (Police have, Cattle are, People say)

questionText: In the following sentence, I prefer / tea than / coffee / in the morning.
explanation:
Rule: 'Prefer' is always followed by 'to', not 'than'. Prefer A to B (पसंद करना)।
उदा. 'Prefer' के बाद 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। वाक्य होगा - I prefer tea to coffee. यहाँ 'than' के स्थान पर 'to' होगा।
grammarRule: Prefer + to (not than) - I prefer tea to coffee / She prefers reading to writing

questionText: ABOMINATE
explanation:
Abominate means to detest or hate intensely. Its antonym is 'Adore', which means to love and respect deeply.
उदा. Abominate का अर्थ घृणा करना होता है, जिसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'Adore' (अत्यधिक प्रेम करना) है।

questionText: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is 'Permanent', meaning lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.
उदा. Ephemeral का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है, जिसका विलोम 'Permanent' (स्थाई) है।

questionText: LUGUBRIOUS
explanation:
Lugubrious means looking or sounding sad and dismal. Its antonym is 'Cheerful', meaning noticeably happy and optimistic.
उदा. Lugubrious का अर्थ उदास होता है, और 'Cheerful' का अर्थ प्रसन्नचित्त होता है।

questionText: NADIR
explanation:
Nadir means the lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization. Its antonym is 'Zenith', the time at which something is most powerful or successful (highest point).
उदा. Nadir का अर्थ सबसे निचला स्तर होता है, और 'Zenith' का अर्थ सर्वोच्च बिंदु होता है।

questionText: OBSTINATE
explanation:
Obstinate means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion. Its antonym is 'Flexible', meaning ready to change or adapt.
उदा. Obstinate का अर्थ जिद्दी होता है, जिसका विलोम 'Flexible' (लचीला) है।

questionText: PARSIMONIOUS
explanation:
Parsimonious means unwilling to spend money or use resources; stingy. Its antonym is 'Generous', showing a readiness to give more of something than is strictly necessary.
उदा. Parsimonious का अर्थ कंजूस होता है, जबकि 'Generous' का अर्थ उदार होता है।

questionText: QUERULOUS
explanation:
Querulous means complaining in a rather petulant or whining manner. Its antonym is 'Contented', meaning happy and at ease.
उदा. Querulous का अर्थ शिकायत करने वाला होता है, और 'Contented' का अर्थ संतुष्ट होता है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word: BENEVOLENT
explanation:
Benevolent means well meaning and kindly. Its antonym is malevolent, which means having or showing a wish to do evil to others.
उदा. Benevolent का अर्थ 'दयाlu या परोपकारी' होता है। इसका विपरीतार्थी शब्द Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण) है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate antonym of the given word: ABUNDANT
explanation:
Abundant means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. Its antonym is scanty, meaning small or insufficient in quantity or amount.
उदा. Abundant का अर्थ प्रचुर मात्रा में होता है। इसका विलोम Scanty (अल्प या कम) है।

questionText: CANDID
explanation:
Candid means truthful and straightforward; frank. Its antonym is evasive, meaning avoiding commitment or self-revelation, especially by responding ambiguously.
उदा. Candid का अर्थ स्पष्टवादी होता है। इसके विपरीत Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला) इसका सही विलोम है।

questionText: Find the antonym of the given word: MITIGATE
explanation:
Mitigate means to make less severe, serious, or painful. Its antonym is aggravate, which means to make a problem, injury, or offense worse or more serious.
उदा. Mitigate का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को कम करना होता है। इसका विपरीत Aggravate (बदतर बनाना या बढ़ाना) है।

questionText: Choose the correct antonym for the word: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is permanent, meaning lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely.
उदा. Ephemeral का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है। इसका विलोम Permanent (स्थायी) है।

questionText: FASTIDIOUS
explanation:
Fastidious means very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. Its antonym is slovenly, meaning messy or careless in appearance or habits.
उदा. Fastidious का अर्थ अत्यधिक तुनकमिजाज या साफ-सफाई का ध्यान रखने वाला होता है। इसका विपरीत Slovenly (अव्यवस्थित या लापरवाह) है।

questionText: GREGARIOUS
explanation:
Gregarious means fond of company; sociable. Its antonym is reclusive, meaning avoiding the company of other people; solitary.
उदा. Gregarious का अर्थ मिलनसार होता है। इसका विपरीत Reclusive (एकांतवासी) है।

questionText: Choose the antonym of the given word: NADIR
explanation:
Nadir means the lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization. Its antonym is zenith, the time at which something is most powerful or successful (highest point).
उदा. Nadir का अर्थ सबसे निचला स्तर होता है। इसका विलोम Zenith (शिखर या उच्चतम बिंदु) है।

questionText: OSTENTATIOUS
explanation:
Ostentatious means characterized by pretentious or showy display; designed to impress. Its antonym is plain, meaning not decorated or elaborate; simple or ordinary.
उदा. Ostentatious का अर्थ दिखावटी होता है। इसका विपरीत Plain (साधा या सरल) है।

questionText: Choose the antonym of the given word: PRUDENT
explanation:
Prudent means acting with or showing care for the future. Its antonym is rash, meaning displaying or proceeding from a lack of careful consideration of the possible consequences of an action.
उदा. Prudent का अर्थ समझदार और दूरदर्शी होता है। इसका विलोम Rash (उतावला या बिना सोचे-समझे काम करने वाला) है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: ABANDON
explanation:

questionText: CANDID
explanation:

questionText: Find the synonym of the given word: DILIGENT
explanation:

उदा. Diligent (परिश्रमी) का सही पर्यायवाची 'Industrious' (मेहनती) है।

questionText: EPHEMERAL
explanation:

questionText: Choose the correct synonym of: GARRULOUS
explanation:
