उदा. Garrulous का अर्थ बहुत बातूनी होता है, अतः 'Loquacious' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: HOSTILE
explanation:
Hostile means showing or feeling opposition or dislike; unfriendly or aggressive. Thus, 'Aggressive' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण) का सही पर्यायवाची 'Aggressive' (आक्रामक) है।

questionText: Find the synonym of the given word: METICULOUS
explanation:
Meticulous means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. 'Scrupulous' is its synonym.
उदा. Meticulous (अतिसावधान/सूक्ष्मता से काम करने वाला) का पर्यायवाची 'Scrupulous' होता है।

questionText: Choose the appropriate synonym of: NOVEL
explanation:
When used as an adjective, novel means new or unusual in an interesting way. 'Original' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Novel (नवीन या अनोखा) का अर्थ 'Original' (मौलिक/नया) होता है।

questionText: PRUDENT
explanation:
Prudent means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. 'Judicious' means having, showing, or done with good judgement, making it a synonym.
उदा. Prudent (समझदार/दूरदर्शी) का सही पर्यायवाची 'Judicious' (विवेकपूर्ण) है।

questionText: Find the synonym of the given word: ZENITH
explanation:
Zenith means the time at which something is most powerful or successful (the peak). 'Summit' represents the highest point.
उदा. Zenith (शिखर/शीर्ष) का अर्थ 'Summit' (शिखर) होता है। Nadir इसका विलोम है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: ABOMINATE
explanation:
'Abominate' means to detest or hate intensely. 'Despise' is the correct synonym as it also means to feel contempt or a deep revulsion for something.
उदा. 'Abominate' का अर्थ घृणा करना होता है। 'Despise' इसका सबसे सटीक पर्यायवाची है, जिसका अर्थ भी नफरत करना है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: CANDID
explanation:
'Candid' means truthful and straightforward; frank. Therefore, 'Frank' is the exact synonym.
उदा. 'Candid' का अर्थ स्पष्टवादी और ईमानदार होता है। अतः 'Frank' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. 'Transient' is a direct synonym meaning passing quickly or impermanent.
उदा. 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है। 'Transient' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है जिसका अर्थ भी थोड़े समय के लिए रहने वाला होता है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: GARRULOUS
explanation:
'Garrulous' means excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters. 'Loquacious' is the exact synonym.
उदा. 'Garrulous' का अर्थ बहुत बातूनी होता है। 'Loquacious' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: METICULOUS
explanation:
'Meticulous' means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. 'Scrupulous' is its apt synonym.
उदा. 'Meticulous' का अर्थ बहुत सावधान और बारीकी से काम करने वाला होता है। 'Scrupulous' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: NOXIOUS
explanation:
'Noxious' means harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant. Thus, 'Harmful' is the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Noxious' का अर्थ हानिकारक या विषैला होता है। 'Harmful' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: PRUDENT
explanation:
'Prudent' means acting with or showing care for the future; wise or judicious. 'Wise' is the correct match.
उदा. 'Prudent' का अर्थ समझदार और दूरदर्शी होता है। 'Wise' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: QUERULOUS
explanation:
'Querulous' means complaining in a petulant or whining manner. 'Complaining' is the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Querulous' का अर्थ बात-बात पर शिकायत करने वाला होता है। 'Complaining' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: SALUBRIOUS
explanation:
'Salubrious' means health-giving; healthy. 'Wholesome' matches this meaning correctly as it refers to conducive to or promoting moral or physical well-being.
उदा. 'Salubrious' का अर्थ स्वास्थ्यवर्धक होता है। 'Wholesome' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: ZENITH
explanation:
'Zenith' means the time at which something is most powerful or successful; the peak. 'Summit' is the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Zenith' का अर्थ सर्वोच्च बिंदु या शिखर होता है। 'Summit' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
The word "plentiful" means having a large quantity, which is the same as "abundant".
उदाहरण: "The harvest was plentiful," यानी बहुतायत थी।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
"Diligent" means hardworking and careful in doing something. "Careful" captures this sense of meticulous effort.
उदाहरण: "She was careful in studying," यानी वह मेहनत से पढ़ रही थी।

questionText: sudden
explanation:
"Abrupt" signifies something that happens quickly and unexpectedly, just like "sudden".
उदाहरण: "The abrupt change surprised everyone," यानी अचानक बदलाव ने सभी को चौंकाया।

questionText: courageous
explanation:
"Brave" means having or showing courage, which is the same as "courageous".
उदाहरण: "The brave soldier fought bravely," यानी साहसी सैनिक ने बहादुरी से लड़ाई की।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
"Precise" denotes exactness and attention to detail, similar to "meticulous".
उदाहरण: "The precise description was clear," यानी सटीक विवरण स्पष्ट था।

questionText: conspicuous
explanation:
"Obvious" means easily noticeable, which is the same as "conspicuous".
उदाहरण: "The obvious error was caught," यानी स्पष्ट त्रुटि पकड़ ली गई।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
"Kind" indicates a friendly or generous nature, which aligns with "benevolent".
उदाहरण: "The kind act helped many," यानी दयालु कर्म ने बहुतों की मदद की।

questionText: reliable
explanation:
"Dependable" means trustworthy and reliable, matching the definition of "reliable".
उदाहरण: "The dependable service was appreciated," यानी विश्वसनीय सेवा की सराहना की गई।

questionText: tangible
explanation:
"Visible" indicates something that can be perceived, which is the same as "tangible".
उदाहरण: "The visible evidence was conclusive," यानी स्पष्ट साक्ष्य निर्णायक थे।

questionText: A person who is unable to pay their debts
explanation:
Insolvent refers to a person who lacks the financial ability to pay their debts.
उदा. 'Insolvent' उस व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जो अपने कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ होता है (दिवालिया)।

questionText: One who walks on ropes
explanation:
A funambulist is an acrobatic person who performs on a tightrope or stretched rope.
उदा. 'Funambulist' उस व्यक्ति को कहा जाता है जो रस्सी पर चलना जानता है या रस्सी पर करतब दिखाता है।

questionText: Fear of closed spaces
explanation:
Claustrophobia is an extreme or irrational fear of confined places.
उदा. 'Claustrophobia' बंद स्थानों से लगने वाले अत्यधिक और तर्कहीन डर को कहा जाता है।

questionText: An establishment where wild animals are kept for exhibition
explanation:
A zoo is a facility where animals are kept within enclosures for public exhibition.
उदा. 'Zoo' (चिड़ियाघर) वह स्थान है जहाँ जंगली जानवरों को प्रदर्शनी के लिए रखा जाता है।

questionText: A person who possesses many talents
explanation:
Versatile describes someone able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.
उदा. 'Versatile' बहुमुखी प्रतिभा वाले व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जो कई तरह के काम आसानी से कर सके।

questionText: Murder of a king
explanation:
Regicide is the action of killing a king or monarch.
उदा. 'Regicide' किसी राजा या शासक की हत्या को कहा जाता है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
The word "diligent" means showing care and effort. "Meticulous" also denotes careful attention to detail, making it the closest synonym.
उदाहरण: "दृढ़निश्चयी काम करने वाला" = "Meticulous".

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
As an adjective, "elaborate" means highly detailed or intricate. "Intricate" shares this sense.
उदाहरण: "जटिल डिज़ाइन" = "Intricate".

questionText: replicate
explanation:
"Replicate" means to copy or duplicate. "Duplicate" is the closest synonym in this context.
उदाहरण: "परीक्षण को दोहराना" = "Duplicate".

questionText: scarce
explanation:
"Scarce" means not plentiful or rare. Thus "Rare" is the appropriate synonym.
उदाहरण: "दुर्लभ वस्तु" = "Rare".

questionText: prevalent
explanation:
"Prevalent" means widespread or common. "Widespread" is the closest synonym.
उदाहरण: "व्यापक रूप से फैलना" = "Widespread".

questionText: facilitate
explanation:
"Facilitate" means to make easier or simplify. "Simplify" is the correct synonym.
उदाहरण: "सरलीकृत करना" = "Simplify".

questionText: oblivious
explanation:
"Oblivious" means unaware or not conscious of something. "Unaware" matches this meaning.
उदाहरण: "अनजान रहना" = "Unaware".

questionText: arduous
explanation:
"Arduous" denotes a task that is hard or requires much effort. "Difficult" is the closest synonym.
उदाहरण: "कष्टसाध्य कार्य" = "Difficult".

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
"Meticulous" means extremely attentive to detail. "Precise" conveys the same sense.
उदाहरण: "सटीक विवरण" = "Precise".

questionText: candid
explanation:
"Candid" means honest and straightforward. "Honest" is the appropriate synonym.
उदाहरण: "ईमानदार टिप्पणी" = "Honest".

questionText: An establishment where clothes are washed, ironed, etc.
explanation:
A place where washing and ironing of clothes is done is called a laundry.
उदा. वह स्थान जहाँ कपड़े धोए और इस्त्री किए जाते हैं, उसे 'Laundry' (धोबीघाट / लॉन्ड्री) कहते हैं।

questionText: Capable of being understood in either of two or more possible senses
explanation:
Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning is ambiguous.
उदा. कोई बात जिसके एक से अधिक अर्थ निकल सकते हों और जो अस्पष्ट हो, उसे 'Ambiguous' (अनेकार्थी / संदिग्धास्पद) कहते हैं।

questionText: Find the word with the correct spelling among the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant' (l-i-e-u-t-e-n-a-n-t). Pronounced as 'leftenant' but spelt differently.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Lieutenant' है। इसका उच्चारण अलग होता है लेकिन वर्तनी में 'lieuten-' आता है।

questionText: Select the option that correctly spells the given word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Renaissance' (the revival of art and literature).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Renaissance' है जिसमें 'ai' और 'ss' का सही संयोजन होता है।

questionText: sanguine
explanation:
The word "sanguine" means optimistic or hopeful.
उदाहरण: "He remained sanguine about the future."

questionText: cognizant
explanation:
"Cognizant" means aware or knowledgeable.
उदाहरण: "She was cognizant of the risks involved."

questionText: laconic
explanation:
"Laconic" means using very few words; concise.
उदाहरण: "His laconic reply left us puzzled."

questionText: perfunctory
explanation:
"Perfunctory" means done without real interest or effort.
उदाहरण: "He gave a perfunctory nod."

questionText: obstinate
explanation:
"Obstinate" means stubborn or unyielding.
उदाहरण: "His obstinate refusal shocked everyone."

questionText: cacophony
explanation:
"Cacophony" refers to a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds.
उदाहरण: "The street was filled with cacophony of horns."

questionText: magnanimous
explanation:
"Magnanimous" means generous and forgiving.
उदाहरण: "Her magnanimous gesture impressed all."

questionText: recalcitrant
explanation:
"Recalcitrant" means stubbornly refusing to obey.
उदाहरण: "The recalcitrant student was disciplined."

questionText: serendipity
explanation:
"Serendipity" refers to a fortunate accident or pleasant surprise.
उदाहरण: "It was pure serendipity that we met."

questionText: ephemeral
explanation:
"Ephemeral" means lasting for a very short time.
उदाहरण: "The beauty of the sunset was fleeting and ephemerally."

questionText: sudden
explanation:
A synonym is a word that has the same or nearly the same meaning as another word.
उदा. "sudden" का समानार्थी शब्द "immediate" है।

questionText: beneficial
explanation:
Synonyms express similar meanings. "Beneficial" means helpful or advantageous.
उदा. "beneficial" का समानार्थी शब्द "advantageous" है।

questionText: fragrant
explanation:
Synonyms share a common sense. "Fragrant" denotes a pleasant smell.
उदा. "fragrant" का समानार्थी "sweet-smelling" है।

questionText: intrepid
explanation:
Synonyms are words with the same or almost same meaning. "Intrepid" means courageous or fearless.
उदा. "intrepid" का समानार्थी "fearless" है।

questionText: perplexed
explanation:
A synonym shares the same sense. "Perplexed" means puzzled or confused.
उदा. "perplexed" का समानार्थी शब्द "confused" है।

questionText: candid
explanation:
Synonyms express essentially the same meaning. "Candid" denotes honesty or openness.
उदा. "candid" का समानार्थी "honest" है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Synonyms convey the same sense. "Abundant" means plentiful or rich in quantity.
उदा. "abundant" का समानार्थी "plentiful" है।

questionText: melancholy
explanation:
A synonym shares the same or almost same meaning. "Melancholy" means sad or gloomy.
उदा. "melancholy" का समानार्थी शब्द "sad" है।

questionText: ascend
explanation:
Synonyms express the same or very similar meaning. "Ascend" means to climb or go up.
उदा. "ascend" का समानार्थी "climb" है।

questionText: oblivious
explanation:
Synonyms share the same sense. "Oblivious" means unaware or not conscious of something.
उदा. "oblivious" का समानार्थी शब्द "unaware" है।

questionText: Select the word with the INCORRECT spelling.
explanation:
The word 'Grammer' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'Grammar', ending with '-ar' instead of '-er'.
उदा. 'Grammer' गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'Grammar' है जिसके अंत में '-ar' आता है।

questionText: Select the option that spells the CORRECT word.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Millennium', which features double 'l' and double 'n' (l-l, n-n).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Millennium' है जिसमें डबल 'l' और डबल 'n' आते हैं।

questionText: Cost an arm and a leg
options: To suffer a severe physical injury
explanation:
If something costs an arm and a leg, it is extremely expensive.
उदा. 'Cost an arm and a leg' का अर्थ बहुत अधिक महंगा होना (बहुत ज्यादा कीमत चुकाना) होता है।

questionText: Once in a blue moon
options: An event that occurs every month
explanation:
Once in a blue moon means an event that happens very infrequently or rarely.
उदा. 'Once in a blue moon' का अर्थ कोई ऐसी घटना जो बहुत ही दुर्लभ (कभी-कभार) घटित हो।

questionText: Capable of being broken or damaged easily
explanation:
Brittle refers to something hard but easily broken or shattered.
उदा. जो वस्तु आसानी से टूट या बिखर जाए, उसे 'Brittle' (भंगुर) कहते हैं।

questionText: An inscription on a tombstone in memory of the person buried there
explanation:
An epitaph is a short text honoring a deceased person, inscribed on a tombstone.
उदा. समाधि या कब्र के पत्थर पर मृत व्यक्ति की याद में लिखा गया लेख 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) कहलाता है।

questionText: A person who hates human kind and avoids human society
explanation:
A misanthrope is a person who dislikes humankind and avoids society.
उदा. मानव जाति से घृणा करने वाला और समाज से दूर रहने वाला व्यक्ति 'Misanthrope' कहलाता है।

questionText: A government by the rich and wealthy class
explanation:
Plutocracy is a society or a system of government ruled by the wealthy.
उदा. धनवानों या अमीर वर्ग द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली सरकार को 'Plutocracy' (धनिक तंत्र) कहते हैं।

questionText: That which cannot be corrected or reformed
explanation:
Incorrigible describes a person or their behavior that is not able to be changed or reformed.
उदा. जिसे सुधारा न जा सके, उसे 'Incorrigible' (असुधार्य) कहा जाता है।

questionText: A life history written by oneself
explanation:
An autobiography is an account of a person's life written by that person.
उदा. किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा खुद अपने जीवन का इतिहास लिखना 'Autobiography' (आत्मकथा) कहलाता है।

questionText: A place where government or public records are kept
explanation:
An archive is a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.
उदा. वह स्थान जहाँ सरकारी या ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड रखे जाते हैं, 'Archive' (अभिलेखागार) कहलाता है।

questionText: Study of birds
explanation:
Ornithology is the scientific study of birds.
उदा. पक्षियों के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को 'Ornithology' (पक्षी विज्ञान) कहा जाता है।

questionText: That which cannot be corrected
explanation:
Incorrigible describes a bad habit or person that is not able to be changed or reformed.
उदा. Incorrigible का अर्थ है जिसे सुधारा न जा सके (असंशोधनीय)।

questionText: A person who loves mankind
explanation:
A philanthropist seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by the generous donation of money to good causes.
उदा. Philanthropist वह व्यक्ति है जो मानवता से प्रेम करता है और दान-पुण्य करता है।

questionText: Study of the origin and history of words
explanation:
Etymology is the study of the historical development of words and their meanings.
उदा. Etymology शब्दों की उत्पत्ति और उनके इतिहास का अध्ययन है।

questionText: A government by a small group of people
explanation:
Oligarchy is a form of government in which a small group of people holds all power.
उदा. Oligarchy (अल्पतंत्र) वह शासन प्रणाली है जिसमें कुछ ही लोगों के हाथ में सत्ता होती है।

questionText: A person who speaks many languages
explanation:
A polyglot is someone who knows or is able to use several languages.
उदा. Polyglot वह व्यक्ति होता है जो कई भाषाएं बोल या जान सकता है (बहुभाषी)।

questionText: A person who believes in the existence of God
explanation:
A theist is a person who believes in the existence of a god or gods.
उदा. Theist (आस्तिक) वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास रखता है।

questionText: Break the ice
options: To start a conversation in a social setting
To physically break a frozen surface
explanation:
This idiom means to initiate conversation or activity in a relaxed manner to overcome initial awkwardness.
हिंदी उदाहरण: "आज रात के कार्यक्रम में आध्यात्मिक नेता ने शुरुआत में हल्की-फुलकी बात कर के माहौल को हल्का किया।"

questionText: Bite the bullet
options: To accept a difficult or unpleasant task bravely
To physically bite a bullet as a test
To use a bullet for self-defense
explanation:
It indicates courageously facing a painful or challenging situation without hesitation.
हिंदी उदाहरण: "साक्षात्कार में कठिन सवालों का सामना करते हुए उसने खुद को शांत किया और बोल्ड उत्तर दिया।"

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag
options: To allow a cat to escape from a bag

questionText: VIRTUE
explanation:

questionText: Choose the word that is most nearly the opposite in meaning to the given word: ABUNDANT
explanation:
'Abundant' means existing or available in large quantities; plentiful. Its antonym is 'Scanty', which means small or insufficient in quantity.

questionText: Choose the correct antonym for the word: TRANSITORIERS (TRANSITORY)
explanation:

questionText: OBSTINATE

questionText: BENEVOLENT
explanation:
'Benevolent' means well meaning and kindly. Its antonym is 'Malevolent', which means having or showing a wish to do evil to others.

questionText: Choose the most appropriate antonym of: GREGARIOUS
explanation:

उदा. 'Gregarious' का अर्थ मिलनसार होता है। इसका विलोम 'Reclusive' (एकांतप्रिय या संन्यासी प्रवृत्ति का) है।

questionText: LACONIC
explanation:

questionText: Find the correct antonym for the word: ZENITH
explanation:

उदा. 'Zenith' का अर्थ सर्वोच्च बिंदु या चोटी होता है। इसका विलोम 'Nadir' (सबसे निचला बिंदु) है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate antonym of: DUE (DUPLICITY)

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to ___ awareness about road safety.
explanation:
To-infinitive 'to' is followed by the base form of the verb (V1). Here, 'to spread' is correct.
उदा. Infinitives (to + V1) में verb की पहली फॉर्म का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: She is proficient ___ French and can translate this document easily.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is always followed by the preposition 'in' when talking about skills or languages.
उदा. 'Proficient' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'in' का प्रयोग होता है (जैसे- proficient in English)।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house ___ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के जोड़े के रूप में हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not achieve the desired ___.
explanation:
The determiner 'the' followed by an adjective 'desired' requires a singular or plural noun. Here, 'result' fits the context as a countable noun.
उदा. Article 'the' और adjective के बाद noun का प्रयोग होता है। Context के अनुसार 'result' सही है।

questionText: The manager asked the employee to explain the reason ___ he was late.
explanation:
When 'reason' is mentioned, we use 'why' to introduce the clause explaining the cause, avoiding redundant use of 'reason why because'.
उदा. 'Reason' के बाद clause को जोड़ने के लिए 'why' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Amit is accustomed ___ working for long hours under pressure.
explanation:
The phrase 'accustomed to' means being familiar with something, and it is followed by a gerund (V+ing).
उदा. 'Accustomed' के साथ fixed preposition 'to' आता है और उसके बाद gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Had the captain informed us earlier, we ___ attended the strategy meeting.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure: If + Past Perfect (Had + V3), Subject + would have + V3.
उदा. Third conditional में यदि वाक्य 'Had + Subject + V3' से शुरू हो, तो दूसरे clause में 'would have + V3' आता है।

questionText: The teacher advised the students to refrain ___ making noise in the corridor.
explanation:
The verb 'refrain' is always followed by the preposition 'from' + gerund.
उदा. 'Refrain' (दूर रहना या बचना) के साथ हमेशा preposition 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: She spoke in such a low voice that she was barely ___.
explanation:
Contextual vocabulary: 'Audible' means loud enough to be heard. Since she spoke in a low voice, she was barely audible.
उदा. 'Audible' का अर्थ है जो सुनने योग्य हो। कम आवाज़ में बोलने के कारण वह मुश्किल से सुनाई दे रही थी।

questionText: The manager _____ the proposal before submitting it to the board of directors.
explanation:
'Look over' means to examine something carefully. Here, the manager examined the proposal before submission.
उदा. 'Look over' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ की सावधानीपूर्वक जांच करना होता है। प्रस्ताव को जमा करने से पहले उसकी जांच की गई।

questionText: She is proficient _____ mathematics and solves complex problems with ease.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is always followed by the preposition 'in'.
उदा. विशेषण 'proficient' (निपुण) के साथ हमेशा पूर्वसर्ग 'in' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Had the authorities taken timely action, the disaster _____ prevented.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence in inverted form (Had + subject + V3). The main clause must take 'would/could/might + have + V3'.
उदा. यह थर्ड कंडीशनल वाक्य है। मुख्य खंड में 'could have been' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: The committee members were _____ in their decision, as no one opposed the new policy.
explanation:
We need an adjective here to describe the committee members. 'Unanimous' means fully in agreement.
उदा. यहाँ समिति के सदस्यों का वर्णन करने के लिए विशेषण चाहिए। 'Unanimous' का अर्थ 'सर्वसम्मति से' होता है।

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not _____ his point across to the audience.
explanation:
'Get across' is a phrasal verb meaning to successfully communicate an idea or message.
उदा. 'Get across' एक फ्रेजल वर्ब है जिसका अर्थ अपने विचार या संदेश को सफलतापूक समझाना होता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students _____ present in the class room when I arrived.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' is correct.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। 'students' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: The startup company made a huge profit by capitalizing _____ the new market trends.
explanation:
The phrasal verb/idiomatic expression is 'capitalize on', meaning to use a situation to gain an advantage.
उदा. 'Capitalize on' का सही उपयोग होता है, जिसका अर्थ किसी स्थिति का लाभ उठाना है।

questionText: His speech was so _____ that many people in the audience were moved to tears.
explanation:
'Poignant' means evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret, fitting the context of being moved to tears.
उदा. 'Poignant' का अर्थ मार्मिक या दिल को छू लेने वाला होता है, जो आंसुओं तक पहुँचाने के संदर्भ में उपयुक्त है।

questionText: The police _____ investigating the robbery case for over a week now.
explanation:
'Police' is treated as a plural noun in English grammar, and 'for over a week now' indicates the present perfect continuous tense.
उदा. अंग्रेजी व्याकरण में 'Police' को बहुवचन संज्ञा माना जाता है, और समय अवधि के कारण 'have been' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Which one of the following words is the antonym of “abundant”?
explanation:

उदा. वह पानी की बड़ी मात्रा है, पर वह पानी बहुत कम है।

questionText: Choose the antonym of “beneficial”.
explanation:
‘Beneficial’ means ‘helpful’ or ‘advantageous’. The opposite is ‘harmful’, meaning ‘causing damage’. 
उदा. यह दवा लाभकारी है, पर यह दवा हानिकारक हो सकती है।

questionText: What is the antonym of “curious”?
explanation:
‘Curious’ denotes a strong desire to know. Its opposite is ‘indifferent’, meaning lacking interest. 
उदा. वह जिज्ञासु है, पर वह उदासीन है।

questionText: Select the word that is the antonym of “diligent”.
explanation:
‘Diligent’ means hardworking or careful. The opposite is ‘lazy’, meaning unwilling to work. 
उदा. वह परिश्रमी है, पर वह आलसी है।

questionText: Which word is the antonym of “generous”?
explanation:
‘Generous’ indicates giving freely. Its opposite is ‘stingy’, meaning unwilling to give. 
उदा. वह उदार है, पर वह कंजूस है।

questionText: Choose the antonym of “elevate”.
explanation:
‘Elevate’ means to raise or lift up. The opposite is ‘lower’, meaning to bring down. 
उदा. उसे ऊँचा उठाया गया, पर उसे नीचे गिराया गया।

questionText: What is the antonym of “fragile”?
explanation:
‘Fragile’ means easily broken. The opposite is ‘robust’, meaning strong and sturdy. 
उदा. वह नाज़ुक है, पर वह मजबूत है।

questionText: Select the word that is the antonym of “honest”.
explanation:
‘Honest’ means truthful. Its opposite is ‘dishonest’, meaning lying or deceitful. 
उदा. वह ईमानदार है, पर वह बेईमान है।

questionText: Which of the following is the antonym of “immerse”?
explanation:
‘Immerse’ means to put or dip into a liquid. Its opposite is ‘expose’, meaning to bring out or make visible. 
उदा. उसे पानी में डुबोया गया, पर उसे बाहर निकाला गया।

questionText: Choose the word that is the antonym of “melancholy”.
explanation:
‘Melancholy’ means sad or gloomy. The opposite is ‘joyful’, meaning full of happiness. 
उदा. वह उदास है, पर वह खुश है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Antonym of 'abundant' is 'scarce'. Rule: Antonyms are words that express opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: 'abundant' का विपरीत 'scarce' होता है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
The antonym of 'meticulous' is 'hasty'. Rule: Words with contrasting meanings are antonyms.
उदाहरण: 'meticulous' का विपरीत 'hasty' है।

questionText: resilient
explanation:
The opposite of 'resilient' is 'fragile'. Rule: Antonyms express opposing characteristics.
उदाहरण: 'resilient' का विपरीत 'fragile' है।

questionText: obscure
explanation:
Opposite of 'obscure' is 'transparent'. Rule: Antonyms represent opposite states of clarity.
उदाहरण: 'obscure' का विपरीत 'transparent' है।

questionText: pioneering
explanation:
The antonym of 'pioneering' is 'traditional'. Rule: Antonyms contrast in innovation.
उदाहरण: 'pioneering' का विपरीत 'traditional' है।

questionText: generous
explanation:
The opposite of 'generous' is 'selfish'. Rule: Antonyms show opposing attitudes towards giving.
उदाहरण: 'generous' का विपरीत 'selfish' है।

questionText: subtle
explanation:
Opposite of 'subtle' is 'obvious'. Rule: Antonyms express contrasting levels of subtlety.
उदाहरण: 'subtle' का विपरीत 'obvious' है।

questionText: fortify
explanation:
The antonym of 'fortify' is 'weaken'. Rule: Antonyms depict opposite actions.
उदाहरण: 'fortify' का विपरीत 'weaken' है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Opposite of 'diligent' is 'indolent'. Rule: Antonyms reflect contrasting work ethics.
उदाहरण: 'diligent' का विपरीत 'indolent' है।

questionText: integrity
explanation:
The opposite of 'integrity' is 'corruption'. Rule: Antonyms represent opposing moral qualities.
उदाहरण: 'integrity' का विपरीत 'corruption' है।

explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that express opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: Abundant (पूरा) – Scarce (कम).

questionText: diligent
explanation:

उदाहरण: Diligent (मेहनती) – Lazy (आलसी).

questionText: chaotic
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that express opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: Chaotic (अव्यवस्थित) – Orderly (सुव्यवस्थित).

questionText: scarce
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that convey opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: Scarce (कम) – Abundant (प्रचुर).

questionText: opposite
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that express opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: Opposite (विपरीत) – Same (समान).

questionText: hasty
explanation:
Rule: Antonyms are words that convey opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: Hasty (जल्दी) – Deliberate (सावधानीपूर्वक).

questionText: generous
explanation:

explanation:
