questionText: Identify the correct spelling.
explanation:

उदाहरण: 'Please separate the components before packing.'

questionText: Find the word that is INCORRECTLY spelt.
explanation:
The incorrect word is 'Guage'. The correct spelling is 'Gauge' where 'u' comes after 'a'.
उदा. गलत वर्तनी 'Guage' है। सही वर्तनी 'Gauge' (माप) होती है जिसमें 'a' के बाद 'u' आता है।

questionText: Select the correct spelling among the choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Rendezvous' (a meeting at an agreed time and place, of French origin).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Rendezvous' है जिसका अर्थ निर्धारित मुलाकात स्थल होता है (फ्रांसीसी मूल का शब्द)।

questionText: The government has launched a massive vaccination drive to ______ the spread of the virus.
explanation:
The context requires a verb meaning to restrain or control an undesirable thing. 'Curb' means to restrain or control.
उदा. 'Curb' का अर्थ रोकना या नियंत्रित करना है, जो वायरस के प्रसार को रोकने के संदर्भ में बिल्कुल सही बैठता है।

questionText: She has a great passion ________ classical music and spends hours practicing every day.
explanation:
The noun 'passion' is conventionally followed by the preposition 'for'.
उदा. संज्ञा 'passion' के बाद उचित प्रीपोजिशन 'for' का प्रयोग होता है (passion for something)।

questionText: If I ________ the king of this country, I would eradicate poverty within a year.
explanation:
In subjunctive mood expressing an imaginary or unreal condition in the present, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक शर्त (Subjunctive mood) को व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employee to explain the reason ________ he was absent yesterday.
explanation:
After 'the reason', the relative adverb 'why' is used to introduce the clause explaining the cause. (Avoid using 'because' redundantly after 'reason').
उदा. 'the reason' के बाद कारण बताने के लिए सापेक्ष क्रियाविशेषण 'why' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not achieve success because his strategy was ________.
explanation:
The sentence indicates a contrast; despite hard work, failure occurred because the strategy had defects. 'Flawed' means having blemishes or defects.
उदा. असफलता का कारण यह था कि रणनीति में दोषपूर्ण (flawed) थी, जिससे कड़ी मेहनत के बावजूद सफलता नहीं मिली।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ present in the class room.
explanation:
According to the rule of subject-verb agreement, when two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' is correct.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर क्रिया अपने सबसे नज़दीकी कर्ता (students) के अनुसार बहुवचन (were) होगी।

questionText: The committee reached a consensus ________ the new environmental policy after a long debate.
explanation:
The noun 'consensus' is followed by the preposition 'on' when referring to the topic of agreement.
उदा. किसी विशेष विषय पर आम सहमति के लिए 'consensus on' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Had the captain guided the team properly, they ________ the match easily.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure: 'Had + subject + V3' in the if-clause takes 'would have + V3' in the main clause.
उदा. यह तृतीय शर्त (Third Conditional) का वाक्य है, जिसमें 'Had + V3' के साथ मुख्य खंड में 'would have + V3' आता है।

questionText: Despite his best efforts to conceal his emotions, a tear escaped and trickled ________ his cheek.
explanation:
Use 'down' to indicate movement from a higher to a lower point on a surface, such as tears on a cheek.
उदा. गालों पर आंसुओं के नीचे की ओर बहने के लिए 'down' प्रीपोजिशन का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employee to ________ the proposal and report back by tomorrow.
explanation:
To 'look through' means to read something quickly or examine it thoroughly. Here, examining a proposal requires this phrasal verb.
उदा. किसी प्रस्ताव या दस्तावेज को सरसरी तौर पर पढ़ने या जांचने के लिए 'look through' फ्रेजल वर्ब का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee members could not reach a consensus because each of them ________ different views.
explanation:
Pronouns like 'each', 'everyone', 'everybody' take a singular verb. Hence, 'has' is the correct choice.
उदा. 'Each' के साथ हमेशा सिंगुलर वर्ब का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए यहाँ 'has' सही उत्तर है।

questionText: Had the driver been more vigilant, the fatal accident ________.
explanation:
In third conditional sentences expressing past hypothetical situations, the structure is 'Had + subject + V3, subject + would/could/might + have + V3 (passive)'.
उदा. पास्ट की असंभव शर्त वाले वाक्यों (Third Conditional) में 'would have been + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: His speech was so ________ that the audience was spellbound for over an hour.
explanation:
'Eloquent' means fluent or persuasive in speaking, which explains why the audience was spellbound.
उदा. 'Eloquent' का अर्थ होता है प्रभावशाली या वक्ता कला में निपुण, जिससे श्रोता मंत्रमुग्ध हो गए।

questionText: Scarcely had she stepped outside the house ________ a heavy downpour began.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'scarcely' or 'hardly' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), whereas 'no sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The newly inaugurated bridge is ________ to heavy commercial vehicles during peak hours.
explanation:
Vehicles are 'restricted' (limited or kept out) to or from certain areas. 'Restricted to' is the standard collocation.
उदा. भारी वाहनों के लिए पुल पर प्रवेश सीमित करने हेतु 'restricted to' का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has announced a new scheme to ________ the economic growth in rural sectors.
explanation:
To 'stimulate' means to encourage or spur growth. The context requires a positive action for economic growth.
उदा. ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा देने (stimulate) के लिए नई योजना शुरू की गई है।

questionText: No sooner did the principal enter the class room ________ all the students stood up in respect.
explanation:
'No sooner' is strictly paired with the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का जोड़ा प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The scientist's groundbreaking theory was met with ________ skepticism by his peers before it was verified experimentally.
explanation:
'Widespread skepticism' means general or broad doubt among many people before proof was provided.
उदा. प्रयोग द्वारा सिद्ध होने से पहले वैज्ञानिक के सिद्धांत को लेकर लोगों में व्यापक संदेह ('widespread skepticism') था।

questionText: The committee has decided ___ a new policy for staff welfare.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use the infinitive form after the verb 'decided' when expressing a future plan.
उदाहरण: उन्होंने अगले वर्ष की शुरुआत में नई नीति लागू करने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: She has been ___ the project since March.
explanation:
Rule in English: After 'has been', use present participle (verb+ing) to indicate an ongoing action.
उदाहरण: वह मार्च से परियोजना पर काम कर रही है।

questionText: I am looking forward ___ meeting you at the conference.
explanation:
Rule in English: After the phrase 'looking forward', use the infinitive marker 'to'.
उदाहरण: मैं सम्मेलन में आपसे मिलने के लिए उत्सुक हूँ।

questionText: The manager's decision was made ___ the input of all department heads.
explanation:
Rule in English: The preposition 'by' is used to indicate the agent who performed an action.
उदाहरण: निर्णय सभी विभाग प्रमुखों के इनपुट द्वारा लिया गया।

questionText: He has a habit of ___ late in the evenings.
explanation:
Rule in English: After 'habit of', use the gerund form (verb+ing).
उदाहरण: उसके पास शाम को देर से रहने की आदत है।

questionText: The report was submitted ___ the dead line
explanation:
Rule in English: 'By' is used to indicate that an action is completed on or before a specific time.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट समय सीमा से पहले जमा की गई।

questionText: The students were asked ___ the questions before the examination.
explanation:
Rule in English: After the verb 'asked', use the infinitive 'to answer' to express the purpose of the request.
उदाहरण: छात्रों से परीक्षा से पहले प्रश्नों का उत्तर देने के लिए कहा गया।

questionText: The new software will ___ significantly improve data processing speed.
explanation:
Rule in English: After the modal verb 'will', use the base form of the verb.
उदाहरण: नया सॉफ्टवेयर डेटा प्रोसेसिंग गति को काफी सुधार करेगा।

questionText: If you ___ the instructions, you will get the best results.
explanation:
Rule in English: In an 'if' clause with a simple present tense, use the base form of the verb.
उदाहरण: यदि आप निर्देशों का पालन करते हैं, तो आपको सर्वोत्तम परिणाम मिलेंगे।

questionText: The singer's voice was so ___ that every one stopped to listen.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use an adjective before 'so' to modify a noun; the adverb form is not used here.
उदाहरण: गायक की आवाज़ इतनी शानदार थी कि सभी सुनने के लिए रुक गए।

questionText: At one
options: To be completely confused and not know what to do
explanation:
At one's wits' end means to be so worried, confused, or annoyed that you do not know what to do next.
उदा. 'At one's wits' end' का अर्थ है बुद्धि समाप्त होना या अत्यधिक परेशान होकर समझ न पाना कि आगे क्या करें।
grammarRule: Idioms related to mental state and confusion

questionText: Bite your tongue
options: To stop yourself from saying something
To suffer from a dental injury
explanation:
To bite your tongue means to make a conscious effort to stop yourself from saying something that you want to say.
उदा. 'Bite your tongue' का मतलब खुद को कुछ बोलने से रोकना ताकि विवाद न बढ़े।

questionText: Don
options: Do not complain about something that cannot be undone
Do not cry when you get hurt
Do not worry about minor kitchen accidents
explanation:
Don't cry over spilt milk means there is no use in worrying about things that have already happened and cannot be changed.
उदा. 'Don't cry over spilt milk' का अर्थ है जो हो चुका और बदला नहीं जा सकता, उसके लिए पछतावा या रोना नहीं चाहिए।
grammarRule: Proverbial idiom reflecting irreversibility of past actions

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word from the options below.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Difference' (single 'e' after ff). 
उदा. 'Difference' शब्द में 'ff' के बाद 'e' आता है, 'diffeerence' गलत है।
grammarRule: Common suffix and root spelling errors

questionText: Choose the word with the correct spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Privilege' (ends in -lege, contains no 'd'). 
उदा. 'Privilege' के अंत में '-lege' आता है और इसमें कोई 'd' नहीं होता।

questionText: Select the correct spelling for the given option.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Guarantee' (ends in -ee). 
उदा. 'Guarantee' के अंत में double 'ee' आता है।

questionText: To add insult to injury
options: To apologize after making a mistake
To apply medicine on a wound
To make a bad situation even worse
explanation:
To add insult to injury means to act in a way that makes a bad or obnoxious situation even worse.
उदा. 'To add insult to injury' का अर्थ है - जले पर नमक छिड़कना यानी किसी बुरी स्थिति को और अधिक बदतर बना देना।

questionText: Break a leg
options: To injure oneself during a performance
To run very fast in a race
To fail miserably in an endeavor
explanation:
To 'break a leg' is an idiom used to wish performers (like actors or musicians) good luck before a show.
उदा. 'Break a leg' का प्रयोग मुख्य रूप से कलाकारों को नाटक या प्रस्तुति से पहले 'शुभकामनाएं' (Good luck) देने के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: Through the grapevine
options: By means of an informal network of gossip or rumor
explanation:
To hear something 'through the grapevine' means to learn about something through informal means, especially by rumor or gossip.
उदा. 'Through the grapevine' का अर्थ है - अफवाहों या अनौपचारिक बातचीत के माध्यम से कोई खबर मिलना।

questionText: Select the correct spelt word.
explanation:
'Environment' is correctly spelt, containing the silent 'n' sound before 'ment'.
उदा. 'Environment' की वर्तनी सही है, जिसमें 'ment' से पहले 'n' आता है।
grammarRule: Silent letters and middle syllable retention

questionText: by the skin of one
explanation:
It indicates that something was achieved narrowly, just barely.
उदाहरण: वह परीक्षा पास कर ही सका, "by the skin of his teeth"।

questionText: once in a blue moon
explanation:
It refers to something that happens very infrequently.
उदाहरण: वह केवल "once in a blue moon" ही अपने दोस्तों से मिलता है।

questionText: have a lot on one
options: to have many tasks to do
to have a lot of food
explanation:
It means having many responsibilities or tasks to handle.
उदाहरण: उसके पास बहुत सारे काम हैं, "a lot on his plate"।

questionText: spill the beans
explanation:
It means to disclose a secret or hidden information unintentionally.
उदाहरण: उसने गलती से राज़ "spill the beans" कर दिया।

questionText: take with a grain of salt
explanation:
It means to view something skeptically or not take it at face value.
उदाहरण: उसकी बातों को "take with a grain of salt" करना चाहिए।

questionText: Select the incorrectly spelled word from the given options.
explanation:
'Occurence' is misspelled; the correct spelling is 'Occurrence' (double 'c' and double 'r').
उदा. 'Occurence' गलत है; सही वर्तनी 'Occurrence' है जिसमें दो बार 'c' और दो बार 'r' आता है।

questionText: Choose the word with incorrect spelling.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **mysterious**. The suffix **-ious** is used for adjectives that mean 'full of'.
उदाहरण: "रहस्यमय" के लिए **mysterious** सही है।

questionText: Which of the following is spelled wrong?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **philosophy**. The letter **l** after **philo** is not capitalised.
उदाहरण: "दार्शनिकता" के लिए **philosophy** सही है।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the following list
explanation:
Correct spelling: **definitely**. The word contains the letter ‘i’ before ‘n’ and ends with ‘ly’. 
Rule: The correct sequence is 'i' before 'n' in words ending with *‑ly*.
Hindi: 'definitely' का सही वर्तनी है, क्योंकि इसमें ‘i’ ‘n’ से पहले आता है।
grammarRule: i before n in words ending with -ly

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled term used in business to refer to a large corporation.
explanation:
Correct spelling: **corporation**. The word contains double ‘p’ and double ‘r’. 
Rule: In words derived from Latin *corporatio*, the consonant ‘p’ is duplicated following the short vowel.
Hindi: 'corporation' का सही वर्तनी है, क्योंकि इसमें ‘p’ और ‘r’ दोनों दुगने हैं।
grammarRule: Double consonant after short vowel in Latin-derived words

questionText: Select the correctly spelled adjective describing a person who is quick to form opinions.
explanation:
Correct spelling: **judgmental**. The American spelling drops the ‘e’ after ‘g’. 
Rule: In *judgment*, the ‘e’ is omitted before the ‘t’. 
Hindi: 'judgmental' का सही वर्तनी है, क्योंकि इसमें ‘e’ नहीं आता।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word that means 'to provide with a necessary supply'.
explanation:
Correct spelling: **supply**. The word has one ‘p’ and one ‘l’. 
Rule: The suffix *‑ly* in *supply* is spelled with ‘l’ only once.
Hindi: 'supply' का सही वर्तनी है, क्योंकि इसमें ‘p’ और ‘l’ केवल एक बार आते हैं।

questionText: A sound that cannot be heard
explanation:
'Inaudible' describes a sound that is unable to be heard. 
उदा. 'Inaudible' (श्रव्य नहीं / जिसे सुना न जा सके) वह आवाज़ है जो कानों तक न पहुंच सके।

questionText: in spite of the fact that
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution removes redundancy.
उदाहरण: ‘in spite of the fact that’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘despite’ है।

questionText: in the event of
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution simplifies the phrase.
उदाहरण: ‘in the event of’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘if’ है।

questionText: at the time of
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution removes extra words.
उदाहरण: ‘at the time of’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘when’ है।

questionText: with reference to
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution streamlines expression.
उदाहरण: ‘with reference to’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘regarding’ है।

questionText: in order to
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution makes sentences concise.
उदाहरण: ‘in order to’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘to’ है।

questionText: as far as
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution removes verbosity.
उदाहरण: ‘as far as’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘regarding’ है।

questionText: as per
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution replaces long prepositional phrases.
उदाहरण: ‘as per’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘according to’ है।

questionText: in the presence of
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution eliminates redundant words.
उदाहरण: ‘in the presence of’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘with’ है।

questionText: with regard to
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution simplifies the phrase.
उदाहरण: ‘with regard to’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘regarding’ है।

questionText: in the absence of
explanation:
Rule in English: One‑word substitution removes extra prepositions.
उदाहरण: ‘in the absence of’ का एक शब्द में अनुवाद ‘without’ है।

questionText: A place where animals are slaughtered for consumption as food
explanation:
An abattoir is a slaughterhouse where animals are killed for meat.
उदा. वह स्थान जहाँ खाने के लिए पशुओं को काटा जाता है, उसे 'Abattoir' (कसाईखाना) कहते हैं।
grammarRule: French origin word commonly asked in SSC exams.

questionText: Incapable of being defeated or subdued
explanation:
Invincible means too powerful to be defeated or overcome.
उदा. जिसे हराया न जा सके, उसे 'Invincible' (अजेय) कहते हैं।
grammarRule: Prefix 'In-' means not + 'vincere' meaning to conquer.

questionText: A group of ships sailing together
explanation:
A fleet is a company of ships or war vessels operating together.
उदा. जहाजों के समूह को 'Fleet' (बेड़ा) कहा जाता है।
grammarRule: Collective noun specific to naval ships.

questionText: An inscription on a tombstone in memory of the person who has died
explanation:
An inscription written on a grave or tomb in memory of the deceased is an epitaph.
उदा. कब्र या समाधि पर मृतक की याद में लिखे गए शब्दों या लेख को 'Epitaph' (समाधि-लेख) कहते हैं।

questionText: Words written on the tomb of a person
explanation:
A phrase or form of words written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone, is an epitaph.
उदा. किसी व्यक्ति की मृत्यु के पश्चात उसकी कब्र पर लिखे जाने वाले शब्दों को 'Epitaph' कहते हैं।

questionText: A person who can use both hands equally well
explanation:
Able to use the right and left hands equally well is ambidextrous.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति अपने दोनों हाथों का समान रूप से उपयोग कर सकता है, उसे 'Ambidextrous' (उभयहस्त) कहते हैं।

questionText: The process of converting raw materials into finished products is known as ________.
explanation:
Use a noun to replace a descriptive phrase. Here "manufacturing" succinctly means "the process of converting raw materials into finished products".
उदाहरण: "उत्पादन" का उपयोग "कच्चे माल को तैयार उत्पादों में बदलने की प्रक्रिया" को दर्शाने के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: The ability to maintain a calm and balanced state of mind under pressure is referred to as ________.
explanation:
A single word can encapsulate a complex description. "Composure" means "calmness and self‑control".
उदाहरण: "शांति" का मतलब "चिंता रहित और संतुलित मन" है।

questionText: The act of expressing a desire or wish for some thing to happen in the future is called ________.
explanation:
A single word can replace a longer description. "Aspiration" means "a strong desire or wish".
उदाहरण: "आकांक्षा" का उपयोग "भविष्य में कुछ होने की इच्छा" के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: A legal act that grants authority to a person or organization to act on behalf of another is termed ________.
explanation:
The word "proxy" replaces the long phrase "a legal act that grants authority...".
उदाहरण: "प्रतिनिधि" का मतलब "किसी को अधिकार देने वाला कानूनी दस्तावेज" है।

questionText: The practice of acquiring data from a large group of people for research purposes is called ________.
explanation:
"Survey" is a concise word for "the practice of gathering information from many people".
उदाहरण: "सर्वेक्षण" का उपयोग "सभी लोगों से डेटा एकत्र करने" के लिए होता है।

questionText: A person who devises and implements new ideas, especially in business, is known as a ________.
explanation:
The word "entrepreneur" captures the entire phrase "a person who starts and runs a business".
उदाहरण: "उद्यमी" का मतलब "व्यवसाय शुरू करने वाला व्यक्ति" है।

questionText: The state of being free from any doubt or fear is referred to as ________.
explanation:
"Confidence" succinctly means "the absence of doubt or fear".
उदाहरण: "आत्मविश्वास" का अर्थ "संदेह और भय से मुक्त होना" है।

questionText: The process of removing impurities from a substance to make it pure is called ________.
explanation:
"Purification" replaces the long phrase "removing impurities to make it pure".
उदाहरण: "शुद्धीकरण" का उपयोग "शुद्ध बनाने की प्रक्रिया" के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: A brief announcement or statement in a news paper is called a ________.
explanation:
"Editorial" is a single word that summarizes "a short statement or opinion piece".
उदाहरण: "समाचारपत्र में संक्षिप्त घोषणा" को "एडिटोरियल" कहा जाता है।

questionText: The scientific examination of the structure and composition of a material is known as ________.
explanation:
"Analysis" is a concise word for "examining structure and composition".
उदाहरण: "विश्लेषण" का अर्थ "सामग्री की संरचना और रचना की जाँच" है।

questionText: TRANSITORI
explanation:
'Transitory' means lasting for a short time; temporary. Its antonym is 'Permanent', which means lasting or remaining unchanged for a indefinitely long time.
उदा. 'Transitory' का अर्थ क्षणिक या कम समय रहने वाला होता है, और इसका विपरीत 'Permanent' (स्थाई) है।

questionText: MELANCHOLY
explanation:
'Melancholy' means a feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause. Its antonym is 'Cheerful', which means noticeably happy and optimistic.
उदा. 'Melancholy' का अर्थ उदासी या विषाद होता है, जबकि 'Cheerful' का अर्थ प्रफुल्लित या खुशमिजाज होता है।

questionText: COVERT
explanation:
'Covert' means not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret. Its antonym is 'Overt', which means done or shown openly; not secret or hidden.
उदा. 'Covert' का अर्थ गुप्त या छिपा हुआ होता है, जबकि 'Overt' का अर्थ खुला हुआ या प्रत्यक्ष होता है।

questionText: LACONIC
explanation:
Laconic means using very few words. Verbose means using or expressed in more words than needed.
उदा. Laconic का अर्थ अल्पभाषी (कम बोलने वाला) होता है, और Verbose का अर्थ बातूनी या जरूरत से ज्यादा शब्दों का इस्तेमाल करने वाला होता है।

questionText: The committee was ________ to the new proposal.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single word to replace a phrase like ‘doubtful about’ or ‘questioning’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘skeptical’ का अर्थ है ‘संदेहपूर्ण’, जो ‘new proposal पर संदेह होना’ को एक शब्द में व्यक्त करता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long descriptive phrase

questionText: She was ________ after receiving the award.
explanation:
Rule in English: Choose a word that conveys a strong emotion instead of a phrase like ‘very excited and thrilled’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘ecstatic’ का मतलब ‘बेवजह उत्साहित’ है, जो ‘उपलब्धि के बाद बहुत खुश’ को एक शब्द में दर्शाता है।
grammarRule: Single word to express intense emotion

questionText: The new policy was met with ________ from the employees.
explanation:
Rule in English: A single word can replace a lengthy description like ‘lack of interest or concern’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘apathy’ का अर्थ है ‘उदासीनता’, जो ‘employees की ओर से कोई रुचि न दिखना’ को एक शब्द में बताता है।
grammarRule: Word substitution for a phrase describing attitude

questionText: He has always been ________ about taking risks.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a descriptive phrase such as ‘careful and wary’ with a single adjective. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘cautious’ का मतलब ‘सावधान’ है, जो ‘जोखिम लेने में सतर्क रहने’ को एक शब्द में व्यक्त करता है।

questionText: The project was ________ after the final audit.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a word that encapsulates the meaning of a long phrase like ‘brought to an end’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘terminated’ का अर्थ है ‘समाप्त किया गया’, जो ‘अंतिम ऑडिट के बाद परियोजना समाप्त हो गया’ को एक शब्द में दर्शाता है।
grammarRule: Word substitution for ‘brought to an end’

questionText: The manager’s decision was ________ to the team’s morale.
explanation:
Rule in English: Choose a single word that replaces a descriptive phrase like ‘depressing’ or ‘demoralizing’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘disheartening’ का मतलब है ‘हतोत्साहित करने वाला’, जो ‘कर्मचारी मनोबल पर नकारात्मक प्रभाव’ को एक शब्द में बताता है।

questionText: The students were ________ during the exam.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a word that replaces a phrase such as ‘full of nervousness and worry’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘anxious’ का मतलब है ‘चिंतित’, जो ‘परीक्षा के दौरान घबराहट से भरे’ को एक शब्द में व्यक्त करता है।

questionText: The discussion was ________ after the new evidence was presented.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long descriptive phrase like ‘not leading to any definite conclusion’ with a single word. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘inconclusive’ का अर्थ है ‘निर्णायक न होने वाला’, जो ‘नई साक्ष्य के बाद चर्चा का कोई ठोस निष्कर्ष न निकलना’ को एक शब्द में बताता है।
grammarRule: Word for lack of definite conclusion

questionText: He was ________ after hearing the news of his promotion.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single word to replace a phrase like ‘extremely happy and delighted’. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘elated’ का मतलब है ‘उत्साहित’, जो ‘प्रमोशन की खबर के बाद बहुत खुश’ को एक शब्द में व्यक्त करता है।

questionText: The new software was ________ to the company's operations.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a lengthy description such as ‘causing a major change’ with one word. 
उदा. Hindi explanation: ‘transformative’ का अर्थ है ‘परिवर्तनकारी’, जो ‘सॉफ्टवेयर के कारण कंपनी के संचालन में बड़ा बदलाव’ को एक शब्द में बताता है।

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **vivid**.
explanation:
Antonyms are words with opposite meaning. For example, the word 'vivid' means bright and highly colorful; its antonym 'dull' means not bright or lacking in color.
उदाहरण: 'vivid' का मतलब चमकीला होता है, जबकि 'dull' का मतलब धुंधला या फीका होता है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **scarce**.
explanation:
The word 'scarce' means not abundant. Its antonym is 'plentiful', which means there is an ample amount.
उदाहरण: 'scarce' का मतलब कम या अल्प है, जबकि 'plentiful' का मतलब प्रचुर या बहुतायत से भरा हुआ है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **predict**.
explanation:
To 'predict' is to say what will happen before it happens. The word that means to cause a surprise, i.e., to do something unexpected, is 'surprise'.
उदाहरण: 'predict' का मतलब भविष्यवाणी करना है, जबकि 'surprise' का मतलब आश्चर्यचकित करना या अप्रत्याशित घटना करना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **strict**.
explanation:
The word 'strict' denotes firmness and rigidity in rules. Its opposite, 'lenient', means permissive or forgiving.
उदाहरण: 'strict' का मतलब सख्त या कड़ाई से नियम पालन करना है, जबकि 'lenient' का मतलब नरम या दयालु होना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **frugal**.
explanation:
To be frugal means to be economical or careful with money. The word that means spending excessively is 'extravagant'.
उदाहरण: 'frugal' का मतलब बचत करना या कम खर्च करना है, जबकि 'extravagant' का मतलब अत्यधिक खर्च करना या विलासिता का पालन करना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **fragile**.
explanation:
The word 'fragile' describes something that can break easily. Its opposite, 'sturdy', means strong and able to withstand pressure.
उदाहरण: 'fragile' का मतलब नाज़ुक या टूटने योग्य है, जबकि 'sturdy' का मतलब मजबूत या टिकाऊ है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **rapid**.
explanation:
The word 'rapid' means happening quickly. Its antonym 'slow' means taking a long time to happen.
उदाहरण: 'rapid' का मतलब तेज़ी से चलना या जल्दी से होना है, जबकि 'slow' का मतलब धीमा या धीरे-धीरे होना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **generous**.
explanation:
Being generous means giving freely. The word that means keeping all for oneself is 'selfish'.
उदाहरण: 'generous' का मतलब उदार या देने वाला है, जबकि 'selfish' का मतलब स्वार्थी या केवल अपने लिए काम करना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **sudden**.
explanation:
The word 'sudden' means occurring quickly and unexpectedly. Its opposite, 'gradual', means happening slowly and over time.
उदाहरण: 'sudden' का मतलब अचानक या बिना किसी पूर्वसूचना के है, जबकि 'gradual' का मतलब धीरे-धीरे या क्रमिक रूप से विकसित होना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: Choose the antonym of the word **humble**.
explanation:
The word 'humble' means modest or not proud. Its antonym 'arrogant' means overly proud or boastful.
उदाहरण: 'humble' का मतलब विनम्र या नम्र होना है, जबकि 'arrogant' का मतलब घमंडी या अतिशय आत्मविश्वासी होना है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation – words with opposite meaning

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Abundant means plentiful. Its opposite is scarce.
उदाहरण: Abundant (बहुतायत) का विपरीत शब्द scarce (कमी) है।

questionText: hefty
explanation:
Hefty means heavy or large. The opposite is light.
उदाहरण: Hefty (भारी) का विपरीत light (हल्का) है।

questionText: cautious
explanation:
Cautious means careful. Its opposite is rash.
उदाहरण: Cautious (सावधान) का विपरीत rash (बेहिसाब) है।

questionText: benefit
explanation:
Benefit means an advantage or profit. Its opposite is detriment.
उदाहरण: Benefit (लाभ) का विपरीत detriment (हानि) है।

questionText: sparse
explanation:
Sparse means thinly spread. Its opposite is dense.
उदाहरण: Sparse (दुर्लभ) का विपरीत dense (घना) है।

questionText: frugal
explanation:
Frugal means economical. Its opposite is extravagant.
उदाहरण: Frugal (संकुचित) का विपरीत extravagant (विलासपूर्ण) है।

questionText: succinct
explanation:
Succinct means brief and concise. Its opposite is verbose.
उदाहरण: Succinct (संक्षिप्त) का विपरीत verbose (विस्तृत) है।

questionText: reliable
explanation:
Reliable means dependable. Its opposite is unreliable.
उदाहरण: Reliable (विश्वसनीय) का विपरीत unreliable (अविश्वसनीय) है।

questionText: obscure
explanation:
Obscure means unclear or hidden. Its opposite is clear.
उदाहरण: Obscure (धुंधला) का विपरीत clear (स्पष्ट) है।

questionText: optimistic
explanation:
Optimistic means hopeful. Its opposite is pessimistic.
उदाहरण: Optimistic (आशावादी) का विपरीत pessimistic (निराशावादी) है।

questionText: A hot potato
options: A controversial situation that is difficult to handle
explanation:
A hot potato refers to a problem, situation, etc. that is difficult to deal with and causes a lot of disagreement.
उदा. 'A hot potato' एक ऐसी विवादास्पद या कठिन स्थिति को कहते हैं जिससे निपटना मुश्किल हो।

questionText: A stitch in time saves nine
options: Preventing small problems early saves bigger problems
explanation:
Rule in English: It means that fixing a small problem right away prevents it from becoming a larger issue later.
उदा. Hindi explanation: समय पर सिलाई नौ बचाती है, यानी जल्दी सुधार करने से बाद में बड़ा नुकसान नहीं होता।

questionText: Break the ice
options: Start a conversation in an awkward situation
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to initiate conversation or interaction in a tense or uncomfortable setting.
उदा. Hindi explanation: बर्फ तोड़ना = बातचीत शुरू करना।

questionText: Cost an arm and a leg
explanation:
Rule in English: It means something is extremely expensive.
उदा. Hindi explanation: बहुत महंगा।

questionText: Hit the books
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to study with intensity.
उदा. Hindi explanation: किताबें पढ़ना यानी गूढ़ अध्ययन करना।

questionText: Under the weather
explanation:
Rule in English: It indicates being ill or not feeling well.
उदा. Hindi explanation: बिमार महसूस करना।

questionText: Bite the bullet
options: Accept a painful or difficult situation
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to endure a painful or difficult situation with courage.
उदा. Hindi explanation: कठिन परिस्थिति स्वीकार करना।

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag
options: Release a cat from a bag
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to disclose a secret that was intended to remain confidential.
उदा. Hindi explanation: रहस्य उजागर करना।

questionText: Burn the midnight oil
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to work late into the night, usually studying or working hard.
उदा. Hindi explanation: रात देर तक काम करना।

questionText: to bite the bullet
options: To endure a painful or difficult situation
explanation:
Rule: An idiom is a phrase whose meaning cannot be deduced from the individual words.
उदा. "बुलेट को काटना" का मतलब है कठिन परिस्थिति का साहस से सामना करना।

questionText: to break the ice
options: To start a conversation in a tense situation
explanation:
Rule: Idioms often use metaphorical imagery.
उदा. "आइस तोड़ना" का मतलब है तनावपूर्ण माहौल में बातचीत शुरू करना।

questionText: to let the cat out of the bag
explanation:
Rule: Idioms convey meanings that differ from literal sense.
उदा. "बिल्ली को बैग से बाहर निकालना" का मतलब है रहस्य उजागर करना।

questionText: to call it a day
options: To take a break for lunch
explanation:
Rule: Idioms often use everyday actions as metaphors.
उदा. "दिन को बंद करना" का मतलब है काम का दिन समाप्त करना।

questionText: to see eye to eye
options: To physically look at each other’s eyes
explanation:
Rule: Idioms express ideas through symbolic comparison.
उदा. "आँखों से आँखें मिलाना" का मतलब है समान राय रखना।

questionText: to hit the nail on the head
explanation:
Rule: Idioms use literal actions to convey abstract meanings.
उदा. "नाख़ून को सिर पर मारना" का मतलब है किसी बात को सही ढंग से बताना।

questionText: to keep your fingers crossed
options: To stretch your fingers for flexibility
To hope for a positive outcome
To wish someone good luck in exams
explanation:
Rule: Idioms often involve actions that symbolize feelings.
उदा. "उंगलियाँ क्रॉस करना" का मतलब है आशा करना कि सब कुछ अच्छा हो।

questionText: spill the beans
options: To pour beans out of a container
explanation:
Rule: Idioms use everyday actions as metaphors.
उदा. "बीन्स गिराना" का मतलब है रहस्य फासला देना।

questionText: to kick the bucket
explanation:
Rule: Idioms often use colorful imagery.
उदा. "बकेट को किक करना" का मतलब है मर जाना।

questionText: put all your eggs in one basket
options: To place eggs in a single basket
To risk everything on one opportunity
To cook eggs in one pan
explanation:
Rule: Idioms convey caution through everyday images.
उदा. "सभी अंडे एक बास्केट में रखना" का मतलब जोखिम एक ही जगह लगाना है।

questionText: make a long story short
options: To add details to a story
explanation:
Rule: Idioms use everyday phrases to denote abstract ideas.
उदा. "लंबी कहानी को छोटा करना" का मतलब है कहानी को संक्षिप्त करना।

questionText: hit the nail on the head
options: To cause a huge amount of damage
explanation:
Rule in English: The idiom means to describe something exactly or correctly.
उदा. Hindi: "किसी बात को बिल्कुल सही ढंग से बताना"
grammarRule: Idiomatic expression used as a verb phrase

questionText: A dime a dozen
explanation:
Rule in English: Indicates something is very common and inexpensive.
उदा. Hindi: "बहुतायत में उपलब्ध"
grammarRule: Idiomatic expression used as a noun phrase

questionText: cost an arm and a leg
explanation:
Rule in English: Indicates that something is very expensive.
उदा. Hindi: "बहुत महंगा"
grammarRule: Idiomatic phrase used as an adjective phrase

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag
explanation:
Rule in English: Disclosing something that was meant to be kept secret.
उदा. Hindi: "गुप्त बात उजागर करना"
grammarRule: Idiomatic expression used as a verb phrase

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word among the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *definitely*.
Rule: Use 'fi' after 'def' and not 'fi' or 'f' after 'def'.
उदाहरण: *definitely* का अर्थ है निस्संदेह।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word among the following.
explanation:
Correct spelling: *government*.
Rule: The word contains 'vern' after 'go', not 'verment'. 
उदाहरण: *government* का अर्थ है सरकार।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below
options: He is a seperator of the group.
He is a separator of the group.
He is a severator of the group.
He is a separator of the groupe
explanation:
The correct spelling is *separator* with ‘a’ after ‘p’. The rule is that the word ‘separator’ is derived from ‘sep‑ar‑ator’.
उदाहरण: separator – सही रूप से।

questionText: Which option is spelled correctly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is *mysterious* with ‘-ous’ ending. The rule is that the adjective ending is ‘-ous’ not ‘-ical’ or ‘-ous’ incorrectly.
उदाहरण: mysterious – सही रूप।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped / out of the house / when a heavy shower / fell down.
explanation:
Replace 'fell down' with 'began' or 'started'. Showers do not 'fall down' as a redundant idiom in this context; a shower starts or begins.
उदा. 'Rain' या 'shower' के साथ 'fell down' का प्रयोग अतिशयोक्ति (superfluous) है, यहाँ 'began' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: She insisted to go / to the market alone / despite the heavy / traffic on the road.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (-ing form), not an infinitive. Replace 'to go' with 'on going'.
उदा. 'Insist' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (V1+ing) आता है, न कि infinitive (to + V1)।

questionText: One of my friends / are leaving for / New York tomorrow / for higher studies.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' के साथ verb हमेशा singular होती है, अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: The teacher asked the students / why they have been / making such a noise / in the class room.
explanation:
If the main clause is in the past tense ('asked'), the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense. Replace 'have been' with 'had been'.
उदा. यदि मुख्य clause past tense में हो, तो subordinate clause भी past tense में होना चाहिए। अतः 'have been' की जगह 'had been' होगा।

questionText: Not only the principal / but also the teachers / was shocked at / the sudden decision.
explanation:
With 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closer to it. 'Teachers' is plural, so 'was' must be changed to 'were'.
उदा. 'Not only... but also' में verb पास वाले subject ('teachers' - plural) के अनुसार आएगी, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had we reached / the station than / the train started / moving slowly.
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ connective शब्द 'when' या 'before' आता है, 'than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है।

questionText: Each of the suspected men / were interrogated / by the police officers / for several hours.
explanation:
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun but takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है, इसलिए 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' आएगा।

questionText: He is superior / than most of / his colleagues in / handling pressure.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior) take the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. जिन adjectives के अंत में '-or' आता है (जैसे superior, junior आदि), उनके बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Hardly had I / arrived at the station / than the train left. / No error
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Use 'when' instead of 'than' in part (C).
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। भाग (C) में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither of the two boys / were willing to / accept the responsibility. / No error
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun but takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (B).
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा/सर्वनाम आता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा एक वचन (singular) होती है। 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: She is one of those persons / who does not care / about what others think. / No error
explanation:
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who) + plural verb', the verb agrees with the antecedent (persons). Replace 'does' with 'do' in part (B).
उदा. 'one of those + plural noun + who' की संरचना में relative pronoun के बाद आने वाली वर्ब अपने antecedent (persons) के अनुसार plural होती है। 'does' की जगह 'do' होगा।

questionText: The manager as well as / his assistants have / agreed to attend the meeting. / No error
explanation:
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject (The manager). Replace 'have' with 'has' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' singular है, इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

questionText: He told me that / he has finished his work / two hours ago. / No error
explanation:
Past time markers like 'ago', 'yesterday' require Simple Past tense, not Present Perfect. Replace 'has finished' with 'finished' in part (B).
उदा. भूतकाल के समय सूचक शब्द ('ago', 'yesterday') के साथ Simple Past Tense का प्रयोग होता है, Present Perfect का नहीं। 'has finished' की जगह 'finished' होगा।

questionText: No sooner did the sun rise / when the fog / disappeared completely. / No error
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than' in part (B).
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। भाग (B) में 'when' की जगह 'than' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Each of the students / have submitted / their assignments on time. / No error
explanation:
'Each of' takes a singular verb. Replace 'have' with 'has' in part (B).
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद आने वाली वर्ब singular होती है। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा।

questionText: Despite of his hard work, / he failed to secure / the first rank in the class. / No error
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Remove 'of' in part (A).
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है, जबकि 'In spite of' सही होता है। भाग (A) से 'of' हटाएं।

questionText: If I was you, / I would not tolerate / such nonsense behavior. / No error
explanation:
In hypothetical/imaginary sentences, 'were' is used with all subjects. Replace 'was' with 'were' in part (A).
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं। भाग (A) में 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had we stepped / out of the hotel / than it started raining heavily. / No error
explanation:
'Scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when' in part (C).
उदा. 'Scarcely' के बाद 'than' का नहीं बल्कि 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है। भाग (C) में 'than' के स्थान पर 'when' आएगा।

explanation:

grammarRule: Synonyms: Words with similar meaning; often used to avoid repetition.
