explanation:
'Ameliorate' means to make something bad or unsatisfactory better. It fits best with 'living standards'. 'Aggravate' means to worsen.
उदा. 'Ameliorate' का अर्थ स्थिति या जीवन स्तर को सुधारना है। 'Aggravate' का अर्थ बिगाड़ना होता है।

questionText: Scarcely had she stepped outside _____ it started pouring heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: She is proficient _____ mathematics and can solve complex problems within seconds.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' (skilled/competent) is appropriately followed by the preposition 'in' when referring to a subject or skill.
उदा. विशेषण 'proficient' (निपुण) के बाद किसी विषय या कौशल में दक्षता दिखाने के लिए प्रीपोज़िशन 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The committee members could not reach a consensus because they were divided in _____ opinions.
explanation:
Since the members are divided in their opinions (acting as individuals rather than a single unit), the plural possessive pronoun 'their' is required.
उदा. चूँकि समिति के सदस्य अपनी राय में विभाजित हैं (अलग-अलग व्यक्तियों के रूप में कार्य कर रहे हैं), इसलिए बहुवचन सर्वनाम 'their' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are _____ to maintaining good health.
explanation:
'Imperative' means of vital importance; crucial. It fits the context that exercise and diet are crucial for health.
उदा. 'Imperative' का अर्थ अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण या अनिवार्य है। स्वास्थ्य के लिए व्यायाम और आहार जरूरी हैं, अतः यह सही विकल्प है।

questionText: Not only the principal but also the teachers _____ present at the meeting yesterday.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closer to it ('teachers', which is plural and in past tense).
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'not only... but also' से जुड़ते हैं, तो क्रिया अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता ('teachers', जो कि बहुवचन है) के अनुसार आती है। काल भूतकाल (yesterday) है, अतः 'were' सही है।

questionText: Despite the heavy downpour, the players carried _____ with their practice.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'carry on' means to continue an activity or task despite obstacles.
उदा. फ्रेज़ल वर्ब 'carry on' का अर्थ बाधाओं के बावजूद किसी कार्य को जारी रखना होता है।

questionText: The government has __________ a new scheme for the welfare of farmers.
explanation:
We use 'launched' when talking about officially introducing a new scheme, project, or product. 
उदा. सरकारी योजना (scheme) या प्रोजेक्ट की शुरुआत के लिए 'launched' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house __________ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'When'. 
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: She has been suffering from fever __________ last Monday.
explanation:
'Since' is used for a point of time in the past (like last Monday) in present/past perfect continuous tense. 
उदा. निश्चित समय (point of time) जैसे 'last Monday' के लिए 'since' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि अवधि (period of time) के लिए 'for' आता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students __________ present in the class yesterday.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('students', which is plural). 
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में वर्ब हमेशा पास वाले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है, यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है इसलिए 'were' आएगा।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not __________ good marks in the examination.
explanation:
In standard English collocation, students 'secure' or 'obtain' marks or ranks in an examination. 
उदा. परीक्षा में अच्छे अंक प्राप्त करने के लिए 'secure marks' या 'obtain marks' का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: A committee was __________ to investigate the matter thoroughly.
explanation:
'Constituted' or 'appointed' is the right formal term for setting up a committee or official body. 
उदा. किसी समिति (committee) या आयोग के गठन के लिए औपचारिक रूप से 'constituted' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: He is proficient __________ mathematics and physics.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' is always followed by the preposition 'in' to indicate skill in a subject. 
उदा. 'Proficient' (निपुण) शब्द के बाद हमेशा फिक्स प्रीपोजिशन 'in' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Had you informed me earlier, I __________ attend the meeting.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure: 'Had + subject + V3' takes 'would have + V3' in the main clause. 
उदा. यह कंडीशनल सेंटेंस का नियम है जहाँ 'Had + V3' होने पर मुख्य खंड (main clause) में 'would have + V3' आता है।

questionText: The manager asked me what my __________ qualifications were.
explanation:
We need an adjective ('educational') to modify the noun 'qualifications'. 
उदा. संज्ञा (qualifications) की विशेषता बताने के लिए एडजेक्टिव 'educational' का प्रयोग किया जाएगा।

questionText: Preventive measures must be taken to __________ the spread of the contagious disease.
explanation:
'Curb' means to restrain or keep in check, which fits the context of stopping a disease's spread. 
उदा. बीमारी के फैलने को रोकने या नियंत्रित करने के लिए 'curb' (अंकुश लगाना) सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द है।

questionText: The chemist prepared the solution with a cautious approach.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "prepared" with an 'a' after the 'p'.
Rule: After 'pr', the vowel 'a' is often used before 'e' and 't' in past tense forms.
उदाहरण: "prepared" – सही वर्तनी।
grammarRule: Past tense verb formation: pr + a + e + r + ed

questionText: The government announced a new policy to improve education.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "education". The word "educaton" is missing an 'i'.
Rule: The letter 'i' follows 'c' in the word "education".
उदाहरण: "education" – सही वर्तनी।
grammarRule: E + c + u + d + i + a + t + i + o + n

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word from the choices given
explanation:
The correct spelling is "definitely". The words "definately" and "definiti ly" are misspelled.
Rule: The suffix is "-ly" and the base word is "definite".
उदाहरण: "definitely" – सही वर्तनी।

questionText: He was an exellent dancer.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "excellent" with two 'l's. "Exellent" is missing an 'l'.
Rule: The word contains double 'l' before the 'e'.
उदाहरण: "excellent" – सही वर्तनी।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: "She received the co-operation from all the team members.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "cooperation". The word "co-oparation" has an extra 'a' after 'r'.
Rule: The word is formed by combining "co" and "operation" without any extra letters.
उदाहरण: "cooperation" – सही वर्तनी।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word from the following options
explanation:
The correct spelling is "management". The other options misspell the word by dropping an 'e' or 'a'.
Rule: The word contains the sequence "manag" followed by "ement".
उदाहरण: "management" – सही वर्तनी।

questionText: The project was completed on time, but it was not done well.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "completed". The word "completed" is misspelled as "completed".
Rule: The past participle of "complete" ends with "-ed".
उदाहरण: "completed" – सही वर्तनी।

questionText: IMPEDIMENT
explanation:
'Impediment' means a hindrance or obstruction in doing something. 'Obstacle' is the exact synonym.
उदा. 'Impediment' का अर्थ बाधा या रुकावट है। सही विकल्प 'Obstacle' है।

questionText: MENDACIOUS
explanation:
'Mendacious' means not telling the truth; lying or deceitful. 'Deceitful' is the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Mendacious' का अर्थ झूठा या कपटी होता है। सही विकल्प 'Deceitful' है।

questionText: NEFARIOUS
explanation:
'Nefarious' means(typically of an action or activity) wicked or criminal. 'Wicked' is its synonym.
उदा. 'Nefarious' का अर्थ कुटिल या जघन्य होता है। सही उत्तर 'Wicked' है।

questionText: She has been working ___ the company for five years.
explanation:
Use of preposition 'for' indicates duration of time.
उदाहरण: वह पाँच वर्षों से कंपनी में काम कर रही है।

questionText: If he ___ earlier, he would have avoided the mistake.
explanation:
Third conditional requires past perfect in the if‑clause.
उदाहरण: अगर वह पहले चला गया होता, तो उसने गलती से बचा लिया होता।

questionText: The committee's decision was ___________.
explanation:
The adjective 'unequivocal' means absolutely certain.
उदाहरण: समिति का निर्णय स्पष्ट और संदेह रहित था।

questionText: Please submit the report ___ 10th August.
explanation:
The preposition 'by' specifies a deadline.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट 10 अगस्त से पहले जमा करें।

questionText: She is ___ to the meeting when I called her.
explanation:
Present continuous is used for scheduled future events.
उदाहरण: वह चल रही है बैठक में जब मैंने उसे फोन किया।

questionText: The new policy has been ____________ to most employees.
explanation:
The verb 'adopted' means accepted or taken up.
उदाहरण: नई नीति अधिकांश कर्मचारियों द्वारा अपनाई गई है।

questionText: He was known ___ his generosity.
explanation:
Preposition 'for' introduces the reason or attribute.
उदाहरण: वह अपनी उदारता के लिए जाना जाता था।

questionText: The team ___ to win the championship last year.
explanation:
Past continuous ('was hoping') expresses an intention in the past.
उदाहरण: टीम ने पिछले वर्ष चैंपियनशिप जीतने की आशा की थी।

questionText: She gave a ___________ explanation, leaving every one confused.
explanation:
The adjective 'ambiguous' means unclear or open to multiple interpretations.
उदाहरण: उसने अस्पष्ट स्पष्टीकरण दिया, जिससे सब भ्रमित रह गए।

questionText: The book lies ___ the table.
explanation:
'On' is used for objects resting on a surface.
उदाहरण: किताब टेबल पर रखी है।

questionText: He told to me / that he would / help me in my / difficult times. /
explanation:
'Tell' does not take a preposition 'to' directly when followed by an object. It should be 'He told me'.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधा कर्म (object) आने पर 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। यहाँ 'He told me' सही होगा।

questionText: One of my friends / are going / to visit Ladakh / next week. /
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'is' should replace 'are'.
उदा. संरचना 'One of + plural noun' के साथ हमेशा एकवचन (singular) क्रिया का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' आएगा।

questionText: Scarcely had I arrived / at the station than / the train started / moving. /
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'than' को 'when' से बदलें।

questionText: The direct or and producer / have given / his consent for / the new project. /
explanation:
When two nouns are joined by 'and' and preceded by a single article, they refer to the same person, taking a singular verb and pronoun ('has' and 'his'). Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो संज्ञाएं 'and' से जुड़ी हों और पहले वाले के साथ article हो, तो वह एक ही व्यक्ति को दर्शाती हैं। अतः 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

questionText: She is more taller / than her younger / sister by two / inches. /
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect. 'Taller' is already comparative, so 'more' should not be used before it.
उदा. दो comparative degrees का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'Taller' अपने आप में comparative है, इसलिए 'more' का प्रयोग गलत है।

questionText: No sooner did the bell / ring when the students / rushed out of / their classrooms. /
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

questionText: Unless you do not / work hard, you / will not clear / the exam. /
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative word and does not take another negative word like 'not' in its clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' एक नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता। 'do not' हटाएं।

questionText: He walked as if / he is the owner / of the entire / company. /
explanation:
'As if' expresses an unreal condition in the past, so it should be followed by 'were' instead of 'is'.
उदा. 'As if' (मानो) अवास्तविक स्थिति को दर्शाता है, इसलिए इसके साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'is' का नहीं।

questionText: Each of the boys / have submitted / their assignment on / time. /
explanation:
'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('has') and singular pronoun ('his'). Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद plural noun होने पर भी verb और pronoun एकवचन (singular) होते हैं। 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

questionText: She was disappointed ___ the sudden cancellation of the event.
explanation:
The preposition *by* is used to indicate the cause of disappointment.
उदाहरण: वह अचानक रद्द होने से निराश थी।

questionText: They ___ finished their assignments before the dead line
explanation:
Past perfect tense (*had finished*) is used to show an action completed before a specific time.
उदाहरण: उन्होंने समय सीमा से पहले अपना असाइनमेंट पूरा कर लिया था।

questionText: I would have helped ___ you were there.
explanation:
Conditional clause requires *if* to express a hypothetical situation.
उदाहरण: अगर तुम वहाँ होते तो मैं मदद करता।

questionText: The book was highly ___ by critics.
explanation:
Past participle *praised* is used in passive voice.
उदाहरण: पुस्तक की आलोचकों द्वारा अत्यधिक प्रशंसा की गई।

questionText: His performance was ___ for the award.
explanation:
The adjective *eligible* describes suitability for something.
उदाहरण: उसकी प्रदर्शन पुरस्कार के लिए योग्य था।

questionText: They were astonished ___ the unexpected turn of events.
explanation:
Preposition *at* is used after *astonished* to indicate the cause.
उदाहरण: वे अप्रत्याशित घटनाक्रम से चकित थे।

questionText: The river runs ___ the mountains.
explanation:
Preposition *through* shows passage within the mountains.
उदाहरण: नदी पर्वतों के बीच बहती है।

questionText: He will ___ the report by tomorrow.
explanation:
Infinitive *submit* follows *will* for future simple tense.
उदाहरण: वह कल तक रिपोर्ट जमा करेगा।

questionText: The new policy will ___ the existing regulations.
explanation:
Infinitive *alter* is used after *will* to express an action.
उदाहरण: नई नीति मौजूदा नियमों को बदल देगी।

questionText: She was ___ a great photographer.
explanation:
Past participle *known* used as adjective in passive construction.
उदाहरण: वह एक महान फोटोग्राफर के रूप में जानी जाती है।

questionText: Science and technology has / made life much easier / and comfortable than / it ever was before.
explanation:
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' to denote two different subjects, they take a plural verb. 'Science' and 'technology' are two distinct subjects, so 'has' must be replaced with 'have'.
उदा. जब दो अलग-अलग सिंगular Nouns को 'and' से जोड़ा जाता है, तो उनके साथ Plural Verb का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'has' के स्थान पर 'have' होगा।

questionText: The direct or asked me / that how I could / achieve such a difficult / target in a short time.
explanation:
In indirect speech, while converting an interrogative sentence starting with a WH-word (like how, what), no conjunction like 'that' or 'if/whether' is used before the WH-word. Remove 'that'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में WH-word से शुरू होने वाले Interrogative वाक्य में WH-word से पहले 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

questionText: Neither the teachers / nor the principal were / present in the meeting / held yesterday.
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, the closest subject is 'the principal' (singular), so 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में Verb पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'the principal' (singular) के अनुसार 'was' आएगा न कि 'were'।

questionText: One of my friend / is a famous doctor / who works in / a government hospital.
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Therefore, 'friend' must be changed to 'friends'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा Plural Noun और Singular Verb का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'friend' की जगह 'friends' होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped / out of the house when / a heavy downpour started / and soaked me completely.
explanation:
No error in segments A, B, and C. The sentence is grammatically correct and correctly pairs 'Hardly' with 'when'. (Mark No Error if applicable, but here let's check segment structure: wait, option D is correct, meaning there is an error in D? Let's use a definite error question). Let's fix the question to have a clear error in D: 'and soaked me completely' -> 'and soak me completely'. Let's replace option 3 error.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'and soaked me completely.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The committee will / submit its report / on the matter / in next week.
explanation:
Prepositions are not used before time expressions starting with 'next', 'last', 'this', 'that', etc. Remove 'in' before 'next week'.
उदा. 'next', 'last', 'this', 'that' आदि से शुरू होने वाले time expressions से पहले किसी Preposition (जैसे in, on) का प्रयोग नहीं होता है।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring / than the students / rushed out of their / respective classrooms.
options: No sooner did the bell ring
explanation:
Wait, let's make an actual erroneous question. Let's change (B) to 'when the students' to create an error with No sooner.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'respective classrooms.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring / when the students / rushed out of their / respective classrooms.
options: No sooner did the bell ring
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not by 'when' or 'then'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। अतः 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

questionText: She is more smarter / than her sister / though she is younger / in age.
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Smart' is a single-syllable adjective whose comparative is 'smarter'. Using 'more' before 'smarter' is superfluous. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक साथ दो Comparative Adjectives ('more' और 'smarter') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। यहाँ 'more' का प्रयोग गलत है।

questionText: Unless you do not / study sincerely, / you cannot hope / to pass the exam.
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative word meaning 'if not'. Therefore, we do not use another negative word like 'not' in the same clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' अपने आप में एक Negative शब्द है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' या 'do not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

questionText: Evident
explanation:
The word "Evident" means clear or obvious. Thus, the best synonym is "Obvious".
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "Evident" का अर्थ "स्पष्ट" या "प्रकट" होता है, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी शब्द "Obvious" है।

questionText: Exquisite
explanation:
"Exquisite" implies something very beautiful or delicate. Hence "Delicate" is the closest synonym.
"Exquisite" का मतलब है बहुत सुंदर या नाज़ुक, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी "Delicate" है।

questionText: Diligent
explanation:
"Diligent" refers to someone who works hard and is persistent. "Industrious" carries the same meaning.
"Diligent" का अर्थ है मेहनती, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी "Industrious" है।

questionText: Obsolete
explanation:
"Obsolete" means no longer in use or outdated. Therefore "Outdated" is the correct synonym.
"Obsolete" का अर्थ है पुराना या अप्रचलित, अतः इसका समानार्थी "Outdated" है।

questionText: Altruistic
explanation:
"Altruistic" describes someone who puts others' needs before their own. "Selfless" reflects the same idea.
"Altruistic" का मतलब है स्वार्थरहित, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी "Selfless" है।

questionText: Cumbersome
explanation:
"Cumbersome" refers to something that is heavy, awkward, or difficult to handle. "Unwieldy" is the synonym.
"Cumbersome" का अर्थ है भारी, बोझिल, या संभालने में कठिन, अतः "Unwieldy" समानार्थी है।

questionText: Impetuous
explanation:
"Impetuous" means acting quickly without thinking. "Impulsive" carries that same meaning.
"Impetuous" का मतलब है आवेगपूर्ण, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी "Impulsive" है।

questionText: Resilient
explanation:
"Resilient" refers to the ability to recover quickly from difficulties. "Recoverable" is the closest synonym.
"Resilient" का अर्थ है मुश्किलों से जल्दी उबरने की क्षमता, अतः "Recoverable" समानार्थी है।

questionText: Tremendous
explanation:
"Tremendous" means very large or great. "Huge" conveys the same sense.
"Tremendous" का अर्थ है बहुत बड़ा, अतः "Huge" समानार्थी है।

questionText: Meticulous
explanation:
"Meticulous" refers to paying great attention to detail. "Precise" reflects that same meaning.
"Meticulous" का मतलब है अत्यंत सावधान, इसलिए इसका समानार्थी "Precise" है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym for the given word: ABOMINATE
explanation:
'Abominate' means to hate intensely or loathe. Options like admire, applaud, and cherish are antonyms.
उदा. 'Abominate' का अर्थ घृणा करना या नफरत करना होता है। इसका पर्यायवाची 'Loathe' है।

questionText: Choose the synonym for: GREGARIOUS
explanation:
'Gregarious' refers to a person who enjoys company; sociable.
उदा. 'Gregarious' का अर्थ मिलनसार होता है, जो लोगों के साथ रहना पसंद करता है ('Sociable')।

questionText: LUGUBRIOUS
explanation:
'Lugubrious' means looking or sounding sad and dismal; mournful.
उदा. 'Lugubrious' का अर्थ बहुत उदास या गमगीन होता है, जिसका पर्यायवाची 'Mournful' है।

questionText: MITIGATE
explanation:
'Mitigate' means to make less severe, serious, or painful; alleviate.
उदा. 'Mitigate' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ के प्रभाव को कम करना होता है, जिसका समानार्थी 'Alleviate' है।

questionText: Choose the synonym of the given word: OBSTINATE
explanation:
'Obstinate' means stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action.
उदा. 'Obstinate' का अर्थ जिद्दी या अडियल होता है, जिसका सही पर्यायवाची 'Stubborn' है।

questionText: PRAGMATIC
explanation:
'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically; practical.
उदा. 'Pragmatic' का अर्थ व्यावहारिक होता है जो वास्तविकता पर आधारित हो ('Practical')।

questionText: ZEAL
explanation:
'Zeal' means great energy or enthusiasm in pursuit of a cause or an objective.
उदा. 'Zeal' का अर्थ जोश या उत्साह होता है, जिसका पर्यायवाची 'Enthusiasm' है।

questionText: Choose the synonym for: TACITURT
explanation:
Note: Word is 'Taciturn'. It means reserved or uncommunicative in speech; reticent.
उदा. 'Taciturn' अल्पभाषी या कम बोलने वाला होता है, जिसका पर्यायवाची 'Reticent' है।

questionText: Find the word with the CORRECT spelling among the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Pronunciation' (derived from pronounce, but 'o' is dropped).
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Pronunciation' है (pronounce से बनता है लेकिन 'o' हट जाता है)।

questionText: The book is ___ the shelf.
explanation:
When indicating position on a surface, we use the preposition *on*.
उदाहरण: पुस्तक शेल्फ पर रखी है।
grammarRule: Preposition for position on a surface

questionText: He has a strong desire ___ learning new languages.
explanation:
The noun *desire* is followed by the infinitive marker *to* when expressing purpose.
उदाहरण: उसे नई भाषा सीखने की तीव्र इच्छा है।

questionText: The students were asked ___ the questions.
explanation:
After the verb *asked*, we use the infinitive *to answer* to indicate the action requested.
उदाहरण: छात्रों से प्रश्नों का उत्तर देने के लिए कहा गया।

questionText: She is ___ the party to night
explanation:
The present continuous tense *is attending* expresses an arrangement for the future.
उदाहरण: वह आज रात पार्टी में जा रही है।

questionText: I have never seen a bird so ___.
explanation:
The adjective *beautiful* modifies the noun *bird*; *beautifully* would be an adverb and does not fit here.
उदाहरण: मैंने कभी इतना सुंदर पक्षी नहीं देखा।

questionText: He was praised ___ his outstanding performance.
explanation:
The preposition *for* is used after *praised* to indicate the reason.
उदाहरण: उसकी उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए उसकी तारीफ की गई।

questionText: The project will be completed ___ December.
explanation:
The preposition *by* indicates a deadline.
उदाहरण: परियोजना दिसंबर तक पूर्ण हो जाएगी।

questionText: The child was very ___ after the accident.
explanation:
*hurt* is an adjective describing the state of the child; *hurtful* means causing hurt, which does not fit.
उदाहरण: दुर्घटना के बाद बच्चा बहुत घायल था।

questionText: She failed ___ the exam.
explanation:
After the verb *failed*, we use the infinitive marker *to* to express the action that was not achieved.
उदाहरण: वह परीक्षा में असफल रही।

questionText: The committee of experts have decided to implement the new policy.
explanation:
The word *committee* is a singular noun, so the verb should be *has* not *have*.
उदाहरण: The committee has decided.

questionText: She, along with her friends, was going to the market yesterday.
explanation:
When the subject is *she* and the verb is *was*, the auxiliary *was* is correct. The error would be *were*.
उदाहरण: She was going to the market.

questionText: The students had finished their assignments before the dead line
explanation:
The past perfect *had finished* is correct. The error would be *has finished*.
उदाहरण: The students had finished their assignments.

questionText: The manager, as well as the employees, needs to review the proposal.
explanation:
When the main subject is *the manager* (singular), the verb should be *needs*.
उदाहरण: The manager needs to review the proposal.

questionText: The committee decided that the project would be completed by next month.
explanation:
The phrase *by next month* is correct, but the error would be *by next months*.
उदाहरण: The project will be completed by next month.

questionText: The students must submit their exams before the dead line
explanation:
The object *exams* is plural, so *their* is correct. The error would be *his* or *her*.
उदाहरण: The students must submit their exams.

questionText: The committee has been working on the project since last year.
explanation:
The preposition *since* is used with a point in time; *for* would be incorrect here.
उदाहरण: The committee has been working on the project since last year.

questionText: The researchers will publish their findings next week.
explanation:
The object *findings* is plural, so *their* is correct. The error would be *his* or *her*.
उदाहरण: The researchers will publish their findings next week.

questionText: The manager have sent an email to all employees.
explanation:
The singular subject *manager* requires *has*, not *have*.
उदाहरण: The manager has sent an email to all employees.

questionText: The team of engineers was able to fix the issue promptly.
explanation:
The subject *team* is singular, so *was* is correct. The error would be *were*.
उदाहरण: The team of engineers was able to fix the issue promptly.

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that best matches the meaning of the given word.
उदाहरण: "abundant" का समानार्थी "plentiful" है।

questionText: concur
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that expresses the same idea.
उदाहरण: "concur" का समानार्थी "agree" है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word with the equivalent meaning.
उदाहरण: "meticulous" का समानार्थी "precise" है।

questionText: candid
explanation:
Rule: Select the word that conveys the same sense.
उदाहरण: "candid" का समानार्थी "honest" है।

questionText: tremendous
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that expresses a comparable magnitude.
उदाहरण: "tremendous" का समानार्थी "enormous" है।

questionText: intractable
explanation:
Rule: Select the word that conveys the same difficulty level.
उदाहरण: "intractable" का समानार्थी "complicated" है।

questionText: facilitate
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that denotes making easy.
उदाहरण: "facilitate" का समानार्थी "assist" है।

questionText: metaphor
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that denotes a figurative comparison.
उदाहरण: "metaphor" का समानार्थी "analogy" है।

questionText: resilient
explanation:
Rule: Select the word that conveys the ability to recover.
उदाहरण: "resilient" का समानार्थी "strong" है।

questionText: cumbersome
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that expresses difficulty in handling.
उदाहरण: "cumbersome" का समानार्थी "awkward" है।

questionText: Select the correct spelling of the given word context.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant' (l-i-e-u-t-e-n-a-n-t).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Lieutenant' है।

questionText: Find the misspelled word among the given options.
explanation:
'Aparatus' is incorrectly spelled; it requires double 'p' (Apparatus).
उदा. 'Aparatus' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Apparatus' है जिसमें दो बार 'p' आता है।

questionText: Select the correct spelling from the options provided.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Connoisseur' (an expert judge in matters of taste).
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Connoisseur' है जिसका अर्थ पारखी होता है।

questionText: cautious
explanation:
Synonyms are words that convey the same or very similar meaning. "Cautious" means careful and prudent. Therefore the correct synonym is "prudent".
उदा. "Cautious" का मतलब "सावधान" होता है, अतः "prudent" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: miserable
explanation:
The word "miserable" denotes extreme unhappiness or discomfort. The closest synonym among the choices is "sorrowful".
उदा. "miserable" का अर्थ "उदास" या "कष्टदायक" है, अतः "sorrowful" सही है।

questionText: obscure
explanation:
To be "obscure" means to be hidden or not easily understood. The synonym in the options is "hidden".
उदा. "obscure" का अर्थ "छिपा हुआ" या "अस्पष्ट" है, अतः "hidden" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: victorious
explanation:
The term "victorious" refers to having won or succeeded. The synonym among the options is "winning".
उदा. "victorious" का मतलब "जीत गया" होता है, अतः "winning" सही है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
"Diligent" means showing care and effort. The word that best matches this meaning is "assiduous".
उदा. "diligent" का अर्थ "परिश्रमी" है, अतः "assiduous" सही है।

questionText: perplex
explanation:
To "perplex" is to confuse or bewilder. Therefore the synonym is "confuse".
उदा. "perplex" का मतलब "ग़लत फहमी पैदा करना" है, अतः "confuse" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: frugal
explanation:
"Frugal" means careful about spending or economical. The correct synonym is "economical".
उदा. "frugal" का मतलब "सावधानीपूर्वक खर्च करना" है, अतः "economical" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: genuine
explanation:
"Genuine" means real or authentic. The synonym in the list is "authentic".
उदा. "genuine" का अर्थ "सच्चा" या "वास्तविक" है, अतः "authentic" सही है।

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
"Elaborate" as an adjective indicates something that is detailed or intricate. Thus "intricate" is the correct synonym.
उदा. "elaborate" का अर्थ "विस्तृत" या "जटिल" है, अतः "intricate" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students was present in the class room.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'students' (plural), so the plural verb 'were' is required.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: She insisted to go to the party despite her mother's warning.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'Insist' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: If I was you, I would not accept this offer under any circumstances.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation or wish, 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।

questionText: One of the most important problem facing the country is unemployment.
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'problem' must be changed to 'problems'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा Plural Noun का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'problem' की जगह 'problems' होगा।
grammarRule: Noun Number Rule (One of + Plural Noun)

questionText: No sooner did the police arrive than the thieves ran away.
options: No sooner had the police arrive than
No sooner did the police arrived than
No sooner the police arrived than
explanation:
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is followed by inversion (did + V1) and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह सही है। 'No sooner' के बाद helping verb (did) + V1 और फिर 'than' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है।

questionText: Despite of working hard, he failed to clear the examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Thus, 'Despite working' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता (In spite के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः 'Despite working' सही है।
grammarRule: Prepositional Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: Each of the participants were given a certificate of appreciation.
explanation:
'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb. 'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('was').
उदा. 'Each' एक singular pronoun है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb ('was') का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: The manager told his subordinates that they must complete the project by tomorrow.
explanation:
In indirect speech, words indicating nearness of time are changed. 'Tomorrow' changes to 'the next day' or 'the following day'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में 'tomorrow' बदलकर 'the next day' हो जाता है।

questionText: Scarcely had I reached the station when the train left.
options: Scarcely had I reached the station than the train left
Scarcely I had reached the station when the train left
Scarcely did I reached the station when the train left
explanation:
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'Scarcely' takes 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'when'.
उदा. वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है। 'Scarcely' के साथ 'had + V3' और 'when' का सही संयोजन है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house *when it began to rain* heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. Therefore, 'when it began to rain' is grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcarly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)।

questionText: If I *was you*, I would not tolerate this insult.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, regardless of person or number.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक शर्त (Hypothetical sentence) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।

questionText: The teacher asked the students *that why they were* making a noise.
explanation:
In indirect speech of a Wh- question, the question word acts as a conjunction, and the subject precedes the verb (assertive sentence structure). 'That' is not used before the question word.
उदा. Indirect speech में Wh- question पूछने पर 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं होता और Wh- word के बाद Subject फिर Verb आता है।

questionText: He is one of those persons who *is always helping* the poor.
explanation:
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb agrees with the antecedent, which is plural ('persons'). Thus, 'are' is correct.
उदा. 'One of those + plural noun + who' की बनावट में relative pronoun (who) का antecedent बहुवचन noun होता है, इसलिए verb भी plural (are) आएगी।

questionText: Neither the manager nor his subordinates *was present* at the meeting.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('subordinates', which is plural). Hence, 'were present' is correct.
उदा. जब दो Subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject (subordinates) के अनुसार आती है, जो कि बहुवचन है।

questionText: She is *more taller than* her sister.
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative adjective, so 'more' is redundant.
उदा. एक ही विशेषण के साथ दो comparative words ('more' और 'taller') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

questionText: No sooner did the train stop *than the passengers rushed* towards the doors.
explanation:
The correct correlative pair for 'No sooner' is 'than'. The sentence is already grammatically correct.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ सही जोड़ी (correlative) 'than' होती है। वाक्य में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

questionText: He told me that he *has finished* his work before I arrived.
explanation:
When two past actions happen at different times, the earlier action takes the past perfect tense (had + V3) and the later action takes the simple past.
उदा. भूतकाल में घटित दो घटनाओं में से जो कार्य पहले समाप्त हुआ हो, उसके लिए Past Perfect Tense (had + V3) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Each of the players *were given* a medal for their performance.
explanation:
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun, but the verb and possessive pronoun following it must be singular.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun/pronoun तो plural होता है, लेकिन इसके साथ आने वाली Verb हमेशा Singular (was) होती है।

questionText: Despite of working hard, *he failed* the examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Therefore, 'Despite working hard' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है)।

questionText: An official pardon granted to a political offender
explanation:
'Amnesty' means an official pardon for people who have been convicted of political offenses.
