questionText: beyond the pale
explanation:
Rule in English: It means outside the bounds of acceptable behavior. 
उदा. Hindi: 'पैल के बाहर' का अर्थ है अस्वीकार्य व्यवहार।

questionText: piece of cake
explanation:
Rule in English: It indicates that something is very easy to do. 
उदा. Hindi: 'केक का टुकड़ा' का मतलब है बहुत आसान।

questionText: spill the beans
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to disclose a secret or confidential information. 
उदा. Hindi: 'बीन्स फेंकना' का मतलब है रहस्य बताना।

questionText: beat around the bush
explanation:
Rule in English: It means to avoid addressing the main point directly. 
उदा. Hindi: 'बुश के चारों ओर मारना' का मतलब है मुख्य विषय से बचना।

questionText: the ball is in your court
options: It is your turn to act
explanation:
Rule in English: It means it is now your responsibility or decision to take action. 
उदा. Hindi: 'गेंद आपकी कोर्ट में है' का मतलब है अब आपका निर्णय लेने का समय है।

questionText: Beyond the pale
options: Something that is unacceptable or outside the bounds of decency
An area beyond a fence or boundary
A location far away from the city
explanation:
It denotes actions or behaviors that are outside acceptable limits.
उदाहरण: उसकी टिप्पणी 'beyond the pale' थी और सभी ने उसे बर्खास्त कर दिया।

questionText: spill the beans
options: To reveal a secret or disclose information
To cook beans and lose them
To make a mistake while cooking
To remove beans from a container
explanation:
It means to disclose a secret or reveal information.
उदाहरण: उसने अपने दोस्त को राज बता दिया, यानी 'spill the beans' कर दिया।

questionText: beat around the bush
options: To avoid talking directly about a subject
To physically beat a bush in the garden
To be very quick in answering questions
To dance around a bush during a party
explanation:
It means to avoid addressing the issue directly.
उदाहरण: उसने सवाल से 'beat around the bush' करके जवाब दिया।

questionText: the ball is in your court
options: It is now your turn to act or decide
You are playing a sport with a ball
You must keep the ball in your hands
You are in charge of a court case
explanation:
It implies that responsibility or decision lies with the person addressed.
उदाहरण: अब निर्णय लेने का समय आपका है; "the ball is in your court"।

questionText: a blessing in disguise
options: An unexpected positive outcome from a bad situation
A literal blessing that disguises itself
A gift hidden under another gift
explanation:
It refers to something that appears negative but turns out beneficial.
उदाहरण: नौकरी खोना उसके लिए 'a blessing in disguise' था क्योंकि नए क्षेत्र में बेहतर मौका मिला।

questionText: add fuel to the fire
options: To intensify an already heated situation
To literally put more fuel on a fire
To create a new fire from scratch
explanation:
It means to worsen or aggravate a situation.
उदाहरण: उसकी टिप्पणियों ने विवाद को 'add fuel to the fire' किया।

questionText: to reveal a secret unintentionally
options: Let the cat out of the bag
explanation:
Rule: This idiom means to disclose a secret by accident.
उदाहरण: उसने गलती से "स्पिल द बीन्स" कर दिया।

questionText: cost an arm and a leg
explanation:
Rule: It signifies something that is very expensive.
उदाहरण: नई कार "कास्ट अ आर्म एंड अ लेग" है।

questionText: in the heat of the moment
explanation:
Rule: It refers to acting impulsively because of strong emotions.
उदाहरण: वह "इन द हीट ऑफ द मोमेंट" में गुस्से में बोल गया।

questionText: a picture is worth a thousand words
explanation:
Rule: Visuals can express more than textual description.
उदाहरण: एक तस्वीर "ए पिक्चर इज़ वर्थ ए थाउज़ैंड वर्ड्स" कहती है।

questionText: keep a stiff upper lip
explanation:
Rule: It means to remain calm and brave in difficult situations.
उदाहरण: वह "कीप अ स्टिफ अप्पर लिप" रखता है।

questionText: write the book
options: To be the best at something
explanation:
Rule: It means to be the best or most knowledgeable in a field.
उदाहरण: वह गणित में "राइट द बुक" है।

questionText: break the ice
options: To start a conversation in a social setting
explanation:
Rule: It means to initiate conversation or activity to ease tension.
उदाहरण: उसने "ब्रेक द आइस" करने के लिए मज़ाक किया।

questionText: The manager as well as his subordinates were present at the meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject (The manager, which is singular). Hence, 'was present' is correct.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता (singular) के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'was' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: She is more smarter than her sister in solving puzzles.
explanation:
Double comparatives ('more smarter') are grammatically incorrect. 'Smart' takes '-er' for its comparative form ('smarter').
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative words ('more' और 'smarter') का प्रयोग एक साथ नहीं किया जा सकता। सही शब्द 'smarter' है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates have submitted their documents on time.
explanation:
'Neither of' takes a singular verb and singular pronoun ('his'). Hence, 'has submitted his' is correct.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद singular verb ('has') और singular possessive pronoun ('his') का प्रयोग होता है।
grammarRule: Pronoun and Verb Agreement with 'Neither of'

questionText: He told to me that he would help me in my crisis.
explanation:
'Tell' is a transitive verb when followed by an object, so it does not take the preposition 'to' after it. 'Told me' is correct.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधा object आता है, बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

questionText: If I was you, I would not accept this project.
explanation:
For hypothetical or imaginary conditional sentences, 'were' is used with all subjects, not 'was'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'was' का नहीं।

questionText: The furniture in his new house are quite expensive and elegant.
explanation:
'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb ('is').
उदा. 'Furniture' एक Uncountable Noun है, जिसके साथ हमेशा Singular Verb ('is') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Despite of working hard, he could not clear the examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (Note: 'In spite of' takes 'of'). Therefore, 'Despite working' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। ('In spite of' होता है)।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: One of the most efficient employee has been transferred to the headquarters.
explanation:
After 'One of the', the noun must be plural ('employees'), but the verb must remain singular ('has') because the subject is 'One'.
उदा. 'One of the' के बाद Noun बहुवचन (plural) होती है ('employees'), लेकिन Verb एकवचन (singular) रहती है ('has')।
grammarRule: Rule of 'One of the + Plural Noun + Singular Verb'

questionText: She has completed her graduation two years ago.
explanation:
Words indicating past time like 'ago', 'yesterday', 'last year' require Simple Past Tense, not Present Perfect.
उदा. 'ago', 'yesterday', 'last year' जैसे शब्दों के साथ Past Indefinite Tense (V2) का प्रयोग होता है, Present Perfect का नहीं।

questionText: The manager as well as his subordinates (were present) at the inaugural ceremony.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('manager', which is singular). Thus, 'was' should replace 'were'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) पहले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'manager' एकवचन है, अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring (when the students rushed) out of their classrooms.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when' or 'then'. Hence, 'than the students rushed' is the correct replacement.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' या 'then' का नहीं।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house (than a heavy shower) drenched me completely.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction used with 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद जोड़े के रूप में 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं।

questionText: If I (was you), I would never accept such a humiliating offer.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary or unreal situation (subjunctive mood), 'were' is used with all subjects, regardless of person or number.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive Mood) में सभी विषयों (subjects) के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, चाहे वह एकवचन हो या बहुवचन।

questionText: She is one of those persons who (always speaks) the truth regardless of the consequences.
explanation:
In sentences starting with 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which)', the verb following the relative pronoun agrees with the plural antecedent (persons), so 'speak' should be used.
उदा. 'one of those + बहुवचन संज्ञा + who' की संरचना में relative pronoun (who) के बाद आने वाली क्रिया अपने antecedent (persons) के अनुसार बहुवचन (plural) होगी।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students (was) present in the auditorium.
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students', which is plural). Therefore, 'were' is correct.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया नजदीक वाले कर्ता (students) के अनुसार बहुवचन (were) होगी।

questionText: He is superior (than me) in both intelligence and experience.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-ior' (such as superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior) take the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'.
उदा. जिन विशेषणों के अंत में '-ior' आता है (जैसे superior, junior आदि), उनके बाद 'than' के स्थान पर 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The committee (are divided) in its opinion regarding the new policy implementation.
explanation:
A collective noun like 'committee' takes a plural verb and plural pronoun when its members are divided in opinion. Here 'are divided' is correct as it refers to individual members.
उदा. जब collective noun (जैसे committee) के सदस्यों में मतभेद हो, तो उसके साथ बहुवचन (plural) क्रिया और सर्वनाम का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Each of the participants (were given) a certificate of appreciation at the end of the work shop
explanation:
The pronoun 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb. Hence, 'was given' must replace 'were given'.
उदा. 'Each' शब्द हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होता है और इसके साथ एकवचन क्रिया का प्रयोग होता है, अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: Scarcely had we reached the station (than the train left).
explanation:
Like 'Hardly', 'Scarcely' is also followed by 'when' (or 'before') and not by 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' की तरह 'Scarcely' के साथ भी 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का।

questionText: The manager put the team on a hot seat.
options: They were praised for their work.
They were literally seated on a hot chair.
explanation:
The idiom 'hot seat' means being in a position of scrutiny or pressure.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक ने टीम को गर्म सीट पर रख दिया, जिसका मतलब है कि टीम पर कड़ी निगरानी है।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions whose meaning is not derived from the literal meaning of the words.

questionText: She was a breath of fresh air.
explanation:
The phrase 'breath of fresh air' denotes someone who brings new energy or positivity.
उदाहरण: वह एक ताज़ा हवा की साँस थी, यानी उसने माहौल को नया जोश दिया।
grammarRule: Idioms often use literal components to convey figurative meaning.

questionText: His argument was a red her ring
options: It was about a literal red fish.
It was a type of fish dish.
explanation:
A 'red herring' is a misleading or distracting point that diverts attention from the real issue.
उदाहरण: उसका तर्क लाल मछली जैसा था, मतलब वह वास्तविक मुद्दे से ध्यान हटाने वाला था।
grammarRule: Idioms are metaphorical expressions used to make a point more vivid.

questionText: They were skating on thin ice.
options: They were literally skating on ice.
They were in a precarious or risky situation.
They were skating on a thick sheet of ice.
explanation:
The idiom 'thin ice' means a dangerous or risky situation that could lead to failure or harm.
उदाहरण: वे पतली बर्फ पर स्केटिंग कर रहे थे, यानी वे जोखिम में थे।
grammarRule: Idioms use imagery to convey a figurative meaning.

questionText: The company is a gold mine.
options: It is a source of great wealth or opportunity.
It is a place where gold is mined.
explanation:
A 'gold mine' refers to a source of abundant benefits or wealth.
उदाहरण: वह कंपनी एक सोने की खान है, यानी बहुत लाभदायक है।
grammarRule: Idioms often employ literal items to create a figurative sense.

questionText: He is a walking encyclopedia.
options: He literally walks around with an encyclopedia.
He knows a large amount of information.
explanation:
A 'walking encyclopedia' means someone who has a vast amount of knowledge at their disposal.
उदाहरण: वह एक चलती-फिरती विश्वकोश है, यानी बहुत ज्ञान रखता है।
grammarRule: Idioms convey complex ideas using simple, everyday language.

questionText: She had a silver lining.
options: She literally had silver on her clothes.
She had a positive aspect or hope in a bad situation.
She had a line of silver.
explanation:
A 'silver lining' is a hopeful or positive aspect hidden within a difficult situation.
उदाहरण: उसके अनुभव में एक चांदी की परत थी, यानी उसमें अच्छा पहलू था।
grammarRule: Idioms often use metaphorical language to express abstract ideas.

questionText: They reached the tipping point.
options: They literally reached the tip of a point.
They arrived at the maximum or critical threshold.
explanation:
The idiom 'tipping point' refers to the moment of maximum change or critical threshold.
उदाहरण: उन्होंने टिंगिंग प्वाइंट पर पहुँच गए, यानी महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ पर।
grammarRule: Idioms use familiar imagery to depict abstract concepts.

questionText: The project is a long shot.
options: It has a low chance of success.
It is a projected long distance.
explanation:
A 'long shot' is an endeavor that is unlikely to succeed or achieve a desired outcome.
उदाहरण: यह परियोजना एक लंबा शॉट है, यानी सफलता की कम सम्भावना है।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions that convey figurative meanings.

questionText: He is burning the midnight oil.
options: He is literally burning oil at midnight.
He is working late into the night.
He is eating oil at midnight.
He is using oil for light.
explanation:
The idiom 'burning the midnight oil' means working late into the night, often studying or working on a task.
उदाहरण: वह आधी रात का तेल जला रहा है, यानी रात देर तक काम कर रहा है।
grammarRule: Idioms use metaphorical language to describe common situations.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'definitely' with an 'f' after the 'e'.
उदाहरण: 'definitely' सही वर्तनी है।
grammarRule: Spelling rule: The suffix '-ly' follows the root 'definite' with an extra 'f'.

questionText: The manager asked the employees to [submit their reports by Monday] in order to prepare the quarterly present at i on.
explanation:
The underlined phrase is already correct. It uses a simple infinitive clause in the correct order. No replacement is needed.
उदाहरण: "वह कर्मचारियों से कह रहा था कि वे अपनी रिपोर्ट सोमवार तक जमा करें।"

questionText: The team was praised for [their outstanding performance] during the championship.
explanation:
The subject of the sentence is "team", which is singular. However, "their" correctly refers to the members of the team. The plural pronoun "their" is acceptable because it refers to the people within the team.
उदाहरण: "उनकी उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए टीम को प्रशंसा मिली।"

questionText: She had to [choose between staying at home and going to the office] after the meeting.
options: choose between staying at home and going to the office
choose between staying at home or going to the office
explanation:
When two alternatives are presented, "or" is the correct conjunction. The phrase should use "or" instead of "and" to show a choice.
उदाहरण: "उसे बैठक के बाद घर पर रहने या कार्यालय जाने के बीच चुनना था।"

questionText: The project was completed by the team due to [their diligent efforts].
explanation:
The clause correctly uses a possessive pronoun to refer to the team members. "Their" matches the plural sense of "team" as a group.
उदाहरण: "उनके परिश्रमी प्रयासों के कारण परियोजना पूरी हुई।"

questionText: The students were told to [submit the assignment by Friday] before the dead line
explanation:
The correct phrase places the time expression "by Friday" after the infinitive. The alternative with "before Friday" changes the meaning.
उदाहरण: "छात्रों को शुक्रवार तक असाइनमेंट जमा करने के लिए कहा गया था।"

questionText: The committee decided to [reschedule the meeting] to accommodate everyone's availability.
explanation:
The phrase is grammatically correct. No change is required.
उदाहरण: "समिति ने सभी की उपलब्धता के अनुसार बैठक को पुनः निर्धारित करने का निर्णय लिया।"

questionText: He was praised for [his leader ship skills] during the crisis.
explanation:
The noun "skills" is plural and matches the plural form. "Skill" would be singular and incorrect.
उदाहरण: "उसकी नेतृत्व क्षमताओं के लिए उसकी प्रशंसा की गई।"

questionText: The manager suggested that the staff [take a short break] to refresh themselves.
explanation:
In a subjunctive clause after "suggested that", the base form of the verb is used. "Take" is correct.
उदाहरण: "प्रबंधक ने कर्मचारियों को ताज़गी के लिए एक छोटा ब्रेक लेने का सुझाव दिया।"

questionText: The company will issue a statement [once all the facts are gathered].
options: once all the facts are gathered
once all the facts have been gathered
once all facts have been gathered
explanation:
The correct form uses the perfect passive "have been gathered" because the gathering is completed before the statement is issued.
उदाहरण: "सभी तथ्यों के इकट्ठा हो जाने पर कंपनी एक बयान जारी करेगी।"

questionText: The report was prepared by the team [to provide an overview of the current situation].
options: to provide an overview of the current situation
to providing an overview of the current situation
explanation:
The infinitive phrase "to provide" correctly follows "by the team". The form "to providing" is incorrect.
उदाहरण: "रिपोर्ट वर्तमान स्थिति का अवलोकन देने के लिए टीम द्वारा तैयार की गई।"

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "She was exapcted to arrive early.
explanation: The correct spelling is "expected". The rule is that the 'x' sound is represented by 'x' followed by 'p', not 'pa'. Hindi: "उम्मीद की गई" के लिए सही वर्तनी "expected" है।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the phrase: "The legislatoin passed.
explanation: The correct spelling is "legislation". The rule is that the root "legis" is followed by the suffix '-lation'. Hindi: "कानून बनाना" के लिए सही वर्तनी "legislation" है।

questionText: The committee [has decided] to postpone the meeting.
explanation:
Subject-verb agreement: a singular subject takes a singular verb.
उदाहरण: समिति ने बैठक को स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया है।

questionText: Neither the manager nor the employees [are] aware of the new policy.
explanation:
When the subjects are joined by neither…nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject.
उदाहरण: न तो प्रबंधक और न ही कर्मचारी नई नीति से अवगत हैं।

questionText: The students who studied [were] the winners of the competition.
explanation:
Plural subject requires plural verb.
उदाहरण: जिन्होंने पढ़ाई की थी, वे प्रतियोगिता के विजेता थे।

questionText: It is important that each of the participants [completes] the form.
explanation:
Each is a singular pronoun, so the verb is singular.

questionText: The committee, <u>which is a body of experts< / u>, is convened to discuss the issue.
options: The committee, a body of experts, is convened to discuss the issue.

The committee, which is a body of experts and is convened to discuss the issue.
The committee, a body of experts, convenes to discuss the issue.
explanation:
The phrase is a non‑restrictive relative clause; it can be replaced by a non‑restrictive noun phrase without changing the meaning. Hence, 'a body of experts' is correct.

explanation:
"Blunt" denotes lack of sharpness. Its opposite is "Sharp", meaning capable of cutting.
उदाहरण: Blunt (मंद) का विपरीत "Sharp" (तीखा) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: A word’s antonym often reflects the opposite attribute.

questionText: Chaos
explanation:
"Chaos" means disorder. The opposite concept is "Order", meaning systematic arrangement.
उदाहरण: Chaos (अराजकता) का विपरीत "Order" (व्यवस्था) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Opposites can denote contrasting states of organization.

questionText: Diminish
explanation:
"Diminish" means to become smaller. Its opposite is "Increase", meaning to become larger.
उदाहरण: Diminish (घटाना) का विपरीत "Increase" (बढ़ाना) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Antonyms often convey opposite actions of quantity or magnitude.

questionText: Eager
explanation:
"Eager" means enthusiastic. The opposite is "Indifferent", meaning lacking interest or enthusiasm.
उदाहरण: Eager (उत्सुक) का विपरीत "Indifferent" (उदासीन) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Antonyms can describe contrasting levels of interest or enthusiasm.

questionText: Fragile
explanation:
"Fragile" means easily broken. Its opposite is "Strong", meaning capable of withstanding pressure.
उदाहरण: Fragile (नाजुक) का विपरीत "Strong" (मजबूत) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Opposite words may describe contrasting durability or resilience.

questionText: Genuine
explanation:
"Genuine" means real and authentic. The opposite is "Fake", meaning not real.
उदाहरण: Genuine (सच्चा) का विपरीत "Fake" (नकली) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Antonyms can indicate authenticity versus falsity.

questionText: Harsh
explanation:
"Harsh" means severe or cruel. Its opposite is "Gentle", meaning mild and kind.
उदाहरण: Harsh (कठोर) का विपरीत "Gentle" (मृदु) है।
grammarRule: Antonym rule: Antonyms often express contrasting degrees of severity.

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word from the list.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "receive" with an 'e' before the 'i'.
नियम: 'i' से पहले 'e' आता है, जब शब्द 'c' से पहले नहीं होता।
grammarRule: Rule of 'i before e except after c'.

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘exhilarate’, not ‘exhilarate’.
Rule: The suffix ‘-ate’ is used after verbs; the base ‘exhilar’ is spelled with ‘h’.
उदाहरण: ‘exhilarate’ means to make someone very happy.

questionText: Choose the incorrectly spelled word
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘misspell’ (two ’s’). The option ‘Mispell’ is wrong.
Rule: The prefix ‘mis-’ is followed by double ‘s’ in words like ‘misspell’.
उदाहरण: ‘misspell’ means to spell incorrectly.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘harassment’. The option ‘harassment’ is misspelled.
Rule: The noun ‘harass’ takes a double ‘s’ before the suffix ‘-ment’.
उदाहरण: ‘harassment’ refers to repeated unwelcome behavior.

questionText: Choose the word that is misspelled
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘convenient’. The option ‘convenient’ is misspelled.
Rule: The root ‘conven’ takes ‘ient’ suffix.
उदाहरण: ‘convenient’ means ‘suitable’.

questionText: Hardly had I stepped / out of the house than / a heavy downpour occur red / without any warning.
explanation:
The conjunction 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when' in part (B).
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः (B) भाग में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates / who had applied for the post / were eligible for / the final selection round.
explanation:
'Neither of' takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (C).
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है। इसलिए (C) में 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' आएगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (Neither of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: The manager as well as his / subordinates were present / at the emergency meeting / called by the direct or.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager'). Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as', 'with', आदि से जुड़ें, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' singular है, अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।

questionText: She insisted to accompany / her younger brother to the market / despite their mother's / strict instructions.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (-ing form), not an infinitive. Replace 'to accompany' with 'on accompanying' in part (A).
उदा. Verb 'insist' के बाद preposition 'on' और gerund (-ing) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (A) में 'to accompany' के स्थान पर 'on accompanying' होगा।
grammarRule: Fixed Preposition with Gerund (Insist on + V-ing)

questionText: No sooner did the train / arrive at the platform / than the eager passengers / rushed towards it.
explanation:
The sentence is grammatically correct and has no error. Option (D) is the correct choice.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई व्याकरण संबंधी त्रुटि नहीं है, यह पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: One of my best friends / are going to London / next week to attend / an international seminar.
explanation:
'One of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).
उदा. 'One of' के बाद plural noun आता है लेकिन verb singular होती है। इसलिए (B) में 'are' की जगह 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: The company has decided to / launch a new range of / products in the market / during the festive season.
explanation:
The sentence is grammatically sound. No error found. Option (D).
उदा. वाक्य में सभी नियम सही रूप से प्रयुक्त हुए हैं, अतः कोई त्रुटि नहीं है।

questionText: If I was the king of / this country, I would ensure / that no one goes to / bed hungry at night.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, not 'was'. Replace 'was' with 'were' in part (A).
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive Mood) में सभी subjects के साथ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (A) में 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: Despite of working hard / through out the year, he failed / to secure the top rank / in the university exams.
explanation:
'Despite' does not take 'of' after it (though 'In spite of' does). Remove 'of' from part (A).
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः (A) में 'of' को हटाना होगा।
grammarRule: Superfluous Preposition (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: He is superior than me / in every aspect of the job / and handles complex situations / with great ease.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like superior, junior, senior, inferior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than me' with 'to me' in part (A).
उदा. Latin adjectives जिनके अंत में '-or' आता है (जैसे superior, junior), उनके बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (A) में 'than me' की जगह 'to me' होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than a heavy downpour / soaked me completely / from head to toe.
options: Hardly had I stepped out of the house
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'Than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है।

questionText: Each of the students in the class / are expected to submit / their assignments / before Friday evening.
options: Each of the students in the class
explanation:
When 'Each of' is followed by a plural noun, the verb and pronoun that follow should ideally be singular. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद plural noun आता है, लेकिन इसके साथ प्रयोग होने वाला verb हमेशा singular होता है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।

questionText: The manager as well as his subordinates / were present / at the emergency meeting / called by the direct or.
options: The manager as well as his subordinates
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' singular है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates / have paid / their examination fee / within the stipulated time.
explanation:
'Neither of' is singular and takes a singular verb. Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Neither of' का अर्थ होता है दो में से कोई नहीं, जो कि singular माना जाता है। इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb 'has' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: She is senior / than me / by two years / in this organization.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (such as senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. Latin comparative adjectives जैसे senior, junior आदि के बाद 'than' के स्थान पर preposition 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: It is high time / the government takes / strict actions against / corruption.
explanation:
The phrase 'It is high time' or 'It is time' must be followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाला clause हमेशा Past Tense (V2) में होना चाहिए। इसलिए 'takes' की जगह 'took' आएगा।

questionText: One of my best friends / are a renowned doctor / working in a prestigious / city hospital.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. नियम के अनुसार 'One of' के बाद noun plural होता है, लेकिन verb हमेशा singular आती है। अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: If I was the king / of this country, / I would eradicate poverty / within a year.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used for all subjects with the verb 'to be'. Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्य (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी subjects के साथ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Scarcely had he reached / the railway station / than the train / started moving.
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' must be followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to _________ awareness about road safety.
explanation:
To infinitive ('to') takes the base form (V1) of the verb. 'Spread' remains the same in V1, V2, and V3.
उदा. Infinitives ('to' + verb) के बाद हमेशा Verb की Base Form (V1) का प्रयोग होता है। 'Spread' की तीनों forms समान होती हैं।

questionText: She has been working in this organization _________ five years.
explanation:
Use 'for' with a period of time (five years) and 'since' with a point of time.
उदा. अवधि (period of time) जैसे 'five years' के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, जबकि निश्चित समय (point of time) के लिए 'since' आता है।

questionText: Had you informed me earlier, I _________ attended the meeting.
explanation:
Third conditional structure: If clause has 'had + V3', the main clause takes 'would have + V3'.
उदा. Conditional Sentences के Type 3 में यदि subordinate clause में 'had + V3' हो, तो main clause में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The manager was highly impressed _________ her dedication and hard work.
explanation:
The adjective 'impressed' is generally followed by the preposition 'with' when referring to things or qualities.
उदा. Adjective 'impressed' के बाद सामान्यतः preposition 'with' का प्रयोग होता है जब किसी की योग्यताओं या गुणों की प्रशंसा की जाए।

questionText: Hardly had he stepped out of the house _________ it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly / Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before'.
उदा. Correlative conjunction 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है (जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है)।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students _________ present in the class room.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it ('students', which is plural).
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: Despite working hard, he could not clear the exam because his preparation was _________.
explanation:
Contextual vocabulary: failing the exam despite hard work implies the preparation was insufficient or 'inadequate'.
उदा. वाक्य के संदर्भ (context) के अनुसार, कठिन परिश्रम करने के बाद भी परीक्षा पास न कर पाने का कारण तैयारी का अपर्याप्त यानी 'inadequate' होना है।

questionText: Choose the correct preposition: He succeeded _________ achieving his goal after years of struggle.
explanation:
The verb 'succeed' is always followed by the preposition 'in' (+ gerund). 
उदा. Verb 'succeed' के बाद हमेशा fixed preposition 'in' का प्रयोग होता है और इसके बाद gerund (V1+ing) आता है।

questionText: The thief confessed _________ the stolen goods from the locked house.
explanation:
The phrase 'confess to' is followed by a gerund (-ing form), as 'to' here acts as a preposition.
उदा. Phrasal verb या expression 'confess to' के बाद preposition 'to' होने के कारण Gerund (V1+ing) यानी 'to stealing' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: A committee of experts _________ appointed to investigate the financial scam.
explanation:
Collective nouns like 'committee' take a singular verb when acting as a single unit.
उदा. Collective noun ('committee') जब एक इकाई (single unit) के रूप में कार्य करे, तो उसके साथ Singular Verb ('was') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure the promotion as his rival was ________ him in experience.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior) are followed by the preposition 'to', not 'than'.
उदा. 'Superior', 'junior', 'senior' आदि के बाद हमेशा preposition 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।
grammarRule: Fixed Preposition with Adjectives ending in '-or'

questionText: The minister appealed to the public to maintain peace and not to ________ to rumors.
explanation:
'Give in' means to surrender or yield. 'Give up' means to stop trying. The context demands yielding to rumors.
उदा. 'Give in' का अर्थ हार मानना या झुकना होता है। यहाँ अफवाहों के आगे न झुकने की बात हो रही है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates who applied for the post of branch manager ________ qualified.
explanation:
'Neither of' takes a singular verb because it refers to none of the two individually.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है, लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (is/has/was) होती है।

questionText: She has a natural ________ for painting and has won several national awards.
explanation:
'Aptitude' means a natural ability to do something. 'Attitude' means a settled way of thinking.
उदा. 'Aptitude' का अर्थ किसी कार्य में स्वाभाविक योग्यता या प्रतिभा होता है।

questionText: Had the police arrived on time, the tragedy ________ averted.
explanation:
In third conditional sentences (Past hypothetical), the structure in the main clause is 'would/could/might + have + V3'.
उदा. Past conditional (Had + Subject + V3) के वाक्य के दूसरे भाग में 'would/could/might + have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee reached a consensus after hours of discussion and decided to ________ the new policy immediately.
explanation:
'Adopt' means to legally take up or start using a policy/idea. 'Adapt' means to adjust.
उदा. किसी नियम, नीति या प्रस्ताव को स्वीकार करने के लिए 'adopt' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has launched a massive campaign to ________ awareness about water conservation.
explanation:
Collocation: We 'spread awareness' or 'raise awareness', making 'spread' the correct fit.
उदा. जागरूकता फैलाने के लिए 'spread awareness' सही collocation है।

questionText: No sooner did the train stop at the platform ________ the passengers rushed towards the exit doors.
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'Scarcely/Hardly' के साथ 'when/before' आता है।

questionText: The company's profits have plummeted this quarter, forcing management to ________ drastic cost-cutting measures.
explanation:
'Resort to' means to do something bad or extreme because you have no other choice.
उदा. 'Resort to' का अर्थ किसी मजबूरी में कोई सख्त कदम उठाना होता है।

questionText: It is high time the authorities ________ strict action against illegal parking in the city.
explanation:
Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are followed by a clause in the simple past tense (V2).
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद यदि subject दिया हो, तो verb की Past Form (V2) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Which one of the following words is spelled correctly?
explanation:
The word ‘definitely’ contains a double ‘i’ after the ‘f’.
उदाहरण: "I am definitely going to attend the meeting."
grammarRule: Spelling of words with double consonants after 'f'

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the given context or options.
explanation:
'Govement' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Government' with an 'n' before 'ment'.
उदा. 'Govement' गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'Government' है जिसमें 'ment' से पहले 'n' आता है।

questionText: Select the incorrectly spelled word among the choices.
explanation:
'Seige' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Siege' following the 'i before e except after c' rule exception.
उदा. 'Seige' गलत है। सही वर्तनी 'Siege' है ('i' पहले आता है 'e' से)।
grammarRule: I before E except after C rule exceptions

questionText: Find the correctly spelled word from the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Millennium' which has double 'l' and double 'n'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Millennium' है जिसमें दो 'l' और दो 'n' होते हैं।
grammarRule: Double consonants in Latin roots (l and n)

questionText: She has been working ________ the company for over five years.
explanation:
Use the preposition "in" to indicate the place of employment.
उदाहरण: "She has been working **in** the company for over five years."

questionText: The train ________ at 10 a.m. tomorrow.
explanation:
Future simple tense: subject + will + base form of verb.
उदाहरण: "The train **will depart** at 10 a.m. tomorrow."

questionText: He is ________ his project when I called.
explanation:
Present continuous + preposition "on".
उदाहरण: "He is **working on** his project when I called."

questionText: Please refrain ________ the kitchen while cooking.
explanation:
"Refrain from" is a fixed phrase.
उदाहरण: "Please refrain **from** the kitchen while cooking."

questionText: She has been ________ the news for the last hour.
explanation:
"Following" is the present participle used after "has been".
उदाहरण: "She has been **following** the news for the last hour."

questionText: The new policy will ________ the employees' morale.
explanation:
Future simple tense: subject + will + base verb.
उदाहरण: "The new policy will **boost** the employees' morale."

questionText: If he ________ earlier, he would have caught the bus.
explanation:
"Had left" is the past perfect form used in third conditional.
उदाहरण: "If he **had left** earlier, he would have caught the bus."

questionText: The manager is known ________ his strict discipline.
explanation:
"Known for" is the correct preposition to express reputation.
उदाहरण: "The manager is known **for** his strict discipline."

questionText: They will start the meeting ________ the chairman's arrival.
explanation:
"Upon" indicates that the meeting will begin immediately after.
उदाहरण: "They will start the meeting **upon** the chairman's arrival."

questionText: I couldn't find my keys; they must have ________ some where.
explanation:
"Must have gone" is the correct modal perfect construction.
उदाहरण: "I couldn't find my keys; they must have **gone** somewhere."

questionText: He had no ________ to explain the sudden change in his behavior.
explanation:
The word *reason* is a noun meaning a cause or explanation.
उदा. "उसे अपनी अचानक परिवर्तन के लिए कोई कारण नहीं मिला।"

questionText: The committee will meet ________ Friday morning.
explanation:
Use *on* with days of the week.
उदा. "समिति शुक्रवार सुबह मिलेगी।"

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'on'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: She was ________ to the new job, but she accepted it.
explanation:
*Reluctant* is an adjective meaning unwilling or disinclined.

An epitaph is a phrase or form of words written in memory of a person who has died, especially as an inscription on a tombstone. 
उदा. 'Epitaph' समाधिलेख या कब्र पर मृत व्यक्ति की स्मृति में लिखा गया लेख होता है।

questionText: A person who cannot be corrected or reformed
explanation:
Incorrigible means incapable of being reformed or corrected. 
उदा. 'Incorrigible' उस व्यक्ति को कहते हैं जिसे सुधारा न जा सके। (In- (not) + corrigere (to correct)).
grammarRule: Root: Corrigible (capable of being corrected) + In- (not)

questionText: A person who is in different to pain or pleasure
explanation:
A stoic is a person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. 
उदा. 'Stoic' (उदासीन/संतोषी) वह व्यक्ति होता है जिस पर सुख या दुःख का कोई विशेष प्रभाव नहीं पड़ता।

questionText: DELECTABLE
explanation:
Delectable means delicious or tasty. Its antonym is 'Unpalatable', which means not pleasant to taste.
उदा. Delectable का अर्थ स्वादिष्ट है, इसका विलोम 'Unpalatable' (बेस्वाद/अरुचिकर) है।

questionText: HAPLESS
explanation:
Hapless means unfortunate. Its antonym is 'Lucky', having good luck or fortunate.
उदा. Hapless का अर्थ अभागा होता है, इसका विलोम 'Lucky' (भाग्यशाली) है।

questionText: OSTENTATION
explanation:
Ostentation means pretentious display. Its antonym is 'Modesty', which means unassuming or moderate behavior.
उदा. Ostentation का अर्थ दिखावा है, इसका विलोम 'Modesty' (विनम्रता/सादगी) है।

questionText: The ___ of the meeting was to discuss policy changes.
explanation:
Rule in English: The noun "agenda" is used to replace the long phrase "list of items to be discussed".
उदा. हिंदी में: इस वाक्य में "agenda" का प्रयोग "meeting के विषयवस्तु" के लिए किया गया है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long phrase

questionText: He was an ___ person who always helped others.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Altruistic" means selfless, used instead of "someone who puts others' needs before his own".
उदा. हिंदी में: "altruistic" का अर्थ है "दूसरों की भलाई में अपना योगदान देने वाला"।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a descriptive phrase

questionText: The ___ of the city was destroyed by the flood.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Infrastructure" replaces the phrase "the essential facilities and systems supporting a city".
उदा. हिंदी में: "infrastructure" का प्रयोग "शहर की मूलभूत सुविधाएँ" के लिए किया जाता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long description

questionText: She has an ___ sense of humor that never fails to amuse.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Inimitable" means impossible to imitate, used instead of "something that cannot be duplicated".
उदा. हिंदी में: "inimitable" का अर्थ है "अनन्य, जिसकी नकल नहीं की जा सकती"।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long phrase

questionText: The ___ of the project is to reduce carbon emissions by 50% in 10 years.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Objective" can replace the phrase "the purpose or aim of a project".
उदा. हिंदी में: "objective" का प्रयोग "परियोजना का उद्देश्य" के लिए किया जाता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long phrase

questionText: The ___ of the policy is to ensure transparency in government dealings.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Principle" replaces the phrase "fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior".
उदा. हिंदी में: "principle" का अर्थ है "मूलभूत सिद्धांत"।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long description

questionText: He gave a ___ explanation that made every one understand the concept quickly.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Succinct" means expressed in a few words, used instead of "short and clear".
उदा. हिंदी में: "succinct" का अर्थ है "संक्षिप्त और स्पष्ट"।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long phrase

questionText: The ___ of the new law will be implemented next month.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Implementation" replaces the phrase "the act of putting a plan into effect".
उदा. हिंदी में: "implementation" का प्रयोग "किसी योजना को लागू करने" के लिए किया जाता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long description

questionText: The ___ of the report highlighted the major challenges faced by the project.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Abstract" can replace the phrase "a brief summary of the main points of a research paper".
उदा. हिंदी में: "abstract" का अर्थ है "सारांश"।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long phrase

questionText: The ___ of the committee is to review the new regulations.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Mandate" replaces the phrase "the authority to make decisions or orders".
उदा. हिंदी में: "mandate" का प्रयोग "अधिकार" के लिए किया जाता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for a long description

questionText: DEARTH
explanation:
'Dearth' means a scarcity or lack of something. Its antonym is 'Abundance', which means a very large quantity of something.
उदा. 'Dearth' का अर्थ कमी या अभाव होता है, और इसका विलोम शब्द 'Abundance' (प्रचुरता) है।

questionText: ECLIPSE
explanation:
'Eclipse' in this context means to obscure or make less bright/prominent. Its antonym is 'Shine', which means to give out bright light or be prominent.
उदा. 'Eclipse' का अर्थ चमक फीकी करना या ग्रहण लगना होता है, जिसका विपरीत 'Shine' (चमकना) है।

questionText: FECUND
explanation:
'Fecund' means producing or capable of producing an abundance of offspring or new growth; fertile. Its antonym is 'Barren' (unproductive).
उदा. 'Fecund' का अर्थ उपजाऊ या उत्पादक होता है, जिसका विलोम 'Barren' (बंजर) है।

questionText: IMPECCABLE
explanation:
'Impeccable' means faultless, in accordance with the highest standards. Its antonym is 'Imperfect', meaning not perfect or containing flaws.
उदा. 'Impeccable' का अर्थ त्रुटिहीन होता है, जिसका विलोम 'Imperfect' (अपूर्ण या त्रुटिपूर्ण) है।

questionText: JUVENILE
explanation:
'Juvenile' means youthful or relating to young people. Its antonym is 'Senile', meaning showing the weaknesses or diseases of old age.
उदा. 'Juvenile' का अर्थ किशोर या युवा होता है, जिसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'Senile' (बुढ़ापे से संबंधित/सठियाया हुआ) है।

questionText: scarce
explanation:
Scarce means not plentiful or in short supply. Its antonym is abundant, which means plentiful or plentifully available.
उदा. 'The desert had scarce water, but the oasis offered abundant life.'

questionText: strict
explanation:
Strict refers to a rigid or harsh enforcement of rules. Lenient means permissive or forgiving, which is the opposite.
उदा. 'The teacher was strict, but the substitute was lenient with the assignments.'

questionText: decrease
explanation:
"Decrease" means to become smaller or smaller in amount. "Increase" means to become larger or larger in amount, which is its antonym.
उदा. 'The population decreased, but the workforce increased during the boom.'

questionText: compromise
explanation:
Compromise means to settle a dispute by mutual concession. Resolve means to find a solution without giving up, which is opposite.
उदा. 'They compromised on the budget, but the council resolved to reject the proposal.'

questionText: optimistic
explanation:
"Optimistic" means hopeful about the future. "Pessimistic" means having a negative outlook, which is its antonym.
उदा. 'She was optimistic about the project, but her colleague remained pessimistic.'

questionText: generate
explanation:
"Generate" means to produce or create. "Destroy" means to cause to cease to exist, which is its opposite.
उदा. 'The factory generates electricity, but the old plant destroyed the environment.'

questionText: tender
explanation:
"Tender" means an offer that is not firm. "Firm" means solid or steadfast, which is the opposite.
उदा. 'The bid was tender, but the board accepted the firm proposal.'

questionText: rare
explanation:
"Rare" means not common. "Common" means frequently occurring or widely present, the opposite.
उदा. 'Her skills were rare, but most of her peers were common in that field.'

questionText: suitable
explanation:
"Suitable" means appropriate or fitting. "Inappropriate" means not suitable or not fitting, which is the antonym.
उदा. 'His dress was suitable for the occasion, but the other guests wore inappropriate attire.'

questionText: opposite
explanation:
An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'विपरीत' का अर्थ 'उल्टा' या 'काउंटर' होता है, इसलिए 'opposite' का विपरीत 'converse' है।

questionText: scarce
explanation:
An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning. 'Scarce' means not plentiful; its opposite is 'abundant', meaning plentiful.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'कम' का विपरीत 'अधिक' या 'पर्याप्त' होता है।

questionText: passive
explanation:
An antonym gives the opposite sense. 'Passive' means not active; its opposite is 'active', meaning engaged or energetic.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'निष्क्रिय' का विपरीत 'सक्रिय' है।

questionText: ancient
explanation:
An antonym is a word that means the opposite. 'Ancient' means very old; its opposite is 'modern', meaning recent or up‑to‑date.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'प्राचीन' का विपरीत 'आधुनिक' है।

questionText: unfair
explanation:
An antonym provides the reverse meaning. 'Unfair' means not just; its opposite is 'just', meaning fair and impartial.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'अन्यायपूर्ण' का विपरीत 'न्यायपूर्ण' है।

questionText: absent
explanation:
An antonym is a word that has the opposite sense. 'Absent' means not there; its opposite is 'present', meaning there.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'ग़ैर‑मौजूद' का विपरीत 'मौजूद' है।

questionText: hot
explanation:
An antonym gives the reverse meaning. 'Hot' means at a high temperature; its opposite is 'cold', meaning at a low temperature.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'गर्म' का विपरीत 'ठंडा' है।

questionText: courageous
explanation:
An antonym expresses the opposite sense. 'Courageous' means brave; its opposite is 'timid', meaning lacking courage.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'साहसी' का विपरीत 'कायर' है।

questionText: brief
explanation:
An antonym means the opposite. 'Brief' means short; its opposite is 'long', meaning extended in time or space.
उदाहरण के लिए, 'संक्षिप्त' का विपरीत 'लंबा' है।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word among the following choices.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *occasion*.

Rule: The word contains double 'c' and double 'a'. 
उदा. *occasion* has two 'c's and two 'a's.
grammarRule: Spelling of words with double consonants and vowels

questionText: Science and technology / has brought about / vital changes in our lives. / No error
explanation:
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' to express a single idea or plural subjects, they take a plural verb. Here 'Science and technology' are plural subjects, so 'have' should be used instead of 'has'.
उदा. जब दो singular nouns को 'and' से जोड़ा जाए और वे अलग-अलग subjects को दर्शाते हैं, तो verb हमेशा plural ('have') आती है, न कि singular ('has')।

questionText: Neither the girl / nor her parents / was present at the party. / No error
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'her parents' (plural), so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ पास वाला subject 'her parents' (plural) है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: The direct or as well as / the crew members / were present in the meeting. / No error
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', 'with', 'along with', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Here the first subject 'The director' is singular, so 'was' should be used instead of 'were'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as', 'with' आदि से जुड़ें, तो verb हमेशा पहले subject ('The director' - singular) के अनुसार होती है, इसलिए 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' होगा।

questionText: Each of the students / in the computer class / have submitted their project. / No error
explanation:
'Each of', 'Every of', 'Either of' are followed by a plural noun but take a singular verb and singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his/her'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb और pronoun हमेशा singular होते हैं। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' और 'their' की जगह 'his' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: No sooner did / the sun rise / when the fog cleared. / No error
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when' or 'before'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। इसलिए वाक्य के भाग (C) में 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

questionText: Hardly had I arrived / at the station than / the train left. / No error
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ 'than' का नहीं बल्कि 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: She is more smarter / than her sister / in solving puzzles. / No error
explanation:
Double comparatives should not be used together. 'Smart' is a single syllable adjective, so its comparative is 'smarter'. Using 'more' before 'smarter' is incorrect. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक ही adjective के साथ दो comparative words ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'smarter' अपने आप में सही है, इसलिए 'more' हटा दें।

questionText: Unless you do not / work hard, / you cannot pass the exam. / No error
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative word and inherently denotes condition. Never use another negative word like 'not' in the same clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ होता है 'यदि नहीं', इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग करना गलत है। भाग (A) से 'do not' हटाएं।

questionText: It is high time / you start preparing / for your upcoming exams. / No error
explanation:
Expressions like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are always followed by a verb in the past subjunctive (Simple Past tense). Replace 'start' with 'started'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाली clause हमेशा Simple Past Tense (V2) में होती है। इसलिए 'start' की जगह 'started' का प्रयोग होगा।
grammarRule: Past Subjunctive after 'It is high time'

questionText: He behaves as if / he is the owner / of this large company. / No error
explanation:
After 'as if' or 'as though', to denote an unreal situation in the present, we always use 'were' instead of 'is/was' with all subjects. Replace 'is' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक स्थिति (Hypothetical situation) दर्शाने के लिए 'as if' के साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, चाहे subject singular ही क्यों न हो।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students / was present in the class / yesterday .
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' होना चाहिए।

questionText: She has / read / all the book / yesterday .
explanation:
The presence of 'yesterday' indicates simple past tense, so 'has read' is incorrect (should be 'read' in simple past). Also, 'all the book' should be 'all the books' because 'book' is countable and plural context is required. Alternatively, 'She read all the books yesterday'.
उदा. वाक्य में 'yesterday' दिया गया है जो भूतकाल (Past tense) को दर्शाता है। साथ ही 'all the' के बाद 'books' (plural) का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: No sooner did / I open the door / when the bird flew out / into the garden .
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Therefore, 'when' should be replaced with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का।

questionText: One of my friends / are going / to America / next month .
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' takes a plural noun ('friends') but a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद संज्ञा (noun) तो बहुवचन होती है, लेकिन क्रिया (verb) हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है। इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: He is / taller than / me / (No Error) .
explanation:
In comparative degree, comparison is made between two nominative cases. It should be 'taller than I (am)' instead of 'me'.
उदा. तुलनात्मक वाक्यों में (Comparative degree) दोनों तरफ कर्ता कारक (Nominative case) का प्रयोग होता है। 'me' के स्थान पर 'I' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Scarcely had I / arrived at the station / than the train left / without me .
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के बाद संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

questionText: The manager as well as / his clerks / were present / at the meeting .
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager'). Since 'manager' is singular, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता ('The manager') के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।

questionText: Unless you / do not work hard / you cannot / pass the exam .
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative word in itself, so we do not use another negative word like 'not' in the same clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' एक नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'do not' को हटाना होगा।

questionText: He told me that / he is writing / a letter to his father / at that moment .
explanation:
The reporting verb 'told' is in the past tense, so the reported speech must also be in the past tense. Replace 'is writing' with 'was writing'.
उदा. मुख्य वाक्य (Reporting verb) 'told' भूतकाल में है, इसलिए आगे का वाक्य भी भूतकाल में होना चाहिए। 'is writing' की जगह 'was writing' आएगा।
grammarRule: Sequence of Tenses in Indirect Speech

questionText: Each of the students / have submitted / their assignments / on time .
explanation:
'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb ('has' instead of 'have') and a singular pronoun ('his' instead of 'their'). Here part (B) contains the verb error. 
उदा. 'Each' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया (singular verb) का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: A. The team of experts were invited to the conference.
B. The team of experts was invited to the conference.
C. The team of experts have been invited to the conference.
D. The team of experts is invited to the conference.
explanation:
The subject ‘team’ is singular, so the verb must be singular.
उदाहरण: The team is ready.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: A. Everyone should bring their own laptop.
B. Everyone should bring his or her own laptop.
C. Everyone should bring her own laptop.
D. Everyone should bring their own laptop.
explanation:
The pronoun ‘everyone’ is singular; the correct pronoun is ‘his or her’ or a singular ‘their’ (non‑standard).
उदाहरण: Everyone has his own book.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: A. The children, as well as the teacher, has been praised.
B. The children, as well as the teacher, have been praised.
C. The children as well as the teacher has been praised.
D. The children as well as the teacher have been praised.
explanation:
When a compound subject joined by ‘as well as’ is singular, the verb must be singular. Here the verb agrees with ‘children’ (plural) because ‘as well as’ does not change the number.
उदाहरण: The students, along with the principal, have been invited.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: A. She had finished her work before the meeting started.
B. She had finished her work before the meeting starts.
C. She had finished her work before the meeting will start.
D. She had finished her work before the meeting had started.
explanation:
The sequence of tenses requires past perfect before past simple: ‘had finished’ (past perfect) and ‘started’ (past simple).
उदाहरण: He had left before the bus arrived.
grammarRule: Past Perfect and Past Simple Sequence

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word from the choices below
explanation:

गलत वर्तनी: Definately, Definetely, Definitley

questionText: Which of the words below is spelled correctly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is *warranty* – 'a' after 't'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी: warranty
गलत वर्तनी: Warrantee, Warantie, Warrenty

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word from the options
explanation:

उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी: conscientious
गलत वर्तनी: Consciencious, Conscientus, Conscientious (duplicate)

questionText: The manager as well as his subordinates were present at the emergency meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject (The manager, which is singular). Hence, use singular verb 'was'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो वर्ब पहले वाले सब्जेक्ट (The manager - singular) के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house then it started raining heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always 'when', not 'than' (which is used with 'No sooner').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का।

questionText: She told me that she is writing a novel for the last three years.
explanation:
Since 'for the last three years' indicates an action starting in the past and continuing into the present within a past narrative context, the past perfect continuous tense 'had been writing' or present perfect continuous is required. Wait, reporting verb is past ('told'), so present continuous 'is writing' becomes past perfect continuous 'had been writing'. Let's use 'had been writing'.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'has been writing' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates have cleared the written examination.
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun but takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'have' should be replaced by 'has'.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद प्लूरल नाउन आता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा सिंगुलर होती है। अतः 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

questionText: If I was the king, I would eradicate poverty from the country.
options: If I will be the king
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary or unreal past/present situation (subjunctive mood), 'were' is used with all subjects, not 'was'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive Mood) में सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The furniture in his new house look very expensive and elegant.
explanation:
'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and always takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'look' must be replaced by 'looks'.
उदा. 'Furniture' एक अनकाउंटेबल नाउन है और इसके साथ हमेशा सिंगुलर वर्ब आती है। अतः 'look' का 'looks' होगा।

questionText: She is more taller than her sister, although she is younger.
explanation:
Double comparatives ('more taller') are grammatically incorrect. The correct comparative form of 'tall' is simply 'taller'.
उदा. दो कॉम्परेटिव एक साथ (more taller) प्रयोग नहीं होते। 'tall' की कॉम्परेटिव डिग्री 'taller' होती है।

questionText: Scarcely had he reached the office when it started to pour cats and dogs.
explanation:
'Scarcely' is correctly followed by 'when', and the past perfect tense with inversion ('had he reached') is accurate. No improvement needed.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के बाद 'when' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है और इनवर्जन भी सही है। कोई बदलाव जरूरी नहीं है।

questionText: He has a [good] plan to increase sales this quarter.
explanation:
The adjective ‘good’ here is an ordinary, non-technical term. In formal written English, ‘excellent’ is a stronger, more precise choice.
उदाहरण: He has an **excellent** plan.

questionText: The project was completed [in a short period of time].
explanation:
The phrase ‘in a short period of time’ is wordy. ‘In a brief span’ is concise and stylistically better.
उदाहरण: The project was completed **in a brief span**.

questionText: She is the most [talented] performer in the group.
explanation:
The adjective ‘talented’ is generic. ‘Exceptional’ conveys a higher degree of skill.
उदाहरण: She is the most **exceptional** performer.

questionText: He was [very unhappy] with the decision.
explanation:
The phrase ‘very unhappy’ is informal. ‘Deeply dissatisfied’ is more formal and precise.
उदाहरण: He was **deeply dissatisfied** with the decision.

questionText: The committee will discuss the proposal [and come to a decision] after the meeting.
explanation:
The phrase ‘come to a decision’ is redundant. ‘Reach a conclusion’ is concise and stylistically better.
उदाहरण: The committee will discuss the proposal **and reach a conclusion** after the meeting.

questionText: He has a [very large] house in the suburbs.
explanation:
The phrase ‘very large’ is a filler. ‘Spacious’ conveys the idea more elegantly.
उदाहरण: He has a **spacious** house in the suburbs.
grammarRule: Replacing filler phrases with precise adjectives

questionText: The new policy will [have a significant impact] on the economy.
explanation:
The phrase ‘have a significant impact’ is wordy. ‘Impact the economy significantly’ is more direct.
उदाहरण: The new policy will **impact the economy significantly**.

questionText: They were [extremely disappointed] by the out come
explanation:
The phrase ‘extremely disappointed’ is informal. ‘Profoundly upset’ is a stronger, more formal alternative.
उदाहरण: They were **profoundly upset** by the outcome.

questionText: The company is [planning to expand its operations] into new markets.
explanation:
The phrase ‘planning to expand its operations’ is redundant. ‘Expanding into new markets’ is concise.
उदाहरण: The company is **expanding into new markets**.

questionText: She was [so very scared] that she couldn't speak.
explanation:
The double adverb ‘so very’ is incorrect. ‘Extremely scared’ replaces it correctly.
उदाहरण: She was **extremely scared**.

questionText: The committee will finalize the report, ___ the next meeting.
explanation:
Rule: Use of preposition to indicate a deadline.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट अगली बैठक से पहले पूरी की जाएगी।

questionText: She has given the present at i on, ___ the audience was impressed.
explanation:
Rule: Use of subordinating conjunction to show reason.
उदाहरण: प्रस्तुति देने के कारण दर्शक प्रभावित हुए।

questionText: He will not be able to attend the conference, ___ he is traveling abroad.
explanation:
Rule: Subordinating conjunction to express cause.
उदाहरण: वह यात्रा पर होने के कारण सम्मेलन में नहीं जा सकेगा।

questionText: We need to finish the project, ___ the dead line is tomorrow.
explanation:
Rule: Use of purpose clause to indicate intention.
उदाहरण: हम परियोजना को समाप्त करना चाहते हैं ताकि समय सीमा से पहले पूरा हो जाए।

questionText: The students were asked to submit the essay, ___ it was over due
explanation:
Rule: Relative pronoun referring to a noun.
उदाहरण: निबंध, जो देर से था, जमा करने को कहा गया।

questionText: The manager decided to postpone the meeting, ___ every one was busy.
explanation:
Rule: Subordinating conjunction to express reason.
उदाहरण: क्योंकि सभी व्यस्त थे, प्रबंधक ने बैठक स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: She has been studying English for years, ___ she is fluent.
explanation:
Rule: Correlative conjunction to show result.
उदाहरण: वह वर्षों से अंग्रेज़ी सीख रही है, इसलिए वह धाराप्रवाह बोलती है।

questionText: The company will release the new product, ___ the launch date remains unchanged.
explanation:
Rule: Subordinating conjunction to express contrast.
उदाहरण: हालांकि लॉन्च तिथि अपरिवर्तित है, कंपनी नया उत्पाद जारी करेगी।

questionText: The plan was approved, ___ it was still under review.
explanation:
Rule: Subordinating conjunction to express contradiction.
उदाहरण: हालांकि योजना स्वीकृत हो गई थी, यह अभी भी समीक्षा के अंतर्गत थी।

questionText: He was warned, ___ he would lose his job.
explanation:
Rule: Use of subordinating conjunction to introduce a consequence clause.
उदाहरण: उसे चेतावनी दी गई, कि वह अपनी नौकरी खो देगा।

questionText: The proposal was rejected, ___ it lacked sufficient evidence.
explanation:
Rule: Subordinating conjunction to explain reason.
उदाहरण: प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार कर दिया गया क्योंकि इसमें पर्याप्त साक्ष्य नहीं थे।

questionText: The committee has decided (underlined) that the project will be postponed until next quarter.
options: that the project should be postponed until next quarter
that the project will be postponed until next quarter
that the project is going to be postponed until next quarter
that the project will postponed until next quarter
explanation:
Rule: After 'decided', the correct structure is 'that + clause' without using 'should' or missing auxiliary.
उदाहरण: समिति ने निर्णय लिया कि परियोजना अगले तिमाही तक स्थगित की जाएगी।

questionText: She was known (underlined) for her punctuality and efficiency.
explanation:
Rule: 'Known' is followed by 'for' to indicate a characteristic.
उदाहरण: वह अपनी समयबद्धता और दक्षता के लिए जानी जाती थी।

questionText: The report, (underlined) which was submitted yesterday, was approved by the board.
explanation:
Rule: A relative clause modifying a noun uses 'which' for objects.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट, जो कल जमा की गई थी, बोर्ड द्वारा अनुमोदित हुई।

questionText: The manager has always believed (underlined) that employees should be given autonomy.
options: that employees should be given autonomy
that employees must be given autonomy
explanation:
Rule: 'Believe' is followed by 'that' clause.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक हमेशा मानता है कि कर्मचारियों को स्वायत्तता दी जानी चाहिए।

questionText: The data (underlined) has shown a steady increase over the past year.
options: has shown a steady increase over the past year
have shown a steady increase over the past year
has shown a steady increases over the past year
have shown a steady increases over the past year
explanation:
Rule: 'Data' is a collective noun; use singular verb 'has'.
उदाहरण: डेटा ने पिछले वर्ष में लगातार वृद्धि दिखाई है।

questionText: The new policy (underlined) was implemented without any delays.
explanation:
Rule: 'Policy' is singular; use 'was implemented'.
उदाहरण: नई नीति बिना किसी देरी के लागू की गई।

questionText: The scientist (underlined) concluded that the experiment was inconclusive.
options: concluded that the experiment was inconclusive
explanation:
Rule: 'Conclude' is followed by 'that' clause when stating a conclusion.
उदाहरण: वैज्ञानिक ने निष्कर्ष निकाला कि प्रयोग निष्कर्षहीन था।

questionText: The students (underlined) were given a chance to present their projects.
options: were given a chance to present their projects
was given a chance to present their projects
were given a chance to presenting their projects
was given a chance to presenting their projects
explanation:
Rule: 'Students' is plural; use 'were given'.
उदाहरण: छात्रों को अपने प्रोजेक्ट प्रस्तुत करने का मौका दिया गया।

questionText: The report (underlined) states that the new policy will increase revenue.
options: states that the new policy will increase revenue
state that the new policy will increase revenue
states that the new policy increases revenue
state that the new policy increases revenue
explanation:
Rule: 'Report' is singular; use 'states'.
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट बताती है कि नई नीति राजस्व बढ़ाएगी।

questionText: The committee (underlined) has recommended that the budget be increased.
options: has recommended that the budget be increased
has recommended that the budget increased
has recommended the budget be increased
explanation:
Rule: After 'recommend', use 'that' + subjunctive 'be'.
उदाहरण: समिति ने बजट बढ़ाने की सिफारिश की है।

questionText: Identify the option with the INCORRECT spelling.
explanation:
The word 'Seige' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Siege' following the 'i before e except after c' rule.
उदा. 'Seige' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Siege' है ('i before e' नियम के अनुसार)।
grammarRule: I before E except after C

questionText: In the sentence: "The committee decided to ______ the proposal after thorough review.", which of the following words is misspelled?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **approve**. The option **aprove** is misspelled by omitting the second 'p'.
Rule: When a word ends with 'prove', keep the 'pp' and add 've'.
उदाहरण: समिति ने प्रस्ताव को स्वीकृत किया।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "The children were excited to attend the s__ceremony.", which of the following options is incorrect?
explanation:
The correct word is **ceremony**. The option **ceremonie** is misspelled by adding an extra 'e' before the final 'y'.
Rule: Words ending in -emony keep the 'y' without an additional 'e'.
उदाहरण: बच्चों को समारोह देखने के लिए बहुत उत्सुकता थी।

questionText: In the sentence: "Please fill out the form with accurate in__formations.", which word is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is **information**. The option **informtion** is misspelled by dropping the second 'r'.
Rule: The root word is *inform*, and the noun form adds *ation*.
उदाहरण: कृपया फ़ॉर्म में सही जानकारी भरें।

questionText: The temperature dropped to a record low of 5°c.",?
explanation:

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence: "She was a remarkable eviden__ for the cause.", which option is wrong?

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "The library has a vast cole__ction of rare books.",?

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "The device has a high perfo__ance rating.", which option is incorrect?

Rule: The noun form uses *performance*.

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "She was praised for her l__inearity in the project.",?
explanation:

Rule: The adjective *linear* + *ity*.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "The event was a huge succ__ss for the organizers.", which option is wrong?

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "The artist's work is known for its ex__pressionist style.",?

questionText: Despite his best efforts, he could not secure the promotion because he lacked the necessary __________ for the senior managerial role.
explanation:
Credentials refer to qualifications, achievements, or aspects of a person's background that indicate they are suitable for a task. 'Credentials' is the correct vocabulary choice.
उदा. 'Credentials' का अर्थ योग्यता या प्रमाण पत्र होता है, जो किसी वरिष्ठ पद के लिए आवश्यक होते हैं।

questionText: The minister emphasized that the government is fully committed __________ the welfare of marginalized communities.
explanation:
The adjective 'committed' is always followed by the fixed preposition 'to' (committed to something).
उदा. 'Committed' के बाद हमेशा निश्चित प्रीपोजिशन 'to' का प्रयोग होता है (committed to)।

questionText: Had the authorities taken timely action, the disaster __________ averted.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure expressing an unfulfilled past condition: 'If + past perfect (had taken), subject + would/could/might + have + V3'. Thus, 'could have been' is correct.
उदा. यह पास्ट कंडीशनल (Third Conditional) का वाक्य है जिसमें 'Had + V3' के साथ दूसरे क्लॉज़ में 'would/could/might have + V3' आता है।

questionText: She is well known for her __________ nature; she always shares her belongings and helps those in need without he sit at i on.
explanation:
Altruistic means showing a disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others, which fits the context of sharing and helping.
उदा. 'Altruistic' का अर्थ परोपकारी या दूसरों की भलाई करने वाला होता है।

questionText: Hardly had the train stepped onto the platform __________ the passengers rushed towards the coaches.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employee to __________ the report for any grammatical errors before final submission.
explanation:
'Look over' means to examine something quickly or inspect it for errors. 'Look into' means to investigate. Here, checking a report for errors requires 'look over'.
उदा. 'Look over' का अर्थ किसी चीज़ की सरसरी तौर पर या गलती ढूंढने के लिए जांच करना होता है।

questionText: Not only the principal but also the teachers __________ present at the annual function.
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'teachers' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is used.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'not only... but also' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब अपने सबसे नज़दीकी सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है ('teachers' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' आएगा)।

questionText: The committee members could not reach a consensus because their opinions on the new policy were completely __________.
explanation:
Divergent means tending to be different or develop in different directions, which explains why they could not reach a consensus.
उदा. 'Divergent' का अर्थ भिन्न या अलग-अलग दिशाओं में जाने वाला होता है, जिससे सहमति (consensus) नहीं बन पाई।

questionText: Rohan takes pride __________ his academic achievements and often boasts about them.
explanation:
The idiom/phrase is 'to take pride in' something (or the verb 'pride oneself on'). Therefore, 'in' is the correct preposition.
उदा. सही फ्रेज़ 'take pride in' होता है, जिसका अर्थ किसी बात पर गर्व करना है।

questionText: By the time the rescue team arrived at the remote village, the storm __________ heavy damage to the infrastructure.
explanation:
In sentences with 'By the time + past simple', the action that occurred earlier in the past must be in the past perfect tense ('had + V3').
उदा. 'By the time + V2' वाले वाक्यों में जो कार्य पहले समाप्त हुआ हो, उसके लिए Past Perfect Tense ('had + V3') का प्रयोग होता है।
