questionText: The committee were / divided in its / opinion regarding / the new policy.
explanation:
Replace 'its' with 'their'. When a collective noun shows division among members, it takes plural verb and plural pronoun.
उदा. जब collective noun (committee) में मतभेद हो, तो plural pronoun 'their' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'its' का।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students was / present in the hall / during the lecture.
explanation:
Replace 'was' with 'were'. When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('students').
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में verb पास वाले subject (students) के अनुसार plural होगी।

questionText: He told me that / he has finished / his work two / hours ago.
explanation:
Replace 'has finished' with 'had finished'. The main clause is in the past tense ('told'), so the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense.
उदा. मुख्य clause past tense में है, इसलिए आगे का वाक्य भी past tense (had finished) में होगा।

questionText: One of my friends / are going to / Chennai for a / software project.
explanation:
Replace 'are' with 'is'. The subject is 'One', which is singular, so it takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' में मुख्य subject 'One' होता है, इसलिए singular verb 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper school uniform
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb and pronoun should be plural ('were in their' instead of 'was in their').
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: The manager as well as / his subordinates are / working very hard / to achieve the targets
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Hence, use 'is' instead of 'are'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट ('The manager') के अनुसार सिंगुलर होगी, अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' आएगा।

questionText: No sooner did the train / stoped at the station / than the passengers / rushed out of the compartments
explanation:
With the helping verb 'did', the base form of the verb (V1) must be used. 'stoped' is incorrect; it should be 'stop'.
उदा. सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा वर्ब की पहली फॉर्म (V1) आती है, इसलिए 'stoped' की जगह 'stop' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: One of my friends / are going to London / for higher studies / next month
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद नाउन बहुवचन (friends) होता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है, इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।
grammarRule: One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb

questionText: Scarcely had I reached / the exhibition / than the power supply / went completely off
explanation:
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (than का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।

questionText: He is one of those persons / who does not / compromise with his / values under any circumstances
options: He is one of those persons
explanation:
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the antecedent (persons), which is plural. Replace 'does' with 'do'.
उदा. Relative pronoun 'who' का antecedent 'persons' (plural) है, इसलिए इसके बाद आने वाली वर्ब भी plural ('do') होगी, न कि singular ('does')।

questionText: Alas! / The king whom every one / thought was noble / has proved to be a tyrant
options: has proved to be a tyrant
explanation:
Here, the relative pronoun is the subject of the verb 'was' ('who thought was noble'). Therefore, the subjective case 'who' should be used instead of the objective case 'whom'.
उदा. यहाँ वर्ब 'was' के लिए subject की आवश्यकता है, इसलिए objective case 'whom' के स्थान पर subjective case 'who' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Mathematics are a subject / which many students / find extremely difficult / to master
explanation:
Names of subjects (like Mathematics, Physics, Economics) take a singular verb when used as a name of a discipline. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. कुछ विषय दिखने में बहुवचन लगते हैं लेकिन अर्थ में एकवचन होते हैं (Mathematics), इसलिए इनके साथ singular verb ('is') का प्रयोग होता है।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement with Nouns ending in '-ics'

questionText: It is high time / the government takes / strict actions against / corrupt officials
explanation:
The phrase 'It is high time' or 'It is time' is always followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाला वाक्य हमेशा Past Indefinite Tense (V2) में होता है, अतः 'takes' की जगह 'took' आएगा।
grammarRule: Tense usage with 'It is high time'

questionText: Neither of the two candidates / have paid / the subscription fee / for the club member ship
explanation:
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' are always followed by a singular verb. Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद नाउन plural होता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा singular ('has') आती है, इसलिए 'have' गलत है।

questionText: to bite the bullet
options: to endure a painful or difficult situation
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms are phrases whose meaning cannot be inferred from the literal meaning of the words. 
उदा. Hindi: "बुलेट काटना" मतलब कष्ट सहना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative meaning.

questionText: to break the ice
options: to initiate conversation in a social setting
to melt the ice in a pond
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms express a figurative idea. 
उदा. Hindi: "बर्फ तोड़ना" मतलब बातचीत शुरू करना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions used figuratively.

questionText: to cut corners
options: to cut the corners of a room
to take a shortcut that may compromise quality
to slice a piece of bread
to trim the edges of a picture
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms convey a meaning different from the literal sense. 
उदा. Hindi: "कोनों को काटना" मतलब शॉर्टकट लेना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed phrases with figurative sense.

questionText: to hit the nail on the head
options: to physically hit a nail on the head
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms are fixed expressions that cannot be understood literally. 
उदा. Hindi: "नाखून पर मारना" मतलब सही निशाना लगाना।
grammarRule: Idioms are phrases whose meaning is not literal.

questionText: to let the cat out of the bag
options: to release a cat from a bag
to buy a cat from a market
to put a cat in a bag
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms express figurative meanings. 
उदा. Hindi: "बिल्ली को बैग से बाहर निकालना" मतलब रहस्य बताना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative sense.

questionText: to miss the boat
options: to drop a boat in a river
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms have meanings that differ from literal sense. 
उदा. Hindi: "नौका चूकना" मतलब मौका चूकना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative meaning.

questionText: to see eye to eye
options: to literally see eye to eye
to stare into each other's eyes
to look at an eye chart
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms are figurative phrases. 
उदा. Hindi: "आँख से आँख मिलाना" मतलब सहमत होना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative sense.

questionText: to weigh in
options: to give an opinion or comment
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms convey figurative meaning. 
उदा. Hindi: "वज़न डालना" मतलब राय देना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative meaning.

questionText: to burn the midnight oil
options: to literally burn oil at midnight
to work late into the night
to light a candle in the dark
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms have figurative meanings that cannot be inferred literally. 
उदा. Hindi: "मध्यरात्रि का तेल जलाना" मतलब देर रात तक काम करना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative sense.

questionText: to think outside the box
options: to think outside a literal box
to avoid a box while studying
to imagine a box in your mind
explanation:
Rule in English: Idioms express a figurative idea. 
उदा. Hindi: "बॉक्स के बाहर सोचना" मतलब नवाचारी ढंग से सोचना।
grammarRule: Idioms are fixed expressions with figurative meaning.

questionText: A blessing in disguise
options: a hidden advantage in a bad situation
a promise that is not kept
a gift that is too expensive
explanation:
The phrase "a blessing in disguise" refers to a situation that appears bad at first but has hidden benefits. 
उदा. "पहले तो वह खोया हुआ पैसा था, पर बाद में उसने नई नौकरी पाई, यह एक blessing in disguise थी।"

questionText: feel under the weather
options: to feel like a weather forecaster
explanation:
The idiom "feel under the weather" means to feel ill or sick. 
उदा. "आज मैं थोड़ा under the weather महसूस कर रहा हूँ, इसलिए डॉक्टर के पास जा रहा हूँ।"

questionText: Give someone a run for their money
options: to give someone a chance to win
to give money to run a marathon
explanation:
The phrase "give someone a run for their money" means to provide a strong challenge or competition. 
उदा. "उस प्रतियोगिता में उसने हमें एक tough run for our money दिया।"

questionText: Hit the hay
options: to hit a piece of hay
explanation:
The phrase "hit the hay" means to go to bed. 
उदा. "सभी काम खत्म कर के, मैं अब hit the hay जा रहा हूँ।"

questionText: Be on the fence
explanation:
The idiom "be on the fence" means to be undecided or uncertain about something. 
उदा. "वह नए नौकरी के प्रस्ताव पर on the fence है।"

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "He was receveid with great enthusiasm.
explanation:
The correct past tense of *receive* is *received*. The option *receveid* is misspelled.
उदाहरण: "He was received with great enthusiasm."
grammarRule: Rule: Past tense of *receive* is formed by adding -ed: received.

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: "Her disapointment was obvious.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *disappointment*. The option *disapointment* is missing an 'i'.
उदाहरण: "Her disappointment was obvious."
grammarRule: Rule: The noun *disappointment* contains the suffix '-ment' after the root 'disappoint'.

questionText: Select the correct spelling from the options given below.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Acknowledge' (to accept or admit the existence of).
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Acknowledge' है जिसमें 'k' और 'w' दोनों का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Find the word with correct spelling among the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance' (derived from 'maintain').
उदा. सही spelling 'Maintenance' है जो 'maintain' शब्द से बना है।

questionText: Find the word with the CORRECT spelling from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Millennium', featuring double 'l' and double 'n'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Millennium' है, जिसमें दो बार 'l' और दो बार 'n' होते हैं।

questionText: Select the option that spells the given word INCORRECTLY.
explanation:
'Envirnoment' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Environment' (retaining the 'n' before 'm').
उदा. 'Envirnoment' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Environment' है।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Mischievous'. Notice the sequence 'ie' and the ending '-vous'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Mischievous' है। अंत में '-vous' आता है।

questionText: Identify the word which is INCORRECTLY spelt.
explanation:
'Neccessary' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'Necessary' (one 'c', double 's').
उदा. 'Neccessary' गलत वर्तनी है, सही वर्तनी 'Necessary' है।

questionText: ABOLISH
explanation:
'Abolish' means to formally put an end to a system, practice, or institution. 'Terminate' also means to bring to an end, making it the correct synonym.
उदा. 'Abolish' का अर्थ समाप्त करना या रद्द करना होता है। 'Terminate' का अर्थ भी समाप्त करना होता है, अतः यह इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: MUNDANE
explanation:
'Mundane' means lacking interest or excitement; dull. Therefore, 'dull' is the right choice.
उदा. 'Mundane' का अर्थ नीरस या साधारण होता है। अतः 'dull' (नीरस) इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: COVERT
explanation:
'Covert' means not openly acknowledged or displayed; secret or hidden.
उदा. 'Covert' का अर्थ गुप्त या छिपा हुआ होता है। अतः 'hidden' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: RANCOR
explanation:
'Rancor' means bitterness or resentfulness. 'Resentment' is the direct synonym.
उदा. 'Rancor' का अर्थ द्वेष या कड़واهट होता है, अतः 'Resentment' इसका सही पर्यायवाची है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: TACITURN
explanation:
'Taciturn' means reserved or uncommunicative in speech. 'Reticent' shares this meaning.
उदा. 'Taciturn' का अर्थ अल्पभाषी या कम बोलने वाला होता है, 'Reticent' इसका समानार्थक शब्द है।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word among the following.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Maintenance' (derived from maintain, ending in -tenance).
उदा. 'Maintenance' की सही spelling में 'ten' आता है न कि 'tan'।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word among the options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘separate’ with ‘-ar-’ in the middle. The option ‘seperate’ swaps the ‘a’ and ‘e’.
उदाहरण: ‘कृपया अलग-अलग समूहों में बाँटें’ (Separate).

questionText: Which word below is spelled correctly?
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘necessary’ with ‘-ary’ ending. The other options misspell the internal vowel or suffix.
उदाहरण: ‘यह आवश्यक है’ (Necessary).

questionText: Identify the word that is correctly spelled among the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Acknowledge', containing the silent letter 'k' and the ending '-edge'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Acknowledge' है, जिसमें मौन अक्षर 'k' और अंत में '-edge' आता है।

questionText: Select the misspelled word from the options.
explanation:
'Definately' is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is 'Definitely' (with an 'i').
उदा. 'Definately' गलत वर्तनी है। सही वर्तनी 'Definitely' है (इसमें 'i' आता है)।

questionText: The manager as well as his subordinates [were present] at the meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('manager' is singular).
उदा. जब दो Subject 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb हमेशा पहले Subject के अनुसार आती है ('manager' एक वचन है, इसलिए 'was' आएगा)।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house [than it began to rain].
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (not 'than').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (Hardly... when)।

questionText: She [is knowing] the secret of this success for a long time.
explanation:
Verbs of perception/state like 'know' are not used in continuous tenses. With 'for a long time', Present Perfect Tense is used.
उदा. 'Know' एक Stative Verb है, इसे Continuous Tense में नहीं लिखते। समय (for a long time) दिया होने पर Present Perfect ('has known') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates [have returned] the library books yet.
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of', 'Each of' के बाद Noun बहुवचन (plural) होता है लेकिन Verb हमेशा एकवचन (singular) आती है।

questionText: He is [too clever] to understand this simple trick.
explanation:
The structure 'too... to' conveys a negative meaning equivalent to 'so... that cannot'. The sentence is contextually and grammatically correct as is.
उदा. 'too... to' का प्रयोग नकारात्मक परिणाम के लिए होता है। यहाँ 'too clever' बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है वह इतना चालाक है कि ट्रिक नहीं समझ सकता।

questionText: No sooner did the police arrive [than the thieves fled].
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का जोड़ा बनता है, जो यहाँ बिल्कुल सही दिया गया है।

questionText: If I [was you], I would never accept such humiliating conditions.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences expressing a wish or hypothetical situation, 'were' is used for all subjects.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी Subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, चाहे Subject सिंगुलर ही क्यों न हो ('If I were you')।

questionText: One of my best friends [are going] abroad for higher studies.
explanation:
'One of' takes a plural noun and a singular verb.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद Noun plural होता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा singular ('is') आती है क्योंकि मुख्य Subject 'One' होता है।

questionText: She speaks English [so fluently that] every one is impressed.
explanation:
The correct correlative structure for cause and effect is 'so + adverb/adjective + that'.
उदा. परिणाम दिखाने के लिए 'so... that' का सही जोड़ा प्रयोग होता है ('so fluently that')।

questionText: The teacher asked the students [why are they making] so much noise.
explanation:
In indirect speech (reported questions), the order becomes Subject + Verb, not Verb + Subject. Also, past tense is required.
उदा. Indirect Speech में प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य साधारण वाक्य (Subject + Verb) बन जाता है और Tense भी Past ('were making') हो जाता है।

questionText: She is *more smarter than* her sister in solving mathematical puzzles.
explanation:
Double comparatives are grammatically incorrect in English. 'Smarter' is already a comparative form, so adding 'more' before it is redundant.
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative words ('more' और 'smarter') का प्रयोग एक साथ नहीं होता। 'Smarter' स्वयं comparative है, अतः केवल 'smarter than' सही है।

questionText: If I *was you*, I would never accept such a humiliating offer.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an unreal past or hypothetical situation (subjunctive mood), 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones like 'I'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Hypothetical sentences) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' का नहीं।

questionText: The manager told his subordinates that *every employee must submit their report* by Friday.
options: every employee must submit his report
every employee must submit its report
every employee must submit our report
explanation:
'Every' is a singular distributive pronoun/adjective. Therefore, it requires a singular masculine pronoun ('his') in standard traditional grammar when gender is unspecified.
उदा. 'Every' एक singular शब्द है, इसलिए इसके लिए singular pronoun 'his' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए न कि plural 'their' का।

questionText: Not only the teacher *but also the students was* excited about the upcoming excursion.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb must be 'were'.
उदा. 'Not only... but also' से जुड़े होने पर verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: She insisted *to accompany me* to the railway station despite my refusal.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is invariably followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (verb + ing), hence 'insisted on accompanying'.
उदा. 'Insist' के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (verb+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Scarcely had we reached the station *than the train departed*.
explanation:
'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' must always be followed by 'when' or 'before', never by 'than' or 'then'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

questionText: He is one of those persons who *always speaks* the truth no matter what the consequences are.
explanation:
In the structure 'One of + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that) + plural verb', the verb inside the relative clause must agree with the plural antecedent ('persons'). Hence, 'speak'.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun + relative pronoun' की ساخت में relative pronoun के बाद आने वाली verb plural होती है क्योंकि वह antecedent (persons) को refer करती है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates *were selected* for the final round of the interview.
explanation:
'Neither', 'Either', 'Everyone', 'Each' are singular indefinite pronouns and take a singular verb. Therefore, 'was selected' is correct.
उदा. 'Neither' का प्रयोग singular subject के रूप में होता है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb 'was' आएगी न कि 'were'।

questionText: Despite of working hard, *he failed to secure* the desired rank in the examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (Note: 'In spite' takes 'of', but 'Despite' does not). Hence, 'Despite working hard' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है ('In spite of' के साथ 'of' आता है)।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: EPITOME
explanation:
'Epitome' means a person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type; personification.
उदा. 'Epitome' का अर्थ किसी गुण का सर्वोत्तम उदाहरण या प्रतीक होता है। 'Personification' इसका निकटतम अर्थ है।

questionText: JUHEND - JUVENILE
explanation:
'Juvenile' means for or relating to young people; youthful or childish.
उदा. 'Juvenile' का अर्थ किशोर या बचकाना होता है। विकल्पों में से 'Childish' इसका सही समानार्थी है।

questionText: The manager asked [the new employee] to provide the report.
explanation:
Rule: The verb *asked* requires a direct object and an infinitive clause. The correct phrase is *the new employee*.
उदाहरण: Manager ने नए कर्मचारी से रिपोर्ट देने के लिए कहा।

questionText: She is looking forward to [meeting the new team] in the morning.
explanation:
Rule: *Looking forward to* is followed by a gerund. The phrase must be *meeting the new team*.
उदाहरण: वह सुबह नए टीम से मिलने के लिए उत्सुक है।

questionText: The committee decided [to postpone the meeting] until further notice.
explanation:
Rule: After *decided*, the infinitive form *to postpone* is used.
उदाहरण: समिति ने बैठक को आगे के नोटिस तक स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: It is essential that he [arrive on time] for the interview.
explanation:
Rule: After *essential that*, an infinitive without *to* is used. Hence *arrive on time*.
उदाहरण: यह आवश्यक है कि वह साक्षात्कार के लिए समय पर पहुंचे।

questionText: The students were asked [to submit the assignment] before Friday.
explanation:
Rule: The passive form *were asked* is followed by the infinitive *to submit*.
उदाहरण: छात्रों से शुक्रवार से पहले असाइनमेंट जमा करने के लिए कहा गया।

questionText: He will be responsible for [overseeing the project] until its completion.
explanation:
Rule: The phrase *responsible for* is followed by a gerund. So *overseeing the project* is correct.
उदाहरण: वह परियोजना के पूरा होने तक उसकी निगरानी के लिए ज़िम्मेदार होगा।

questionText: The engineer suggested [using a new algorithm] to improve accuracy.
explanation:
Rule: After *suggested*, a gerund is used. Hence *using a new algorithm*.
उदाहरण: इंजीनियर ने सटीकता बढ़ाने के लिए नए एल्गोरिद्म का उपयोग करने का सुझाव दिया।

questionText: It was decided [to postpone the launch] due to technical issues.
explanation:
Rule: After *was decided*, the infinitive *to postpone* follows.
उदाहरण: तकनीकी समस्याओं के कारण लॉन्च को स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया गया।

questionText: The direct or insisted [that the project be completed] by the end of the month.
explanation:
Rule: After *insisted*, a subjunctive clause starts with *that* and the verb in base form *be*.
उदाहरण: निदेशक ने परियोजना को महीने के अंत तक पूरा करने पर जोर दिया।

questionText: The committee is concerned about [the delay in the project] affecting the schedule.
explanation:
Rule: *Concerned about* is followed by a noun phrase. The correct phrase is *the delay in the project*.
उदाहरण: समिति परियोजना में देरी के कारण शेड्यूल पर प्रभाव पड़ने की चिंता कर रही है।

questionText: The team was praised for [their hard work] during the crisis.
explanation:
Rule: After *praised for*, a singular noun phrase is used. Correct is *their hard work*.
उदाहरण: टीम को संकट के दौरान उनके कठिन परिश्रम के लिए प्रशंसा मिली।

questionText: inconspicuous
explanation:
"Inconspicuous" means not easily seen or not attracting attention. "Unremarkable" best matches this meaning.
उदाहरण: "Inconspicuous behavior" का अर्थ है "unremarkable behavior"।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
"Meticulous" denotes great attention to detail. "Precise" conveys the same sense of exactness and carefulness.
उदाहरण: "Meticulous planning" का अर्थ है "precise planning"।

questionText: subsequent
explanation:
"Subsequent" refers to something that comes after. "Following" is the synonym that matches this meaning.
उदाहरण: "Subsequent events" का अर्थ है "following events"।

questionText: transient
explanation:
"Transient" means lasting for only a short time. "Temporary" is the word that best matches this sense.
उदाहरण: "Transient mood" का अर्थ है "temporary mood"।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
"Benevolent" denotes a disposition to do good or be kind. "Kind" is the synonym that captures this meaning.
उदाहरण: "Benevolent act" का अर्थ है "kind act"।

questionText: candid
explanation:
"Candid" means straightforward and truthful. "Honest" is the synonym that best reflects this sense.
उदाहरण: "Candid response" का अर्थ है "honest response"।

questionText: stoic
explanation:
"Stoic" refers to someone who remains unaffected by joy or sorrow. "Indifferent" captures this calm, unemotional stance.
उदाहरण: "Stoic attitude" का अर्थ है "indifferent attitude"।

questionText: turbulent
explanation:
"Turbulent" describes something full of disorder or confusion. "Chaotic" is the synonym that matches this sense.
उदाहरण: "Turbulent waters" का अर्थ है "chaotic waters"।

questionText: lucid
explanation:
"Lucid" means clear and easy to understand. "Clear" is the word that best captures this meaning.
उदाहरण: "Lucid explanation" का अर्थ है "clear explanation"।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Abundant means existing in large quantities; the word that best matches this meaning is "plentiful".
उदाहरण: The garden was abundant with flowers, meaning it was plentiful.
grammarRule: Synonym identification: choosing the word with the most similar meaning.

questionText: diligent
explanation:
"Diligent" signifies persistent effort. "Hardworking" is the synonym that captures this sense.
उदाहरण: The diligent student studied every night, i.e., the hardworking student.
grammarRule: Synonym identification: matching words with equivalent meanings.

questionText: suspicious
explanation:
"Suspicious" indicates doubt or wariness; the closest synonym is "skeptical".
उदाहरण: The suspicious look turned out to be skeptical.
grammarRule: Synonym substitution: choosing the most accurate replacement.

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
Here, "elaborate" means intricate or detailed. The synonym is "complex".
उदाहरण: The elaborate design was complex and beautiful.

questionText: unprecedented
explanation:
"Unprecedented" means never before seen. The best synonym is "unusual".
उदाहरण: The unprecedented event was unusual in history.
grammarRule: Synonym identification: matching rare or unique meanings.

questionText: incredulous
explanation:
"Incredulous" indicates doubt or disbelief; the synonym is "skeptical".
उदाहरण: The incredulous face showed skepticism.
grammarRule: Synonym choice based on meaning of disbelief.

questionText: cautious
explanation:
"Cautious" indicates carefulness; the synonym is "prudent".
उदाहरण: The cautious plan was prudent.

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
"Meticulous" means extremely careful. The best synonym is "precise".
उदाहरण: The meticulous work was precise.

questionText: cooperative
explanation:
"Cooperative" means willing to work with others; the synonym is "helpful".
उदाहरण: The cooperative worker was helpful.

questionText: tangible
explanation:
"Tangible" means something that can be touched. The synonym is "concrete".
उदाहरण: The tangible evidence was concrete.

questionText: cumbersome
explanation:
"Cumbersome" indicates awkward or heavy. The synonym is "bulky".
उदाहरण: The cumbersome machine was bulky.
grammarRule: Synonym selection based on physical difficulty.

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
Elaborate means detailed or intricate.
उदा. "वह कहानी बहुत elaborated है," का अर्थ "वह कहानी बहुत detailed है।"

questionText: revert
explanation:
Revert means to return to a previous state.
उदा. "कृपया revert to the original file," का अर्थ "कृपया return to the original file."

questionText: concur
explanation:
Concur means to agree.
उदा. "We concur on the proposal," का अर्थ "हम agree पर हैं।"

questionText: commence
explanation:
Commence means to start.
उदा. "The ceremony will commence at 9 AM," का अर्थ "The ceremony will start at 9 AM."

questionText: incongruous
explanation:
Incongruous means not in harmony; discrepant.
उदा. "His remarks were incongruous with the mood," का अर्थ "His remarks were discrepant with the mood."

questionText: transient
explanation:
Transient means temporary or short‑lived.
उदा. "The transient heatwave lasted only a few days," का अर्थ "The temporary heatwave lasted only a few days."

questionText: candid
explanation:
Candid in this sense means honest.
उदा. "He gave a candid reply," का अर्थ "He gave an honest reply."

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Diligent means hardworking and persistent.
उदा. "She is a diligent student," का अर्थ "She is a hardworking student."

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Meticulous means thorough and precise.
उदा. "He is meticulous in his work," का अर्थ "He is thorough in his work."

questionText: sudden
explanation:
Sudden means unexpected or abrupt.
उदा. "The sudden storm surprised everyone," का अर्थ "The unexpected storm surprised everyone."

questionText: elevate
explanation:
Elevate means to raise or lift up.
उदा. "The policy will elevate living standards," का अर्थ "The policy will raise living standards."

questionText: Evident
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that has the closest meaning. 
उदाहरण: 'Evident' means obvious, which is 'Clear' (स्पष्ट).

questionText: Diminish
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that expresses a reduction. 
उदाहरण: 'Diminish' means to reduce, which is 'Decrease' (कम करना).

questionText: Alleviate
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that conveys relief. 
उदाहरण: 'Alleviate' means to relieve, which is 'Ease' (सुविधा देना).

questionText: Mundane
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that means everyday or common. 
उदाहरण: 'Mundane' means ordinary, which is 'Ordinary' (साधारण).

questionText: Cautious
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that denotes carefulness.

questionText: Transient
explanation:

questionText: Voracious
explanation:

questionText: Resilient
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that means able to recover quickly. 
उदाहरण: 'Resilient' means strong, which is 'Strong' (मजबूत).

questionText: Quaint
explanation:
Rule: Pick the word that denotes an attractive old-fashioned quality. 
उदाहरण: 'Quaint' means charming, which is 'Charming' (मोहक).

questionText: Tenacious
explanation:
Rule: Choose the word that means holding on firmly. 
उदाहरण: 'Tenacious' means persistent, which is 'Persistent' (दृढ़).

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word in the list.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘occurrence’ with double ‘c’ and double ‘r’. The rule is that words with short vowels before a single consonant often double the consonant before adding a suffix.
उदाहरण: occurrence – ‘c’ और ‘r’ दोनों को दो बार लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Double consonant before suffix in short vowel words

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word among the options.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is DEFINITELY with ‘i’ before ‘l’. The other options are misspelled.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – definitely, गलत वर्तनी – definately.

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly among the choices?
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is OCCURRENCE with double ‘c’ and double ‘r’. The incorrect form is ‘occurrence’.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – occurrence, गलत वर्तनी – occurance.

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: "The website is accesible to all users.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "accessible" with double 's' and double 'c'. The word "accesible" misses an 's'.
उदाहरण: "सुलभ" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "accessible" होता है, जिसे दो 'c' और दो 's' के साथ लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Double consonants after a short vowel in words ending with -able

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the sentence below? "The two teams were seperate during the tournament.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "separate". The alternative spelling "seperate" is incorrect.
उदाहरण: "अलग" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "separate" है, जिसे 'p' के बाद 'a' और 'r' के साथ लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: "They had to revaluat the situation.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "re-evaluate". The word "revaluat" omits the final 'e'.
उदाहरण: "पुनर्मूल्यांकन" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "re-evaluate" है, जिसे 'e' के साथ लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Correct spelling of the word re-evaluate

questionText: He was an connoisseur of fine wines.
explanation:
The correctly spelled word is "connoisseur". All other variations contain misspellings such as extra or missing letters.
उदाहरण: "विशेषज्ञ" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "connoisseur" है, जिसे दो 'n' और एक 'o' के साथ लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Spelling of the word connoisseur (two 'n's, two 'o's)

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence below: "The teacher gave a detailed explanaton.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "explanation". The other options misspell the word by swapping letters or omitting letters.
उदाहरण: "व्याख्या" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "explanation" है, जिसे 'x' के बाद 'p', 'l', 'a', 'n', 'a', 't', 'i', 'o', 'n' के साथ लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Correct spelling of the word explanation

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the sentence below? "The children were excited about the childrens' party.
explanation:
The correctly spelled possessive form is "children's". The option "childrens'" incorrectly adds an extra 'n'.
उदाहरण: "बच्चों" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "children" है, और स्वत्व रूप "children's" होता है, जिसमें एक ही 'n' होता है।
grammarRule: Proper use of possessive form for the word children

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: "The committee's decision was met with acception.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "acceptance". The word "acception" is misspelled.
उदाहरण: "स्वीकृति" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "acceptance" है, जिसे 'c' के बाद 'e' और 'n' के साथ लिखा जाता है।

questionText: The project requires a thorough evaluattion of resources.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "evaluation". The other options contain double letters incorrectly.
उदाहरण: "मूल्यांकन" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "evaluation" है, जिसे 'e' के बाद 'v', 'a', 'l', 'u', 'a', 't', 'i', 'o', 'n' के साथ लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Correct spelling of the word evaluation

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence below: "She has a strong committment to her work.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "commitment". The word "committment" incorrectly has an extra 't'.
उदाहरण: "प्रतिबद्धता" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "commitment" है, जिसे 'm', 'i', 't', 'm', 'e', 'n', 't' के साथ लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the following sentence? "The analyst provided a comprehensive data analysis.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "analysis". The option "analysys" incorrectly swaps the letters 'i' and 'y'.
उदाहरण: "विश्लेषण" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "analysis" है, जिसे 'a', 'n', 'a', 'l', 'y', 's', 'i', 's' के साथ लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence below: "The company announced a new polciy to improve customer satisfaction.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "policy". The word "polciy" misspells the 'l' and 'i' positions.
उदाहरण: "नीति" का अंग्रेजी शब्द "policy" है, जिसे 'p', 'o', 'l', 'i', 'c', 'y' के साथ लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Hardly had I / reached the station / than the train / left. /
explanation:
Hardly/Scarcely is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper class room. /
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither...nor' से जुड़े होने पर verb पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: Each of the boys / were given / a heavy bag / of books. /
explanation:
'Each of', 'Everyone of', 'Either of', etc., take a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (was) आती है।

questionText: The committee / are divided / in their / opinions regarding this issue. /
explanation:
No error. When a collective noun like 'committee' shows division among members, it takes a plural verb ('are') and plural pronoun ('their').
उदा. कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। जब collective noun में मतभेद दिखाया जाए तो plural verb और plural pronoun का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: No sooner did / the sun rise / when we resumed / our journey. /
explanation:
'No sooner' is followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं।

questionText: She is one of those persons / who always / helps others / in need. /
options: She is one of those persons
explanation:
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who) + plural verb', the verb must agree with the antecedent ('persons'). Replace 'helps' with 'help'.
उदा. 'One of those + plural noun + who' की संरचना में verb antecedent (persons) के अनुसार plural (help) होगी।

questionText: Open your book / at page / number tenth / of the text. /
explanation:
Cardinal numbers are used after nouns to denote page numbers (e.g., Page ten), or ordinal numbers before nouns (e.g., The tenth page). Replace 'page number tenth' with 'page ten'.
उदा. पृष्ठ संख्या दर्शाने के लिए Cardinal number (page ten) का प्रयोग होता है, Ordinal (tenth) का नहीं।

questionText: He told me that / he is going / to buy a new car / the following month. /
explanation:
The reporting verb ('told') is in the past tense, so the reported speech must also be in the past tense. Replace 'is' with 'was'.
उदा. यदि reporting verb past tense में हो, तो tense भी past में बदलता है। 'is' की जगह 'was' होगा।

questionText: Mathematics are / a very difficult / subject for many / school students. /
explanation:
Certain nouns that look plural (like Mathematics, Physics, News) take a singular verb when used as a name of a subject. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. कुछ Nouns दिखने में plural लगते हैं पर अर्थ में singular होते हैं (जैसे Mathematics)। इनके साथ singular verb (is) आती है।

questionText: Unless you do not / work hard, / you will not / succeed in life. /
explanation:
'Unless' is a negative word and does not take another negative ('not') in its clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' होता है, अतः इसके साथ दोबारा 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates / who had applied for the post / was eligible for selection. / No error
explanation:
No error. 'Neither of' takes a plural noun ('candidates') and a singular verb ('was').
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद plural noun और singular verb का प्रयोग होता है, जो यहाँ सही है।

questionText: The principal along with his teachers / have been invited / to attend the annual function. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'have' with 'has'. When subjects are joined by 'along with', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The principal').
उदा. जब दो subjects 'along with' से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार singular/plural होती है। Principal एक singular subject है, अतः 'has' आएगा।

questionText: She is more taller / than her younger sister / who is still in school. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'more taller' with 'taller'. Double comparatives ('more' and 'taller' together) are incorrect.
उदा. एक ही adjective के साथ 두 comparative words ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता।

questionText: Despite of working hard / he failed to secure / the desired rank in the exam. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'Despite of' with 'Despite' or 'In spite of'. 'Despite' does not take 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है, जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: No sooner did the train / arrive at the station / than the passengers rushed towards it. / No error
explanation:
No error. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by auxiliary verb 'did', base verb 'arrive', and conjunction 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का सही प्रयोग है और पास्ट टेंस में 'did' के साथ V1 आती है।

questionText: The committee is / divided in their / opinions regarding the new policy. / No error
explanation:
No error. When a collective noun like 'committee' shows division, it takes a plural verb and plural pronoun ('their').
उदा. जब collective noun (जैसे committee) में मतभेद (division) दिखाया जाए, तो उसके साथ plural verb और plural pronoun का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: One of my friends / are a successful doctor / practicing in Mumbai. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'are' with 'is'. The subject is 'One', not 'friends', so the verb must be singular.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद plural noun आता है, लेकिन वाक्य का मुख्य कर्ता 'One' होता है, इसलिए singular verb 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Had I realized the danger, / I would not have / ventured into the dark forest. / No error
explanation:
No error. This is a third conditional sentence in inverted form (Had + Subject + V3), followed by 'would have + V3'.
उदा. यह Third Conditional का Inversion नियम है, जिसमें 'Had + subject + V3' के साथ 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है। वाक्य बिल्कुल सही है।

questionText: Find the correctly spelt word from the choices below.
explanation:
'Bureaucracy' follows the standard 'eau' and 'cracy' root rule.
उदा. 'Bureaucracy' में 'eau' और 'cracy' का सही संयोजन होता है।

questionText: Select the word that is spelled correctly
explanation:
The correct spelling is *embarrassment* with double ‘r’ and double ‘s’.
उदा. शर्मिंदगी: embarrassment.
grammarRule: The root ‘embarrass’ adds ‘-ment’ and retains double consonants from the base word.

questionText: The following paragraph contains a grammatical error in one of the segments. The committee has decided to increase the budget for the new project. The team will finishes the project by December. The manager will brief them about the goals. They will also be given the opportunity to ask questions.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: *will finishes* should be *will finish*.
उदाहरण: वह पुस्तक *पढ़ती है* (present), वह पुस्तक *पढ़ती हैं* (plural).

questionText: Spot the grammatical error in the paragraph below. One of the segments contains the mistake. She has written the report on time. She has wrote the report on time. The report has been reviewed by the supervisor. The supervisor will approve it tomorrow.
explanation:
Wrong form of past participle: *has wrote* should be *has written*.
उदाहरण: वह *लिख चुका है* (has written), वह *लिख चुका है* (has written).
grammarRule: Correct use of past participle with auxiliary verb

questionText: The students are studying hard for the exams. The students is studying hard for the exams. The exams will start next week. They will finish their assignments on time.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: *students is* should be *students are*.
उदाहरण: छात्र *पढ़ते हैं* (students study), छात्र *पढ़ते हैं* (students study).

questionText: He had finished the assignment before the dead line He had finished the assignment before dead line The dead line was set by the professor. The assignment was due on Friday.
explanation:
Missing article: *before deadline* should be *before the deadline*.
उदाहरण: *से पहले* (before), *पूर्व में* (before).
grammarRule: Use of definite article before noun phrases

questionText: The project was completed by the team. The project was completed by the team. The team was proud of their achievement. The achievement was celebrated by every one.
explanation:
Incorrect pronoun gender agreement: *their* should be *its* because *team* is a collective singular noun.
उदाहरण: टीम *उसका* (its) काम था, टीम *उनका* (their) काम था.

questionText: Which segment contains a grammatical error? She will attend the meeting tomorrow. She will attend the meeting tommorow. The meeting will start at 10 a.m. She has prepared the present at i on.
explanation:
Spelling error: *tommorow* should be *tomorrow*.
उदाहरण: कल (tomorrow) सही वर्तनी है.

questionText: The manager has announced a new policy. The manager have announced a new policy. The policy will affect all employees. All employees must comply with the new rules.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: *manager have* should be *manager has*.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक *है* (has), प्रबंधक *हैं* (are).

questionText: Choose the segment that contains a grammatical error. The data were analyzed by the researchers. The data were analyzed by the researcher. The researchers concluded that the hypothesis was correct. The hypothesis was supported by the evidence.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: *data were* should be *data were* (correct already) but *researcher* is singular, should be *researchers*.
उदाहरण: शोधकर्ता *हैं* (are), शोधकर्ता *है* (is).

questionText: Which segment contains a grammatical mistake? The book is located on the shelf. The book is located on the shelf. The shelf is made of oak wood. The oak wood is sturdy and strong.
explanation:
Repeated segment: A and B are identical; no error. But the actual mistake is in the use of *oak* as adjective twice: *oak wood* is acceptable but may be considered redundant. However since only one error allowed, none of the options is correct. For the sake of the test, we consider *oak wood* as acceptable.
उदाहरण: ओक लकड़ी (oak wood) सही है.

questionText: They have completed the task ahead of schedule. They has completed the task ahead of schedule. The task was challenging but rewarding. The team celebrated their success.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: *They has* should be *They have*.
उदाहरण: वे *हैं* (are), वे *है* (is).

questionText: The committee will review the proposal tomorrow. The committee will review the proposal tomorrow. The proposal was accepted by the board. The board will publish the results next week.
explanation:
Both A and B are identical; there is no error. Thus the test has no correct option. For the exercise, we consider *will review* as correct, no error present. Hence no segment contains error.
उदाहरण: समिति *समीक्षा करेगी* (will review).

questionText: to hit the books

questionText: The ball is in your court

आपको खेल में भाग लेने के लिए आमंत्रित किया गया है

questionText: Break the ice

questionText: Cost an arm and a leg

किसी को दो हाथ और एक पैर देना

questionText: Hit the nail on the head
explanation:

questionText: Let the cat out of the bag

questionText: Under the weather
explanation:

questionText: Spill the beans
explanation:

questionText: By the skin of your teeth
explanation:

questionText: A blessing in disguise
explanation:

questionText: At a snail
explanation:

questionText: To call a spade a spade
options: To dig deep into a matter
explanation:

questionText: To miss the boat
