When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' is used.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: The teacher advised the students to listen _______ to what the guest speaker had to say.
explanation:
The verb 'listen' needs to be modified by an adverb ('attentively'), not an adjective.
उदा. Verb 'listen' की विशेषता बताने के लिए adverb ('attentively') का प्रयोग किया जाएगा, adjective का नहीं।

questionText: The government has taken strict measures to curb the rising ________ of inflation.
explanation:
With inflation, we use the word 'rate' to denote the speed or frequency at which prices rise.
उदा. महंगाई (inflation) बढ़ने की गति या दर को दर्शाने के लिए 'rate' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: She was confident ________ her success in the competitive examination.
explanation:
The adjective 'confident' is followed by the preposition 'of' when expressing certainty about something.
उदा. 'Confident' विशेषण के बाद निश्चितता व्यक्त करने के लिए पूर्वसर्ग (preposition) 'of' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked the employees to ________ their differences and work together.
explanation:
'Put aside' means to ignore or forget something (usually a difference or disagreement) for a particular purpose.
उदा. 'Put aside' एक phrasal verb है जिसका अर्थ किसी मतभेद को नजरअंदाज करना या भुलाना होता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ present in the class today.
explanation:
According to the rule of Subject-Verb Agreement, when subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'are' is used.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे पास वाले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'are' आएगा।

questionText: He is addicted ________ playing online games all night.
explanation:
The adjective/participle 'addicted' always takes the preposition 'to' after it.
उदा. 'Addicted' शब्द के साथ हमेशा निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग 'to' का प्रयोग होता है (जैसे- addicted to alcohol/games)।

questionText: The arduous journey through the mountains left the travellers completely ________.
explanation:
An arduous (very difficult) journey would logically leave travellers feeling completely tired or 'exhausted'.
उदा. एक कठिन (arduous) यात्रा यात्रियों को पूरी तरह से थका देगी, इसलिए यहाँ 'exhausted' (थका हुआ) सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द है।

questionText: Had the captain played well, the team ________ the match.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence structure: 'Had + subject + V3' takes 'would have + V3' in the main clause.
उदा. यह Third Conditional वाक्य है। यदि शर्त वाले क्लॉज़ में 'Had + V3' हो, तो परिणाम वाले क्लॉज़ में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The committee will ________ its report by the end of next week.
explanation:
Modal verbs like 'will' are always followed by the base form of the verb (V1).
उदा. मॉडल वर्ब 'will' के बाद हमेशा वर्ब की पहली फॉर्म (V1) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: It is high time you ________ your career seriously.
explanation:
Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', etc., when followed by a subject, always take the Simple Past tense (V2).
उदा. यदि 'It is high time' के बाद कोई सब्जेक्ट दिया गया हो, तो वाक्य के अगले भाग में Past Indefinite (V2) का प्रयोग होता है।
grammarRule: It is high time + Simple Past

questionText: She is proficient ________ painting and classical music.
explanation:
The adjective 'proficient' (skilled) is followed by the preposition 'in'.
उदा. किसी कला या कार्य में कुशल होने के लिए प्रयुक्त शब्द 'proficient' के साथ पूर्वसर्ग 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager was very “_____” about the project dead line
explanation:
The adjective "concerned" correctly describes a person's feeling about something.
उदा. वह परियोजना की समय सीमा को लेकर चिंतित थी।

questionText: She has been working here for “_____” years.
explanation:
When indicating duration, the noun "years" can be omitted after the number.
उदा. वह यहाँ पाँच साल से काम कर रही है।

questionText: He was “_____” by the sudden noise.
explanation:
"Startled" is the past participle used as an adjective.
उदा. अचानक शोर से वह चौंक गया।

questionText: The company is “_____” to improve employee welfare.
explanation:
"Committed" is the adjective form meaning dedicated.
उदा. कंपनी कर्मचारी कल्याण को बेहतर बनाने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।

questionText: The committee will meet “_____” Thursday.
explanation:
"On" is the correct preposition for days of the week.
उदा. समिति गुरुवार को मिलेगी।

questionText: She was “_____” to the news of the promotion.
explanation:
"Elated" is the adjective meaning very happy.
उदा. उसे पदोन्नति की खबर से बहुत खुशी हुई।

questionText: The new policy will be implemented “_____” the end of the month.
explanation:
"By" indicates the latest time or deadline.
उदा. नई नीति महीने के अंत तक लागू की जाएगी।

questionText: They have been studying French for “_____” months.
explanation:
The number alone can indicate duration; the noun is optional.
उदा. उन्होंने दस महीने से फ्रेंच का अध्ययन किया है।

questionText: The report was “_____” by the auditors.
explanation:
"Examined" is the past participle used as an adjective.
उदा. रिपोर्ट का ऑडिटरों द्वारा निरीक्षण किया गया।

questionText: He was praised “_____” his efforts.
explanation:
"For" is the correct preposition to indicate the reason for praise.
उदा. उसके प्रयासों के लिए उसे प्रशंसा मिली।

questionText: They ____ the train to arrive on time.
explanation:
Use the past tense of *expect* to express a prediction that the train would reach on time.
उदा. उन्होंने उम्मीद की कि ट्रेन समय पर पहुंचेगी।

questionText: She has been studying English ____ 2012.
explanation:
Use *since* with a specific point in time. 2012 is a point, so *since 2012*.
उदा. वह 2012 से अंग्रेज़ी पढ़ रही है।

questionText: He was known for his ____ generosity.
explanation:
After *for* we use an adjective, not an adverb. So *generous*.
उदा. वह अपनी उदारता के लिए जाना जाता है।

questionText: The project will be completed ____ the dead line
explanation:
*Within* the deadline means before it ends.
उदा. परियोजना समय सीमा के भीतर पूरा हो जाएगी।

questionText: If you ____ the instructions carefully, you will not make mistakes.
explanation:
In a conditional clause we use the simple present: *follow*. 
उदा. यदि आप निर्देशों का सावधानी से पालन करते हैं, तो आप गलतियाँ नहीं करेंगे।

questionText: The new policy aims ____ the gap between the rich and the poor.
explanation:
Use *to* + infinitive after *aims*.
उदा. नई नीति अमीर और गरीब के बीच की खाई को बंद करने का लक्ष्य रखती है।

questionText: I am looking forward to ____ you again.
explanation:
*Looking forward to* is followed by a gerund.
उदा. मैं फिर से आपसे मिलने का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

questionText: She has a talent ____ playing the violin.
explanation:
*Talent for* indicates a skill.
उदा. उसे वायलिन बजाने में कौशल है।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'for'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: The company was established ____ 1995.
explanation:
*In* a year. 1995 is a year.
उदा. कंपनी की स्थापना 1995 में हुई थी।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'in'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: His speech was ____ and filled with emotion.
explanation:
Use the adjective *moving* to describe the speech.
उदा. उसका भाषण भावनाओं से भरा हुआ था।

questionText: The manager's instructions were ___, leaving no room for error.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single adjective to replace the phrase "very clear and detailed".
उदा. Hindi: "Manager के निर्देश बहुत स्पष्ट और विस्तृत थे, जिससे कोई गलती नहीं हुई।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'very clear and detailed'

questionText: The politician's speech was filled with ___ promises that seemed unrealistic.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one adjective to replace the phrase "promises that are void of substance".
उदाहरण: "राजनेता का भाषण खाली वादों से भरा हुआ था।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'promises that are void of substance'

questionText: The novel's plot was ___, making it difficult for readers to follow.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace the phrase "very complicated and confusing" with a single adjective.
उदाहरण: "उपन्यास का कथानक जटिल था, जिससे पाठकों को समझने में कठिनाई हुई।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'very complicated and confusing'

questionText: The athlete's performance was ___, earning her the championship title.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one adjective to replace the phrase "of outstanding quality".
उदाहरण: "खिलाड़ी का प्रदर्शन उत्कृष्ट था, जिससे उसे चैंपियनशिप मिली।"

questionText: The conference was attended by ___ experts from various fields.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace the phrase "many people" with a single adjective.
उदाहरण: "सम्मेलन में कई विशेषज्ञ उपस्थित थे।"

questionText: The city’s infrastructure is ___, allowing efficient transportation.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one adjective to replace the phrase "sufficient to meet needs".
उदाहरण: "शहर की बुनियादी ढांचा पर्याप्त है, जिससे यातायात सुगम होता है।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'sufficient to meet needs'

questionText: The teacher's explanation was ___, clarifying all doubts.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one adjective to replace the phrase "short and to the point".
उदाहरण: "शिक्षक का स्पष्टीकरण संक्षिप्त था, जिससे सभी शंकाएँ दूर हुईं।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'short and to the point'

questionText: The project was completed ___, ahead of schedule.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace the phrase "quickly and efficiently" with a single adverb.
उदाहरण: "परियोजना को शीघ्रता से पूरा किया गया, समय से पहले।"

questionText: The company's profits have been ___ for the last five years.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one adverb to replace the phrase "in a consistent manner".
उदाहरण: "कंपनी के मुनाफे लगातार बढ़ रहे हैं।"
grammarRule: Adverb Substitution for 'in a consistent manner'

questionText: The documentary offered ___ insights into the subject.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace the phrase "extremely useful or indispensable" with a single adjective.
उदाहरण: "दस्तावेज़ी फिल्म ने विषय पर अनमोल अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान की।"
grammarRule: Adjective Substitution for 'extremely useful or indispensable'

questionText: Select the incorrectly spelled word among the given options.
explanation:
The word 'Mischeivous' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'Mischievous'.
उदा. 'Mischeivous' गलत है, सही स्पेलिंग 'Mischievous' है (ie नहीं ei आता है अंत में)।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled option.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **receive**. Rule: The sequence *ei* follows the 'c' before the vowel 'i' when the sound is /iː/.
उदाहरण: *receive* सही लिखा जाता है।
grammarRule: Use *ei* after 'c' when followed by 'i' sound.

questionText: Hardly had I reached the station **than the train left**.
explanation:
'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than' (which is used with 'No sooner'). Hence, 'when the train left' is correct.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का।

questionText: The principal as well as the teachers **were present** in the meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The principal', singular). Thus, 'was present' is correct.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The principal' एक वचन है, इसलिए 'was' आएगा।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates **have qualified** for the post.
explanation:
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' always take a singular verb because they refer to individuals separately. Hence, 'has qualified' is correct.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of' और 'Each of' के बाद सिंगुलर वर्ब का प्रयोग होता है क्योंकि ये एक समय में एक की बात करते हैं।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (Neither of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: She told me that she **has bought** a new car the previous day.
explanation:
The reporting verb 'told' is in the past tense, and 'the previous day' indicates a past time before another past action. Therefore, past perfect tense 'had bought' should be used.
उदा. यदि रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब पास्ट टेंस में हो और वाक्य में 'the previous day' दिया हो, तो पास्ट परफेक्ट टेंस ('had + V3') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: No sooner did the sun rise **when the fog disappeared**.
explanation:
'No sooner' is strictly followed by the conjunction 'than', not 'when'. Hence, 'than the fog disappeared' is correct.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'when' का नहीं।

questionText: She is one of those women who **always speaks** the truth.
explanation:
In the structure 'One of + Plural Noun + Relative Pronoun (who/which/that) + Plural Verb', the verb must agree with the plural antecedent ('women'). Thus, 'always speak' is correct.
उदा. 'One of + Plural Noun + who' की बनावट में रिलेटिव प्रोनाउन (who) से पहले आने वाले प्लुरल नाउन के अनुसार प्लुरल वर्ब (speak) का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: He is superior **than me** in intelligence and capability.
explanation:
Adjectives ending in '-or' such as superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior, etc., are followed by the preposition 'to', not 'than'. Hence, 'to me' is correct.
उदा. 'superior', 'junior', 'senior' जैसे एडजेक्टिव्स के बाद 'than' के स्थान पर हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Despite of his hard work, **he failed** to secure good marks.
options: In spite of his hard work
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of' (Despite = In spite of). Therefore, both 'In spite of his hard work' and 'Despite his hard work' are grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता, जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है। अतः विकल्प 2 और 3 दोनों सही हैं।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: Each boy and each girl **were given** a prize by the direct or.
explanation:
When two singular subjects are preceded by 'Each' and connected by 'and', the verb must be singular. Hence, 'was given' is correct.
उदा. जब दो सिंगुलर नाउन 'Each' से जुड़े हों और 'and' से मिलें, तो वर्ब हमेशा सिंगुलर होती है।

questionText: Each of the students participating in the science fair are given a certificate of appreciation.
explanation:
When a subject begins with 'Each of', the verb that follows must be singular because 'Each' is singular.
उदा. जब वाक्य की शुरुआत 'Each of' से हो, तो इसके बाद आने वाली वर्ब हमेशा singular (एकवचन) होती है क्योंकि 'Each' एकवचन को दर्शाता है।

questionText: She is more smarter than her younger sister in solving complex puzzles.
explanation:
Double comparatives ('more smarter') are grammatically incorrect. 'Smarter' is already a comparative adjective.
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative degree (more और smarter) का प्रयोग करना गलत है। 'Smarter' अपने आप में comparative है।

questionText: No sooner did the bell ring when the students rushed out of their classrooms.
explanation:
'No sooner' must always be followed by 'than' in the correlative pair.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का जोड़ा बनता है, न कि 'when' का।

questionText: Despite of working hard, he failed to secure good marks in the examination.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. 'In spite of' is correct, whereas 'Despite' is used alone.
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'In spite of' होता है, लेकिन 'Despite' अकेला आता है।
grammarRule: Preposition usage with Despite / In spite of

questionText: One of my friends are going to relocate to London next month.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb because the main subject is 'One'.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' की संरचना में मुख्य subject 'One' होता है, इसलिए verb हमेशा singular (is) आती है।

questionText: Neither the manager nor his subordinates was present at the crucial meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('subordinates' is plural).
उदा. जब दो subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है ('subordinates' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा)।

questionText: She insisted to accompany me to the railway station despite my refusal.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (verb+ing).
उदा. 'Insist' वर्ब के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (v1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee ____ the proposal after reviewing it.
explanation:
Rule: Present perfect tense is used to describe an action that was completed before another past event. 
उदाहरण: "उसने रिपोर्ट लिखी है" (He has written the report).

questionText: She has been studying for two hours and ____.
explanation:
Rule: Present participle is used after continuous verbs to describe an ongoing state. 
उदाहरण: "वह पढ़ रही है, इसलिए वह थकी हुई है" (She is studying, so she is feeling tired).

questionText: It is ____ to accept the terms if you are not satisfied.
explanation:
Rule: An adjective is used to describe a noun, while an adverb modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb. 
उदाहरण: "यह निर्णय समझदारीपूर्ण है" (This decision is reasonable).

questionText: The new policy will be implemented after ____.
options: the necessary approvals have been obtained
explanation:
Rule: The passive voice with present perfect is used when the action has been completed before a future event. 
उदाहरण: "मंजूरी मिलने के बाद ही परियोजना शुरू होगी" (The project will start after the approvals have been obtained).

questionText: He gave me a book, and ____.
explanation:
Rule: Past simple is used after a past event to describe a past feeling. 
उदाहरण: "मैंने किताब ली, और मैं आभारी था" (I received the book, and I was grateful).

questionText: The manager asked the team to finish the project, but they ____.
explanation:
Rule: The past simple form of the verb is used after negative contractions in past tense. 
उदाहरण: "उन्हें काम पूरा नहीं किया" (They did not finish the work).

questionText: The students were given a chance to win a prize, however they ____.
explanation:
Rule: Use the past simple form after negative contraction. 
उदाहरण: "उन्हें मौका मिला, लेकिन उन्होंने भाग नहीं लिया" (They were given a chance, but they did not participate).

questionText: By the end of the year, the company will have ____.
explanation:
Rule: Future perfect tense is used for actions that will be completed before a future time. 
उदाहरण: "वर्ष के अंत तक कंपनी अपना लक्ष्य हासिल कर लेगी" (By the end of the year, the company will have reached its target).

questionText: The book was written by a famous author, and it ____.
explanation:
Rule: Present perfect passive is used to show that an action has been completed and its effect continues. 
उदाहरण: "पुस्तक को आलोचक ने सराहा" (The book has been acclaimed).

questionText: We have to finish the work before the dead line otherwise ____.
explanation:
Rule: Future simple is used after a conditional clause to express a consequence. 
उदाहरण: "समय पर नहीं हो पाया, तो देर हो जाएगी" (Otherwise we will be late).

questionText: The committee [has been discussing] the proposal for weeks.
explanation:
The action is completed; use simple perfect tense. 
उदाहरण: समिति ने प्रस्ताव पर चर्चा कर ली है।

questionText: She [has been studying] French since she was a child.
explanation:
Use present perfect to indicate an action that started in the past and continues. 
उदाहरण: उसने फ्रेंच का अध्ययन किया है।

questionText: The manager [has been recommending] the new policy to the staff.
explanation:
The recommendation is a completed action; simple perfect is appropriate. 
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक ने नई नीति की सिफारिश की है।

questionText: Students [are expected] to submit their assignments by Friday.
explanation:
The passive form without auxiliary is sufficient. 
उदाहरण: छात्रों को शुक्रवार तक असाइनमेंट जमा करने की अपेक्षा है।

questionText: The project [has been completed] last month.
explanation:
Past perfect is unnecessary; simple past is correct. 
उदाहरण: परियोजना पिछले महीने पूरी हुई।

questionText: The report [has been prepared] by the auditor.
explanation:
The simple past passive form is sufficient. 
उदाहरण: रिपोर्ट ऑडिटर द्वारा तैयार की गई है।

questionText: Employees [are being given] opportunities for growth.
explanation:
The simple passive form conveys the meaning adequately. 
उदाहरण: कर्मचारियों को विकास के अवसर दिए जा रहे हैं।

questionText: The data [has been analyzed] and found to be accurate.
explanation:
Past simple passive states that the data was analyzed; the result follows. 
उदाहरण: डेटा का विश्लेषण किया गया और यह सटीक पाया गया।

questionText: The committee [has been voting] on the matter for hours.
explanation:
The simple perfect tense is sufficient for completed voting. 
उदाहरण: समिति ने इस विषय पर घंटों तक मतदान किया है।

questionText: The team [has been working] on the task for days.
explanation:
Simple perfect indicates continuous effort; no need for continuous form. 
उदाहरण: टीम ने कई दिनों तक कार्य पर काम किया है।

questionText: Select the incorrectly spelled word among the following.
explanation:
'Garantee' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Guarantee'.
उदा. 'Garantee' गलत है; सही spelling 'Guarantee' है।

questionText: Which of the following options contains an incorrectly spelt word?
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Temperament' with an 'e' in the middle, not an 'a'.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Temperament' है, बीच में 'a' के स्थान पर 'e' आता है।

questionText: Identify the word that is spelt INCORRECTLY among the given options.
explanation:
The word 'Occurence' is incorrect; the correct spelling is 'Occurrence' (double 'c' and double 'r'). 
उदा. 'Occurence' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Occurrence' है जिसमें डबल 'c' और डबल 'r' आते हैं।
grammarRule: Double consonant rule in derivative words

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the following sentence: "The government announced a new policy to improve the e-commence sector.
explanation:
"e-commence" is misspelled; the correct term is "e-commerce".
उदा. सही शब्द: e-commerce

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "The committee will discus the new guidelines next week.
explanation:
"discus" is misspelled; the correct verb is "discuss".
उदा. सही शब्द: discuss

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelt word in the given options.
explanation:
'Diemond' is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is 'Diamond' (D-i-a-m-o-n-d).
उदा. 'Diemond' गलत है, सही वर्तनी 'Diamond' है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelt word from the given options.
explanation:
'Pharmacy' is the correct spelling. It refers to the preparation and dispensing of medicinal drugs.
उदा. सही वर्तनी 'Pharmacy' है।

questionText: Science and technology / has made our lives / much more faster / and comfortable.
explanation:
Double comparatives (more faster) are incorrect. Use 'much faster'.
उदा. 'more' और 'faster' दोनों एक साथ तुलना करने के लिए प्रयोग नहीं किए जा सकते, यहाँ केवल 'faster' आएगा।

questionText: Neither the girl / nor her parents / was present / at the function.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('parents', plural). Hence, use 'were' instead of 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' में verb पास वाले subject (parents जो कि बहुवचन है) के अनुसार लगेगी, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: Each of the students / in the mathematics class / have submitted / their assignment on time.
explanation:
'Each of' takes a singular verb and singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (has) आती है।

questionText: The direct or as well as / the staff members / were present / at the annual meeting.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The director', singular). Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'as well as' से जुड़ने पर verb पहले subject ('The director' जो singular है) के अनुसार आएगी, अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I / stepped out of the house / when a heavy downpour / drenched me completely.
explanation:
No error in the sentence. 'Hardly' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'when'.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है, 'Hardly' के साथ 'when' का जोड़ा बिल्कुल सही है।

questionText: He told me that / he is reading / a book for the last / two hours.
explanation:
Since the reporting verb is in the past tense ('told') and time duration ('for the last two hours') is given, the reported speech must be in the past perfect continuous tense ('he was reading' or 'he had been reading').
उदा. मुख्य वाक्य भूतकाल (told) में है और समय दिया गया है, इसलिए 'is reading' की जगह 'has been reading' या 'was reading' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Alas! Our leader / is no more / and we are left / in utter darkness.
explanation:
The sentence is completely correct. 'Alas' is an interjection of sorrow, followed by correct grammar. No error.
उदा. वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः शुद्ध है, इसमें कोई अशुद्धि नहीं है।

questionText: One of the most important task / in the project is to complete / the documentation before the dead line / No error
explanation:
Replace 'task' with 'tasks'. The structure 'One of + plural noun + singular verb' requires a plural noun after 'One of'.
उदा. 'task' को 'tasks' से बदलें। 'One of + बहुवचन संज्ञा + एकवचन क्रिया' की संरचना में 'One of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement / Noun after One of

questionText: Neither the manager / nor his subordinates was able / to explain the sudden drop in sales. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'was' with 'were'. When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it (subordinates is plural).
उदा. 'was' को 'were' से बदलें। जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता (subordinates जो कि बहुवचन है) के अनुसार होती है।

questionText: She is more smarter / than her sister / in handling complex situations. / No error
explanation:
Remove 'more'. Double comparatives ('more smarter') are grammatically incorrect. Use 'smarter'.
उदा. 'more' को हटा दें। दो तुलनात्मक शब्दों का एक साथ प्रयोग ('more smarter') गलत है, केवल 'smarter' का प्रयोग करें।

questionText: Despite of his hard work / he failed to secure / the top rank in the examination. / No error
explanation:
Remove 'of' after 'Despite'. 'Despite' is synonymous with 'In spite of' and does not take 'of' after it.
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद 'of' का प्रयोग न करें। 'Despite' का अर्थ 'In spite of' होता है और इसके साथ 'of' नहीं लगता।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: The committee will meet / tomorrow to discuss about / the new welfare schemes for farmers. / No error
explanation:
Remove 'about' after 'discuss'. 'Discuss' is a transitive verb and takes a direct object without any preposition.
उदा. 'discuss' के बाद 'about' हटा दें। 'Discuss' एक सकर्मक क्रिया है और इसके बाद सीधे कर्म आता है, बीच में कोई पूर्वसर्ग नहीं लगता।

questionText: No sooner did the train / arrive at the platform / then the passengers rushed towards it. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'then' with 'than'. The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when' or 'then'.
उदा. 'then' को 'than' से बदलें। 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' या 'when' का नहीं।

questionText: If I was the king / of this country, I would eradicate / poverty and corruption completely. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'was' with 'were'. In subjunctive sentences expressing an imaginary wish or condition, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. 'was' को 'were' से बदलें। काल्पनिक इच्छा या शर्त वाले वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: She is working in this / department for the last / five years with utmost dedication. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'She is working' with 'She has been working'. Present perfect continuous tense is used for an action starting in the past and continuing into the present with 'for/since'.
उदा. 'She is working' की जगह 'She has been working' का प्रयोग करें। भूतकाल से शुरू होकर वर्तमान तक जारी रहने वाले कार्य के लिए 'for/since' के साथ Present Perfect Continuous Tense आता है।

questionText: Each of the suspected men / were interrogated thoroughly / by the senior police officers. / No error
explanation:
Replace 'were' with 'was'. 'Each of' takes a singular verb because the subject 'Each' is singular.
उदा. 'were' को 'was' से बदलें। 'Each of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है लेकिन क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (singular verb) होती है क्योंकि मुख्य कर्ता 'Each' है।

questionText: The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policies. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: The word "policy" is used in singular form, but "policies" (plural) is required to match the plural subject "new" when referring to multiple policies.
उदा. गलत वाक्य: The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policies.
सही वाक्य: The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy.

questionText: He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: Use "for" with a duration and "since" with a point in time. The correct phrase is "since five years" is incorrect; it should be "for five years".
उदा. गलत वाक्य: He has been working here since five years.
सही वाक्य: He has been working here for five years.
grammarRule: Use of for and since for time expressions

questionText: The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: When a verb is in passive voice, the auxiliary should be "was" for singular subject "research". Here the verb is correct but the object "team" should be preceded by "by" once; the error is that the phrase "by the team" is repeated unnecessarily. The correct segment is (B).
उदा. गलत वाक्य: The research was conducted by the team last year.
सही वाक्य: The research was conducted by the team last year.

questionText: They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: Use "next week" without the article "the" when referring to the upcoming week. So (B) and (D) are correct, but the question marks the use of "the next week" in (A) and (C) as incorrect.
उदा. गलत वाक्य: They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week.
सही वाक्य: They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
grammarRule: Use of articles with time expressions

questionText: The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: When using a non‑essential clause with commas, the subject of the clause should agree with the antecedent. Here the clause "along with his team" is non‑essential and the verb should remain singular "will attend". The error lies in (A) where the comma placement makes it ambiguous. Correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: The past perfect tense is used when an action was completed before another past action. Here the correct form is "had finished". The error is that (A) uses the simple past "finished" instead of past perfect. Correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: Use "for" with a duration and "since" with a point of time. The phrase "for three years" is correct; the error is in (A) where "has been studying" is fine, but the context might require "has been studying" with "since" if a starting point is mentioned. However, in this sentence, (A) is correct and the error is in the other segments where the verb tense is wrong. The correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
grammarRule: Use of for and since for time expressions

questionText: The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: A non‑essential relative clause (introduced by "which") must be set off by commas. The error is the missing comma after "report" in (A). The correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: The past simple "were required" is correct, but the error is that the phrase "their documents" should be "their documents" (no error). However, in the original sentence, (A) uses the wrong tense "were required" while the correct tense is "were required to". The correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Rule in English: The phrase "after the meeting" is acceptable, but the error lies in the use of the singular noun "policy" with a plural verb. In (A), the verb "will be implemented" is correctly singular, but the error is that the article "the" before "new policy" is missing. The correct segment is (B).

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: Which one of the following words is misspelled?
explanation:
The correct spelling is *occurrence* with two ‘c’s and two ‘r’s. The option *Occurance* has only one ‘c’ and one ‘r’. 
उदाहरण: सही शब्द ‘occurrence’ है, जबकि ‘Occurance’ में एक ‘c’ और ‘r’ गायब हैं।
grammarRule: Spelling of words with double consonants after short vowel

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: The committee decided to _seperate_ the funds for the new project.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **separate**. The word is formed with an 'a' after the 't'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: separate; गलत वर्तनी: seperate.

questionText: In the sentence below, which word is misspelled? The scientist presented his findigs at the conference.
explanation:
The correct word is **findings**. It ends with 'ings' after the root 'find'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: findings; गलत वर्तनी: findigs.

questionText: They had a great toke of laughter during the play.
explanation:
The correct form is **took**. The past tense of 'take' is 'took'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: took; गलत वर्तनी: toke.
grammarRule: Past tense of the verb take

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence: The library contains a rare book of antiquated scince.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **science**. It contains the 'i' after the 'c'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: science; गलत वर्तनी: scince.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the following sentence: She was an excellent chemist, known for her precise experimennts.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **experiments**. The suffix is '-ments' after 'experiment'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: experiments; गलत वर्तनी: experimennts.

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the sentence below? The government announced a new policy for childre's education.
explanation:
The correct word is **children's**. The possessive form is formed from 'children'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: children's; गलत वर्तनी: childre's.
grammarRule: Possessive form of plural nouns ending in -ren

questionText: Choose the word that is misspelled in the sentence: The auditorium was filled with a large number of audience.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **audience**. It ends with 'e' after 'enc'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: audience; गलत वर्तनी: audenc.

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelled word in the following sentence: He was known for his elegant and sophisicated speeches.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **sophisticated**. It contains 'st' after 'ph'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: sophisticated; गलत वर्तनी: sophisicated.

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the following sentence? The researcher was praised for his new discovery in the field of astrophysic.
explanation:
The correct word is **astrophysics**. The field is spelled with 'ics' at the end.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: astrophysics; गलत वर्तनी: astrophysic.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: She made a great deference to the older members of the committee.
explanation:
The correct spelling is **deference**. It contains 'f' after 'e'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: deference; गलत वर्तनी: defrance.

questionText: Identify the word which is spelled INCORRECTLY.
explanation:
The word 'Acheivement' is incorrectly spelled. The 'i' comes before 'e' after 'h', making it 'Achievement'.
उदा. 'Acheivement' गलत है क्योंकि नियम 'i before e except after c' के तहत सही वर्तनी 'Achievement' है।
grammarRule: I before E except after C rule

questionText: Read the passage and fill in blank (1): Education is not merely acquiring knowledge for a livelihood, it is (1) ______ for life. Passage context: Education and human development.
explanation:
Contextually, education prepares a person for life's challenges. 'Preparation' fits best.
उदा. संदर्भ के अनुसार, शिक्षा जीवन के लिए तैयार करती है, इसलिए 'preparation' सही विकल्प है।
passage: Effective communication is the [BLANK_1] of successful interpersonal relationships and professional growth. It involves not only expressing ideas clearly but also [BLANK_2] actively to others with empathy. Misunderstandings often arise when messages are [BLANK_3] or interpreted through personal biases. In workplace environments, transparent dialogue fosters trust and [BLANK_4] workplace productivity. Mastering both verbal and non-verbal cues is [BLANK_5] for career advancement.

questionText: Read the passage and fill in blank (2): Books are our best companions. They never demand anything from us (2) ______ give us immense joy and wisdom. Passage context: The value of reading books.
explanation:
The conjunction 'but' is used to show contrast between not demanding anything and giving immense joy.
उदा. यहाँ विरोध (contrast) दर्शाने के लिए 'but' (लेकिन) कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग किया जाएगा।

explanation:
No error in this sentence. 'Hardly' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' in the first clause and 'when' in the second clause.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'Hardly' के साथ सही संयोजन 'when' का प्रयोग हुआ है और वाक्य की संरचना भी सही है।

questionText: She insisted to go / to the market alone / despite the heavy / rain warning.
explanation:
Replace 'insisted to go' with 'insisted on going'. The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'insisted to go' की जगह 'insisted on going' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'insist' के बाद हमेशा प्रीपोजिशन 'on' और उसके बाद जेरंड (gerund) आता है।

questionText: One of the most important / feature of this book / is its simple and / lucid language.
explanation:
Replace 'feature' with 'features'. The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun or pronoun.
उदा. 'feature' को 'features' से बदलें क्योंकि 'One of' के बाद हमेशा बहुवचन संज्ञा (plural noun) का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: No sooner did the train / arrived at the station / than the passengers / rushed towards it.
explanation:
Replace 'arrived' with 'arrive'. 'Did' is a helping verb and is always followed by the base form of the verb (V1).
उदा. 'arrived' की जगह 'arrive' होगा क्योंकि 'did' के साथ हमेशा वर्ब की पहली फॉर्म (V1) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The manager asked him / that why he was / coming late to the office / for past several days.
explanation:
Remove 'that' in segment (B). In indirect speech for WH-questions (why, what, where), conjunction 'that' is not used before the question word.
उदा. भाग (B) में 'that' का प्रयोग गलत है। Indirect speech में WH-word (why) से पहले 'that' नहीं लगाया जाता।

questionText: Despite of working hard / he could not clear / the competitive exam / in his first attempt.
explanation:
Replace 'Despite of' with 'Despite' or 'In spite of'. 'Despite' does not take 'of' after it, whereas 'In spite' takes 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite of' की जगह केवल 'Despite' या 'In spite of' का प्रयोग करें क्योंकि 'Despite' के साथ 'of' नहीं आता है।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: Each of the suspected / terrorists have been / arrested by the police / early this morning.
explanation:
Replace 'have been' with 'has been'. The pronoun 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'have been' को 'has been' से बदलें क्योंकि 'Each' एक सिंगुलर सब्जेक्ट है और इसके साथ सिंगुलर वर्ब आती है।

questionText: Scarcely had we reached / the exhibition ground / than it started / raining heavily.
explanation:
Replace 'than' with 'when'. 'Scarcely' or 'Barely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'than' की जगह 'when' का प्रयोग करें क्योंकि 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का जोड़ा बनता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than a heavy downpour / caught me completely unawares. / No error
explanation:
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when' in part (B).
उदा. 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। 'than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ किया जाता है। अतः भाग (B) में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates / have paid their subscription / to the club for the year. / No error
explanation:
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' are followed by a plural noun/pronoun but take a singular verb and singular possessive pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his' in part (B).
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है। 'have' की जगह 'has' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: The principal along with all the teachers / are going to attend / the seminar tomorrow. / No error
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The principal' is singular, so replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो subjects 'along with', 'as well as' आदि से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'The principal' singular है, इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।

questionText: She told to me / that she would not be able / to attend the meeting. / No error
explanation:
The verb 'tell' is a transitive verb and does not take a preposition like 'to' before its indirect object. Replace 'told to me' with 'told me' in part (A).
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद कभी भी preposition 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है जबकि 'said' के बाद 'to' आ सकता है। अतः 'told to me' गलत है।

questionText: No sooner did the train arrive / than the passengers rushed / towards the compartments. / No error
explanation:
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by the auxiliary verb 'did', the base form of the verb 'arrive', and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह से सही है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'did' और फिर 'than' का सही संयोजन किया गया है।

questionText: It is high time / that the government takes / strict action against corruption. / No error
explanation:
Expressions like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took' in part (B).
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाली clause में Past Indefinite Tense (V2) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'takes' की जगह 'took' होगा।
grammarRule: Subjunctive Mood (It is high time + V2)

questionText: One of my friends / are a renowned scientist / working in NASA. / No error
explanation:
'One of' is always followed by a plural noun but the verb associated with it is singular because the subject is 'One'. Replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).
उदा. 'One of' के बाद plural noun आता है लेकिन verb singular होती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'One' होता है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: He walked as if / he is lame / though he was perfectly fine. / No error
explanation:
'As if' or 'as though' denotes an unreal condition, which is always followed by 'were' (regardless of the subject). Replace 'is' with 'were' in part (B).
उदा. 'As if' या 'as though' काल्पनिक स्थिति को दर्शाते हैं, जिसके साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। 'is' की जगह 'were' सही होगा।

questionText: Scarcely had we reached the station / when the train started moving / in full speed. / No error
explanation:
The correct prepositional idiom is 'at full speed', not 'in full speed'. Replace 'in' with 'at' in part (C).
उदा. यहाँ निश्चित मुहावरेदार प्रयोग (Fixed preposition) की गलती है। 'in full speed' की जगह 'at full speed' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Not only the principal / but also the students was / involved in the protest. / No error
explanation:
When subjects are connected by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'the students' is plural, so replace 'was' with 'were' in part (B).
उदा. जब subjects 'not only... but also' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'the students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

questionText: The *adress* of the event was posted online.
explanation:
The correct spelling of the noun and verb meaning 'to address' is "address".
सही वर्तनी "address" है, जिसमें दो 'd' और दो 's' होते हैं।
grammarRule: Spelling of common nouns and verbs.

questionText: He was very *exhilarate* at the news.
explanation:
"Exhilarated" is the past participle of the verb "exhilarate".
सही शब्द "exhilarated" है, जो भूतकालीन रूप है।

questionText: The *seperate* file is on the desktop.
explanation:
"Separate" is spelled with an 'a' after the 'e'.
सही वर्तनी "separate" है, जिसमें 'a' आता है।

questionText: She has a *dilema* to solve.
explanation:
"Dilemma" has two 'm's. It refers to a difficult choice.
सही वर्तनी "dilemma" है, जिसमें दो 'm' होते हैं।

questionText: The *accomodate* area is too small.
explanation:
"Accommodate" has double 'c' and double 'm'.
सही वर्तनी "accommodate" है, जिसमें 'c' और 'm' दोनों दो बार आते हैं।
grammarRule: Spelling of verbs meaning to provide lodging.

questionText: They *recieve* the package yesterday.
explanation:
"Receive" is spelled with 'e' before 'i'.
सही वर्तनी "receive" है, जिसमें 'e' 'i' से पहले आता है।
grammarRule: Rule for 'i before e except after c'.

questionText: The *militry* parade was impressive.
explanation:
"Military" is spelled with a 'a' after 'l'.
सही वर्तनी "military" है, जिसमें 'a' आता है।
grammarRule: Spelling of words derived from Latin roots.

questionText: It is *neccessary* to submit the form.
explanation:
"Necessary" has double 's' and double 'c'.
सही वर्तनी "necessary" है, जिसमें 's' और 'c' दोनों दो बार आते हैं।

questionText: The *occassion* was a big event.
explanation:
"Occasion" has double 'c' and double 's'.
सही वर्तनी "occasion" है, जिसमें 'c' और 's' दो बार आते हैं।

questionText: She was *intrested* in the topic.
explanation:
"Interested" is spelled with a 'e' after 't'.
सही वर्तनी "interested" है, जिसमें 'e' आता है।
grammarRule: Spelling of past participles of regular verbs.

questionText: He was *completely* surprised.
explanation:
"Completely" has double 'p' and double 'l'.
सही वर्तनी "completely" है, जिसमें 'p' और 'l' दो बार आते हैं।

questionText: In hot water
explanation:
In hot water: to be in trouble or facing difficulties.
उदाहरण: "उसके देर से आने के कारण उसे आधिकारिक तौर पर गर्म पानी में डाल दिया गया।"

questionText: To cost an arm and a leg
options: To suffer a serious physical injury in an accident
To pay a huge amount of money for something
To lose body parts in a war
To work hard using hands and legs
explanation:
To cost an arm and a leg means to be extremely expensive.
उदा. 'To cost an arm and a leg' का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक खर्चीला होना या बहुत महँगा होना।

questionText: Break the ice
options: To physically break ice into pieces
To start a conversation or activity
explanation:
The idiom means to initiate conversation or warm up a situation. It is used when someone wants to ease tension at the beginning of an event.
उदा. "After a long silence, she decided to break the ice by asking about his hobbies."

questionText: A blessing in disguise
options: A gift hidden in a disguise
Something that appears bad but turns out good
A secret that is kept hidden
explanation:
The idiom is used when an apparent misfortune leads to a beneficial outcome. It highlights hidden positives.
उदा. "Losing that job was a blessing in disguise because it pushed me to start my own business."

questionText: Cutting corners
options: Physically cutting the corners of a cake
Running around corners in a race
explanation:
It refers to shortcuts that compromise quality, often to save time or money. The phrase implies a lack of thoroughness.
उदा. "They were cutting corners during construction, which led to cracks later."

questionText: Kick the bucket
explanation:
It is a euphemism for dying. The phrase likely comes from old practices of hanging livestock by a bucket.
उदा. "The old farmer finally kicked the bucket after a long life."

questionText: break the ice
options: to start a conversation in a social setting
explanation:
The idiom "break the ice" means to initiate conversation or activity in a social context to reduce tension.
उदाहरण: जब नए लोग मिलते हैं, तो बातचीत के विषय के माध्यम से "break the ice" किया जाता है।

questionText: on the fence
explanation:
"On the fence" refers to someone who cannot decide between two options.
उदाहरण: वह चुनाव में 'on the fence' है, इसलिए उसने मत नहीं दिया।

questionText: jump the gun
explanation:
"Jump the gun" means to start an activity before the proper time.
उदाहरण: उसने परीक्षा से पहले ही पढ़ाई शुरू कर दी, यानी "jump the gun" किया।

questionText: take a back seat
options: to step aside and allow others to lead
explanation:
"Take a back seat" means to give others the opportunity to take charge.
उदाहरण: उसने टीम को "take a back seat" देने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: see the light
explanation:
"See the light" means to understand or realize something.
उदाहरण: उसने आखिरकार समस्या को "see the light" कर लिया।

questionText: miss the boat
explanation:
"Miss the boat" refers to missing out on a chance or opportunity.
उदाहरण: वह नौकरी के लिए आवेदन नहीं कर पाया, इसलिए "miss the boat" हो गया।

questionText: turn a blind eye
explanation:
"Turn a blind eye" means to ignore or refuse to acknowledge something.
उदाहरण: उसने नियमों को "turn a blind eye" करने का फैसला किया।

questionText: bite the bullet
explanation:
"Bite the bullet" means to accept a difficult or unpleasant situation.
उदाहरण: उसने परीक्षा देने से पहले "bite the bullet" कर लिया।

questionText: give someone the cold shoulder
explanation:
"Give someone the cold shoulder" means to deliberately ignore or snub someone.
उदाहरण: उसने उसे "give someone the cold shoulder" किया।

questionText: The manager as well as his assistants **have been arrested** for financial irregularities.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Hence, 'has been arrested' is correct.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) पहले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'has been arrested' होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I opened the front door **than a dog entered** the house.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' (not 'than'). Hence, 'when a dog entered' is correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। इसलिए 'when a dog entered' सही विकल्प है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates **have qualified** for the interview.
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Since 'candidates' is plural, the verb must be singular ('has qualified').
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा (plural noun) और एकवचन क्रिया (singular verb) का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'has qualified' सही है।

questionText: She is living in this city **since five years**.
explanation:
For a period of time (duration), we use 'for', not 'since'. 'Since' is used for a point of time. Thus, 'for five years' is correct.
उदा. समय की अवधि (duration) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है न कि 'since' का। 'since' का प्रयोग निश्चित समय (point of time) के लिए होता है।

questionText: The student apologized to the teacher **for arrive late** to the class.
explanation:
Prepositions (like 'for') are followed by a gerund (V1+ing). Therefore, 'for arriving late' is grammatically correct.
उदा. प्रीपोज़िशन (जैसे 'for') के बाद हमेशा जेरंड (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'for arriving late' सही होगा।

questionText: If I **was you**, I would not tolerate such insult.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation or wish, 'were' is used with all subjects (plural and singular). Hence, 'were you' is correct.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Conditional sentences) में सभी विषयों के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'were you' सही है।

questionText: No sooner did the train arrive at the station **than the passengers rushed** towards it.
explanation:
'No sooner' is correctly followed by 'than'. The sentence is grammatically correct as written.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का सही प्रयोग किया गया है। वाक्य में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

questionText: Despite of his hard work, **he could not pass** the examination.
options: In spite of his hard work,
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (In spite + of = Despite). Therefore, 'Despite his hard work' is correct.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है (In spite of = Despite)। अतः 'Despite his hard work' सही विकल्प है।

questionText: One of my friends **are going to Mumbai** next week.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Here, the subject is 'One', so the singular verb 'is going' must be used.
उदा. संरचना 'One of + plural noun' के साथ एकवचन क्रिया (singular verb) का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ मुख्य कर्ता 'One' है, इसलिए 'is going' आएगा।

questionText: He told me that he **has bought a new car** the previous day.
options: has been buying a new car
explanation:
In indirect speech, when the reporting verb is in the past tense ('told'), the simple past or present perfect in direct speech changes to the past perfect tense ('had bought').
उदा. इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में जब रिपोर्टिंग वर्ब भूतकाल (past tense) में हो, तो 'the previous day' वाले वाक्य में Past Perfect tense ('had bought') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house *when it started raining heavily*.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. Therefore, the original sentence is grammatically correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः वाक्य में कोई सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates *have paid* the registration fee yet.
explanation:
'Neither of' is always followed by a singular verb because it refers to none of the two items individually.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of', और 'Everyone of' के बाद हमेशा singular verb का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' आएगा।

questionText: If I was the king, I *would help* the poor and the needy.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences (subjunctive mood expressing a hypothetical wish), 'were' is used with all subjects, and the main clause takes 'would + V1'. The underlined part 'would help' is already correct.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी subjects के साथ 'were' आता है और मुख्य क्लॉज में 'would + V1' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'would help' सही है।

questionText: The manager asked the employee *why did he come* late to the office.
explanation:
In indirect speech or embedded questions, the structure changes from interrogative (wh-word + auxiliary + subject) to assertive (wh-word + subject + verb).
उदा. Indirect speech या embedded question में प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य साधारण वाक्य (subject + verb) बन जाता है। इसलिए 'why he came' सही होगा।

questionText: He is one of those persons who *is always ready* to help others.
explanation:
In the structure 'One of + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that) + verb', the verb agrees with the plural antecedent (persons), not 'one'. Thus, 'are' is correct.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun + relative pronoun' के बाद आने वाली verb अपने antecedent (plural noun) के अनुसार plural होती है। अतः 'is' की जगह 'are' होगा।

questionText: Despite of working hard, *he could not clear* the competitive exam.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. However, 'In spite' must be followed by 'of'. Therefore, 'Despite working hard' is the correct replacement.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है (जबकि 'In spite of' सही होता है)। अतः 'Despite working hard' सही विकल्प है।

questionText: She looks as if she *knows the answer*, but she is keeping it a secret.
explanation:
The phrase 'as if' or 'as though' indicating an unreal situation in the present takes the past subjunctive form (V2 / 'were'). Thus, 'knew' is correct.
उदा. 'As if' या 'As though' के बाद काल्पनिक स्थिति बताने के लिए Past Tense (V2) का प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसलिए 'knows' की जगह 'knew' आएगा।

questionText: The thief confessed his crime *before the police officer arrived*.
options: before the police officer had arrived
explanation:
The action of confessing happened and was completed in the past before another past action (police arriving). Past simple 'confessed' and 'arrived' in sequence is standard and correct.
उदा. भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में जो पहले हुई उसके लिए simple past या past perfect सही है। यहाँ 'before the police officer arrived' व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: AUGMENT
explanation:
Augment means to make greater, larger, or more numerous; to increase.
उदा. 'Augment' का अर्थ बढ़ाना या वृद्धि करना होता है।

questionText: DEVIATE
explanation:
Deviate means to depart from an established course or norm; to stray.
उदा. 'Deviate' का अर्थ अपने मार्ग से भटकना या अलग होना होता है ('Stray')।

questionText: AUDACIOUS
explanation:
'Audacious' means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks. 'Bold' is its synonym.
उदा. 'Audacious' का अर्थ साहसी या निडर होता है, जिसका सही पर्याय 'Bold' है।

questionText: She has been working on this project ________ three months.
explanation:
'For' is used for a period of time (duration like three months). 'Since' is used for a point of time.
उदा. अवधि (duration) जैसे 'three months' के साथ 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, जबकि निश्चित समय (point of time) के लिए 'since' आता है।

questionText: Had you informed me earlier, I ________ attended the meeting.
explanation:
Third conditional structure: If + past perfect (Had + subject + V3), subject + would have + V3.
उदा. यह Third Conditional वाक्य है। यदि शर्त वाले भाग में 'Had + V3' हो, तो परिणाम वाले क्लॉज में 'would have + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house ________ it started raining.
explanation:
Conjunction 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: He is proficient ________ English and can translate texts easily.
explanation:
Fixed preposition: 'Proficient in' means skilled or competent in a particular subject or activity.
उदा. 'Proficient' शब्द के बाद हमेशा निश्चित प्रीपोजिशन 'in' का प्रयोग होता है जिसका अर्थ किसी कार्य में निपुण होना है।

questionText: The manager decided to ________ the meeting due to unavoidable circumstances.
explanation:
Phrasal verb 'call off' means to cancel something.
उदा. 'Call off' का अर्थ किसी कार्यक्रम या मीटिंग को रद्द (cancel) करना होता है।

questionText: Rohan is junior ________ me in the corporate hierarchy.
explanation:
Latin comparative adjectives ending in '-or' (junior, senior, superior, inferior, prior) take 'to' instead of 'than'.
उदा. 'junior', 'senior', 'superior' आदि शब्दों के बाद तुलना के लिए 'than' के स्थान पर 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has taken strict measures to ________ inflation in the country.
explanation:
Vocabulary in context: 'Curb' means to restrain or keep in check (control inflation).
उदा. वाक्य के संदर्भ के अनुसार, महंगाई (inflation) को नियंत्रित करने के लिए 'curb' (नियंत्रित करना/रोकना) सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द है।

questionText: One of the major problems facing our cities ________ air pollution.
explanation:
Subject-Verb Agreement: The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb because the main subject is 'One'.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' के बाद आने वाली वर्ब हमेशा singular होती है क्योंकि मुख्य सब्जेक्ट 'One' (एकवचन) होता है।

questionText: She has been working on this complex project ________ the last three years.
explanation:
Use 'for' to denote a period of time (duration) like 'three years'. 'Since' is used for a point of time.
उदा. निश्चित समय (point of time) के लिए 'since' और समय की अवधि (period of time) के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है। यहाँ 'three years' अवधि है, इसलिए 'for' आएगा।

questionText: The committee reached a consensus ________ the new tax policy after hours of debate.
explanation:
The noun 'consensus' is typically followed by the preposition 'on' regarding a topic or policy.
उदा. 'consensus' (सहमति) शब्द के बाद आमतौर पर किसी विषय या नीति पर 'on' प्रीपोजिशन का उपयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: If the government ________ strict measures, corruption could be curbed effectively.
explanation:
In unreal conditional sentences of the type 'If + Past Subjunctive (V2), would/could/might + V1', the past tense form 'took' is correct.
उदा. काल्पनिक शर्त वाले वाक्यों में 'If + V2' के साथ 'could/would + V1' आता है, इसलिए यहाँ 'took' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: His novel was so ________ that readers could not put it down until the very last page.
explanation:
'Riveting' means completely engrossing or compelling, which fits the context that readers couldn't put the book down.
उदा. 'Riveting' का अर्थ है अत्यंत आकर्षक या मनमोहक, जिससे पाठक किताब को अंत तक छोड़ नहीं पाए। अन्य विकल्प नकारात्मक अर्थ वाले हैं।

questionText: The manager asked me ________ I intended to submit the final report.
explanation:
In indirect speech inquiring about time, the question word 'when' acts as a conjunction without changing its interrogative sense of time.
उदा. समय के संदर्भ में अप्रत्यक्ष प्रश्न (Indirect speech) पूछते समय कंजंक्शन के रूप में 'when' का प्रयोग उपयुक्त है।

questionText: The athlete was disqualified because he failed to abide ________ the anti-doping rules.
explanation:
The phrasal verb 'abide by' means to accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.
उदा. 'Abide by' एक निश्चित फ्रेजल वर्ब है जिसका अर्थ नियमों या आदेशों का पालन करना होता है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students ________ present in the class room when the inspection happened.
explanation:
According to the rule of proximity in subject-verb agreement, when subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('students', which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither...nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में क्रिया अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता (subject) के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: Despite his immense wealth, he leads a very ________ lifestyle, avoiding all luxuries.
explanation:
'Austere' means severe or strict in manner, attitude, or appearance, specifically living a simple life without comforts/luxuries. This contrasts with 'immense wealth'.
उदा. 'Austere' का अर्थ सादा और संयमी जीवन जीने वाला होता है, जो अपार धन होने के बावजूद विलासिता से दूर रहने के विरोधाभास को दर्शाता है।

questionText: The startup aims to ________ new talent from premier engineering institutes this campus season.
explanation:
'Recruit' is the standard formal verb used for hiring or enlisting new employees or personnel into an organization.
उदा. किसी संस्थान या कंपनी द्वारा नए कर्मचारियों या प्रतिभाओं को काम पर रखने के लिए 'recruit' शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Efficacious
explanation:
Synonyms share the same or nearly the same meaning. "Efficacious" means capable of producing a desired effect. The word that best matches this meaning is "Productive" which also denotes effectiveness.
उदाहरण: "Efficacious" और "Productive" दोनों का अर्थ "प्रभावी" होता है।

questionText: Luminous
explanation:
A synonym for "Luminous" is a word that means emitting light. "Radiant" conveys brightness and shining quality, matching "Luminous".
उदाहरण: "Luminous" और "Radiant" दोनों का अर्थ "चमकदार" होता है।

questionText: Candid
explanation:
The term "Candid" refers to being truthful and straightforward. "Honest" is the synonym that captures the same quality.
उदाहरण: "Candid" और "Honest" दोनों का अर्थ "ईमानदार" होता है।

questionText: Pernicious
explanation:
"Pernicious" means causing harm in a gradual or subtle way. "Destructive" reflects this harmful nature.
उदाहरण: "Pernicious" और "Destructive" दोनों का अर्थ "हानिकारक" होता है।

questionText: Incessant
explanation:
"Incessant" means never ending or ceaseless. "Continuous" is the synonym that conveys the same idea.
उदाहरण: "Incessant" और "Continuous" दोनों का अर्थ "निरंतर" होता है।

questionText: Benevolent
explanation:
A synonym of "Benevolent" is a word that indicates kindness and goodwill. "Kind" perfectly matches this definition.
उदाहरण: "Benevolent" और "Kind" दोनों का अर्थ "दयालु" होता है।

questionText: Alleviate
explanation:
"Alleviate" means to reduce or lessen. The synonym that reflects this meaning is "Ease".
उदाहरण: "Alleviate" और "Ease" दोनों का अर्थ "कम करना" होता है।

questionText: Punctilious
explanation:
"Punctilious" denotes paying great attention to detail. "Meticulous" is the synonym that matches this sense.
उदाहरण: "Punctilious" और "Meticulous" दोनों का अर्थ "कुशलता से सूक्ष्मता" होता है।

questionText: Capricious
explanation:
"Capricious" refers to sudden changes in behavior or mood. "Impulsive" captures this unpredictable nature.
उदाहरण: "Capricious" और "Impulsive" दोनों का अर्थ "अचानक बदलने वाला" होता है।

questionText: Obsolete
explanation:
"Obsolete" means no longer in use or out of date. The synonym that matches is "Outdated".
उदाहरण: "Obsolete" और "Outdated" दोनों का अर्थ "पुराना" होता है।

questionText: frugal
explanation:
Frugal means careful with money, saving resources. "Economical" expresses the same idea.
उदाहरण: Frugal का मतलब किफ़ायती होना है, इसलिए "Economical" सही है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Meticulous means extremely careful and precise. "Careful" shares this meaning.
उदाहरण: Meticulous का मतलब सूक्ष्म और परिश्रमी है, इसलिए "Careful" सही विकल्प है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Diligent means hardworking and persistent. "Industrious" conveys the same sense.
उदाहरण: Diligent का मतलब परिश्रमी है, इसलिए "Industrious" सही उत्तर है।

questionText: candid
explanation:
Candid means truthful and straightforward. "Honest" is its synonym.
उदाहरण: Candid का अर्थ सच्चा और सीधा है, इसलिए "Honest" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: magnanimous
explanation:
Magnanimous means generous and forgiving. "Generous" matches this meaning.
उदाहरण: Magnanimous का मतलब उदार और क्षमाशील है, अतः "Generous" सही है।

questionText: tenacious
explanation:
Tenacious means holding on firmly; persistent. "Persistent" is the synonym.
उदाहरण: Tenacious का अर्थ दृढ़ रहता है, इसलिए "Persistent" सही विकल्प है।

questionText: trivial
explanation:
Trivial means of little importance; insignificant. "Insignificant" is its synonym.
उदाहरण: Trivial का मतलब तुच्छ है, अतः "Insignificant" उपयुक्त है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Abundant means present in large quantities; plentiful. "Plentiful" matches the meaning.
उदाहरण: Abundant का अर्थ प्रचुर मात्रा में है, इसलिए "Plentiful" सही है।

questionText: fortify
explanation:
Fortify means to strengthen or strengthen. "Strengthen" is the synonym.
उदाहरण: Fortify का अर्थ सुदृढ़ करना है, अतः "Strengthen" सही विकल्प है।

questionText: Choose the synonym of: GREGARIOUS
explanation:
Gregarious refers to a person who enjoys company; sociable. Reclusive and solitary are antonyms.
उदा. Gregarious का अर्थ 'मिलनसार' (sociable) होता है।

questionText: PRUDENT
explanation:
Prudent means acting with or showing care for the future; wise or judicious.
उदा. Prudent का अर्थ 'समझदार या विवेकपूर्ण' (wise) होता है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of: LUGUBRIOUS
explanation:
Lugubrious means looking or sounding sad and dismal; melancholy.
उदा. Lugubrious का अर्थ 'उदास या शोकपूर्ण' (melancholy) होता है।

questionText: AUDACIOUS
explanation:
Audacious means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks; daring or bold.
उदा. Audacious का अर्थ 'साहसी या निडर' (bold) होता है।

questionText: Find the synonym of: MITIGATE
explanation:
Mitigate means to make less severe, serious, or painful; alleviate.
उदा. Mitigate का अर्थ 'कम करना या घटाना' (alleviate) होता है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: LETHARGIC
explanation:
'Lethargic' means affected by lethargy; sluggish and lazy. 
उदा. 'Lethargic' का अर्थ सुस्त या आलसी होता है, जिसका सही पर्यायवाची 'Sluggish' है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: HOSTILE
explanation:
'Hostile' means unfriendly or aggressive. 
उदा. 'Hostile' का अर्थ शत्रुतापूर्ण या आक्रामक होता है, जिसका समानार्थी 'Aggressive' है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: ALACRITY
explanation:
'Alacrity' means brisk and cheerful readiness; 'Eagerness' is its synonym. 
उदा. 'Alacrity' का अर्थ तत्परता या उत्साह होता है, जिसका सही पर्यायवाची 'Eagerness' है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: BENEVOLENT
explanation:
'Benevolent' means well meaning and kindly; 'Kind' is the direct synonym. 
उदा. 'Benevolent' का अर्थ परोपकारी या दयालु होता है, जिसका समानार्थी शब्द 'Kind' है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the given word: DILIGENT
explanation:
'Diligent' means having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work; 'Hardworking' is the synonym. 
उदा. 'Diligent' का अर्थ मेहनती या परिश्रमी होता है, जिसका समानार्थी 'Hardworking' है।

questionText: The project was delayed because the team members were not able to complete their tasks on time. [The team members] were not able to complete their tasks on time.
explanation:
Use a more precise and less redundant phrase.
उदाहरण: "The members of the team" better specifies who is being referred to, avoiding repetition of "team".

questionText: She was very excited about the trip, and [she was] very excited about the trip.
explanation:
Avoid repeating the same clause; use a subject pronoun without the verb.
उदाहरण: "She" is sufficient to indicate the subject, eliminating redundancy.

questionText: The manager praised the employees for their hard work, and [he praised them] for their hard work.
explanation:
To avoid repetitive verb phrases, use a pronoun without repeating the verb.
उदाहरण: "He praised them" is concise and avoids repetition.

questionText: The proposal was approved by the committee, and [it was] approved by the committee.
explanation:
Use a simple pronoun to refer back to the subject instead of repeating the clause.
उदाहरण: "It was" succinctly refers to the proposal.

questionText: The students were excited about the upcoming exam, and [they were] excited about the upcoming exam.
explanation:
To avoid redundancy, replace the repeated clause with a pronoun.
उदाहरण: "They were" keeps the meaning without repetition.

questionText: The new policy was introduced to improve efficiency, and [it was] introduced to improve efficiency.
explanation:
Use a pronoun to avoid repeating the entire clause.
उदाहरण: "It was" succinctly refers to the new policy.

questionText: The company increased its revenue, and [the company] increased its revenue.
explanation:
Replace the repeated noun phrase with a pronoun to avoid repetition.
उदाहरण: "It" refers to the company and makes the sentence concise.

questionText: The committee reviewed the application, and [the committee] reviewed the application.
explanation:
Use a pronoun instead of repeating the same noun phrase.
उदाहरण: "They" refers to the committee and avoids redundancy.

questionText: The report was submitted on time, and [it was] submitted on time.
explanation:
Use a pronoun to refer back to the subject, eliminating repetition.
उदाहरण: "It was" refers to the report without repeating the entire clause.

questionText: The new manager implemented a new system, and [he implemented] a new system.
explanation:
Replace the repeated clause with a pronoun and verb.
उदाहरण: "He implemented" keeps the meaning and avoids duplication.

questionText: The students completed the assignment early, and [they completed] the assignment early.
explanation:
Use a pronoun and verb to avoid repeating the entire clause.
उदाहरण: "They completed" is concise and retains the meaning.

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Abundant" means in great quantity or plentiful.
उदा. वह खेत बहुत ही अधिक फसल देता है।

questionText: candid
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Candid" means truthful and straightforward.
उदा. वह अपनी बात खुलकर कहता है।

questionText: lament
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Lament" means to express sorrow or grief.
उदा. वह अपनी माँ की याद में रोता है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail.
उदा. वह हर काम को बहुत ही सूक्ष्मता से करता है।

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Elaborate" means detailed and complex.
उदा. उसकी कहानी बहुत ही विस्तृत है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Diligent" means hardworking and industrious.
उदा. वह मेहनती छात्र है।

questionText: exquisite
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Exquisite" means extremely beautiful or delicate.
उदा. वह चित्र बहुत ही खूबसूरत है।

questionText: perplex
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Perplex" means to confuse or baffle.
उदा. वह सवाल उसे उलझा देता है।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Benevolent" means kind and charitable.
उदा. वह दयालु और सहायक है।

questionText: subtle
explanation:
Synonym selection. "Subtle" means not obvious or not easily noticed.
उदा. उसकी नजर बहुत ही सूक्ष्म थी।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
The word "abundant" means existing or available in large quantities. The closest synonym from the options is "plentiful".
उदाहरण: "The garden was abundant with flowers" – "गमल में फूल बहुतायत से थे".

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
To elaborate means to explain in detail. The word "explicate" carries the same meaning of giving a detailed explanation.
उदाहरण: "She explicated the policy in depth" – "उसने नीति का विस्तार से वर्णन किया".

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Diligent means showing care and effort. "Assiduous" also means showing persistent and earnest effort.
उदाहरण: "His assiduous work earned him a promotion" – "उसका मेहनती काम उसे पदोन्नति दिलाया".

questionText: resilient
explanation:
Resilient means able to recover quickly from difficulties. "Hardy" implies similar toughness and resilience.
उदाहरण: "A hardy plant can survive harsh climates" – "एक मजबूत पौधा कठोर जलवायु में जीवित रह सकता है".

questionText: to criticize
explanation:
To criticize is to express disapproval. "Condemn" means to express strong disapproval or censure.
उदाहरण: "He condemned the policy as unfair" – "उसने नीति को अनुचित घोषित किया".

questionText: frugal
explanation:
"Frugal" means careful with money and resources. "Economical" is a synonym indicating prudent use of resources.
उदाहरण: "An economical lifestyle saves money" – "एक किफायती जीवनशैली पैसे बचाती है".

questionText: tolerant
explanation:
"Tolerant" means accepting and not judging. "Open-minded" shares this sense of being receptive to different ideas.
उदाहरण: "An open‑minded person accepts diverse viewpoints" – "एक खुला मन रखने वाला व्यक्ति विभिन्न दृष्टिकोणों को स्वीकार करता है".

questionText: consequent
explanation:
"Consequent" means following as a result. "Subsequent" has the same meaning of occurring after.
उदाहरण: "The subsequent effect was dramatic" – "इसके बाद का प्रभाव नाटकीय था".

questionText: to simplify
explanation:
"To simplify" is to make something easier to understand. "Clarify" means to make clear and easy to comprehend.
उदाहरण: "She clarified the instructions for the students" – "उसने छात्रों के लिए निर्देश स्पष्ट किए".

questionText: vivid
explanation:
"Vivid" describes something bright and intense. "Radiant" shares this quality of emitting bright light or color.
उदाहरण: "The radiant colors of the sunset were breathtaking" – "सूर्यास्त के तेज रंग मनमोहक थे".

questionText: abundant
explanation:
The word "abundant" means having plenty of something. Its synonym is "plentiful".
उदाहरण: "The harvest was abundant, so we had plenty of food for the festival." (उत्थित) "Plentiful" का मतलब भी वही है।

questionText: cumbersome
explanation:
Cumbersome means difficult to carry or manage. "Burdensome" has the same meaning.
उदाहरण: "The cargo was cumbersome, so we had to use a forklift." (भारी) "Burdensome" का मतलब भी वही है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Meticulous means extremely careful and precise. "Precise" is a synonym.
