questionText: Hardly had I arrived / at the station than / the train departed. / No error
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when' in part (B).
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। 'than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ किया जाता है। अतः (B) में 'than' के स्थान पर 'when' होगा।

questionText: One of the most important / task in the project / has been completed successfully. / No error
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Here, 'task' should be plural 'tasks'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा Plural Noun (बहुवचन संज्ञा) का प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसलिए 'task' की जगह 'tasks' होना चाहिए।

questionText: Neither the teacher / nor the students was / present in the class. / No error
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, the nearest subject is 'students' (plural), so the verb should be 'were' instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'neither...nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पास वाले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ पास वाला सब्जेक्ट 'students' (plural) है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

questionText: She is more taller / than her sister / in every aspect. / No error
explanation:
Double comparatives are incorrect. 'Tall' is a single-syllable adjective, so its comparative form is 'taller'. Using 'more' before 'taller' is superfluous.
उदा. एक साथ दो Comparative Degrees ('more' और 'taller') का प्रयोग एक साथ नहीं किया जा सकता। 'taller' अपने आप में सही है, इसलिए 'more' हटाना होगा।

questionText: Each of the boys / have submitted / their assignments on time. / No error
explanation:
'Each of' takes a singular verb and singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद Plural Noun आता है लेकिन Verb और Pronoun हमेशा Singular (एकवचन) होते हैं। अतः 'have' की जगह 'has' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: He told to me / that he would help me / with my home work. / No error
explanation:
The verb 'tell' does not take a preposition 'to' when followed by an object. It should be 'He told me', not 'He told to me'.
उदा. 'Tell' वर्ब के बाद सीधे ऑब्जेक्ट आता है, इसके साथ 'to' प्रीपोजिशन का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। अतः 'told to me' गलत है, 'told me' सही है।

questionText: No sooner did the sun rise / when the fog disappeared / completely from the valley. / No error
options: No sooner did the sun rise
explanation:
'No sooner' must be followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than' in part (B).
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। अतः (B) में 'when' के स्थान पर 'than' होगा।

questionText: Despite of working hard / he failed to secure / the first rank in the exam. / No error
options: the first rank in the exam
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (In spite of = Despite). Therefore, 'Despite of' is incorrect and should be changed to 'Despite' or 'In spite of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है ('In spite of' होता है)। अतः 'Despite of' के स्थान पर केवल 'Despite' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: It is high time / you start preparing / for your upcoming examinations. / No error
explanation:
Expressions like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'start' with 'started'.
उदा. 'It is high time' या 'It is time' के बाद आने वाला उपवाक्य (clause) हमेशा Past Indefinite Tense (V2) में होता है। अतः 'start' की जगह 'started' होगा।
grammarRule: It is high time + Past Tense

questionText: The committee is / divided in their opinions / regarding the new policy. / No error
explanation:
When a collective noun like 'committee' is divided in opinion or acts as individuals, it takes a plural verb and plural pronoun ('their'). Therefore, 'is' should be changed to 'are'.
उदा. जब Collective Noun (जैसे committee) में मतभेद हो जाए या अलग-अलग सदस्यों की बात हो, तो उसके साथ Plural Verb का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'is' की जगह 'are' होगा।

questionText: The manager insisted ___ checking all the financial documents before signing the deal.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is always followed by the fixed preposition 'on'.
उदा. 'Insist' verb के साथ हमेशा fixed preposition 'on' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Had the police arrived on time, the jeweler ___ saved from the robbery.
explanation:
This is a third conditional sentence in passive voice: 'If + had + V3, would + have + been + V3'.
उदा. यह Third Conditional का passive structure है जिसमें 'would have been + V3' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The minister appealed to the public to maintain peace and not to ___ to rumors.
explanation:
'Give in' means to surrender or yield to something. Here, it means not surrendering to rumors.
उदा. 'Give in' का अर्थ हार मानना या झुकना होता है। यहाँ अफवाहों के आगे न झुकने की बात की गई है।

questionText: Hardly had I stepped out of the house ___ it started pouring heavily.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before').
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा conjunction 'when' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: The government has taken several steps to ___ the economic growth of the country.
explanation:
'Bolster' means to support or strengthen. The context requires a positive word for economic growth.
उदा. 'Bolster' का अर्थ मजबूत करना या समर्थन देना है। आर्थिक वृद्धि के संदर्भ में यह सही शब्द है।

questionText: She speaks English with such fluency that every one mistakes her ___ a native speaker.
explanation:
The phrase is 'to mistake someone for someone/something', meaning to wrongly identify.
उदा. 'Mistake someone for' एक fixed phrase है जिसका अर्थ किसी को दूसरा समझ लेना होता है।

questionText: Rajesh is accustomed ___ working for long hours without taking a break.
explanation:
The adjective phrase 'accustomed' is followed by 'to' and then a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'Accustomed' के बाद preposition 'to' और उसके बाद gerund का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: She has been studying ___ 9 AM for the exam.
explanation:
Use 'since' to indicate the starting point of an action that continues up to now.
उदा. वह 9 बजे से पढ़ रही है।

questionText: He was unaware ___ what the consequences would be.
explanation:
'Unaware of' means lacking knowledge or awareness about something.
उदा. उसे उसके परिणामों के बारे में पता नहीं था।

questionText: Please hand over the report ___ you finish the current task.
explanation:
'After' is used to indicate that one action follows another.
उदा. जब आप वर्तमान कार्य पूरा कर लें, तो रिपोर्ट सौंप दें।

questionText: The committee will review the proposal ___ a week.
explanation:
'In' is used to denote a period of time.
उदा. समिति एक सप्ताह में प्रस्ताव की समीक्षा करेगी।

questionText: She offered to help ___ he needed assistance.
explanation:
'If' introduces a conditional clause.
उदा. उसने पेशकश की कि अगर उसे मदद की ज़रूरत हो तो वह मदद करेगा।

questionText: The new policy will be effective ___ January 1.
explanation:
'On' is used with specific dates.
उदा. नई नीति 1 जनवरी को प्रभावी होगी।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'on'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: I cannot attend the meeting ___ I have a prior commitment.
explanation:
'Unless' indicates an exception to a statement.
उदा. मैं बैठक में नहीं आ सकता जब तक कि मेरी कोई अन्य प्रतिबद्धता न हो।

questionText: The company is planning to expand ___ the Asian market.
explanation:
'In' is used to indicate the location or area of expansion.
उदा. कंपनी एशियाई बाजार में विस्तार की योजना बना रही है।

questionText: He was accused ___ stealing the money.
explanation:
'Accused of' is the correct collocation.
उदा. उसे पैसे चुराने के लिए आरोपित किया गया।

questionText: She will be available ___ Friday evening.
explanation:
'On' is used with days of the week.
उदा. वह शुक्रवार शाम को उपलब्ध होगी।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'on'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time; transient. Thus, 'Transient' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Ephemeral का अर्थ क्षणिक होता है, जो Transient से मेल खाता है।

questionText: Choose the synonym of the given word: GREGARIOUS
explanation:
Gregarious means fond of company; sociable. Therefore, 'Sociable' is the correct option.
उदा. Gregarious का अर्थ मिलनसार होता है, यानी Sociable।

questionText: Find the synonym of the given word: LUGUBRIOUS
explanation:
Lugubrious means looking or sounding sad and dismal (mournful). Hence, 'Mournful' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Lugubrious का अर्थ उदास या शोकाकुल (Mournful) होता है।

questionText: MITIGATE
explanation:
Mitigate means to make less severe, serious, or painful; alleviate. Thus, 'Alleviate' is correct.
उदा. Mitigate का अर्थ कम करना या राहत देना (Alleviate) होता है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the word: NADIR
explanation:
Nadir means the lowest point in the fortunes of a person or organization. Hence, 'Lowest point' is correct.
उदा. Nadir का अर्थ पतन या सबसे निचला बिंदु होता है।

questionText: PRAGMATIC
explanation:
Pragmatic means dealing with things sensibly and realistically. Therefore, 'Realistic' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Pragmatic का अर्थ व्यावहारिक या यथार्थवादी (Realistic) होता है।

questionText: Find the synonym of the given word: RETICENT
explanation:
Reticent means not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily; reserved. Thus, 'Reserved' is correct.
उदा. Reticent का अर्थ कम बोलने वाला या अंतर्मुखी (Reserved) होता है।

questionText: Choose the synonym of the given word: ZEALOUS
explanation:
Zealous means having or showing zeal; fervent or passionate. Hence, 'Fervent' is the correct synonym.
उदा. Zealous का अर्थ उत्साही या जोशीला (Fervent) होता है।

questionText: The scientists are working ___ the new experiment.
explanation:
The preposition **on** is used with *work* to indicate the subject of the work. 
उदाहरण: *She is working on her thesis.*

questionText: She has been waiting ___ you for two hours.
explanation:
Use **for** with *waiting* to express the duration of an action. 
उदाहरण: *They have been waiting for the bus.*

questionText: The project was completed ___ the dead line
explanation:
The preposition **by** indicates completion *before* the specified time. 
उदाहरण: *Finish the task by Friday.*

questionText: He was appointed ___ the position of chief editor.
explanation:
Use **as** after *appointed* to denote the role taken. 
उदाहरण: *She was appointed as the new manager.*

questionText: The company will launch the new product ___ next month.
explanation:
The preposition **in** is used for months, years, and seasons. 
उदाहरण: *The festival is in December.*

questionText: It is necessary ___ you to read the instructions.
explanation:
After *necessary*, the clause *that you read* is used. 
उदाहरण: *It is necessary that he attend the meeting.*

questionText: I am looking forward ___ meeting you again.
explanation:
The phrase *looking forward to* is followed by a noun or gerund. 
उदाहरण: *I am looking forward to hearing from you.*

questionText: The painting was heavily ___ when the museum was renovated.
explanation:
The verb *damage* in past tense becomes **damaged** as an adjective. 
उदाहरण: *The house was heavily damaged.*

questionText: The committee will discuss the proposal ___ the board meeting.
explanation:
The preposition **during** indicates the time in which an event occurs. 
उदाहरण: *She slept during the lecture.*

questionText: Please submit the report ___ the end of the month.
explanation:
Use **by** to indicate a deadline before a specific time. 
उदाहरण: *Submit the form by tomorrow.*

questionText: She has been working ______ the company for 5 years.
explanation:
Use preposition 'in' to indicate a place or organization where one works. E.g., "I work in a bank."
उदाहरण: वह पाँच वर्षों से कंपनी में काम कर रही है।

questionText: The committee will convene ______ Saturday morning.
explanation:
Use 'on' with days of the week to specify a date. E.g., "We will meet on Monday."
उदाहरण: समिति शनिवार सुबह में मिलेगी।

questionText: He was awarded the medal for his ______ service.
explanation:
Use noun form 'bravery' to denote the quality of being brave. E.g., "Her bravery earned her recognition."
उदाहरण: उसकी बहादुरी के लिए उसे पदक मिला।

questionText: The students were asked to submit their assignments ______ Friday.
explanation:
Use 'by' to indicate a deadline. E.g., "Finish the work by Tuesday."
उदाहरण: छात्रों से शुक्रवार से पहले असाइनमेंट जमा करने के लिए कहा गया।

questionText: She has a habit of _____ a cup of tea every night.
explanation:
After a verb like 'habit', use gerund form. E.g., "He has a habit of reading."
उदाहरण: वह हर रात चाय पीने की आदत रखती है।

questionText: The company is known for its _____ and innovative products.
explanation:
Use adjective 'quality' to describe products. E.g., "high quality."
उदाहरण: कंपनी अपने गुणवत्ता वाले उत्पादों के लिए जानी जाती है।

questionText: He was dismissed from the team ______ his unsportsmanlike behavior.
explanation:
Use 'for' to indicate the reason for an action. E.g., "He was fired for misconduct."
उदाहरण: उसके असportsmanlike व्यवहार के कारण वह टीम से बाहर कर दिया गया।

questionText: She is looking forward to meeting her friends ______ the week end
explanation:
Use 'on' with days or periods like weekend. E.g., "We will meet on Sunday."
उदाहरण: वह सप्ताहांत में दोस्तों से मिलने की उम्मीद कर रही है।

questionText: The project will be completed ______ December.
explanation:
Use 'by' to indicate a deadline month. E.g., "Finish by December."
उदाहरण: परियोजना दिसंबर तक पूरी हो जाएगी।

questionText: He was praised for his ______ leader ship during the crisis.
explanation:
Use noun 'excellence' to denote the quality of leadership. E.g., "His excellence earned him praise."
उदाहरण: संकट के समय उसकी उत्कृष्ट नेतृत्व के लिए उसे प्रशंसा मिली।

questionText: The new policy will be effective ______ January 1st.
explanation:
Use 'on' with a specific date. E.g., "Effective on March 5th."
उदाहरण: नई नीति 1 जनवरी से प्रभावी होगी।

questionText: Which word below contains a spelling error?
explanation: The correct spelling is *accommodate* (double m and double c).\nउदा. सही वर्तनी: accommodate।

questionText: Which word below contains a spelling mistake?
explanation: The correct spelling is *completely* (two p’s and two l’s).\nउदा. सही वर्तनी: completely।

questionText: Choose the word that has a spelling error.
explanation: The correct spelling is *separating* (separate + ing).\nउदा. सही वर्तनी: separating।

questionText: Find the correctly spelt word from the options given below.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Renaissance', meaning a revival of art and literature.
उदा. सही spelling 'Renaissance' है, जिसका अर्थ पुनर्जागरण होता है।

questionText: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word from the choices.
explanation:
The incorrect word is 'Recieve'. The correct spelling is 'Receive' (following 'i before e except after c').
उदा. गलत शब्द 'Recieve' है। सही spelling 'Receive' है ('c' के बाद 'ei' आता है)।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
The word "abundant" means existing in large amounts. Its synonym is "plentiful".
उदाहरण: "The garden had an abundant supply of fruits" translates to "बगीचे में फलों का प्रचुर भंडार था".

questionText: diligent
explanation:
The word "diligent" refers to someone who works hard and is careful. A synonym is "hardworking".
उदाहरण: "She is a diligent student" translates to "वह एक परिश्रमी छात्रा है".

questionText: melancholy
explanation:
The word "melancholy" means feeling sad or depressed. Its synonym is "sad".
उदाहरण: "He felt melancholy after the loss" translates to "उसने हानि के बाद उदासी महसूस की".

questionText: candid
explanation:
The word "candid" means being open and honest. A synonym is "frank".
उदाहरण: "She gave a candid response" translates to "उसने एक सच्ची प्रतिक्रिया दी".

questionText: tenacious
explanation:
The word "tenacious" means holding fast or persistent. Its synonym is "persistent".
उदाहरण: "A tenacious spirit" translates to "एक दृढ़ संकल्पित आत्मा".

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
The word "meticulous" refers to paying great attention to detail. A synonym is "precise".
उदाहरण: "Meticulous planning" translates to "सूक्ष्म योजना".

questionText: obscure
explanation:
The word "obscure" means not clear or vague. Its synonym is "vague".
उदाहरण: "An obscure explanation" translates to "एक अस्पष्ट व्याख्या".

questionText: beneficial
explanation:
The word "beneficial" means providing good or helpful effects. A synonym is "advantageous".
उदाहरण: "Beneficial habits" translates to "लाभकारी आदतें".

questionText: sophisticated
explanation:
The word "sophisticated" indicates something complex and refined. A synonym is "complex".
उदाहरण: "A sophisticated system" translates to "एक जटिल प्रणाली".

questionText: gullible
explanation:
The word "gullible" refers to someone who is easily deceived. A synonym is "naïve".
उदाहरण: "A gullible person" translates to "एक मूर्ख व्यक्ति".

questionText: The hotel was very accommodated by the guests.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "accommodated".
Rule: Use double 'c' and double 'm' after the first consonant.
उदाहरण: "accommodate" का सही वर्तनी "accommodate" है।
grammarRule: Rule of double consonants after vowel

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word in the following sentence: "She definately needs to finish the report by Friday.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "definitely".
Rule: The suffix '-ly' follows 'definite', not 'definate'.
उदाहरण: "definitely" को सही लिखें, न कि "definately"।

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the following sentence: "The committee will seperate the documents into two categories.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "separate".
Rule: The verb form is 'separate' with an 'a' before the 'r'.
उदाहरण: "separate" सही वर्तनी है, "seperate" गलत है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word used in the sentence: "I will occure a meeting tomorrow.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "occur".
Rule: The verb is spelled with double 'c' and double 'r' at the end.
उदाहरण: "occur" सही है, "occure" गलत है।

questionText: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence: "Please recieve the package at your office.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "receive".
Rule: The suffix '-ive' follows the root 'receiv', not 'receiv'.
उदाहरण: "receive" सही है, "recieve" गलत है।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence: "Which of the following is not a valid option?
explanation:
The correct spelling is "which".
Rule: The word is spelled with 'h' between 'i' and 'c'.
उदाहरण: "which" सही वर्तनी है, "wich" गलत है।

questionText: He spent a lot of writting time on the project.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "writing".
Rule: The verb form is spelled with one 't' after 'i'.
उदाहरण: "writing" सही है, "writting" गलत है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "She cannot beleave the news.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "believe".
Rule: The root verb ends with '-ieve'.
उदाहरण: "believe" सही है, "beleave" गलत है।

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly in the sentence: "It is neccessary to finish the assignment.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "necessary".
Rule: The word contains a single 'c' after 'ne'.
उदाहरण: "necessary" सही वर्तनी है, "neccessary" गलत है।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "We will untill the end of the month.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "until".
Rule: The word is spelled with a single 't'.
उदाहरण: "until" सही है, "untill" गलत है।

questionText: They had to loose the road to avoid the flood.
explanation:
The correct spelling is "lose".
Rule: The verb meaning to misplace is spelled with 'o' after 'l' and no second 'o'.
उदाहरण: "lose" सही है, "loose" अलग अर्थ के लिए है।

questionText: A government by the wealthy class
explanation:
Plutocracy is a society ruled or controlled by people of great wealth.
उदा. धनिक वर्ग द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली सरकार को 'Plutocracy' (धनतंत्र) कहा जाता है।

questionText: A person who is in different to pain and pleasure
explanation:
A stoic can endure pain or hardship without complaining or showing emotions.
उदा. जो व्यक्ति सुख और दुख, दर्द और ख़ुशी में तटस्थ (उदासीन) रहता है, उसे 'Stoic' (संयम) कहते हैं।

questionText: To give up one's throne or authority
explanation:
To abdicate means to formally relinquish or renounce a throne, high office, or responsibility.
उदा. अपनी गद्दी या अधिकार का त्याग करना 'Abdicate' (पदत्याग करना) कहलाता है।
grammarRule: Prefix 'Ab-' means away from + root 'dicare' means to proclaim.

questionText: An office with high salary but no work
explanation:
A position requiring little or no work but giving status or financial benefit is a sinecure.
उदा. ऐसा पद जिसमें काम कम या बिलकुल न हो लेकिन वेतन और मान-सम्मान बहुत हो, उसे 'Sinecure' (अक्र्म-पद) कहते हैं।

questionText: A speech made without any prior preparation
explanation:
Extempore refers to spoken or done without preparation.
उदा. बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के दिया गया भाषण 'Extempore' (तत्कालिक भाषण) कहलाता है।
grammarRule: Latin phrase 'ex tempore' meaning 'out of the time'.

questionText: Animals that eat both plants and flesh
explanation:
Omnivores are creatures that consume both plant and animal matter.
उदा. जो जीव पौधे और मांस दोनों खाते हैं, उन्हें 'Omnivore' (सर्वाहारी) कहते हैं।
grammarRule: Root: 'Omni' means all + 'vore' means to devour.

questionText: Which is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
"Pharaoh" is spelled with the sequence 'ph' + 'ar'. The variant "pharoah" swaps the 'a' and 'o'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – pharaoh

questionText: Spot the misspelled word
explanation:
"Liaison" contains an 'i' after the first 'l'. The variant "liason" omits this 'i' and is wrong.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी – liaison

questionText: TRANSITORIALLY
explanation:
'Transitorily' means lasting for a short time. Its exact antonym is 'Permanently', meaning lasting or remaining without change indefinitely.
उदा. 'Transitorily' का अर्थ क्षणिक रूप से होता है। इसका विपरीत शब्द 'Permanently' (स्थाई रूप से) है।

questionText: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: HARMONY
explanation:
'Harmony' means agreement or peaceful coexistence. Its antonym is 'Strife', which means angry or bitter disagreement over fundamental issues; conflict.
उदा. 'Harmony' का अर्थ सामंजस्य या तालमेल होता है। इसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'Strife' (संघर्ष या कलह) है।

questionText: Choose the word opposite in meaning to: BENEVOLENT
explanation:
'Benevolent' means well meaning and kindly. Its antonym is 'Malevolent', meaning having or showing a wish to do evil to others.
उदा. 'Benevolent' का अर्थ दयालु होता है। इसका विपरीतार्थक शब्द 'Malevolent' (द्वेषी या बुरा चाहने वाला) है।

questionText: EPHEMERAL
explanation:
'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time. Its antonym is 'Permanent', lasting or remaining without change indefinitely.
उदा. 'Ephemeral' का अर्थ अल्पकालिक होता है। इसका विलोम 'Permanent' (स्थाई) है।

questionText: AUDACIOUS
explanation:
'Audacious' means showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks. Its antonym is 'Timid', showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened.
उदा. 'Audacious' का अर्थ साहसी या दुःसाहसी होता है। इसका विलोम 'Timid' (डरपोक या संकोची) है।

questionText: He was so ________ that he couldn't keep his eyes open.
explanation:
Rule in English: A single word can replace a descriptive phrase. Here "so tired that he couldn't keep his eyes open" is best replaced by the word "exhausted".
उदा. हिंदी: "थकान से भरा" को "exhausted" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The committee was very ________ about the new proposal.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single adjective to replace a phrase conveying lack of interest. "Very indifferent" can be replaced by "unconcerned".
उदा. "बहुत उदासीन" को "unconcerned" से बदला जा सकता है।
grammarRule: One-word substitution for expressions of indifference

questionText: The teacher gave the students a ________ assignment, which they found difficult.
explanation:
Rule in English: A single word can replace a descriptive phrase. Here "a difficult assignment" is best expressed by the adjective "challenging".
उदा. "कठिन" को "challenging" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: She was ________ about the outcome of the election.
explanation:
Rule in English: A single adjective can replace a phrase of uncertainty. "Unsure about" is best expressed by "unsure".
उदा. "अनिश्चित" को "unsure" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The new software is very ________ to use, even for beginners.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a two-word phrase with a single adjective. "User-friendly" replaces "easy to use".
उदा. "उपयोगकर्ता के अनुकूल" को "user-friendly" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The city was known for its ________ architecture.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single adjective to replace a descriptive phrase. "Impressive architecture" is best expressed by the word "impressive".
उदा. "प्रभावशाली वास्तुकला" को "impressive" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The politician's speech was filled with ________ promises.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a phrase with a single adjective. "Vague promises" is best expressed by the word "vague".
उदा. "अस्पष्ट वादों" को "vague" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The museum offers a ________ view of the city sky line
explanation:
Rule in English: Use one word to substitute a phrase describing the view. "Breathtaking view" is replaced by the adjective "breathtaking".
उदा. "श्वास रोक देने वाला दृश्य" को "breathtaking" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The new policy was a ________ change for the company.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long phrase with a single adjective. "Significant change" is best expressed by the word "significant".
उदा. "महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन" को "significant" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The new law was met with ________ criticism from environmentalists.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use a single adjective to replace a phrase like "intense criticism". The correct word is "intense".
उदा. "तीव्र आलोचना" को "intense" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: She has a _______ personality, making him feel comfortable in her presence.
explanation:
Rule in English: Choose a single word that captures the long descriptive phrase. Here ‘affable’ replaces ‘friendly and easy to talk to’.
उदा. ‘affable’ का अर्थ है ‘मित्रवत और बात करने में आसान’।

questionText: The committee was _______ with the new policy, showing no he sit at i on in approving it.
explanation:
The phrase ‘full of confidence and support’ is best expressed by the word ‘convinced’. The other options convey opposition or neutrality.
उदा. ‘convinced’ का अर्थ है ‘पूर्ण विश्वास के साथ’।

questionText: The new software is _______ and user-friendly, requiring only a few clicks to complete the task.
explanation:
The definition ‘easy to understand or use’ is best captured by ‘intuitive’. The other options indicate difficulty.
उदा. ‘intuitive’ का अर्थ है ‘सहज और उपयोग में आसान’।

questionText: He was a _______ critic, never hesitating to point out flaws in any design.
explanation:
The description ‘severe and harsh in judgment’ is best expressed by ‘censorious’. The options ‘praising’ and ‘appreciative’ convey positivity.
उदा. ‘censorious’ का अर्थ है ‘कठोर आलोचना करने वाला’।

questionText: The city’s traffic situation is _______ after the major road closures for the festival.
explanation:
The phrase ‘confusing and disorderly’ is best expressed by ‘chaotic’. Other options denote orderliness.
उदा. ‘chaotic’ का अर्थ है ‘अराजक और अव्यवस्थित’।

questionText: The report was _______ with data, leaving no doubt about the results.
explanation:
To say ‘full of information’ we use ‘replete’. The other options imply a lack of data.
उदा. ‘replete’ का अर्थ है ‘पूरा और भरपूर’।

questionText: The artist’s work is _______ with emotion, resonating deeply with viewers.
explanation:
The phrase ‘filled with strong feeling’ is expressed by ‘laden’. The other options suggest emptiness.
उदा. ‘laden’ का अर्थ है ‘भावनाओं से भरा हुआ’।

questionText: The new policy aims to _______ the gap between urban and rural education.
explanation:
To ‘narrow or close the difference’ is ‘bridge’. The options ‘exacerbate’ and ‘widen’ increase the gap, while ‘expand’ implies general growth.
उदा. ‘bridge’ का अर्थ है ‘मध्यस्थता करना’।

questionText: The lecture was _______ with jargon, making it difficult for non-experts to follow.
explanation:
The phrase ‘filled with complex technical terms’ is best captured by ‘dense’. The other options signify simplicity.
उदा. ‘dense’ का अर्थ है ‘घना और जटिल’।

questionText: The manager was _______ with the staff, offering generous bonuses for their hard work.
explanation:
The phrase ‘generous and forgiving’ is best expressed by ‘indulgent’. The other options connote restraint.
उदा. ‘indulgent’ का अर्थ है ‘उदार और करुणामय’।

questionText: Hardly had I / stepped out of the house / when a heavy downpour / ruined my clothes.
explanation:
No error in this part. The correlative conjunction 'Hardly' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' and 'when'. 
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है और वाक्य की शुरुआत में आने पर inversion नियम (had + subject) लागू होता है। यहाँ कोई गलती नहीं है, इसलिए वाक्य 'No Error' श्रेणी में है या फिर ऑप्शन (D) सही है यदि कोई अन्य त्रुटि हो। (Assuming error-free standard format).

questionText: She told to me / a very interesting / story about her / childhood days.
explanation:
Replace 'told to me' with 'told me'. The verb 'tell' does not take a preposition 'to' before its indirect object, unlike 'say to me'.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधा object आता है, बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है ('told me' सही है, 'told to me' गलत)।

questionText: One of the most / popular leaders who / is alive today / is Mahatma Gandhi.
explanation:
Replace 'is' with 'are'. The verb in a relative clause ('who') agrees with its antecedent ('leaders', which is plural). Therefore, 'are' should be used.
उदा. Relative pronoun ('who') से पहले आए Antecedent ('leaders') के अनुसार verb plural ('are') होगी, न कि singular ('is')।

questionText: Each of the students / in the science class / have submitted their / assignment on time.
explanation:
Replace 'have submitted their' with 'has submitted his/her'. 'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb ('has') and singular possessive pronoun ('his/her').
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb और pronoun हमेशा singular होते हैं। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' और 'their' की जगह 'his/her' होगा।

questionText: Despite of working hard / he failed to secure / the first rank in / the final examination.
explanation:
Replace 'Despite of' with 'Despite' or 'In spite of'. 'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is always followed by 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। सही रूप या तो 'Despite working hard' होगा या 'In spite of working hard' होगा।

questionText: The number of accidents / on the national highway / have increased significantly / over the past year.
explanation:
Replace 'have' with 'has'. 'The number of' takes a singular verb, whereas 'A number of' takes a plural verb.
उदा. 'The number of' के साथ singular verb ('has') का प्रयोग होता है, जबकि 'A number of' के साथ plural verb आती है।

questionText: Scarcely had I reached / the ticket counter when / the clerk closed / the booking window.
explanation:
No error in this segment. The structure 'Scarcely had + subject + V3 ... when ...' is completely correct.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ 'when' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है और past perfect tense का नियम भी सटीक है। वाक्य त्रुटi-रहित है।

questionText: reliable
explanation:
Reliable means dependable and trustworthy. The opposite is "unreliable", meaning lacking trustworthiness.
उदाहरण: "विश्वसनीय" का विपरीत "अविश्वसनीय" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: add prefixes such as un‑, in‑, non‑ to create the opposite.

questionText: arrogant
explanation:
Arrogant means overly proud or self‑confident. The opposite is "humble", which indicates modesty.
उदाहरण: "अहंकारी" का विपरीत "नम्र" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: select a word with opposite meaning; prefixes like un‑, in‑, non‑ are common.

questionText: subtle
explanation:
Subtle means not immediately obvious or delicate. The opposite is "obvious", which is easily seen or understood.
उदाहरण: "सूक्ष्म" का विपरीत "स्पष्ट" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: use a word with the opposite sense; often formed using prefixes or by selecting a contrasting word.

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Diligent means hardworking and careful. The opposite is "lazy", which means unwilling to work or use effort.
उदाहरण: "परिश्रमी" का विपरीत "आलसी" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: select a word with the opposite meaning; prefixes like un‑, in‑, non‑ can be used.

questionText: volatile
explanation:
Volatile means unstable or prone to change. The antonym is "stable", meaning steady and unchanging.
उदाहरण: "अस्थिर" का विपरीत "स्थिर" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: use a word with the opposite meaning; prefixes such as un‑, in‑, non‑ help form opposites.

questionText: infinite
explanation:
Infinite means without limits or endless. The opposite is "finite", meaning having limits.
उदाहरण: "अनंत" का विपरीत "सीमित" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: choose a word with opposite meaning; prefixes like un‑, in‑, non‑ create the negative form.

questionText: prohibit
explanation:
Prohibit means to forbid or prevent. The opposite is "allow", which means to give permission.
उदाहरण: "निषेध" का विपरीत "अनुमति" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: use a word with opposite meaning; prefixes like un‑, in‑, non‑ can create the negative sense.

questionText: magnify
explanation:
Magnify means to enlarge or make bigger. The opposite is "reduce", which means to make smaller.
उदाहरण: "बढ़ाना" का विपरीत "घटाना" है।
grammarRule: Antonym formation: select a word that expresses the opposite idea; prefixes such as un‑, in‑, non‑ help form negatives.

questionText: She is / more smarter / than her / younger sister.
explanation:
Do not use double comparatives. 'Smart' already takes '-er' to form its comparative degree ('smarter'), so 'more' is redundant.
उदा. दो कम्पेरेटिव डिग्री का प्रयोग एक साथ नहीं किया जाता है। 'smart' की कम्पेरेटिव 'smarter' है, इसलिए 'more' का प्रयोग गलत है।

questionText: One of my friends / are going / to the USA / next month.
explanation:
The phrase 'One of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद नाउन प्लुरल होता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा सिंगुलर होती है। 'are' की जगह 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: Hardly had I / reached the station / than the train / started moving.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (than का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।

questionText: The manager as well as / his subordinates / were present / at the meeting.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager'). Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट्स 'as well as' से जुड़ते हैं, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' सिंगुलर है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

questionText: No sooner did / the sun rise / when we resumed / our journey.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'when' का नहीं।

questionText: He asked me / where was I going / during the / summer vacation.
explanation:
In indirect speech, the structure of the reported clause should be assertive (Subject + Verb), not interrogative. Change 'where was I going' to 'where I was going'.
उदा. इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में प्रश्नवाचक वाक्य साधारण वाक्य बन जाता है (Subject + Verb)। 'where was I going' की जगह 'where I was going' होगा।

questionText: Despite of working / very hard, he / failed to clear / the competitive exam.
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (In place of 'Despite of', use 'In spite of' or simply 'Despite'). Remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'In spite of' का अर्थ और 'Despite' का अर्थ समान होता है, लेकिन despite के बाद 'of' नहीं आता।
grammarRule: Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: If I was you, / I would not / tolerate such / nonsense behavior.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used with all subjects. Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक शर्त (Hypothetical sentence) वाले वाक्यों में सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, चाहे सब्जेक्ट सिंगुलर ही क्यों न हो।

questionText: The committee of managers was given a week to submit the report.
options: The committee of managers were given a week to submit the report.
The committee of managers was given a week to submit the report.
The committee of managers was given a week to submit the reports.
The committee of managers were given a week to submit the reports.
explanation:
The subject ‘committee’ is a collective noun and is treated as singular. Hence the verb should be ‘was’. 
उदा. समिति को रिपोर्ट जमा करने के लिए एक सप्ताह दिया गया।

questionText: Neither the students nor the teacher were prepared for the examination.
options: Neither the students nor the teacher were prepared for the examination.
Neither the students nor the teacher was prepared for the examination.
Neither the students nor the teacher have prepared for the examination.
Neither the students nor the teacher has prepared for the examination.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by ‘neither…nor’, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. ‘Teacher’ is singular, so use ‘was’. 
उदा. न तो छात्रों ने परीक्षा की तैयारी की, न ही शिक्षक ने।

questionText: The data is collected every month to analyze the trend.
options: The data is collected every month to analyze the trend.
The data are collected every month to analyze the trend.
The data is collected every month to analyze the trends.
explanation:
The word ‘data’ is singular in this context (a mass noun), so use ‘is’. 
उदा. डेटा हर महीने एकत्र किया जाता है।
grammarRule: Singular vs plural form of data

questionText: The children has been playing in the park all after no on.
options: The children has been playing in the park all afternoon.
The children have been playing in the park all afternoon.
The child has been playing in the park all afternoon.
The children has been played in the park all afternoon.
explanation:
The subject ‘children’ is plural, so the verb should be ‘have’. 
उदा. बच्चे पूरे दोपहर पार्क में खेल रहे हैं।

questionText: He suggested that we should stay at home not to catch the flu.
options: He suggested that we should stay at home not to catch the flu.
He suggested that we should stay at home to not catch the flu.
He suggested that we should stay at home not catching the flu.
He suggested that we should stay at home to not catching the flu.
explanation:
When ‘suggest’ is followed by a clause, the infinitive should not have ‘to’. 
उदा. उसने सुझाव दिया कि हमें फ्लू से बचने के लिए घर पर रहना चाहिए।

questionText: The manager, along with his staff, have decided to resign.
options: The manager, along with his staff, have decided to resign.
The manager, along with his staff, has decided to resign.
explanation:
When a singular subject is joined by a prepositional phrase, the verb remains singular. Use ‘has’. 
उदा. मैनेजर, साथ में अपने स्टाफ के, इस्तीफा देने का निर्णय लिया।
grammarRule: Verb agreement with singular subject + prepositional phrase

questionText: The results of the experiment were inconclusive, so we will have to conduct the test again.
options: The results of the experiment were inconclusive, so we will have to conduct the test again.
The results of the experiment was inconclusive, so we will have to conduct the test again.
explanation:
The plural noun ‘results’ requires the verb ‘were’. 
उदा. प्रयोग के परिणाम अनिश्चित थे, इसलिए हमें परीक्षण फिर से करना होगा।

questionText: She said that he will come tomorrow if he could finish his work.
options: She said that he will come tomorrow if he could finish his work.
She said that he would come tomorrow if he could finish his work.
explanation:
In reported speech, the future ‘will’ changes to ‘would’ after a past reporting verb. 
उदा. उसने कहा कि वह अपना काम पूरा कर सके तो वह कल आएगा।

questionText: The library provides books, magazines, and newspapers to the students.
options: The library provides books, magazines, and newspapers to the students.
The library provide books, magazines, and newspapers to the students.
The library provides books, magazines, and newspapers to the student.
The library provides books, magazines, and newspaper to the students.
explanation:
The subject ‘library’ is singular, so use ‘provides’. 
उदा. पुस्तकालय छात्रों को पुस्तकें, पत्रिकाएँ और अखबार उपलब्ध कराता है।

questionText: enormous
explanation:
The opposite meaning of "enormous" is "tiny".
उदा. "enormous" का विपरीत शब्द "tiny" है।

questionText: desolate
explanation:
The opposite of "desolate" (abandoned, empty) is "abundant" (full, plentiful).
उदा. "desolate" का विपरीत शब्द "abundant" है।

questionText: complicate
explanation:
The opposite of "complicate" is "simplify".
उदा. "complicate" का विपरीत शब्द "simplify" है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
The opposite of "diligent" (hardworking) is "indolent" (lazy, idle).
उदा. "diligent" का विपरीत शब्द "indolent" है।

questionText: integrity
explanation:
The opposite of "integrity" (honesty, uprightness) is "corruption" (dishonesty, moral decay).
उदा. "integrity" का विपरीत शब्द "corruption" है।

questionText: scarcity
explanation:
The opposite of "scarcity" (lack, deficiency) is "abundance" (plenty, plenty).
उदा. "scarcity" का विपरीत शब्द "abundance" है।

questionText: Obscure
explanation:
The opposite of "obscure" (dark, unclear) is "transparent" (clear, visible).
उदा. "obscure" का विपरीत शब्द "transparent" है।

questionText: persevere
explanation:
The opposite of "persevere" (continue steadfastly) is "abandon" (leave, give up).
उदा. "persevere" का विपरीत शब्द "abandon" है।

questionText: Sophisticated
explanation:
The opposite of "sophisticated" (refined, complex) is "unsophisticated" (simple, naive).
उदा. "sophisticated" का विपरीत शब्द "unsophisticated" है।

questionText: sudden
explanation:
The opposite of "sudden" (happening quickly) is "gradual" (slowly, over time).
उदा. "sudden" का विपरीत शब्द "gradual" है।

questionText: rapid
explanation:
Antonym refers to a word with the opposite meaning. 'Rapid' means fast, so its opposite is slow.
उदाहरण: 'Rapid' का विपरीत 'Slow' है।

questionText: increased

Increased means made larger; its antonym is decreased.
उदाहरण: 'Increased' का विपरीत 'Decreased' है।

questionText: generous

questionText: ancient

questionText: absent

questionText: increase

उदाहरण: 'Increase' का विपरीत 'Decrease' है।

questionText: rich

उदाहरण: 'Rich' का विपरीत 'Poor' है।

questionText: complicated
explanation:
'Complicated' means complex; its opposite is simple.
उदाहरण: 'Complicated' का विपरीत 'Simple' है।

questionText: exclusive
explanation:
'Exclusive' means not inclusive; its opposite is inclusive.
उदाहरण: 'Exclusive' का विपरीत 'Inclusive' है।

questionText: tangible
explanation:
'Tangible' means able to touch; its opposite is intangible.
उदाहरण: 'Tangible' का विपरीत 'Intangible' है।

questionText: The manager as well as his clerks <ins>were present< / ins> at the meeting.
explanation:
When subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject (The manager, which is singular). Hence, 'was present' is correct.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'The manager' singular है, इसलिए 'was' का प्रयोग होगा।

questionText: Hardly had I arrived at the station <ins>than the train left< / ins>.
explanation:
'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. Therefore, 'when the train left' is correct.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)।

questionText: Neither of the two candidates <ins>have paid< / ins> the subscription fee.
explanation:
'Neither of' is followed by a plural noun/pronoun but takes a singular verb. Thus, 'has paid' is correct.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद plural noun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (has) होती है।

questionText: She is one of those women who <ins>always praises< / ins> her children.
explanation:
In the structure 'one of + plural noun + relative pronoun (who) + plural verb', the verb must agree with the antecedent ('women'), which is plural. So, 'always praise' is correct.
उदा. 'one of + plural noun + who' की बनावट में relative pronoun (who) अपने से पहले आने वाले plural noun (women) को refer करता है, इसलिए verb भी plural ('praise') होगी।

questionText: If I <ins>was a bird< / ins>, I would fly across the ocean.
explanation:
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary, unreal past or present wish, 'were' is used for all subjects. Hence, 'were a bird' is correct.
उदा. काल्पनिक इच्छा (Hypothetical condition) व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, न कि 'was' का।

questionText: The weather is much more nicer today <ins>than it was yesterday< / ins>.
explanation:
Double comparatives like 'much more nicer' are grammatically incorrect because 'nicer' is already a comparative adjective. The original phrase 'than it was yesterday' correctly uses 'than' for comparison.
उदा. 'much more nicer' गलत है क्योंकि 'nicer' के साथ 'more' नहीं आ सकता। 'than it was yesterday' बिल्कुल सही है।

questionText: No sooner did the teacher enter the class room <ins>then the students stood up< / ins>.
explanation:
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'then' or 'when'. Therefore, 'than the students stood up' is the correct replacement.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: He insisted <ins>to go< / ins> to the party despite his illness.
explanation:
The verb 'insist' is strictly followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (-ing form), i.e., 'insisted on going'.
उदा. 'Insist' verb के बाद हमेशा preposition 'on' और उसके बाद gerund (-ing form) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questionText: Each boy and each girl <ins>were given< / ins> a prize at the annual function.
explanation:
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' and preceded by 'each', the verb must be singular. Hence, 'was given' is correct.
उदा. जब दो singular nouns 'and' से जुड़े हों और उनके पहले 'each' का प्रयोग हो, तो verb हमेशा singular ('was') होती है।

questionText: She is capable to <ins>doing this work< / ins> efficiently.
explanation:
The adjective 'capable' is followed by the preposition 'of' and a gerund. Therefore, 'of doing this work' (option covers gerund part, but let's check standard options. Wait, options provided: 'doing this work' implies 'capable of doing' if 'to' is removed, but let's correct the option context). Let's adjust options: 'capable of doing this work'. Since the underlined part includes 'to doing', changing it to 'of doing' makes it correct.
उदा. 'Capable' के साथ preposition 'of' आता है और उसके बाद gerund (-ing) लगता है।

questionText: He <u>was decided to go< / u> to the party.
explanation:
The verb *decide* is an intransitive verb that is followed directly by a to‑infinitive. The phrase *was decided to* is ungrammatical.

Rule: Intransitive verbs like *decide* do not take an auxiliary *was* before the infinitive.

हिंदी: "decide" क्रिया के बाद सीधे to‑infinitive आता है, इसलिए *was decided to* गलत है।

questionText: She has <u>been seeing to< / u> the doctor regularly.
explanation:
The auxiliary *been* is used with a present participle to form the present perfect continuous. The correct form is *has been seeing*.

Rule: *been* + present participle.

हिंदी: *been* के बाद वर्तमान कृदंत आता है, इसलिए *been seeing to* गलत है।

questionText: They <u>are suffering from< / u> a lack of resources.
explanation:
The verb *suffer* is followed by *from* when indicating cause. *Are suffering of* is incorrect.

Rule: *suffer* + from.

हिंदी: *suffer* के बाद *from* आता है, इसलिए *are suffering of* गलत है।

questionText: The project has <u>been completed by< / u> them.
explanation:
Passive voice with present perfect requires *has been* + past participle. The correct phrase is *has been completed by*.

Rule: *has been* + past participle + by.

हिंदी: पास्ट पार्टिसिपल के साथ *has been* का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए *been completed by* सही है।

questionText: He <u>was seen to be< / u> working on the project.
explanation:
The expression *was seen* is followed directly by a -ing form when describing an action. The infinitive *to be* is unnecessary.

Rule: *was seen* + present participle.

हिंदी: *was seen* के बाद क्रिया का वर्तमान कृदंत आता है, इसलिए *was seen to be* गलत है।

questionText: She <u>was decided to leave< / u> before noon.
explanation:
The verb *decide* takes a to‑infinitive directly; *was decided to leave* is ungrammatical.

Rule: Intransitive verb + to‑infinitive.

हिंदी: *decide* के बाद सीधे to‑infinitive आता है, इसलिए *was decided to leave* गलत है।

questionText: The committee <u>has been met with< / u> strong opposition.
explanation:
For passive construction with a present perfect continuous, use *has been* + past participle. Thus *has been met with* is correct.

Rule: *has been* + past participle + with.

हिंदी: पास्ट पार्टिसिपल के साथ *has been* का प्रयोग, इसलिए *has been met with* सही है।

questionText: The team <u>was performing to< / u> better results.
explanation:
The verb *perform* does not take *to* before a noun phrase; it simply takes the complement. Hence *was performing* is correct.

Rule: Verb + object (no preposition).

हिंदी: *perform* के बाद कोई preposition नहीं आता, इसलिए *was performing* सही है।

questionText: The results of the experiment <u>are being analyzed by< / u> the researchers.
explanation:
Passive voice in present progressive uses *are being* + past participle. The correct form is *are being analyzed by*.

Rule: *are being* + past participle.

हिंदी: *are being* + past participle का प्रयोग, इसलिए *are being analyzed by* सही है।

questionText: He <u>was being to help< / u> the team.
explanation:
The correct construction is *was helping*; *was being to help* mixes passive and infinitive incorrectly.

Rule: *was* + present participle.

हिंदी: *was* के बाद present participle आता है, इसलिए *was helping* सही है।

questionText: They <u>has been working on< / u> the project for three months.
explanation:
The subject *they* is plural; therefore the auxiliary should be *have*. The correct phrase is *have been working on*.

Rule: *have* + been + present participle for plural subjects.

हिंदी: बहुवचन विषय के लिए *have* प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए *have been working on* सही है।

उदा. उसकी खुशी के आँसू बहने लगे।

questionText: the ball is in your court
options: you are responsible for the next action
you have a ball to play
explanation:
It means that it is now your turn to make a decision or take action.
उदा. अब फैसला आपका है।

questionText: Which option has the correct spelling?
explanation:
"Maintenance" is spelled with a 't' after the 'i' and a double 'n' before the 'a'.
उदाहरण: सही शब्द "maintenance" है।

questionText: Identify the word that is spelled correctly
explanation:
Correct spelling: "independent" with 'e' after 'n'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: independent – यह शब्द independent के रूप में लिखा जाता है।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelt word among the following options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Lieutenant' (lie-u-tenant).
उदा. 'Lieutenant' का अर्थ होता है उप-Lieutenant, सही स्पेलिंग 'Lieutenant' है।

questionText: Which of the following is not a correct spelling?
explanation:
"Acknowlegde" is missing an 'e' after 'l'.
उदाहरण: "स्वीकार करना" के लिए "acknowledge" सही है।

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word from the given options.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'Occurrence'. It doubles both 'c' and 'r'.
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग 'Occurrence' है जिसमें double 'c' और double 'r' आता है।

questionText: In the sentence "She was very (accomodate) to the new environment.", which word is misspelled?
explanation:
Rule: The verb "accommodate" has double 'c' and double 'm'.
उदाहरण: "accommodate" का सही स्पेलिंग है।
grammarRule: Spelling of words with double consonants

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the sentence: "The team will definately finish the project on time.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "definitely" with 'i' after 'f'.
उदाहरण: "definitely" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "Please separate the items into different categories.
explanation:
Rule: The correct form is "separate" with an 'a' after 'p'.
उदाहरण: "separate" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "There were several occurrances of the error.
explanation:
Rule: The word is spelled "occurrences" with a double 'c' and double 'r'.
उदाहरण: "occurrences" का सही स्पेलिंग।
grammarRule: Spelling of nouns with double consonants

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "He spoke publicly about the issue.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "publicly" with one 'l'.
उदाहरण: "publicly" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word: "It is nescessary to review the documents.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "necessary" with double 's' and double 'c'.
उदाहरण: "necessary" का सही स्पेलिंग।
grammarRule: Spelling of adjectives with double consonants

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "The recommendation was well received.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "recommendation" with 'm' before 'e'.
उदाहरण: "recommendation" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "He worked independently for years.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "independently" with one 'e' after 'n'.
उदाहरण: "independently" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Which word is misspelled in the sentence: "The goverment announced new policies.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "government" with 'e' before 'r'.
उदाहरण: "government" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word: "The environment needs protection.
explanation:
Rule: The correct spelling is "environment" with 'ri' after 'n'.
उदाहरण: "environment" का सही स्पेलिंग।

questionText: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
explanation:
'Rendezvous' is a French word meaning a meeting at an agreed time and place. 
उदा. 'Rendezvous' एक फ्रांसीसी मूल का शब्द है जिसकी सही वर्तनी यही है।

questionText: A person who writes news for newspapers or broadcasts them on radio or television
explanation:
A journalist is a person who collects, writes, or distributes news and other current information. 
उदा. जो व्यक्ति समाचार पत्रों या मीडिया के लिए समाचार लिखता या प्रसारित करता है, उसे 'Journalist' (पत्रकार) कहते हैं।

questionText: A study of ancient things like tombs, buried cities, etc.
explanation:
Archaeology is the study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites and the analysis of artifacts. 
उदा. प्राचीन वस्तुओं, भवनों और खंडहरों के अध्ययन को 'Archaeology' (पुरातत्व विज्ञान) कहा जाता है।

questionText: An act of murdering one's own brother
explanation:
Fratricide is the killing of one's brother or sister (derived from Latin 'frater' meaning brother). 
उदा. अपने भाई की हत्या करने की क्रिया को 'Fratricide' (भ्रातृहत्या) कहा जाता है।

questionText: in order to
explanation: Rule: Prepositions and conjunctions that express purpose can be replaced by a single word. Example in Hindi: "in order to" का एक शब्द "to" है।

questionText: given that
explanation: Rule: Conjunctive phrases indicating a condition can be simplified to a single word. Example in Hindi: "given that" का एक शब्द "since" है।

questionText: as a result of
explanation: Rule: Causal phrases can be condensed into a single word expressing cause. Example: "as a result of" का एक शब्द "because" है।

questionText: in spite of
explanation: Rule: The prepositional phrase meaning 'despite' is replaced by the single word "despite". Example: "in spite of" का एक शब्द "despite" है।

questionText: in the event that
explanation: Rule: Conditional phrases can be simplified to a single word. Example: "in the event that" का एक शब्द "when" है।

questionText: in the absence of
explanation: Rule: A prepositional phrase indicating lack can be replaced by the word "without". Example: "in the absence of" का एक शब्द "without" है।

questionText: provided that
explanation: Rule: Conditional clauses can be condensed to a single word. Example: "provided that" का एक शब्द "if" है।

questionText: as opposed to
explanation: Rule: Comparative phrases can be shortened to a single word like "vs". Example: "as opposed to" का एक शब्द "vs" है।

questionText: in lieu of
explanation: Rule: The phrase meaning "instead of" can be replaced by the single word "instead". Example: "in lieu of" का एक शब्द "instead" है।

questionText: in view of
explanation: Rule: A prepositional phrase indicating consideration can be shortened to "given". Example: "in view of" का एक शब्द "given" है।

questionText: The manager's ________ of the project was not obvious to the investors.
explanation:
The sentence needs a noun that means the manager's participation in the project. The word "involvement" fits as a single word substitution for "manager's participation".
उदाहरण: "प्रबंधक की भागीदारी" को एक शब्द "involvement" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the new policy will have to be communicated to all staff members.
explanation:
The phrase requires a noun that denotes the act of putting the policy into effect. "Implementation" is the appropriate one-word noun.
उदाहरण: "नई नीति का कार्यान्वयन" को "implementation" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The company announced a ________ to increase shareholder value.
explanation:
The sentence requires a noun meaning a plan of action. "Strategy" is the correct one-word substitution.
उदाहरण: "कंपनी की रणनीति" को "strategy" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the book was evident from the first chapter.
explanation:
The noun needed is a single word meaning the storyline. "Plot" serves as a one-word replacement for "the story's sequence of events".
उदाहरण: "कहानी की कहानी" को "plot" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the project was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation:
A noun that indicates the completion of the project is required. "Delivery" is the correct one-word substitute for "the project's completion".
उदाहरण: "परियोजना का समापन" को "delivery" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The team's ________ in the competition was remarkable.
explanation:
The sentence requires a noun that denotes the team's actions in the competition. "Performance" is the appropriate one-word noun.
उदाहरण: "टीम का प्रदर्शन" को "performance" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the new law will affect all businesses.
explanation:
A noun that means the act of putting the law into effect is needed. "Implementation" is the correct one-word substitution.
उदाहरण: "नई कानून का लागू होना" को "implementation" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The company's ________ to improve customer service was well received.
explanation:
The noun required is a single word meaning a plan or action taken. "Initiative" fits as a one-word replacement for "the company's plan".
उदाहरण: "कम्पनी की पहल" को "initiative" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the meeting was to discuss the new policy.
explanation:
The sentence needs a noun that means the purpose. "Objective" is the correct one-word substitute for "the meeting's purpose".
उदाहरण: "बैठक का उद्देश्य" को "objective" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The ________ of the proposal was not clear to the committee.
explanation:
A noun that denotes the information within the proposal is needed. "Content" is the correct one-word substitution.
उदाहरण: "प्रस्ताव का विषय" को "content" से बदला जा सकता है।

questionText: The committee members have presented their reports after the meeting. The number of participants who attended the seminar was impressive. Each of the students' opinions seems to be considered carefully. The list of items, including the pens and notebooks, are on the table.
explanation:
In (D), the subject is the singular noun ‘list’, hence the verb should be ‘is’ not ‘are’. The phrase ‘including the pens and notebooks’ is a non‑restrictive clause and does not affect agreement.
उदाहरण: The list of items, including the pens and notebooks, is on the table.

questionText: Choose the sentence that contains an error in pronoun‑antecedent agreement: Every student should submit his assignment by Friday. Neither of the options has worked for her. The committee has decided to postpone its meeting. The couple, whose wedding photo was taken last year, is planning a trip.
explanation:
In (A), ‘every student’ is singular but ‘his’ is masculine; the correct pronoun is ‘his or her’ or ‘their’. 
उदाहरण: Every student should submit their assignment by Friday.

questionText: Identify the sentence with a misplaced modifier: The teacher explained the concept to the students, which was appreciated. The students, who were tired, finished the exam quickly. The manager, after reviewing the report, has decided to hire more staff. The chef, cooking the meal, was unaware of the allergy.
explanation:
In (A), the clause ‘which was appreciated’ incorrectly attaches to ‘students’ instead of the action of explaining. It should read: The teacher explained the concept, which was appreciated by the students.
उदाहरण: The teacher explained the concept, which was appreciated by the students.

questionText: Which sentence contains an error in the use of a comparative adjective? John is taller than his brother. The new policy is more efficient than the old one. She is the bestest performer in the team. This solution is cheaper than the previous one.
explanation:
In (C), ‘bestest’ is not a correct comparative form. The correct comparative is ‘best’ (superlative) or ‘better’ (comparative). 
उदाहरण: She is the best performer in the team.

questionText: Choose the sentence that contains an error in comma usage: He bought apples, oranges, and bananas at the market. After the lecture, the students left the hall. The manager, who had been absent, was not present. The report, which was due yesterday, has been submitted.
explanation:
In (C), the comma after ‘manager’ is unnecessary because the clause ‘who had been absent’ is essential for identifying which manager. It should read: The manager who had been absent was not present.
उदाहरण: The manager who had been absent was not present.
grammarRule: Comma usage with restrictive vs non‑restrictive clauses

questionText: Identify the sentence with an error in the use of the subjunctive mood: If I were you, I would take the job. It is essential that he attend the meeting. I wish we was at the beach. I recommend that she read the guidelines carefully.
explanation:
In (C), the subjunctive form should be ‘were’ not ‘was’. The correct sentence is: I wish we were at the beach.
उदाहरण: I wish we were at the beach.

questionText: Which sentence contains an error in verb tense consistency? She has been working on the project since yesterday. They will finish the report by tomorrow. The manager had given the instructions, and every one has started working. The team is planning to launch the product next month.
explanation:
In (C), the past perfect ‘had given’ is followed by present perfect ‘has started’, breaking tense consistency. It should be ‘had started’.
उदाहरण: The manager had given the instructions, and everyone had started working.

questionText: She adopted a dog from the animal shelter. He bought an apple while walking. The weather today is sunny. I saw a elephant at the zoo.
explanation:
In (D), the article ‘a’ should be ‘an’ before a vowel sound. Correct: I saw an elephant at the zoo.
उदाहरण: I saw an elephant at the zoo.

questionText: Identify the sentence with an error in the use of a preposition: She is good at playing the violin. He is responsible for the project. The book is placed in the shelf. They arrived at the airport on time.
explanation:
In (C), the correct preposition is ‘on’ or ‘in’ depending on context. The sentence should read: The book is placed on the shelf.
उदाहरण: The book is placed on the shelf.

questionText: Which sentence contains an error in the use of an apostrophe? The company’s success is due to its employees. The students’ project was impressive. The cat’s tail was fluffy. The books are on the table’s shelf.
explanation:
In (D), the possessive should be ‘shelf’ not ‘shelf’s’ because the shelf belongs to the books. Correct: The books are on the table shelf.
उदाहरण: The books are on the table shelf.

questionText: Choose the sentence that contains an error in the use of a modal verb: She can finish the assignment before noon. They should have completed the task by now. He might go to the conference tomorrow. We must of finished the report earlier.
explanation:
In (D), the modal verb ‘must’ is incorrectly followed by ‘of’. It should be ‘must have finished’.
उदाहरण: We must have finished the report earlier.
grammarRule: Correct use of modal + perfect infinitive

questionText: She has been working ____ the company since 2010.
explanation:
The preposition "for" is used to indicate a period of time. 
उदा. वह 2010 से कंपनी में काम कर रही है।

questionText: The manager was reprimanded ____ his failure to meet the dead line
explanation:
"For" is used to express the reason for an action. 
उदा. उसे समय सीमा न मिलने के कारण डांटा गया।

questionText: I am looking forward ____ meeting you.
explanation:
The idiom "looking forward to" is followed by the infinitive form "to + verb." 
उदा. मैं आपसे मिलने का इंतज़ार कर रहा हूँ।

questionText: He has been living in Paris ____ six months.
explanation:
"For" is used to indicate an amount of time. 
उदा. वह छह महीने से पेरिस में रह रहा है।

questionText: The team will be awarded ____ their outstanding performance.
explanation:
"For" expresses the reason or cause of an award. 
उदा. उनके उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए उन्हें पुरस्कार दिया जाएगा।

questionText: It is essential ____ maintaining a balanced diet.
explanation:
The infinitive form "to + verb" follows the adjective "essential." 
उदा. संतुलित आहार बनाए रखना आवश्यक है।

questionText: She was praised ____ her dedication.
explanation:
"For" is used to indicate the reason for the praise. 
उदा. उसकी समर्पण के लिए उसकी प्रशंसा की गई।

questionText: The book is considered ____ one of the greatest novels.
explanation:
"An" is used before a word that begins with a vowel sound. 
उदा. यह एक महान उपन्यास माना जाता है।

questionText: He was appointed ____ the head of the department.
explanation:
"The" is the definite article used for a specific noun. 
उदा. उसे विभाग के प्रमुख के रूप में नियुक्त किया गया।

questionText: The students were asked ____ submit their reports by Friday.
explanation:
The infinitive "to submit" follows the verb "asked". 
उदा. छात्रों से कहा गया कि वे शुक्रवार तक अपने रिपोर्ट जमा करें।

questionText: The committee met ____ ordinary business to discuss the new policy.
explanation:
"For" indicates the purpose of the meeting. 
उदा. समिति ने नई नीति पर चर्चा करने के लिए सामान्य व्यवसाय के लिए बैठक की।

questionText: The committee was ______ about the new policy.
explanation:
Rule in English: After the verb 'to be', an adjective is used to describe a state. In this sentence, 'concerned' means worried or interested. 
उदाहरण: समिति नई नीति के बारे में चिंतित है।

questionText: She has been studying ______ for her exam.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use the preposition 'for' to indicate a duration of time. 
उदाहरण: वह तीन महीनों से अपनी परीक्षा के लिए पढ़ रही है।

questionText: He was ______ to leave the office early.
explanation:
Rule in English: 'Allowed' is a past participle used as an adjective meaning permitted. 
उदाहरण: उसे ऑफिस जल्दी छोड़ने की अनुमति थी।

questionText: The children were ______ to learn new languages.
explanation:
Rule in English: An adjective describing enthusiasm or willingness must be used. 'Eager' means enthusiastic. 
उदाहरण: बच्चे नई भाषाएँ सीखने के लिए उत्सुक थे।

questionText: The team ______ the match with a stunning victory.
explanation:
Rule in English: Simple past tense of 'win' is 'won'. 
उदाहरण: टीम ने मैच को शानदार जीत के साथ जीता।

questionText: The scientist will ______ his findings next week.
explanation:
Rule in English: The future simple tense uses 'will' + base form of the verb. 
उदाहरण: वैज्ञानिक अगले सप्ताह अपनी खोजों को प्रस्तुत करेगा।

questionText: The company's profits have ______ since last quarter.
explanation:
Rule in English: Present perfect tense uses 'have' + past participle. 
उदाहरण: कंपनी के मुनाफे ने पिछले तिमाही से बढ़ोतरी की है।

questionText: They decided to ______ the new project.
explanation:
Rule in English: After verbs like 'decided', the infinitive form 'to + base verb' is used. 
उदाहरण: उन्होंने नया प्रोजेक्ट शुरू करने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: The book is ______ the topic.
explanation:
Rule in English: The adjective 'relevant' is followed by the preposition 'to' when indicating a subject. 
उदाहरण: यह किताब विषय के लिए प्रासंगिक है।

questionText: He ______ the meeting without prior notice.
explanation:
Rule in English: Simple past tense of 'leave' is 'left'. 
उदाहरण: उसने बिना पूर्व सूचना के बैठक छोड़ी।

questionText: The government has decided to _______ the new policy next month.
explanation:
Verb in base form after 'decided to'.
उदा. सरकार ने अगले महीने नई नीति लागू करने का निर्णय लिया।
grammarRule: Verb in base form after decide to

questionText: She is very good _______ mathematics.
explanation:
Preposition 'at' is used with 'good' to indicate proficiency.
उदा. वह गणित में बहुत अच्छी है।

questionText: The doctor advised him to _______ the medication twice a day.
explanation:
Infinitive form after 'advise' to give instructions.
उदा. डॉक्टर ने उसे दवा दो बार लेने की सलाह दी।

questionText: If you want to succeed, you must _______ hard.
explanation:
Base form after 'must' for modal verbs.
उदा. सफल होने के लिए आपको कड़ी मेहनत करनी चाहिए।

questionText: The students were amazed at the _______ of the new technology.
explanation:
Use noun form 'innovation' after 'amazed at'.
उदा. नई तकनीक की नवाचार से छात्र चकित थे।

questionText: He has been living in Mumbai _______ five years.
explanation:
Preposition 'for' indicates duration of time.
उदा. वह मुंबई में पांच साल से रह रहा है।

questionText: The book is _______ to the shelf.
explanation:
Past participle used as adjective to describe state.
उदा. किताब शेल्फ पर रखी गई है।

questionText: She has a reputation _______ a reliable person.
explanation:
Preposition 'as' used after reputation to indicate role.
उदा. उसे विश्वसनीय व्यक्ति के रूप में जाना जाता है।

questionText: They are planning to _______ the project by next month.
explanation:
Base form after 'plan to' for future intention.
उदा. वे अगले महीने परियोजना समाप्त करने की योजना बना रहे हैं।

questionText: The news was spread _______ the internet.
explanation:
Preposition 'through' indicates means of distribution.
उदा. समाचार इंटरनेट के माध्यम से फैला।

questionText: Choose the word that is opposite to the given word: Incessant
explanation:
Rule in English: An antonym is a word that expresses the opposite meaning of another word.
उदा. "incessant" का अर्थ है "लगातार"; इसका विपरीत "brief" (थोड़ा) होता है।

questionText: Choose the word that is opposite to the given word: Pervasive
explanation:
Rule in English: An antonym is a word that conveys the opposite concept.
उदा. "Pervasive" का अर्थ है "सार्वभौमिक"; इसका विपरीत "Localized" (स्थानीय) है।

questionText: Choose the word that is opposite to the given word: Subsequent
explanation:
Rule in English: An antonym is a word with a meaning opposite to another.
उदा. "Subsequent" का अर्थ है "बाद का"; इसका विपरीत "Previous" (पहला) है।

questionText: Choose the word that is opposite to the given word: Ample
explanation:
Rule in English: Antonyms express contrary meanings.
उदा. "Ample" का अर्थ है "पर्याप्त"; इसका विपरीत "Scarce" (कम) है।

questionText: Choose the word that is opposite to the given word: Cautious
explanation:

questionText: The person who regularly goes to the gym to exercise is a ___.
explanation:

questionText: A person who is very punctual and never arrives late is ___.
explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long description with a concise adjective.

questionText: The act of speaking in a loud and aggressive manner is ___.
explanation:

questionText: A person who always helps others without expecting anything in return is ___.
explanation:

explanation:
Rule in English: Replace a long phrase with a concise noun.

questionText: The condition of a building that requires immediate repair is ___.
explanation:

explanation:
Rule in English: Use a noun that summarizes the activity.

explanation:

questionText: The _________ of the policy was to reduce pollution.

questionText: The news was received with _________ by the public.

questionText: The ____________ of the project was not achieved due to lack of funds.
explanation:

questionText: The shop was closed for ____________ due to renovation.

questionText: In the event that you encounter any difficulty, please inform me.

questionText: For the purpose of evaluating the data, we will use statistical tools.

questionText: In the absence of any evidence, the case will be dismissed.

questionText: In view of the recent developments, the policy has been revised.

questionText: In the light of the new evidence, we have changed our stance.

questionText: Due to the heavy rain, the match was postponed.

questionText: Despite the difficulties, the project was completed on time.

questionText: In addition to the benefits, the new policy also offers more flexibility.

questionText: The committee has decided to allocate the funds for the new project. The committee has decided to allocate the funds for the new projects. The committee have decided to allocate the funds for the new project. The committee has decided to allocating the funds for the new project.

questionText: Identify the erroneous part. The data shows a significant increase in sales. The data shows a significant increase in saleses. The data shows a significant increase in sales. The data show a significant increase in sales.

questionText: She is the most talented singer among all the participants. She is the most talented singer among all the participants. She is the most talented singer among the participants. She is the most talented singer among all the participant.

questionText: Which part has an error? The students, who were late, had to wait for the instructor. The students, which were late, had to wait for the instructor. The students, who were late, had to wait for the instructor. The students, which were late, had to wait for the instructor.

questionText: Identify the erroneous part. The committee has been urged to submit the report by Friday. The committee has been urged to submit the report by Friday. The committee has been urged to submit the report by Friday. The committee has been urged to submit the report by Friday’s.

questionText: Which part contains a mistake? The project will commence after the fund is released. The project will commence after the fund is released. The project will commence after the funds is released. The project will commence after the fund is released.

questionText: The manager advised the team to perform the task efficiently. The manager advised the team to perform the task efficiently. The manager advised the team to perform the task efficiently. The manager advised the team to performing the task efficiently.

questionText: Identify the erroneous part. The research was published in the journal after a peer review. The research was published in the journal after a peer review. The research was published in the journal after peer review. The research was published in the journal after a peer review.
