questionText: Choose the segment containing the error. The committee will consider the applications and will decide by the end of the month. The committee will consider the applications and will decide by the end of the month. The committee will consider the applications and will decide by the end of the month. The committee will consider the applications and will decide by the end of the month.
explanation:
Repeated ‘will’ is unnecessary; use a single ‘will’ or restructure.
उदाहरण: … and decide by the end of the month.

questionText: Choose the segment containing the error. The in form at i on was carefully analyzed by the experts. The in form at i on was carefully analyzed by the experts. The in form at i on was carefully analyzed by the experts. The in form at i on was carefully analyzed by the experts.
explanation:
The word ‘information’ is uncountable and takes a singular verb.
उदाहरण: The information *was* carefully analyzed.

questionText: Choose the segment containing the error. The new policy will be implemented and will improve efficiency. The new policy will be implemented and will improve efficiency. The new policy will be implemented and will improve efficiency. The new policy will be implemented and will improve efficiency.
explanation:
The use of ‘and will’ after a passive verb is redundant; use ‘and will’ only once.
उदाहरण: … and will improve efficiency.

questionText: Choose the segment containing the error. The team was praised for their outstanding performance. The team was praised for their outstanding performance. The team was praised for their outstanding performance. The team was praised for their outstanding performance.
explanation:
With a singular collective noun ‘team’, use singular pronoun ‘its’.
उदाहरण: The team was praised for *its* performance.

questionText: The committee has decided to postpone the meeting. The committee had decided to postpone the meeting. The committee has decided to postpone the meeting, however, the members are upset. The committee has decided to postpone the meeting; however, the members are upset. Which of the following is grammatically correct?
explanation:
The correct sentence is (D). The semicolon correctly joins two independent clauses. 
हिंदी: (D) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि सेमीकोलन दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य को जोड़ने के लिये सही है।
grammarRule: Use of semicolon with independent clauses

questionText: Choose the sentence that contains no grammatical mistake: If you would have come earlier, you could have joined us. If you had come earlier, you would have joined us. If you had come earlier, you could have joined us. If you would come earlier, you could have joined us.
explanation:
Correct form is (C) using the third conditional: past perfect + would have. 
हिंदी: (C) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि तीसरी शर्त में ‘had’ + past participle और ‘could have’ का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Find the sentence with the correct use of the participle clause: The man, who was seen at the scene, was arrested yesterday. The man, whom was seen at the scene, was arrested yesterday. The man, who was seen at the scene, was arrested yesterday. The man, who was seen at the scene, arrested yesterday.
explanation:
Option (A) correctly uses the relative pronoun ‘who’ for a person. 
हिंदी: (A) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि ‘who’ का प्रयोग व्यक्ति के लिए किया गया है।

questionText: There are few people attending the seminar. There are less people attending the seminar. There are few people attending the seminar. There are less people attending the seminar.
explanation:
‘Few’ is used with countable nouns and indicates a small number. ‘Less’ is for uncountable nouns. (A) is correct. 
हिंदी: (A) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि ‘few’ गिनती योग्य संज्ञा के साथ प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Identify the correctly punctuated sentence: The report, which was due last week, was submitted yesterday. The report which was due last week, was submitted yesterday. The report, which was due last week, was submitted yesterday. The report which was due last week was submitted yesterday.
explanation:
Option (D) correctly omits commas because the clause is essential. 
हिंदी: (D) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि आवश्यक उपवाक्य के चारों ओर कॉमा नहीं लगती।

questionText: Choose the sentence that correctly uses the reflexive pronoun: Each of the students must submit their assignment. Each of the students must submit his or her assignment. Each of the students must submit their assignments. Each of the students must submit his or her assignments.
explanation:
Option (B) uses the singular ‘his or her’ correctly with ‘each’. 
हिंदी: (B) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि ‘each’ के साथ ‘his or her’ का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Find the sentence that has the correct use of the modal verb: She can to finish the work on time. She can finish the work on time. She could finish the work on time. She may finish the work on time.
explanation:
Modal verbs are followed by the base form of the verb. (B) is correct. 
हिंदी: (B) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि मोडल के बाद बेस फॉर्म आता है।
grammarRule: Modal verbs followed by base verb

questionText: Select the sentence with no error in the use of the passive voice: The project was completed by the team. The project is completed by the team. The project has been completed by the team. The project had been completed by the team.
explanation:
Option (A) correctly uses simple past passive. 
हिंदी: (A) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि ‘was completed’ साधारण भूतकाल निष्क्रिय है।

questionText: Which sentence correctly uses the comparative form? She is more taller than her brother. She is taller than her brother. She is more tall than her brother. She is tallest than her brother.
explanation:
Comparatives use ‘taller’ without ‘more’. (B) is correct. 
हिंदी: (B) वाक्य सही है क्योंकि ‘taller’ तुलना का सही रूप है।

questionText: tremendous
explanation:
"Tremendous" and "enormous" both describe something very large or great. Example: The crowd was tremendous / enormous.
"Tremendous" का अर्थ "enormous" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms convey nearly identical meanings and can replace each other in a sentence.

questionText: devastated
explanation:
"Devastated" and "desolate" both mean severely shocked or ruined. Example: She was devastated / desolate after the news.
"Devastated" का अर्थ "desolate" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms are words with almost identical meanings used in similar contexts.

questionText: frugal
explanation:
"Frugal" and "thrifty" both mean careful with money or resources. Example: He is frugal / thrifty with his expenses.
"Frugal" का अर्थ "thrifty" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms are words that can be used interchangeably because they share the same meaning.

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
"Elaborate" and "ornate" both mean richly detailed or decorated. Example: The design was elaborate / ornate.
"Elaborate" का अर्थ "ornate" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms express the same or very close meanings and can replace each other in a sentence.

questionText: obstinate
explanation:
"Obstinate" and "stubborn" both describe someone who refuses to change their mind. Example: He was obstinate / stubborn about the decision.
"Obstinate" का अर्थ "stubborn" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms are words that share similar meanings and can be used interchangeably.

questionText: candid
explanation:
"Candid" and "honest" both mean truthful and straightforward. Example: He was candid / honest about his feelings.
"Candid" का अर्थ "honest" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms convey the same meaning and can be interchanged in most contexts.

questionText: lucid
explanation:
"Lucid" and "clear" both mean easily understood or bright. Example: The explanation was lucid / clear.
"Lucid" का अर्थ "clear" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms are words that have nearly identical meanings and can be used interchangeably.

questionText: luminous
explanation:
"Luminous" and "radiant" both mean emitting light or shining brightly. Example: The luminous / radiant glow lit the room.
"Luminous" का अर्थ "radiant" है।
grammarRule: Synonyms share the same or very close meanings and can replace each other in sentences.

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words that have similar meanings.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, 'elaborate' का समानार्थी शब्द 'expand' है।

questionText: incessant
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym expresses the same idea.
उदाहरण: 'incessant' का समानार्थी 'continuous' है।

questionText: suspicious
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words with analogous meanings.
उदाहरण: 'suspicious' का समानार्थी 'wary' है।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
Rule in English: Words that share similar sense are synonyms.
उदाहरण: 'benevolent' का समानार्थी 'charitable' है।

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms convey nearly identical meaning.
उदाहरण: 'meticulous' का समानार्थी 'thorough' है।

questionText: ephemeral
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words that are semantically close.
उदाहरण: 'ephemeral' का समानार्थी 'transitory' है।

questionText: arrogant
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym expresses the same or a very close idea.
उदाहरण: 'arrogant' का समानार्थी 'proud' है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms share a common meaning.
उदाहरण: 'diligent' का समानार्थी 'hardworking' है।

questionText: quaint
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words that convey the same sense.
उदाहरण: 'quaint' का समानार्थी 'old-fashioned' है।

questionText: contemplate
explanation:
The word "contemplate" means to think deeply about something. Here, the best synonym is "Contemplate".
उदा. "वह अक्सर चंद्रमाच्छाया क्षितिज पर विचार करता था।"
grammarRule: Synonym selection based on meaning context

questionText: diligent
explanation:
To replace "diligent", we need a word meaning hardworking. "Industrious" matches this meaning.
उदा. "वह एक परिश्रमी छात्रा थी, जो हमेशा समय पर असाइनमेंट जमा करती थी।"

questionText: meticulous
explanation:
"Meticulous" means showing great attention to detail. The synonym "Precise" conveys the same sense.
उदा. "वह अपनी काम में बहुत ही सटीक होती है।"

questionText: In the sentence "The manager was ___, ensuring all protocols were followed", which word best fits?
explanation:
The sentence implies carefulness and strict adherence. "Scrupulous" is the correct synonym.
उदा. "प्रबंधक कड़ी सावधानी बरतते थे।"

questionText: rapid
explanation:
"Rapid" denotes quickness. "Brisk" carries the same meaning.
उदा. "वह तेज़ चाल से दौड़ता है।"

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
"Benevolent" means kind and charitable. The synonym "Charitable" fits.
उदा. "उस उदार दाता ने अनाथालय को उदारता से दान दिया।"

questionText: elaborate
explanation:
When used as a verb, "elaborate" means to explain in detail. "Explain" is the synonym.
उदा. "वह अपनी कहानी को विस्तार से समझाती है।"

questionText: vivid
explanation:
"Vivid" indicates bright, lively colors. "Lively" is an appropriate synonym.
उदा. "उसने जीवंत पेंटिंग बनाई।"

questionText: awful
explanation:
"Awful" in this context means very bad. The synonym is "Terrible".
उदा. "यह स्थिति बहुत ही भयानक थी।"

questionText: inquire
explanation:
"Inquire" means to ask or seek information. The synonym is "Ask".
उदा. "मैंने उससे पूछताछ की।"

questionText: The committee members were very ___ about the changes proposed in the new policy.
explanation:
The correct word is *critical* (adjective) meaning "having a high standard". 
उदा. समिति के सदस्यों को नई नीति में प्रस्तावित परिवर्तनों के बारे में बहुत आलोचनात्मक (critical) विचार थे।

questionText: She decided ___ a new strategy to improve the team’s performance.
explanation:
After *decided* we use the base form of the verb without *to*: *decided to adopt* is wrong. 
उदा. उसने टीम के प्रदर्शन को बेहतर बनाने के लिए नई रणनीति अपनाने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: The museum is located ___ the old city walls.
explanation:
*Inside* is the appropriate preposition meaning "within the confines of". 
उदा. संग्रहालय पुरानी शहर की दीवारों के अंदर स्थित है।

questionText: He is the only person ___ ever travelled to the remote island.
explanation:
When referring to a person in a relative clause, use *who*. 
उदा. वह एकमात्र व्यक्ति है जिसने कभी उस दूरस्थ द्वीप का दौरा किया है।

questionText: The project will be completed ___ the end of next month.
explanation:
*By* indicates a deadline. 
उदा. परियोजना अगले महीने के अंत तक पूरी हो जाएगी।

questionText: The author’s latest novel is ___ to receive critical acclaim.
explanation:
*Likely* is the correct adjective meaning "probable". 
उदा. लेखक का नवीनतम उपन्यास आलोचनात्मक प्रशंसा प्राप्त करने की संभावना रखता है।

questionText: The data ___ was presented in the meeting was in complete.
explanation:
*That* is correct for a restrictive relative clause referring to the data. 
उदा. वह डेटा जो बैठक में प्रस्तुत किया गया था, अपूर्ण था।

questionText: They had to ___ the proposal because it was unrealistic.
explanation:
After *had to* we use the base form of the verb: *reject*. 
उदा. उन्हें प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार करना पड़ा क्योंकि यह अवास्तविक था।
grammarRule: Modal + base form after had to

questionText: The company’s profits have ___ since the new management took over.
explanation:
*Increased* (past tense) correctly matches the present perfect construction *have increased*. 
उदा. नई प्रबंधन के आने के बाद कंपनी के मुनाफे में वृद्धि हुई है।

questionText: The mayor announced that the city will ___ a new park by the river.
explanation:
*To build* is the infinitive form after *will*. 
उदा. महापौर ने घोषणा की कि शहर नदी के किनारे एक नया पार्क बनाएगा।

questionText: The scientist's theory was accepted by the scientific community, _____ he had presented a compelling set of data.
explanation:
The word 'because' introduces a reason that supports the preceding statement.
हिंदी: "क्योंकि" का प्रयोग कारण बताने के लिए किया जाता है।

questionText: She has been working as a nurse _____ the hospital for over ten years.
explanation:
The preposition 'at' is used with institutions like hospitals.
हिंदी: अस्पताल जैसी संस्था के साथ 'at' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee will ___ the proposals at the upcoming meeting.
explanation:
The infinitive form 'discuss' follows 'will'.
हिंदी: 'will' के बाद क्रिया का मूल रूप उपयोग होता है।

questionText: He bought a new laptop, ___ he could work on the go.
explanation:
Both 'so that' and 'in order that' express purpose. The standard phrase is 'so that'.
हिंदी: उद्देश्य व्यक्त करने के लिये 'so that' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The artist's work has been admired _____ critics and the general public alike.
explanation:
The preposition 'by' is used to indicate the agents of admiration.
हिंदी: 'by' का प्रयोग उन लोगों के लिए होता है जो प्रशंसा करते हैं।

questionText: If you ___ the meeting, we will have to postpone the announcement.
explanation:
The past simple 'missed' is used in a second conditional clause.
हिंदी: शर्तीय वाक्य में भूतकाल का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The new policy will improve the quality of life for ______ citizens.
explanation:
The phrase 'every citizen' means all citizens.
हिंदी: 'every' का मतलब सभी से है।

questionText: The mayor, _____ had been in office for a decade, announced a new development plan.
explanation:
The relative pronoun 'who' is used for people.
हिंदी: लोगों के लिए 'who' का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The committee's decision was made after ___ all the evidence thoroughly.
explanation:
The gerund 'reviewing' follows the preposition 'after'.
हिंदी: 'after' के बाद gerund का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: The company announced a new policy to ___ the environmental impact of its operations.
explanation:
The infinitive 'reduce' follows the verb 'to' in the purpose clause.
हिंदी: उद्देश्य बताने के लिये infinitive का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: He was the first person to ___ the new highway system.
explanation:
The past simple 'designed' matches the past perfect sense of 'first person to'.
हिंदी: 'first person to' के बाद भूतकाल का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: She has been living _______ this city for five years.
explanation:
In English, we use the preposition **in** with cities and countries. 
उदा. वह इस शहर में पाँच साल से रह रही है।

questionText: The manager is responsible _______ ensuring the project is completed on time.
explanation:
The verb **be responsible** is followed by the preposition **for**. 
उदा. प्रबंधक परियोजना को समय पर पूरा करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है।

questionText: If he _______ earlier, he would have caught the train.
explanation:
Conditional sentences of the third type use the **past perfect** tense. 
उदाहरण: अगर वह पहले पहुँच गया होता, तो ट्रेन पकड़ पाता।
grammarRule: Verb Form – Past Perfect (had + past participle)

questionText: Her explanation was so _______ that every one understood the concept immediately.
explanation:
The adjective **clear** is used to describe something that can be easily understood. 
उदाहरण: उसकी व्याख्या इतनी स्पष्ट थी कि सभी ने तुरंत समझ लिया।

questionText: The book is placed _______ the shelf.
explanation:
We use the preposition **on** when something is physically resting on a surface. 
उदाहरण: किताब शेल्फ पर रखी है।

questionText: They have been working on the project _______ until now.
explanation:
The phrase **since** is used with a starting point in time and continues up to the present. 
उदाहरण: वे परियोजना पर अब तक काम कर रहे हैं।

questionText: The committee will conduct the meeting _______ Tuesday.
explanation:
For days of the week, we use **on**. 
उदाहरण: समिति मंगलवार को बैठक करेगी।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'on'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: The painting was hung _______ the wall at a height of two meters.
explanation:
The painting is attached to the wall, so we use **on**. 
उदाहरण: पेंटिंग दीवार पर 2 मीटर ऊँचाई पर टंगी हुई है।

questionText: I wish I _______ you sooner.
explanation:
After **wish** + **I**, we use the simple past for unreal past wishes. 
उदाहरण: मैं चाहता था कि मैं तुम्हें पहले मिल पाता।
grammarRule: Verb Form – Simple Past after wish

questionText: The athlete's performance was _______ than expected.
explanation:
The comparative form of **good** is **better**. 
उदाहरण: खिलाड़ी का प्रदर्शन अपेक्षा से बेहतर रहा।

questionText: She has been working __________ the company for 3 years.
explanation:
Prepositions used with organizations.
In English: "in" is used to indicate a workplace.
हिंदी में: "कंपनी में काम करना"।

questionText: The new policy will take effect __________ next month.
explanation:
Preposition for future time frames.
In English: "in" is used for months, years, and future periods.
हिंदी में: "अगले महीने में"।

questionText: He has saved __________ money for his future.
explanation:
Quantifier with uncountable nouns like money.
In English: use "some" to indicate an unspecified amount.
हिंदी में: "कुछ पैसे"।

questionText: The teacher asked him to write a __________ essay on the topic.
explanation:
Adjective used as a noun modifier.
In English: "short" modifies "essay".
हिंदी में: "छोटी निबंध"।

questionText: She was amazed __________ the news.
explanation:
Idiomatic preposition after "amazed".
In English: the correct preposition is "by".
हिंदी में: "ख़बर से चकित"।

questionText: The meeting was postponed __________ the heavy rain.
explanation:
Preposition to express reason.
In English: "because of" indicates cause.
हिंदी में: "भारी बारिश के कारण"।

questionText: They have been living there __________ 10 years.
explanation:
Preposition for duration of time.
In English: use "for" with a period of time.
हिंदी में: "10 साल के लिए"।

questionText: She is responsible __________ the project.
explanation:
Fixed phrase "responsible for".
In English: the preposition after "responsible" is "for".
हिंदी में: "जिम्मेदार है"।

questionText: The book is __________ (adj) than the previous edition.
explanation:
Comparative form of the adjective "good".
In English: use "better" for comparison.
हिंदी में: "बेहतर"।

questionText: He always arrives __________ the train station at 7 am.
explanation:
Preposition for specific time and place.
In English: "at" is used for exact times and points.
हिंदी में: "7 बजे स्टेशन पर"।

questionText: The committee has decided to ___ the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation:
The infinitive form of the verb is used after 'to'.
उदाहरण: The committee has decided to *postpone* the meeting.

questionText: She has been working at the firm ___ 2010.
explanation:
Use *since* to indicate a point of time from the past to the present.
उदाहरण: She has been working at the firm *since* 2010.

questionText: The students were asked to ___ the essay by the end of the week.
explanation:
The base form of the verb is required after 'to' in the infinitive.
उदाहरण: The students were asked to *submit* the essay.

questionText: It is essential that every employee ___ the safety protocols.
explanation:
Subjunctive mood requires the base form of the verb after *that*.
उदाहरण: It is essential that every employee *observe* the safety protocols.

questionText: The new policy will ___ the current system by 2025.
explanation:
The base form of the verb follows *will*.
उदाहरण: The new policy will *revise* the current system.

questionText: The new law will ___ the rights of citizens.
explanation:
Base form of the verb after *will*.
उदाहरण: The new law will *protect* the rights of citizens.

questionText: He has been praised ___ his outstanding performance.
explanation:
The correct preposition after *praised* is *for*.
उदाहरण: He has been praised *for* his outstanding performance.

questionText: The company needs to ___ its product i on capacity.
explanation:
Base form of the verb follows *to*.
उदाहरण: The company needs to *increase* its production capacity.

questionText: The direct or was ___ to a new position.
explanation:
Past participle *promoted* is used after *was* in passive construction.
उदाहरण: The director was *promoted* to a new position.

questionText: She is known ___ her quick wit.
explanation:
The phrase *known for* is followed by *for*.
उदाहरण: She is known *for* her quick wit.

questionText: During the conference, the speaker emphasized the need to ___ innovative solutions.
explanation:
Base form of the verb after *to* in infinitive.
उदाहरण: The speaker emphasized the need to *develop* innovative solutions.

questionText: She has been working ___ the company for 5 years.
explanation:
We use the preposition **for** to indicate a period of time. 
उदाहरण: "मैं तीन साल से इस कंपनी में काम कर रहा हूँ।"

questionText: They arrived ___ the station just in time.
explanation:
The preposition **at** is used with a point or a specific location. 
उदाहरण: "वे स्टेशन पर समय पर पहुंचे।"

questionText: I have never ___ such a beautiful painting.
explanation:
After a perfect‑tense verb (have/has/had), we use the past participle form. **Seen** is the past participle of see. 
उदाहरण: "मैंने कभी ऐसी सुंदर पेंटिंग नहीं देखी है।"

questionText: It was a ___ decision to cancel the meeting.
explanation:
The adjective **sensible** describes a good, practical choice. 
उदाहरण: "बैठक रद्द करने का निर्णय समझदारी भरा था।"

questionText: He apologized ___ his mistake.
explanation:
We use the preposition **for** after apologise to indicate the reason. 
उदाहरण: "उसने अपनी गलती के लिए माफी मांगी।"

questionText: By the time the train arrived, the passengers ___.
explanation:
The past perfect **had left** shows an action completed before another past event. 
उदाहरण: "ट्रेन आने तक, यात्री निकल चुके थे।"

questionText: The scientist's discovery was hailed as a ___ breakthrough.
explanation:
The hyphenated adjective **ground-breaking** means revolutionary. 
उदाहरण: "वैज्ञानिक की खोज को एक क्रांतिकारी सफलता कहा गया।"

questionText: The book is ___ the table.
explanation:
The preposition **on** indicates something placed on top of a surface. 
उदाहरण: "किताब मेज़ पर है।"

questionText: She was ___ to the party because she had a fever.
explanation:
The past participle **invited** is used after the simple past verb *was*. 
उदाहरण: "वह पार्टी के लिए आमंत्रित थी क्योंकि उसे बुखार था।"

questionText: He was known for his ___ attitude towards learning.
explanation:
The adjective **enthusiastic** describes having enthusiasm. 
उदाहरण: "वह सीखने के प्रति उत्साही रवैया रखता था।"

questionText: Which option below contains the correct spelling?
explanation:
The correct form is *definitely*, with the suffix *-ly*.
उदाहरण: *definitely* का सही वर्तनी है।

questionText: She will ___ to the office tomorrow.
explanation:
Rule in English: The correct spelling has double 'c' and double 'm' before the 'ate' ending.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "accommodate" शब्द में दो "c" और दो "m" होते हैं।
grammarRule: Double consonants in the root word

questionText: He was ___ at the party.
explanation:
Rule in English: After the root 'defin', the correct suffix is 'itely' with an 'i' before the 'tly'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "definitely" शब्द में "i" को "tly" से पहले रखा जाता है।

questionText: Please ___ the documents before signing.
explanation:
Rule in English: The word contains an 'a' after the 'p', not an 'e'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "separate" में "a" आता है, "e" नहीं।
grammarRule: Correct vowel usage in root words

questionText: I will ___ the package to the courier.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb takes 'c' before 'r' and the ending is 'eve'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "receive" शब्द में "c" के बाद "r" आता है।

questionText: The event has ___ a significant impact on the economy.
explanation:
Rule in English: The past tense of 'occur' is spelled with double 'r' and double 'e' before the ending.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "occurred" में दो "r" और दो "e" होते हैं।
grammarRule: Double consonants in past tense verbs

questionText: The scientist studied the behavior of __ particles.
explanation:
Rule in English: The correct prefix is "nuclear" with an 'e' after the 'u'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "nuclear" में "e" आता है।

questionText: They aim to ___ new skills for the project.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb is spelled with a 'c' after the 'a' and 'q' before 'u'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "acquire" में "c" और "q" का सही क्रम है।

questionText: The judge issued a ___ for the defendant to pay damages.
explanation:
Rule in English: The noun is spelled with double 'r' and double 't' after the 'wa'.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "warrant" में दो "r" और दो "t" होते हैं।

questionText: She has ___ a reputation for punctuality in her career.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb is spelled with double 'm' and double 't' before the 'ed' ending.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "committed" में दो "m" और दो "t" होते हैं।

questionText: The teacher said, "___, you can proceed with the experiment.
explanation:
Rule in English: The adverb is spelled "furthermore" with an 'o' after 'm' and an 'e' at the end.
उदाहरण के तौर पर, "furthermore" का सही रूप है।

questionText: The committee, __________, decided to postpone the meeting.
explanation:
The phrase requires the singular form ‘discussion’ because the verb ‘after’ is followed by a singular noun. Rule: Use singular noun after prepositions like ‘after’ when referring to a single event.
उदाहरण: After a brief discussion, the committee decided to postpone the meeting.

questionText: She was praised for her courage, __________.
explanation:
The relative pronoun ‘which’ is appropriate for objects. The verb should be in past perfect ‘shown’. Rule: Use ‘which’ for objects and correct past participle.
उदाहरण: She was praised for her courage, which she had shown.

questionText: The results are expected to be published, __________.
explanation:
The clause refers to ‘results’ (plural noun), so ‘which’ is correct. Also ‘researchers’ should be plural. Rule: Use ‘which’ for objects, match number.
उदाहरण: The results are expected to be published, which will help researchers.

questionText: He has been working on the project, __________.
options: which he had started last week
who he had started last week
explanation:
The clause refers to the project (object), so ‘which’ is correct, and the verb should be past perfect ‘started’.
उदाहरण: He has been working on the project, which he had started last week.
grammarRule: Relative clause for objects with past perfect

questionText: The book, __________, was sold out within a day.
options: which was written by a renowned author
who was written by a renowned author
which was written by renowned author
who was written by renowned author
explanation:
The book is a noun; use ‘which’. The adjective ‘renowned’ needs a definite article ‘a’ before it. Rule: Use ‘which’ for inanimate objects and proper article usage.
उदाहरण: The book, which was written by a renowned author, was sold out within a day.
grammarRule: Relative pronoun for nouns and article usage

questionText: Both teams, __________, will compete in the final match.
explanation:
The subject ‘both teams’ is plural, so ‘who’ and ‘have’ are appropriate. Rule: Use ‘who’ for people and ‘have’ for plural subjects.
उदाहरण: Both teams, who have trained hard, will compete in the final match.
grammarRule: Relative pronoun for people with plural subject

questionText: The manager, __________, will address the issue in the meeting.
explanation:
The manager is a person, so ‘who’ is correct, and the verb form should be ‘will take’ (not takes). Rule: Use ‘who’ for people and base form after modal verbs.
उदाहरण: The manager, who will take charge, will address the issue in the meeting.
grammarRule: Relative pronoun for people with modal verbs

questionText: The proposal, __________, was rejected by the board.
explanation:
The proposal is an object, so ‘which’ is correct. The passive form ‘had been presented’ is required. Rule: Use ‘which’ with passive past perfect.
उदाहरण: The proposal, which had been presented, was rejected by the board.
grammarRule: Relative clause with passive past perfect

questionText: The students, __________, were given extra time for the exam.
explanation:
The subject ‘students’ is plural and refers to people, so ‘who’ is correct. The verb should be past perfect ‘had requested’. Rule: Use ‘who’ for people, past perfect for completed action.
उदाहरण: The students, who had requested it, were given extra time for the exam.
grammarRule: Relative pronoun for people with past perfect

questionText: The software, __________, is user-friendly and efficient.
options: which has been developed by experts
who has been developed by experts
which has been developed by expert
who has been developed by expert
explanation:
The software is an object, so ‘which’ should be used. Also ‘experts’ is plural. Rule: Use ‘which’ for inanimate objects and plural noun for experts.
उदाहरण: The software, which has been developed by experts, is user-friendly and efficient.
grammarRule: Relative pronoun for objects with plural noun

questionText: increase
explanation:
Rule in English: Increase means to make something larger. The opposite of increase is decrease.
उदा. किसी वस्तु को बढ़ाने के बजाय उसे घटाना उसका विपरीत है।

questionText: childish
explanation:
Rule in English: Childish describes immature behavior. The opposite is mature, which denotes adulthood or fully developed behavior.
उदा. बालसुलभ व्यवहार का विपरीत परिपक्व व्यवहार है।

questionText: obscure
explanation:
Rule in English: Obscure means not clear or difficult to understand. The opposite is clear, which means easy to perceive or understand.
उदा. अस्पष्ट का विपरीत स्पष्ट है।

questionText: unfair
explanation:
Rule in English: Unfair denotes injustice or lack of fairness. The opposite is just, which signifies fairness and equality.
उदा. अन्याय का विपरीत न्याय है।

questionText: descend
explanation:
Rule in English: Descend means to go down. The opposite action is ascend, meaning to go up.
उदा. नीचे उतरने का विपरीत ऊपर चढ़ना है।

questionText: succeed
explanation:
Rule in English: Succeed means to achieve a desired result. The opposite is fail, which means not to achieve the result.
उदा. सफलता का विपरीत विफलता है।

questionText: narrow
explanation:
Rule in English: Narrow describes something that is not wide. The opposite is wide, which means having a large breadth.
उदा. संकीर्ण का विपरीत चौड़ा है।

questionText: generous
explanation:
Rule in English: Generous means willing to give. The opposite is selfish, meaning concerned only with oneself.
उदा. उदार का विपरीत स्वार्थी है।

questionText: fragile
explanation:
Rule in English: Fragile indicates something that can be easily broken. The opposite is strong, meaning sturdy and not easily damaged.
उदा. कोमल का विपरीत मजबूत है।

questionText: Plethora
explanation:
Rule in English: An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word. Udaahaaran: Plethora (excess) → Scarcity (lack).
उदाहरण: Plethora का विपरीत शब्द Scarcity होता है।

questionText: Dilapidated
explanation:
Rule in English: Dilapidated means broken or fallen into ruin. Its opposite is pristine, meaning clean or in perfect condition.
उदाहरण: Dilapidated का विपरीत शब्द Pristine है।

questionText: Thorough
explanation:
Rule in English: Thorough means complete or exhaustive. Superficial means shallow or incomplete.
उदाहरण: Thorough का विपरीत शब्द Superficial होता है।

questionText: Expedite
explanation:
Rule in English: Expedite means to make something happen faster. Delay means to postpone or slow down.
उदाहरण: Expedite का विपरीत शब्द Delay है।

questionText: Enormous
explanation:
Rule in English: Enormous means very large. Minuscule means very small, the opposite meaning.
उदाहरण: Enormous का विपरीत शब्द Minuscule है।

questionText: Obsolete
explanation:
Rule in English: Obsolete means no longer in use or outdated. Current means in use now.
उदाहरण: Obsolete का विपरीत शब्द Current है।

questionText: Generous
explanation:
Rule in English: Generous means giving or kind. Selfish means not giving or caring.
उदाहरण: Generous का विपरीत शब्द Selfish है।

questionText: Transient
explanation:
Rule in English: Transient means lasting only for a short time. Perpetual means lasting forever, the opposite.
उदाहरण: Transient का विपरीत शब्द Perpetual है।

questionText: Lucid
explanation:
Rule in English: Lucid means clear or easy to understand. Obscure means unclear or difficult to understand.
उदाहरण: Lucid का विपरीत शब्द Obscure है।

questionText: Punctual
explanation:
Rule in English: Punctual means arriving at the right time. Late means arriving after the scheduled time.
उदाहरण: Punctual का विपरीत शब्द Late है।

questionText: scarce
explanation:

questionText: abundant
explanation:
Rule in English: An antonym of a word expresses the contrary meaning.
उदाहरण: "abundant" का विपरीत "scarce" है।

questionText: tall
explanation:
Rule in English: Words having opposite meanings are antonyms.
उदाहरण: "tall" का विपरीत "short" है।

questionText: modern
explanation:
Rule in English: Antonyms are words with opposite meanings.

questionText: expand
explanation:

questionText: honest
explanation:
Rule in English: Antonyms are words with opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: "honest" का विपरीत "dishonest" है।

questionText: smooth
explanation:
Rule in English: Antonyms express the contrary meaning.

questionText: public
explanation:
Rule in English: Antonyms are words with opposite meanings.
उदाहरण: "public" का विपरीत "private" है।

questionText: sparse
explanation:
An antonym is a word that expresses the opposite meaning of another word. For example, 'sparse' means not dense, while its antonym 'dense' means closely packed.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'sparse' का अर्थ  होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'dense'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) dense • (B) thin • (C) light • (D) few

questionText: frugal
explanation:
An antonym denotes a contrasting meaning. 'Frugal' means careful with money; its opposite is 'extravagant', meaning spending freely.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'frugal' का अर्थ (मितव्ययी / सोच-समझकर खर्च करने वाला) होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'extravagant' (फिजूलखर्ची) इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) extravagant: फिजूलखर्ची • (B) thrifty: मितव्ययी • (C) prudent: विवेकी / समझदार (Wise and careful) • (D) economical

questionText: ancient
explanation:
Antonyms are words with opposite meanings. 'Ancient' refers to something very old, whereas 'modern' refers to something current or recent.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'ancient' का अर्थ  होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'modern'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) modern • (B) old • (C) archaic: प्राचीन • (D) time-honored

questionText: diligent
explanation:
An antonym is a word that means the opposite. 'Diligent' means hardworking; its opposite, 'indolent', means lazy.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'diligent' का अर्थ (मेहनती / परिश्रमी) होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'indolent'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) indolent • (B) persistent • (C) hardworking • (D) assiduous

questionText: ambitious
explanation:
Antonyms express contrasting meanings. 'Ambitious' means eager to achieve; 'content' means satisfied with what one has.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'ambitious' का अर्थ  होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'content' (सामग्री) इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) aspiring • (B) goals • (C) satisfied • (D) content: सामग्री

questionText: generous
explanation:
An antonym is a word with the opposite sense. 'Generous' means giving freely; its opposite is 'selfish', meaning concerned only with oneself.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'generous' का अर्थ (उदार) होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'selfish'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) selfish • (B) kind • (C) giving • (D) benevolent: दयालु / परोपकारी

questionText: opaque
explanation:
Antonyms are words that express opposing meanings. 'Opaque' means not see-through; 'transparent' means fully see-through.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'opaque' का अर्थ (अस्पष्ट) होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'transparent'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) translucent • (B) transparent • (C) cloudy • (D) shadowy

questionText: promote
explanation:
An antonym denotes a contrary action. 'Promote' means to support or advance; 'hinder' means to obstruct or delay.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'promote' का अर्थ  होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'hinder' (बाधा पहुंचाना) इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) advocate • (B) hinder: बाधा पहुंचाना • (C) endorse • (D) support

questionText: elevate
explanation:
Antonyms convey opposite meanings. 'Elevate' means to raise; 'lower' means to reduce or bring down.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'elevate' का अर्थ (तरक्की) होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'lower'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) lower • (B) raise • (C) lift • (D) heighten

questionText: compassionate
explanation:
An antonym is a word with an opposite meaning. 'Compassionate' means caring and empathetic; 'indifferent' means uninterested or unconcerned.

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: 'compassionate' का अर्थ  होता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में से 'indifferent'  इसका सटीक विलोम शब्द (Antonym) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) empathy: सहानुभूति / परानुभूति • (B) indifferent • (C) sympathy • (D) caring

questionText: He was very ________ when the news came out, refusing to speak to anyone.
explanation:
The sentence requires a word that means "expressing regret or remorse".

Rule: Use a single word that captures the long description. Example: "He was very **apologetic** when the news came out, refusing to speak to anyone."

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त एक शब्द (One Word Substitute) 'apologetic'  है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) apologetic • (B) suspicious • (C) indifferent • (D) indulgent

questionText: The manager’s decision was a ________ move that benefited the whole team.
explanation:
The phrase needs a word meaning "wise or shrewd".

Rule: Replace long descriptions with a single adjective. Example: "The manager’s decision was a **sagacious** move that benefited the whole team."

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त एक शब्द (One Word Substitute) 'sagacious'  है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) sagacious • (B) haphazard: बेतरतीब • (C) indistinct • (D) distracted

questionText: She gave a ________ explanation that left every one puzzled.
explanation:
The context indicates a brief explanation.

Rule: Choose a word that means "short and clear". Example: "She gave a **concise** explanation that left everyone puzzled."

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त एक शब्द (One Word Substitute) 'concise' (संक्षिप्त) है।

📝 **विकल्पों का अर्थ (Options)**: (A) concise: संक्षिप्त • (B) elaborate: विस्तार में बताना • (C) articulate • (D) inadequate

questionText: The new policy will ________ the current bottlenecks in the system.
explanation:
We need a word that means "improve or make better".

Rule: Replace a long phrase with a single verb. Example: "The new policy will **ameliorate** the current bottlenecks in the system."

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: दिए गए वाक्यांश के लिए उपयुक्त एक शब्द (One Word Substitute) 'ameliorate' (सुधारना) है।

questionText: The new software is expected to ________ the efficiency of the workflow.

questionText: The state of not knowing.

questionText: The data <u>was being analyzed< / u> by the team.

questionText: The committee <u>has decided to approve< / u> the proposal.

questionText: The manager was praised by the team, who had been working diligently, for their exceptional leader ship.
options: The manager was praised by the team, who had been working diligently for their exceptional leadership.
For their exceptional leadership, the manager was praised by the team, who had been working diligently.
The manager was praised by the team for their exceptional leadership, who had been working diligently.
The manager was praised, for their exceptional leadership, by the team who had been working diligently.
explanation:
The relative clause ‘who had been working diligently’ should directly follow the noun it modifies (the team) and not be separated by the phrase ‘for their exceptional leadership’.
Hindi: ‘who had been working diligently’ को ‘the team’ के बाद रखना चाहिए, न कि ‘for their exceptional leadership’ के बाद।

questionText: The committee, which had been formed last year, will conduct the audit in the upcoming month.
options: The committee, which had been formed last year, will conduct the audit in the upcoming month.
The committee will conduct the audit in the upcoming month, which had been formed last year.
The committee will conduct the audit in the upcoming month, having been formed last year.
The committee, having been formed last year, will conduct the audit in the upcoming month.
explanation:
The participial phrase ‘having been formed last year’ correctly provides additional information about the committee without interrupting the main clause.
Hindi: ‘having been formed last year’ को ‘the committee’ के बाद रखना चाहिए, ताकि वाक्य सुचारू रहे।

questionText: The new policy, being implemented this semester, will affect all students who have enrolled for the course.
options: The new policy will affect all students who have enrolled for the course, being implemented this semester.
The new policy, being implemented this semester, will affect all students who have enrolled for the course.
The new policy, will affect all students who have enrolled for the course, being implemented this semester.
The new policy being implemented this semester will affect all students who have enrolled for the course.
explanation:
The participial phrase ‘being implemented this semester’ is correctly placed after the subject and before the main verb.
Hindi: ‘being implemented this semester’ को ‘the new policy’ के बाद रखना चाहिए।

questionText: Although the project was completed on time, the results were disappointing, and the team is disappointed.

questionText: The manager, who had been leading the project for five years, will be replaced by a younger employee.

The manager will be replaced by a younger employee, who had been leading the project for five years.

questionText: The new software, which is user-friendly, is expected to improve productivity significantly.

questionText: The teacher, who had been teaching for 15 years, will retire next month.
options: The teacher, who had been teaching for 15 years, will retire next month.
The teacher will retire next month, who had been teaching for 15 years.

questionText: The company has been expanding its operations, which has increased the workload for employees.

The company has been expanding its operations, which increased the workload for employees.

questionText: The new policy, which will take effect next month, aims to improve employee morale.

questionText: The students, who are studying in the city, will attend the seminar next week.
options: The students, who are studying in the city, will attend the seminar next week.
The students will attend the seminar next week, who are studying in the city.

questionText: Choose the correct alternative to replace the underlined phrase in the following sentence: <u>It does not matter how the plan is executed, as long as the end result is achieved.< / u>
options: It does not matter how the plan is executed, provided the end result is achieved.
It does not matter how the plan is executed, unless the end result is achieved.
It does not matter how the plan is executed, though the end result is achieved.
It does not matter how the plan is executed, when the end result is achieved.
explanation:

questionText: Choose the correct alternative to replace the underlined phrase in the following sentence: <u>She has been working on the project for three years, and her efforts have paid off.< / u>

questionText: Read the following passage and The children were playing in the park when the rain started. The team has been winning every match this season. She had finished her home work and then she was going to the cinema. They will go to the market tomorrow. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
In segment (A) the verb *were* should agree with the singular subject *child*. The correct form is *was*.

Rule: Subject‑verb agreement requires singular verb with singular subject and plural verb with plural subject.
उदाहरण: "The child **was** playing."

questionText: Read the following passage and The committee decided to postpone the meeting. Each of the students has submitted his or her assignment. The manager said that the project would be completed on time. The results were presented to the board. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (B) uses the singular pronoun *his or her* with the plural subject *students*. It should be *their*.

Rule: Pronoun‑antecedent agreement requires the pronoun to match the number of its antecedent.
उदाहरण: "Each of the students has submitted **their** assignment."

questionText: Read the following passage and He has been studying for exams since last year. The project was completed and the results were published. They had started the competition when the judge arrived. She will finishes the task by tomorrow. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (D) incorrectly pairs the modal *will* with the third‑person singular verb *finishes*. It should be *finish*.

Rule: After modal verbs, the base form of the verb is used.
उदाहरण: "She will **finish** the task by tomorrow."

questionText: Read the following passage and The cat is sleeping under the table. Please bring the documents to the office. We are going to the beach and we will have a picnic. The student’s performance was very good. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (C) contains a comma splice: two independent clauses joined only by a comma. It should be separated by a semicolon or conjunction.

Rule: Independent clauses must not be joined by a comma alone.
उदाहरण: "We are going to the beach; we will have a picnic."

questionText: Read the following passage and There are many reasons for the delay. The team, as well as the coach, were disappointed. I have visited many countries. She has been working here for three years. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (B) has a subject‑verb disagreement: the compound subject *team* and *coach* is singular, so the verb should be *was*.

Rule: Singular compound subject takes singular verb.
उदाहरण: "The team, as well as the coach, **was** disappointed."

questionText: Read the following passage and The in form at i on was shared with the public. He gave me a book, and I looked at it. We will attend the meeting tomorrow. They had been waiting for the announcement. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (A) incorrectly places the article *the* before *information*, which is uncountable. It should be omitted.

Rule: Uncountable nouns do not require an article in the singular form.
उदाहरण: "The **information** was shared with the public."

questionText: Read the following passage and The manager asked me if I was ready. She has been working here since 2010. The students had completed the assignments and they were ready to submit. The weather had been very hot, therefore we went to the pool. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (D) uses *therefore* incorrectly; the correct conjunction is *so* or *therefore* should be followed by a comma.

Rule: Conjunctions like *therefore* need proper punctuation and placement.
उदाहरण: "The weather had been very hot, **so** we went to the pool."

questionText: Read the following passage and He is a good student, but he sometimes forgets his home work. The data shows a significant rise in temperature. The committee has been meeting every week. She was the best player of the team. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:
Segment (D) uses *of* after *best* incorrectly. It should be *in*.

Rule: *Best* as a superlative is followed by *in*, not *of*.
उदाहरण: "She was the best player **in** the team."

questionText: Read the following passage and The teacher asked the students to submit the assignments. She has been learning English since she was five years old. They have to finish the project by Friday. The city has increased its population by 10%. Which segment contains an error?
explanation:

Rule: *Since* is used for a starting point; *for* indicates duration.
उदाहरण: "She has been learning English **for** five years."

questionText: Read the following passage and The students had completed the test before the clock struck noon. He was walking home when he realised that he had lost his keys. The report was submitted to the manager. The results were the best in the sector. Which segment contains an error?

उदाहरण: "The results were **best** in the sector."

यहाँ 'had studied' सही है, 'had been studying' गलत।
grammarRule: Simple past perfect vs. past perfect continuous

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase: "The committee **has decided** to postpone the meeting.
explanation:
The correct form is **has decided**; adding prepositions changes the meaning and is incorrect.
यहाँ 'has decided' सही है, अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं।

questionText: The underlined part should be replaced: "The new manager **is being appointed** next week.
explanation:
The future simple **will be appointed** is appropriate for a scheduled event; present continuous passive is wrong.
यहाँ 'will be appointed' सही है।

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase: "The students **have been studying** for the exam.
explanation:
The simple present perfect **have studied** fits the context; the continuous form is unnecessary.
यहाँ 'have studied' सही है।
grammarRule: Present perfect vs. present perfect continuous

questionText: The underlined part should be replaced: "The report **has been written** by the team.
explanation:
The passive form **has been written** is correct; the active form would change the subject.
यहाँ 'has been written' सही है।

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase: "They **will have finished** the project by next month.
explanation:
The future perfect **will have finished** correctly expresses completion before a future time.
अंतिम वाक्य 'will have finished' सही है।

questionText: The new policy, **which was introduced last month**, has already received mixed reviews from employees.
options: that has been introduced last month
which has been introduced last month
explanation:
When referring to a singular noun (policy), use 'that' for restrictive clauses. 
उदाहरण: The new policy that was introduced last month has already received mixed reviews.

questionText: The committee, **including the chair man the secretary, and the treasurer**, will meet tomorrow.
options: including the chairman, the secretary, and the treasurer
who includes the chairman, the secretary, and the treasurer
which includes the chairman, the secretary, and the treasurer
including the chairman, the secretary and the treasurer
explanation:
Use a comma-separated list after 'including' without an additional conjunction. 
उदाहरण: The committee, including the chairman, the secretary, and the treasurer, will meet tomorrow.

questionText: She is confident, **despite the fact that many experts doubt her abilities**.
options: despite the fact that many experts doubt her abilities
despite the fact that many experts doubt her ability
despite many experts doubt her abilities
despite many experts doubting her abilities
explanation:
Use 'despite the fact that' followed by a clause. 
उदाहरण: She is confident, despite the fact that many experts doubt her abilities.

questionText: The report, **which is due next week, will be submitted by the end of the month**, has already been approved.
options: which is due next week, will be submitted by the end of the month
which is due next week and will be submitted by the end of the month
which, being due next week, will be submitted by the end of the month
which, due next week, will be submitted by the end of the month
explanation:
Use 'which' to introduce a non-restrictive clause with commas. 
उदाहरण: The report, which is due next week, will be submitted by the end of the month, has already been approved.

questionText: The software, **by which the users are able to generate reports** in seconds, has become popular.
options: by which the users are able to generate reports in seconds
by which users can generate reports in seconds
by which users are able to generate reports in seconds
by which users can generate reports in seconds in seconds
explanation:
Use 'by which' followed by an infinitive phrase when describing means. 
उदाहरण: The software, by which users can generate reports in seconds, has become popular.

questionText: The project was completed on time, **although the team had faced several delays** during the initial phase.
options: although the team had faced several delays during the initial phase
although the team had faced several delays during the initial phases
although the team faced several delays during the initial phase
although the team had faced several delays in the initial phase
explanation:
Use 'although' with past simple when the action occurred before the main clause. 
उदाहरण: The project was completed on time, although the team had faced several delays during the initial phase.

questionText: The book, **having been written by a renowned author**, is a must read for every one.
options: having been written by a renowned author
which has been written by a renowned author
who has written a renowned author
having written by a renowned author
explanation:
Use 'having been' for a passive participial phrase. 
उदाहरण: The book, having been written by a renowned author, is a must-read for everyone.

questionText: The manager, **whose suggestions improved the process**, received a bonus.
options: who has suggested improving the process
who had suggested improving the process
explanation:
Use 'whose' as a possessive relative pronoun for people. 
उदाहरण: The manager, whose suggestions improved the process, received a bonus.

questionText: The plan, **being implemented across all branches**, aims to reduce costs.
options: has been implemented across all branches
explanation:
Use 'being' for an ongoing passive action. 
उदाहरण: The plan, being implemented across all branches, aims to reduce costs.

questionText: The seminar, **which was attended by experts from various fields, covered a wide range of topics**, is now archived.
options: which was attended by experts from various fields, covered a wide range of topics
which was attended by experts from various fields and covered a wide range of topics
which was attended by experts from various fields, has covered a wide range of topics
which was attended by experts from various fields covering a wide range of topics
explanation:
Use 'and' to join two main actions in a non-restrictive clause. 
उदाहरण: The seminar, which was attended by experts from various fields and covered a wide range of topics, is now archived.

questionText: The report, **which has been reviewed by the senior management**, will be published next week.
options: which has been reviewed by the senior management
which reviewed by the senior management
which was reviewed by the senior management
which are reviewed by the senior management
explanation:
Use present perfect passive for an action completed before now. 
उदाहरण: The report, which has been reviewed by the senior management, will be published next week.
grammarRule: Present perfect passive / Has been + past participle

questionText: The committee was satisfied with the project, the fact that the project was completed on time.
options: The committee was satisfied with the project, that the project was completed on time.
The committee was satisfied with the project, when the project was completed on time.
The committee was satisfied with the project, since the project was completed on time.
The committee was satisfied with the project, because the project was completed on time.
explanation:
The phrase *the fact that* is redundant when the clause already explains the fact. Drop *the fact* and use *that* to link the clause.
उदाहरण: The committee was satisfied with the project, that the project was completed on time.

questionText: She was praised for her efforts, in spite of the fact that she had not received any formal training.
options: She was praised for her efforts, despite the fact that she had not received any formal training.
She was praised for her efforts, in spite of she had not received any formal training.
She was praised for her efforts, despite she had not received any formal training.
She was praised for her efforts, in spite of that she had not received any formal training.
explanation:
Use *despite* or *in spite of* followed by a noun phrase or a clause; the clause should begin with *that*.
उदाहरण: She was praised for her efforts, despite the fact that she had not received any formal training.

questionText: The report, which is due next week, needs to be completed by tomorrow, **by means of** the new software.
explanation:
The idiomatic phrase *by means of* is incorrect here. Use *by utilizing* or *by using* to indicate the method.
उदाहरण: The report needs to be completed by utilizing the new software.

questionText: The new policy will be implemented, **on account of** the recent changes in regulations.
explanation:
*On account of* is an overly formal and rarely used phrase in contemporary English. Replace it with *due to* for clarity.
उदाहरण: The new policy will be implemented due to the recent changes in regulations.

questionText: The project was delayed, **in the event of** unforeseen circumstances.
explanation:
*In the event of* is used for future possibilities, not for past causes. Use *in case of* or *because of* to indicate the cause.
उदाहरण: The project was delayed in case of unforeseen circumstances.

questionText: He was appointed as the head of the department, **for the purpose of** ensuring better coordination.
explanation:
*For the purpose of* is unnecessarily wordy. Replace it with the more concise *to ensure*.
उदाहरण: He was appointed as the head of the department to ensure better coordination.

questionText: The committee, **in terms of** its size, is one of the largest in the organization.
explanation:
*In terms of* can be replaced by the more common *with respect to* in formal writing.
उदाहरण: The committee, with respect to its size, is one of the largest.

questionText: She has been working on the project **over the past year**.
explanation:
*Over the past year* is incorrect; the correct preposition is *for*. 
उदाहरण: She has been working on the project for the past year.

questionText: The company decided to expand its operations in the country **although** it faced several challenges.
explanation:
*Although* is a conjunction, not a preposition; the correct preposition is *despite*.
उदाहरण: The company decided to expand its operations in the country despite several challenges.
grammarRule: Correct use of prepositions vs. conjunctions

questionText: The research findings were presented **by the team** during the conference.
explanation:
*By the team* indicates authorship. The sentence is correct as it stands; the other options change meaning.
उदाहरण: The research findings were presented by the team during the conference.

questionText: Identify the misspelled word in the following sentence: "She definately needs to improve her spelling.
explanation:
"Definitely" is spelled with an 'i' before the 'e' after a consonant. 
उदा. सही स्पेलिंग: definitely
grammarRule: i before e except after c

questionText: Identify the misspelled word from the list below.
explanation: Rule: The correct spelling is ‘separate’ with an ‘a’ after ‘e’. ‘seperate’ is a frequent error. Example: 'separate' (सेपरेट).
grammarRule: Correct order of vowels in common words

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence: "The project was neccessary for the team.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'necessary' with a single 'c' after 'ne'.
उदाहरण: The team found the meeting necessary.

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the phrase: "He has a lot of expeience.
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'experience' with 'r' after 'e'.
उदाहरण: She has a great amount of experience.

questionText: She was awarded the prize ___ her outstanding performance in the competition.
explanation:
The preposition *for* is used after the verb *awarded* to indicate the reason or cause.
उदा. "He was awarded the award **for** his bravery."

questionText: The scientist was praised ___ his discovery of the new particle.
explanation:
The verb *praised* is followed by *for* to specify the reason.
उदा. "He was praised **for** his dedication."

questionText: He has been working ___ this company since 2010.
explanation:
The preposition *at* is used with *company* to denote the place of employment.
उदा. "I work **at** a bank."

questionText: The committee will meet ___ Friday morning to discuss the proposal.
explanation:
The preposition *on* is used with days and dates.
उदा. "We will meet **on** Monday."

questionText: I can't believe he forgot ___ the meeting.
explanation:
After *forgot*, the preposition *about* is used to refer to an event.
उदा. "She forgot **about** her appointment."

questionText: The policy was enacted ___ the early 1990s.
explanation:
The preposition *in* is used with a decade or period.
उदा. "It began **in** the 1980s."

questionText: They are planning to launch the product ___ the next quarter.
explanation:
The preposition *in* is used with a time period such as a quarter or year.
उदा. "We will finish **in** June."

questionText: The book, ___ author is renowned world wide, was published last year.
explanation:
The relative pronoun *whose* indicates possession of the author.
उदा. "The novel, **whose** protagonist is famous, won awards."

questionText: He succeeded ___ the project manager's resignation.
explanation:
The preposition *after* is used to indicate a sequence of events.
उदा. "He succeeded **after** the CEO left."

questionText: The company has seen a sharp decline ___ revenue in the last quarter.
explanation:
The phrase *decline of revenue* uses *of* to link the noun *decline* with the thing that declined.
उदा. "A decline **of** sales was noted."

questionText: She has been working ___ the company for over a decade.
explanation:
The preposition *in* is used with *company* when referring to being employed inside the organization.
Example in Hindi: वह कंपनी में दस साल से काम कर रही है।
grammarRule: Preposition after the verb *have been working*

questionText: The manager was ___ the meeting when the fire alarm rang.
explanation:
The preposition *at* is used to indicate the location of a meeting. *In* is used for a room, not a meeting itself.
Hindi: जब फायर अलार्म बजा, तो मैनेजर बैठक में था।
grammarRule: Preposition indicating location of an event

questionText: After the present at i on, the committee asked the speaker to ___ a brief summary.
explanation:
The infinitive form *write* follows the verb *asked* in the past tense. *Wrote* is past tense but not suitable after *asked* in this construction.
Hindi: प्रस्तुति के बाद, समिति ने वक्ता से संक्षिप्त सारांश लिखने के लिए कहा।
grammarRule: Infinitive after the verb *ask* in past tense

questionText: The policy will be effective ___ the next fiscal year.
explanation:
The preposition *in* is used to refer to a period of time, such as a fiscal year. *By* indicates a deadline, not a time frame.
Hindi: नीति अगले वित्तीय वर्ष में प्रभावी होगी।

questionText: The students were asked to submit their reports ___ Friday.
explanation:
The preposition *on* is used with days of the week. *By* would indicate a deadline, but *on* is correct here.
Hindi: छात्रों से रिपोर्ट शुक्रवार को जमा करने के लिए कहा गया।
grammarRule: Preposition with days of the week

questionText: He is known ___ his punctuality and attention to detail.
explanation:
The preposition *for* is used after *known* to indicate the reason or quality.
Hindi: वह अपनी समयबद्धता और विस्तृत ध्यान के लिए जाना जाता है।

questionText: The new software will ___ the process of data entry.
explanation:
The infinitive *simplify* follows the auxiliary verb *will*. The other forms are incorrect in this structure.
Hindi: नया सॉफ्टवेयर डेटा एंट्री की प्रक्रिया को सरल बनाएगा।

questionText: The river ___ the city into two parts.
explanation:
The simple present verb *divides* matches the subject *river* and describes a habitual action.
Hindi: नदी शहर को दो हिस्सों में विभाजित करती है।

questionText: The committee will convene ___ the end of the month.
explanation:
The preposition *at* is used with a specific point in time, such as the end of a month. *In* refers to a period.
Hindi: समिति महीने के अंत में मिलेंगी।

questionText: She is eager ___ learning more about data science.
explanation:
The infinitive *to* follows the adjective *eager* when expressing desire. Other prepositions are incorrect.
Hindi: वह डेटा विज्ञान के बारे में अधिक सीखने के लिए उत्सुक है।

questionText: He has ____ to finish the project before the dead line
explanation:
Use of 'have a chance to + verb' meaning opportunity.
उदा. वह जर्मनी जाने का एक मौका रखता है।

questionText: The manager was ______ by the employees for his impartiality.
explanation:
Passive construction with 'be + past participle'.
उदा. कर्मचारी उसकी निष्पक्षता के लिए उसकी प्रशंसा करते हैं।

questionText: She has been studying medicine ______ her 12th grade.
explanation:
'Since' is used to indicate the starting point of an action that continues to the present.
उदा. वह 12वीं कक्षा से ही चिकित्सा पढ़ रही है।

questionText: I am looking forward to ______ you at the conference.
explanation:
After 'look forward to' we use a gerund.
उदा. मैं सम्मेलन में आपको देखने के लिए उत्सुक हूँ।

questionText: The company announced a plan ______ reduce costs.
explanation:
A plan to + verb expresses intention.
उदा. कंपनी ने लागत घटाने की योजना की घोषणा की।

questionText: He has a habit of ______ his keys.
explanation:
Noun + of + gerund indicates habitual action.
उदा. उसका अपनी चाबियाँ खोने की आदत है।

questionText: The teacher asked the students to ______ their assignments by Monday.
explanation:
After 'ask + someone to', use infinitive.
उदा. शिक्षक ने छात्रों से सोमवार तक अपने असाइनमेंट जमा करने को कहा।

questionText: She felt ____ after hearing the news.
explanation:
After 'feel' we use adjective to describe emotion.
उदा. समाचार सुनकर वह खुश महसूस करती है।

questionText: The building was built ______ 1850.
explanation:
'Built in' is used with a year or period.
उदा. भवन 1850 में बनाया गया था।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'in'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: He is known ______ his rigorous training.
explanation:
Use 'known for' + noun or phrase.
उदा. वह अपनी कठोर प्रशिक्षण के लिए जाना जाता है।

questionText: The committee will review the proposal ______ the new policy is implemented.
explanation:
'After' is used to indicate a subsequent event.
उदा. नई नीति लागू होने के बाद समिति प्रस्ताव की समीक्षा करेगी।

questionText: The committee has decided to __________ the meeting due to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation:
The verb *postpone* means to delay something. It is followed by the object directly: *postpone the meeting*. In Hindi: "बैठक को स्थगित किया गया।"
उदा. The meeting will be postponed tomorrow.

questionText: She has been working here __________ 2010.
explanation:
Use *since* to indicate a point in time from which something has been continuous. In Hindi: "2010 से वह यहाँ काम कर रही है।"
उदा. I have lived here since 2015.

questionText: The new policy will be implemented __________ the next fiscal year.
explanation:
Use *in* to refer to a period of time: *in the next fiscal year*. In Hindi: "अगले वित्तीय वर्ष में नीति लागू की जाएगी।"
उदा. The project will finish in June.

questionText: The students were asked to __________ their assignments before the dead line
explanation:
The verb *submit* is used with the object directly: *submit their assignments*. In Hindi: "वे अपनी असाइनमेंट जमा करें।"
उदा. Please submit the report by Friday.

questionText: Despite the rain, the match continued __________.
explanation:
Use the adjective phrase *without interruption* to mean uninterrupted. In Hindi: "बारिश के बावजूद मैच बिना किसी रुकावट के चला।"
उदा. The play continued without interruption.

questionText: He was __________ to the committee for his outstanding contribution.
explanation:
When someone is selected for a role, use *nominated for*. In Hindi: "उसे उत्कृष्ट योगदान के लिए समिति में नामित किया गया।"
उदा. She was nominated for the award.

questionText: The conference will be held __________ the auditorium on Tuesday.
explanation:
Use *in* before a building or place: *in the auditorium*. In Hindi: "सम्मेलन मंगलवार को ऑडिटोरियम के अंदर आयोजित किया जाएगा।"
उदा. The event will be held in the hall.
grammarRule: Preposition for location inside a place

questionText: The manager was __________ by the employees for his fairness.
explanation:
When someone receives respect from others, use *respected by*. In Hindi: "प्रबंधक को कर्मचारियों द्वारा उनकी निष्पक्षता के कारण सम्मानित किया गया।"
उदा. She was respected by her peers.

questionText: The project is expected to be completed __________ the end of the year.
explanation:
Use *by* to indicate a deadline: *by the end of the year*. In Hindi: "परियोजना वर्ष के अंत तक पूरी होने की उम्मीद है।"
उदा. Finish the task by tonight.

questionText: The book was written __________ a renowned author.
explanation:
Use *by* to indicate authorship: *written by a renowned author*. In Hindi: "किताब एक प्रसिद्ध लेखक द्वारा लिखी गई है।"
उदा. The novel was written by the famous writer.

questionText: Which word is spelled accurately?
explanation:
Rule in English: The correct spelling is "recommendation".
उदा. सही वर्तनी: recommendation.
गलत वर्तनी: recomendation, recommedation, recommendtion.

questionText: Which word among the options is spelled incorrectly?
explanation:
Correct spelling: *Maintenance*.
नियम: 'e' के बाद 'n' आता है, 'Maintanance' गलत है।

questionText: Choose the word that is correctly spelled
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'definitely' with an 'e' after 'i'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी "definitely" है।

questionText: Which option contains an incorrectly spelled word?
explanation:
The correct spelling is 'maintenance' with 'i' after 'n'.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी "maintenance" है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word meaning "a small poisonous snake".
explanation:
The correct spelling is *viper*.
Rule: The word has a double 'p' before the suffix '-er'.
उदा. Hindi explanation: सही वर्तनी "viper" है।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word meaning "to give a warning".
explanation:
The correct spelling is *alert*.
Rule: The word is formed by rearranging the letters 'a', 'l', 'e', 'r', 't' with no extra consonants.
उदा. Hindi explanation: सही वर्तनी "alert" है।

questionText: She had finished her home work before the football match. He is going to the market to buy some fruits. The book, which was on the table, was taken by the teacher. They has been working on the project for months.
explanation:
The verb form is incorrect in (D). The subject ‘They’ is plural, so the verb should be ‘have’ not ‘has’. Correct sentence: 
*They have been working on the project for months.*

Rule: Plural subjects require plural verb forms.
उदाहरण: ‘They have’ न कि ‘They has’

questionText: The committee will discuss the proposal tomorrow. The children was playing in the garden. She is an excellent dancer. I have never seen such a beautiful painting.
explanation:
In (B) the plural noun ‘children’ requires a plural verb. It should be ‘were’ instead of ‘was’. 
*The children were playing in the garden.*

Rule: Plural subjects + plural verbs.
उदाहरण: ‘Children were’ न कि ‘Children was’

questionText: He doesn’t like to eat spicy food. The students are working in their classrooms. She has read the book which was recommended by the teacher. There is many reasons for the delay.
explanation:
In (D) the verb ‘is’ does not agree with the plural subject ‘many reasons’. It should be ‘are’. 
*There are many reasons for the delay.*

Rule: Plural subjects + plural verbs.
उदाहरण: ‘Reasons are’ न कि ‘Reasons is’

questionText: The new policy will be implemented next month. The meeting has been scheduled for Monday. The team have completed the task on time. She has a good understanding of the topic.
explanation:
In (C) the verb form is wrong. The subject ‘The team’ is singular, so ‘has’ should be used. 
*The team has completed the task on time.*

Rule: Singular subjects + singular verbs.
उदाहरण: ‘Team has’ न कि ‘Team have’

questionText: She will attend the conference tomorrow. The in form at i on given by the manager was incorrect. The students has done all the assignments. The teacher will provide the solutions to the students.
explanation:
In (C) the verb does not agree with the plural noun ‘students’. It should be ‘have’.
*The students have done all the assignments.*

Rule: Plural subjects + plural verbs.
उदाहरण: ‘Students have’ न कि ‘Students has’

questionText: I have visited many countries in Europe. The teacher was speaking to the students. He will be arriving at the station at 9 o’clock. The book was taken from the shelf by the children.
explanation:
In (A) the preposition ‘in’ is incorrectly used with a continent. It should be ‘in Europe’ or ‘to Europe’. 
*I have visited many countries in Europe.*

Rule: Prepositions with continents.
उदाहरण: ‘in Europe’ न कि ‘in Europe’

questionText: The chef cooked a delicious meal. The paintings was displayed in the gallery. The team won the championship. The students will be attending the work shop
explanation:
In (B) the verb ‘was’ does not agree with the plural noun ‘paintings’. It should be ‘were’. 
*The paintings were displayed in the gallery.*

Rule: Plural subjects + plural verbs.
उदाहरण: ‘Paintings were’ न कि ‘Paintings was’

questionText: He has been working here for five years. The in form at i on given by the manager was incorrect. The children was given a new toy. She will finish the report by Tuesday.
explanation:

questionText: The organization will launch the new product next month. The committee has decided to postpone the meeting. The project have been completed by the team. She will be attending the conference tomorrow.
explanation:

Rule: Singular subjects + singular verbs.

questionText: The students are preparing for their exams. The book was read by many people. He will arrive at the station at 6 o’clock. The committee is meeting tomorrow morning.

Rule: Future continuous tense for planned actions.

questionText: He don't like to play cricket.
options: He doesn't like to play cricket.
He don't likes to play cricket.
He doesn't likes to play cricket.
He don't like to play cricket.

questionText: She has went to the market yesterday.
options: She has gone to the market yesterday.
She has went to the market yesterday.
explanation:
Past participle of *go* is *gone*; *went* is simple past.
उदा. सही वाक्य: She has gone to the market yesterday.

questionText: I have a cat and dog.
options: I have a cat and a dog.
I have a cat and dog.
I has a cat and a dog.
I have a cat, and a dog.
explanation:
When listing two singular nouns, each noun needs its determiner *a*.

questionText: The books on the shelf is dusty.
options: The books on the shelf are dusty.
The books on the shelf is dusty.
explanation:

questionText: They were going to the cinema, but it was close to midnight, so they didn't want to go because they was tired.
options: They were going to the cinema, but it was close to midnight, so they didn't want to go because they were tired.
They were going to the cinema, but it was close to midnight, so they didn't want to go because they was tired.

questionText: If I will finish the work, I will go to the market.

questionText: She has visited the museum yesterday.

questionText: The man who is standing by the door, is my uncle.

questionText: The students has completed the assignment.

questionText: He is the person who helps me and she is my sister.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: She gave me a book which I was very much interested to read.

questionText: 6. The company, like many others, have been facing financial difficulties. Choose the correct sentence.
options: The company, like many others, have been facing financial difficulties.
The company, like many others, has been facing financial difficulties.
explanation:
The primary subject is *company* (singular), so the verb should be *has*. The phrase *like many others* is a non‑restrictive clause and does not alter subject‑verb agreement.

questionText: 7. I could hardly see the sign because of the heavy foggy. Which sentence is correct?

questionText: 8. She has been studying in the library without any interruption. Identify the correct sentence.

questionText: 9. The manager, who is well known for his decisions, are always punctual. Which option corrects the error?
options: The manager, who is well known for his decisions, are always punctual.
The manager, who is well known for his decisions, is always punctual.

questionText: 10. Either the students or the teacher should have completed the assignment. Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Either the students or the teacher should have completed the assignment.
explanation:
When the subject of a compound is a singular noun (teacher) and a plural noun (students), the verb should agree with the nearer subject: *should have completed*.
