questionText: The children were excited ________ the trip.
explanation:
"Excited about" is the correct collocation. The preposition "about" follows the adjective "excited" when talking about a subject.
उदाहरण: बच्चे यात्रा के बारे में उत्साहित थे।

questionText: By the time we arrived, the train had already ________.
explanation:
The past perfect tense requires the past participle of the verb. Here, the correct form is "left".
उदाहरण: जब हम पहुंचे, ट्रेन पहले ही निकल चुकी थी।

questionText: She had to apologise ________ the mistake.
explanation:
The verb "apologise" is followed by the preposition "for" when mentioning the reason.
उदाहरण: उसने गलती के लिए माफ़ी माँगी।

questionText: The teacher asked the students to write a report ________ their trip.
explanation:
The preposition "about" is used after the noun "report" to indicate the subject of the report.
उदाहरण: शिक्षक ने छात्रों से अपनी यात्रा पर रिपोर्ट लिखने को कहा।

questionText: The new policy aims to reduce ________ of traffic accidents.
explanation:
"Number" is a countable noun and requires the article "the" in this context.
उदाहरण: नई नीति का उद्देश्य सड़क दुर्घटनाओं की संख्या घटाना है।

questionText: He had been waiting ________ over an hour when the bus finally arrived.
explanation:
"Waiting for" is the correct phrase to express the duration of an action.
उदाहरण: उसने एक घंटे से अधिक इंतजार किया जब बस आखिरकार आई।

questionText: The manager was pleased with the team's efforts, but ________ improvement is still needed.
explanation:
"However" is used to introduce a contrast. It fits the sentence structure after a positive statement followed by a contrasting idea.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक टीम के प्रयासों से संतुष्ट थे, लेकिन फिर भी सुधार की आवश्यकता है।

questionText: She is keen ___ learning new languages.
explanation:
Rule: The adjective 'keen' is followed by an infinitive.
उदा. उसे नई भाषाएँ सीखने का शौक है।

questionText: He has been working ___ the project for three months.
explanation:
Rule: The preposition 'on' is used with a project.
उदा. वह तीन महीने से परियोजना पर काम कर रहा है।

questionText: The manager was praised ___ his efficient handling of the crisis.
explanation:
Rule: The verb 'praise' is followed by the preposition 'for' when referring to an action.
उदा. प्रबंधक को संकट के कुशल प्रबंधन के लिए प्रशंसा मिली।

questionText: The team will meet ___ Friday morning.
explanation:
Rule: The preposition 'on' is used with days of the week.
उदा. टीम शुक्रवार सुबह मिलेगी।

questionText: She has been studying ___ literature for two years.
explanation:
Rule: The preposition 'in' is used with a field of study.
उदा. वह दो साल से साहित्य में अध्ययन कर रही है।

questionText: The report was prepared ___ a thorough investigation.
explanation:
Rule: The preposition 'by' follows a passive verb to indicate the agent.
उदा. रिपोर्ट एक व्यापक जांच द्वारा तैयार की गई।

questionText: He was chosen ___ the position of chief editor.
explanation:
Rule: The verb phrase 'be chosen' is followed by 'for' when indicating a position.
उदा. उन्हें मुख्य संपादक के पद के लिए चुना गया।

questionText: The company plans ___ expand its operations overseas.
explanation:
Rule: The verb 'plan' is followed by an infinitive with 'to'.
उदा. कंपनी अपने ऑपरेशन्स को विदेश में विस्तार करने की योजना बना रही है।

questionText: The lecture ____ more than two hours and was very engaging.
explanation:
Rule: Use simple past tense for completed action.
उदा. व्याख्यान दो घंटे से अधिक चला और बहुत रोचक था।

questionText: She will ___ her thesis by next week.
explanation:
Rule: 'will' is followed by the base form of the verb to express future.
उदा. वह अगले सप्ताह अपनी थीसिस जमा करेगी।

questionText: The company will ________ its annual report next week.
explanation:
Future simple: use the base verb after 'will'.
उदा. कंपनी अपना वार्षिक रिपोर्ट अगले हफ्ते प्रकाशित करेगी।
grammarRule: Future simple with modal 'will' + base verb

questionText: He has been studying English ________ five years.
explanation:
Duration with 'for' indicates a period of time.
उदा. वह पांच वर्षों से अंग्रेजी पढ़ रहा है।

questionText: I would have gone to the party, but I was ________.
explanation:
Idiomatic phrase 'under the weather' means sick.
उदा. मैं पार्टी में जा सकता था, पर मैं बीमार था।

questionText: The teacher asked the students to hand in their assignments ________ the dead line
explanation:
Use 'by' to indicate up to the deadline.
उदा. छात्रों को समय सीमा से पहले असाइनमेंट जमा करने को कहा।

questionText: She has been working here ________ the summer.
explanation:
Duration during a specific period uses 'during'.
उदा. वह इस गर्मी के दौरान यहाँ काम कर रही है।
grammarRule: Duration with 'during' for a specific period

questionText: The new law will ________ the rights of consumers.
explanation:
Future simple: base verb after 'will'.
उदा. नई कानून उपभोक्ताओं के अधिकारों की रक्षा करेगा।
grammarRule: Future simple with modal 'will' + base verb

questionText: Please ________ your ID before entering the premises.
explanation:
Imperative sentences use the base form of the verb.
उदा. कृपया प्रवेश से पहले अपनी आईडी दिखाएँ।

questionText: The committee was formed ________ the recommendations of the committee.
explanation:
Prepositional phrase 'in accordance with' means in agreement with.
उदा. समिति सिफ़ारिशों के अनुसार बनाई गई थी।

questionText: He is ________ his work, and he will finish it by tomorrow.
explanation:
Idiomatic phrase 'in progress' indicates something ongoing.
उदा. वह अपने काम पर प्रगति कर रहा है।

questionText: The hotel will offer a discount ________ guests who book in advance.
explanation:
Use 'to' with people receiving something.
उदा. होटल अग्रिम बुकिंग करने वाले मेहमानों को छूट देगा।

questionText: She has been ________ to the office for the past two hours.
explanation:
Use present participle after 'has been' for continuous action.
उदाहरण: वह दो घंटे से कार्यालय आ रही है।

questionText: He was ________ by the news of the accident.
explanation:
Use past participle after 'was' to form passive.
उदाहरण: वह समाचार से चकित हुआ।

questionText: The manager will ________ the new policy next week.
explanation:
Use base verb after modal 'will'.
उदाहरण: वह अगले सप्ताह नीति लागू करेगा।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'implement'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: They have been searching for a suitable candidate ________.
explanation:
Use 'since' for a time period starting in the past.
उदाहरण: जनवरी से वे उपयुक्त उम्मीदवार खोज रहे हैं।

questionText: The proposal was rejected ________ the committee.
explanation:
Use 'by' to indicate the agent in a passive construction.
उदाहरण: समिति द्वारा प्रस्ताव अस्वीकृत किया गया।

questionText: I am looking forward ________ you at the conference.
explanation:
Use 'to' after 'look forward'.
उदाहरण: मैं कॉन्फ्रेंस में आप से मिलने का इंतजार कर रहा हूँ।

questionText: She was given a certificate ________ her outstanding performance.
explanation:
Use 'for' to indicate reason or purpose.
उदाहरण: उसकी उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए उसे प्रमाणपत्र दिया गया।

questionText: The project will be completed ________ the end of this month.
explanation:
Use 'by' to indicate a deadline.
उदाहरण: परियोजना इस महीने के अंत तक पूरी होगी।

questionText: He was reprimanded ________ his lack of preparation.
explanation:
Use 'for' to indicate reason.
उदाहरण: तैयारी की कमी के लिए उसे डांटा गया।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'for'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: The committee will meet ________ Thursday morning.
explanation:
Use 'on' for a specific day of the week.
उदाहरण: समिति गुरुवार सुबह मिलती है।
grammarRule: Preposition for days of the week

questionText: She has been living ___ that city for ten years.
explanation:
Preposition 'in' is used to indicate a location. 
उदा. वह शहर में रहती है।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'in'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।

questionText: The committee has decided ___ the proposal by next week.
explanation:
Infinitive form 'to review' follows the verb 'decided'. 
उदा. उसने निर्णय लिया कि वह रिपोर्ट पढ़ेगा।
grammarRule: Infinitive after decided (verb + to + base verb)

questionText: He was absent from the meeting _______ his illness.
explanation:
Preposition phrase 'because of' introduces a reason. 
उदा. वह अपनी बीमारी के कारण अनुपस्थित था।
grammarRule: Reason expressed with because of (preposition + noun)

questionText: The scientist's paper was highly _______ by critics.
explanation:
Adjective 'appreciated' describes the paper. 
उदा. वैज्ञानिक का पेपर बहुत सराहा गया।
grammarRule: Adjective used to describe a noun

questionText: She cannot _______ the news even if it is true.
explanation:
Base form 'believe' follows modal 'cannot'. 
उदा. वह खबर पर विश्वास नहीं कर सकती।
grammarRule: Modal + base verb (cannot + infinitive without to)

questionText: The manager _______ to the project budget by 10%.
explanation:
Past tense 'reduced' follows the subject and auxiliary 'has/had'. 
उदा. प्रबंधक ने बजट कम किया।
grammarRule: Simple past tense for completed action

questionText: I have been waiting for you _______ an hour.
explanation:
Preposition 'for' is used with a duration of time. 
उदा. मैंने तुम्हारा एक घंटे से इंतज़ार किया।

questionText: The soldiers marched _______ the flag.
explanation:
Preposition 'with' indicates accompaniment. 
उदा. सैनिक झंडे के साथ मार्च कर रहे थे।

questionText: The book is available _______ the new edition.
explanation:
Preposition 'in' is used to refer to a particular edition. 
उदा. किताब नई संस्करण में उपलब्ध है।
grammarRule: Preposition in (referring to edition or version)

questionText: She has a talent _______ painting.
explanation:
Preposition 'for' is used after the noun 'talent' to indicate the domain. 
उदा. उसकी पेंटिंग में बड़ी प्रतिभा है।
grammarRule: Preposition for after noun talent (talent for + activity)

questionText: The _______ of the mountain was breathtaking.
explanation:
Noun 'peak' correctly completes the phrase. 
उदा. पर्वत की चोटी अद्भुत थी।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: रिक्त स्थान में 'peak'  का प्रयोग वाक्य के संदर्भ और व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः सही है।
grammarRule: Noun usage (peak as a noun meaning top)

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word in the following sentence: "The company announced its new product launch tomorrow.
explanation:
Rule: The word "product" is correctly spelled with "o" after "pr" and "uct" at the end.
उदा. हिंदी: "product" का सही वर्तनी "product" है, न कि "prouct"।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word that fits the sentence: "She was very excitate about the concert.
explanation:
Rule: The adjective is "excited"; the adverbial form is "excitedly". Here the correct base form is "excite".
उदा. हिंदी: "excite" का सही वर्तनी "excite" है, न कि "excite"।

questionText: The scientists discovered a new exoplanet in the solar system.
explanation:
Rule: The prefix "exo-" means outside, and the suffix "-planet" is spelled with 'a' after 'o'.
उदा. हिंदी: "exoplanet" सही वर्तनी है, न कि "exoplante"।

questionText: Which word is spelled correctly in the following sentence? "The committee will convene next week.
explanation:
Rule: The verb meaning to assemble is spelled "convene".
उदा. हिंदी: "convene" का सही वर्तनी "convene" है, न कि "convenu"।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled adjective in the sentence: "The weather was unexpectedly brrr-ly cold.
explanation:
Rule: The playful form is "brrly", derived from the sound "brr".
उदा. हिंदी: "brrly" सही वर्तनी है, न कि "brrr-ly"।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word that completes the sentence: "He was known for his quick reflexes during the match.
explanation:
Rule: The plural noun is spelled "reflexes".
उदा. हिंदी: "reflexes" का सही वर्तनी "reflexes" है, न कि "reflex"।

questionText: The artist's masterpiece was displayed in the gallery.
explanation:
Rule: The word means an outstanding work of art and is spelled "masterpiece".
उदा. हिंदी: "masterpiece" का सही वर्तनी "masterpiece" है, न कि "masterpiecee"।

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word that fits the context: "They decided to adopt a new policy for the department.
explanation:
Rule: The base verb is spelled "adopt".
उदा. हिंदी: "adopt" का सही वर्तनी "adopt" है, न कि "adopted"।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word in this sentence: "The conference will be held in a grand hall.
explanation:
Rule: The word for a large room is spelled "hall".
उदा. हिंदी: "hall" का सही वर्तनी "hall" है, न कि "hal"।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled adjective for the sentence: "The new legislation was quite controverial.
explanation:
Rule: The adjective meaning disputed is spelled "controversial".
उदा. हिंदी: "controversial" का सही वर्तनी "controversial" है, न कि "controverial"।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word from the list.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *Separate*; the vowel 'e' following 'p' is required. 
उदा. सही: *Separate*; गलत: *Seperate*.
grammarRule: Spelling of words with 'ea' or 'e' after 'p'

questionText: The committee has decided to postpone the meeting. She will be arriving at 10 a.m. tomorrow. The students were given a chance to present their projects. The books was placed on the shelf.
explanation:
The error is in segment (D) – the subject ‘books’ is plural, so the verb should be ‘were’ not ‘was’. Correct sentence: "The books were placed on the shelf."

Rule: Subject–verb agreement – the verb must agree in number with the subject.
उदाहरण: "पुस्तकें शेल्फ पर रखी गईं।"

questionText: He has been working on the report since morning. They had finished the assignment before the dead line The manager will speak at the conference to night I seen the movie last week.
explanation:
Segment (D) contains the error – the past tense of ‘see’ is ‘saw’, not ‘seen’. Correct: "I saw the movie last week."

Rule: Simple past tense – use the irregular past form.
उदाहरण: "मैंने पिछली हफ़्ते फिल्म देखी।"

questionText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. She is going to the market to buy some vegetables. The project was completed on time by the team. He like to read books after dinner.
explanation:
Segment (D) is wrong – after the verb ‘like’ the subject ‘he’ requires the base form ‘likes’. Correct: "He likes to read books after dinner."

Rule: Third person singular – add ‘s’ or ‘es’ to the base verb.
उदाहरण: "वह किताबें पढ़ना पसंद करता है।"
grammarRule: Verb conjugation for third person singular

questionText: The new policy will be implemented next month. The results of the experiment were inconclusive. We has decided to postpone the trip. She has finished all her assignments.
explanation:
Segment (C) has the error – the auxiliary verb ‘has’ should be ‘have’ for the subject ‘we’. Correct: "We have decided to postpone the trip."

Rule: Auxiliary verbs agree with the subject.
उदाहरण: "हमने यात्रा को स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया।"

questionText: The children were playing in the park. He has been working on his thesis all week. The government will announce the new policy tomorrow. It were raining when we left the house.
explanation:
Segment (D) contains the error – the verb should agree with the singular subject ‘it’, so use ‘was’ not ‘were’. Correct: "It was raining when we left the house."

Rule: Subject–verb agreement with impersonal subjects.
उदाहरण: "जब हम घर से निकले तो बरस रहा था।"

questionText: The teacher asked the students to submit their assignments. She is going to attend the meeting at 3 p.m. The dogs barked loudly at the mailman. The cake will baked tomorrow by the chef.
explanation:
Segment (D) is incorrect – passive voice requires the auxiliary ‘be’ in correct form; should be ‘baked’ not ‘baked’. Correct: "The cake will be baked tomorrow by the chef."

Rule: Passive voice construction – ‘be’ + past participle.
उदाहरण: "केक कल बेक किया जाएगा।"

questionText: The report was submitted on time. They have been working on the project for months. The manager will review the proposals tomorrow. She are going to the cinema to night
explanation:
Segment (D) contains the error – the verb should be ‘is’ for the subject ‘she’. Correct: "She is going to the cinema tonight."

Rule: Verb agreement with singular third person.
उदाहरण: "वह आज रात सिनेमा जाने वाली है।"

questionText: The team has finished their project. He will be arriving at the station at 6 p.m. She has been studying French for years. The children was excited about the trip.
explanation:
Segment (D) has the error – ‘children’ is plural, so the verb should be ‘were’ not ‘was’. Correct: "The children were excited about the trip."

Rule: Subject–verb agreement with plural nouns.
उदाहरण: "बच्चे यात्रा के बारे में उत्साहित थे।"

questionText: She will finish the assignment by tomorrow. They have been reviewing the documents for hours. The project will be completed next week. I have went to the market earlier.
explanation:
Segment (D) contains the error – the correct past participle of ‘go’ is ‘gone’. Correct: "I have gone to the market earlier."

Rule: Past participle of irregular verbs.
उदाहरण: "मैं पहले ही बाज़ार गया हूँ।"

questionText: The new policy will be implemented next month. She had finished the book before the dead line The students were given a chance to present their projects. He likes to play cricket in the evening.
explanation:
Segment (D) is incorrect – the verb should be ‘likes’ to agree with the third person singular subject ‘he’. Correct: "He likes to play cricket in the evening."

Rule: Third person singular – add ‘s’ or ‘es’.
उदाहरण: "वह शाम को क्रिकेट खेलना पसंद करता है।"
grammarRule: Verb conjugation for third person singular

questionText: diminish
explanation:
Rule: The antonym of a verb indicating reduction is a verb indicating growth.
उदाहरण: "Diminish" का विपरीत "increase" है।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
Rule: Words describing good intentions have opposite words describing ill intentions.
उदाहरण: "Benevolent" का विपरीत "malevolent" है।

questionText: Obscure
explanation:
Rule: The opposite of hidden or unclear is clear or bright.
उदाहरण: "Obscure" का विपरीत "bright" है।

questionText: negligible
explanation:
Rule: The antonym of a word indicating smallness is a word indicating largeness.
उदाहरण: "Negligible" का विपरीत "significant" है।

questionText: Pride
explanation:
Rule: Pride is a positive self-view; its opposite is a modest self-view.
उदाहरण: "Pride" का विपरीत "humility" है।

questionText: Abundant
explanation:
Rule: The opposite of plenty is scarcity.
उदाहरण: "Abundant" का विपरीत "scarce" है।

questionText: stagnant
explanation:
Rule: The opposite of stillness is motion or activity.
उदाहरण: "Stagnant" का विपरीत "dynamic" है।

questionText: Rational
explanation:
Rule: The opposite of reasonableness is illogic or irrationality.
उदाहरण: "Rational" का विपरीत "illogical" है।

questionText: Epitome
explanation:
Rule: The opposite of a quintessential example is something that contradicts it.
उदाहरण: "Epitome" का विपरीत "antithesis" है।

questionText: prohibit
explanation:
The word "prohibit" means to forbid or prevent. Its antonym is "permit", which means to allow or give permission.
उदाहरण: "The rule prohibits smoking; the manager permits it."

questionText: tangible
explanation:
"Tangible" means something that can be touched or felt. Its opposite is "intangible", meaning not able to be touched or perceived physically.
उदाहरण: "The intangible benefits of education are often overlooked."

questionText: ascend
explanation:
"Ascend" means to go up. The opposite is "descend", meaning to go down.
उदाहरण: "The plane ascended; now it will descend."

questionText: ancient
explanation:
"Ancient" means very old. The opposite is "modern", meaning belonging to the present or recent past.
उदाहरण: "Ancient temples contrast with modern skyscrapers."

questionText: sparse
explanation:
"Sparse" means thinly scattered or few in number. The opposite is "dense", meaning closely packed or thickly arranged.
उदाहरण: "Sparse foliage gives way to dense jungle."

questionText: In the sentence "The committee approved the new policy without any objections," which word is misspelled?

questionText: Which of the following correctly spells the word that means ‘a collection of stories’?

questionText: Which option contains the correctly spelled word meaning ‘to separate’?

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence "The examination was scheduled for the 12th of August.

उदाहरण: We visited Paris last year (सही) बजाय We have visited Paris last year (गलत).
grammarRule: Tense consistency – present perfect vs simple past

questionText: The committee will discuss the proposal tomorrow. She had been waiting for an hour when the bus finally came. If I will have time, I will call you. He has finished his home work.
explanation:
Rule: In conditional sentences with a future scenario, use ‘will’ in the main clause but not in the if‑clause.

उदाहरण: If I have time, I will call you (सही) बजाय If I will have time, I will call you (गलत).

questionText: The children have played in the garden. I have known her for five years. She is reading a book that was written by her favorite author. They had walked for hours before they reached the station.
explanation:
Rule: In the present perfect continuous, the verb should be ‘have been’ with a continuous form. The correct form is ‘have been playing’.

उदाहरण: They have been playing in the garden (सही) बजाय They have played in the garden (गलत).

questionText: Which segment contains the error? He had left the house early in the morning. She have never seen such a beautiful sight. The results of the test are out. I had finished my work when the alarm rang.
explanation:
Rule: In the simple past tense, the verb should be in past form. ‘Have’ should be ‘had’.

उदाहरण: She had never seen such a beautiful sight (सही) बजाय She have never seen such a beautiful sight (गलत).

questionText: The teacher explained the lesson clearly. It was raining when we left the house. The news that the company had been acquired was shocking. He will having finished his assignment, he left early.
explanation:
Rule: After ‘will’, the base form of the verb should be used. ‘Will have finished’ is correct.

उदाहरण: He will have finished his assignment, he left early (सही) बजाय He will having finished his assignment, he left early (गलत).

questionText: She has seen the movie, and it was amazing. We had been going to the park when it started to rain. He will finish the project if he is given more resources. The students had studied for the test, but they didn’t perform well.
explanation:
Rule: In a past perfect continuous, the verb should be ‘had been’ + present participle. The correct form is ‘had been going’.

उदाहरण: They had been going to the park (सही) बजाय They had been going to the park (सही). (Note: this example shows correct usage; the erroneous sentence used ‘been going’ incorrectly.)

questionText: Which segment contains the error? I have never seen such a strange phenomenon. If she will finish early, she will join us. He had been working for ten hours before he took a break. The team has been winning the championship for the last five seasons.
explanation:
Rule: In conditional sentences, use ‘will’ in the main clause only; the ‘if’ clause should use simple present.

उदाहरण: If she finishes early, she will join us (सही) बजाय If she will finish early, she will join us (गलत).

questionText: The book has been read by many students. They have lived in this city for five years. The manager will having finished the report, he left. She has been working here since 2010.
explanation:
Rule: After ‘will’, use the base form of the verb. The correct form is ‘will have finished’.

उदाहरण: She will have finished the report, she left (सही) बजाय She will having finished the report, she left (गलत).

questionText: Which segment contains the error? The children was playing in the courtyard. The train is arriving at 6 pm. We have visited the museum last year. She will be studying at 7 pm tomorrow.
explanation:
Rule: The verb must agree with the plural subject. Use ‘were’ with plural subjects.

उदाहरण: The children were playing (सही) बजाय The children was playing (गलत).

questionText: He had been working on the project for two months. The dog that had barked all night was finally quiet. She will having arrived, she called for help. We had finished the assignment before the dead line
explanation:
Rule: After ‘will’, use the base form of the verb. The correct form is ‘will have arrived’.

उदाहरण: She will have arrived, she called for help (सही) बजाय She will having arrived, she called for help (गलत).

questionText: If no substitution is required, select 'No improvement'. Hardly had she entered the office _than the phone began to ring_.
options: than the phone began to ring
when the phone began to ring
then the phone began to ring
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' (or 'before'), not 'than'. 'No sooner' takes 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है।

questionText: One of the most popular novels _have been adapted_ into a movie recently.
explanation:
The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb because the subject is 'One', not the plural noun. Hence, 'has been adapted' is correct.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' के बाद verb हमेशा singular आती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'One' होता है। अतः 'has been adapted' सही है।
grammarRule: Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

questionText: If I _was you_, I would never accept such a humiliating offer.
explanation:
In subjunctive mood expressing an imaginary condition, 'were' is used with all subjects, even singular ones ('I', 'he', 'she').
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक शर्त (Subjunctive mood) को व्यक्त करने के लिए सभी subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'was' का नहीं।

questionText: She told me that she _has finished_ her home work before the guests arrived.
explanation:
In past tense narrative, for an action completed before another past action, past perfect tense (had + V3) must be used.
उदा. भूतकाल में दो घटनाओं में से जो घटना पहले घटित होती है, उसके लिए Past Perfect Tense (had + V3) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
grammarRule: Tenses (Past Perfect for prior past action)

questionText: No sooner did the train stop at the station _than the passengers rushed out_.
explanation:
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is always 'than'. The given sentence is grammatically correct.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है। दिया गया वाक्य बिल्कुल सही है, इसलिए इसमें सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

questionText: Neither the teacher nor the students _was present_ in the class room.
explanation:
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, the closest subject is 'students' (plural), so 'were present' is required.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'were' आएगा।

questionText: Despite of working hard, _he failed to secure_ the top rank in the exam.
options: In spite working hard, he failed
Despite of worked hard, he failed
explanation:
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Either use 'Despite working' or 'In spite of working'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है। अतः 'Despite working' सही है।
grammarRule: Prepositions / Prepositional Errors (Despite vs In spite of)

questionText: He is too weak _that he cannot walk_ without support.
options: so weak that he cannot walk
very weak that he cannot walk
explanation:
The correct correlative structure with 'too... to' is 'too + adjective + to-infinitive'. Alternatively, 'so... that' can be used, but 'too... that' is incorrect.
उदा. 'too' के साथ 'to-infinitive' का जोड़ा बनता है ('too... to')। 'too... that' का प्रयोग व्याकरण की दृष्टि से अशुद्ध है।

questionText: Each of the participants _were given_ a certificate of appreciation at the end of the seminar.
explanation:
Pronouns/determiners like 'Each', 'Every', 'Everyone' take a singular verb. Therefore, 'was given' must replace 'were given'.
उदा. 'Each', 'Every', 'Everyone' आदि शब्द singular होते हैं और इनके साथ singular verb ('was') का प्रयोग होता है।

questionText: Scarcely had the minister stepped out of the car _than the crowd started cheering_.
explanation:
Like 'hardly', 'scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Thus, 'when the crowd started cheering' is correct.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ सही कंजंक्शन 'when' (या before) होता है, न कि 'than'। इसलिए विकल्प 1 सही है।

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The committee decided to postpone the meeting due to a lack of ________ participants.
explanation:
Use a noun phrase when the adjective modifies the noun directly; hence "sufficiently qualified participants" is correct. 
उदाहरण: "वह छात्र, जिनकी योग्यता पर्याप्त है, परीक्षाएं पास करते हैं."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "He is known for his perseverance, which has helped him ________ in the field of research.
explanation:
After a noun phrase such as "his perseverance", the verb that follows should be in the infinitive form with the preposition 'at' when referring to a field. 
उदाहरण: "उसकी मेहनत ने उसे विज्ञान में उत्कृष्ट बनाया."
grammarRule: Infinitive with preposition after noun phrase

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The manager's decision to reduce costs was applauded, but it also ________ staff morale.
explanation:
The object of the verb is a noun phrase; we need the article 'the' before 'staff morale'. 
उदाहरण: "उस निर्णय से कर्मचारियों का मनोबल घट गया."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The new policy will encourage employees to ________ their time more efficiently.
explanation:
After 'encourage' we use infinitive with object; "manage their time" is correct. 
उदाहरण: "कर्मचारियों को अपने समय का प्रबंधन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाएगा."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "Despite the challenges, the project was completed on time, proving that persistence ________ results.
explanation:
The object of the verb is a noun phrase; we need the adjective 'results' after the verb. 
उदाहरण: "धैर्य से अच्छे परिणाम मिलते हैं."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The author’s narrative skill ________ the readers from the very first page.
explanation:
The past tense verb 'captured' correctly describes the action performed by the author. 
उदाहरण: "लेखक की कहानी ने पाठकों को पहले पन्ने से ही मोहित किया."
grammarRule: Past tense verb for completed action

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The committee expressed its gratitude, stating that the support had ________ the success of the event.
explanation:
The verb 'made' should be followed by the noun phrase 'the success of the event' without extra words. 
उदाहरण: "सहायता ने कार्यक्रम की सफलता में योगदान दिया."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The new software improved the workflow, allowing employees to ________ tasks faster.
explanation:
After 'allowing', we use infinitive with object: 'complete the tasks'. 
उदाहरण: "सॉफ्टवेयर ने कर्मचारियों को कार्य तेजी से पूर्ण करने में सक्षम बनाया."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "Her relentless pursuit of excellence ________ her to the top of the class.
explanation:
The subject 'Her' is the object of the verb 'brought', so we use 'brought her to'. 
उदाहरण: "उसकी सतत प्रयास ने उसे कक्षा के शीर्ष तक पहुँचाया."

questionText: Choose the most appropriate replacement for the underlined phrase in the sentence: "The new initiative aims to reduce carbon emissions by encouraging people to ________ greener transportation options.
explanation:
After 'encouraging', use infinitive 'adopt' followed by the noun phrase. 
उदाहरण: "नई पहल लोगों को हरित परिवहन विकल्प अपनाने के लिए प्रेरित करती है."

questionText: The committee members, <u>who had been invited< / u>, decided to postpone the meeting.
explanation:
Use the simple past ‘were invited’ to indicate a completed action in the past that is not a relative clause. The phrase ‘who had been invited’ is incorrect here.
उदाहरण: समिति के सदस्यों, <u>जो आमंत्रित किए गए थे</u>, ने बैठक को स्थगित करने का निर्णय लिया।
grammarRule: Simple Past for past completed action

questionText: She accepted the offer, <u>as soon as she had finished< / u> the examination.
options: as soon as she had finished
as soon as she will finish
explanation:
Use the simple past ‘finished’ because the action is completed before the acceptance. The past perfect ‘had finished’ is unnecessary.
उदाहरण: उसने प्रस्ताव स्वीकार किया, <u>जैसे ही उसने परीक्षा पूरी की</u>।
grammarRule: Simple Past for completed action before another past event

questionText: The results were announced, <u>that led to a wave of protests< / u>.
options: that led to a wave of protests
which led to a wave of protests
leading to a wave of protests
which leads to a wave of protests
explanation:
Use a participial phrase ‘leading to a wave of protests’ to modify ‘results were announced’. The relative clause is unnecessary.
उदाहरण: परिणामों की घोषणा <u>प्रदर्शनों की लहर पैदा करते हुए</u> हुई।

questionText: He was praised, <u>for his outstanding performance in the competition, which was held last month< / u>.
options: for his outstanding performance in the competition, which was held last month
for his outstanding performance in the competition, that was held last month
for his outstanding performance in the competition, the competition was held last month
for his outstanding performance in the competition, held last month
explanation:
Use a participial phrase ‘held last month’ to modify ‘competition’ without a relative pronoun.
उदाहरण: उसकी उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन के लिए उसे सराहा गया, <u>प्रतियोगिता जो पिछले महीने आयोजित हुई</u>।

questionText: The project will be completed, <u>if the funding is secured by the end of this year< / u>.
options: if the funding is secured by the end of this year
if the funding will be secured by the end of this year
if the funding had been secured by the end of this year
if the funding had secured by the end of this year
explanation:
Use the simple present ‘is secured’ in a conditional clause referring to a future possibility. ‘Will be secured’ is incorrect.
उदाहरण: परियोजना तब पूरी होगी, <u>यदि इस वर्ष के अंत तक धन सुरक्षित किया जाता है</u>।
grammarRule: Simple Present in ‘if’ clause for future condition

questionText: They announced the new policy, <u>which was expected to raise productivity levels< / u>.
options: which was expected to raise productivity levels
that was expected to raise productivity levels
who was expected to raise productivity levels
who expected to raise productivity levels
explanation:
Use the relative pronoun ‘which’ to refer to a policy (inanimate). ‘Who’ is incorrect.
उदाहरण: उन्होंने नई नीति की घोषणा की, <u>जिससे उत्पादकता स्तर बढ़ने की उम्मीद थी</u>।

questionText: The students were excited, <u>as the exam results were announced< / u>.
options: as the exam results were announced
when the exam results were announced
while the exam results were announced
after the exam results were announced
explanation:
Use ‘when’ to indicate the time of the action. ‘As’ is less precise here.
उदाहरण: छात्र उत्साहित थे, <u>जब परीक्षा के परिणाम घोषित हुए</u>।

questionText: He will attend the conference, <u>unless the schedule changes< / u>.
explanation:
Use simple present ‘changes’ in a ‘unless’ clause referring to a future possibility. ‘Will change’ is incorrect.
उदाहरण: वह सम्मेलन में भाग लेगा, <u>यदि कार्यक्रम बदलता नहीं है</u>।
grammarRule: Simple Present in ‘unless’ clause for future possibility

questionText: The new law will be implemented, <u>which was passed by the parliament last month< / u>.
options: which was passed by the parliament last month
that was passed by the parliament last month
whose passed by the parliament last month
who was passed by the parliament last month
explanation:
Use ‘which’ for an inanimate object (law). ‘That’ can also be acceptable but ‘which’ is preferred for non-restrictive clauses.
उदाहरण: नया कानून लागू किया जाएगा, <u>जो पिछले महीने संसद द्वारा पारित किया गया था</u>।

questionText: The book was difficult to read, <u>because the sentences were too long< / u>.
options: because the sentences were too long
because the sentences will be too long
because the sentences had been too long
because the sentences are too long
explanation:
Use simple past ‘were’ to describe a fact that was true at the time of reading. Future or present tense is incorrect.
उदाहरण: पुस्तक पढ़ने में कठिन थी, <u>क्योंकि वाक्य बहुत लंबे थे</u>।

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
explanation:
The correct preposition for duration of employment is *at*. Hence, "She has been working **at the same company** for 10 years." 
उदा. "वह 10 वर्षों से उसी कंपनी में काम कर रही है."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "He is the most intelligent person ___ ever seen in this department.
explanation:
The relative pronoun *who* should be followed by *has* because it refers to a singular person. Hence, "He is the most intelligent person **who has** ever seen in this department." 
उदा. "वह इस विभाग में कभी देखा गया सबसे बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति है."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "The committee, ___ members are from different states, concluded the meeting early.
explanation:
The relative pronoun *whose* is used to show possession or association. Hence, "The committee, **whose** members are from different states, concluded the meeting early." 
उदा. "समिति, जिसके सदस्य विभिन्न राज्यों से हैं, ने जल्दी बैठक समाप्त कर दी."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the most appropriate alternative: "The project will be completed ___ the dead line
explanation:
The preposition *by* is used to indicate the time before which something must be finished. Hence, "The project will be completed **by** the deadline." 
उदा. "परियोजना समय सीमा से पहले पूरी हो जाएगी."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "The book, ___ I bought last month, is already missing some pages.
explanation:
A non-restrictive relative clause uses *which* to refer to objects. Hence, "The book, **which** I bought last month, is already missing some pages." 
उदा. "किताब, जिसे मैंने पिछले महीने खरीदा था, पहले ही कुछ पन्ने गायब हैं."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "There were no signs ___ the train would be delayed.
explanation:
The conjunction *that* introduces a clause explaining the absence of signs. Hence, "There were no signs **that** the train would be delayed." 
उदा. "कोई संकेत नहीं थे कि ट्रेन देर होगी."
grammarRule: Use of *that* to introduce a clause

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "John, ___ is known for his punctuality, missed the meeting.
explanation:
The relative pronoun *who* refers to a person. Hence, "John, **who** is known for his punctuality, missed the meeting." 
उदा. "जॉन, जो अपनी समयबद्धता के लिए जाना जाता है, बैठक में चूक गया."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the most appropriate alternative: "The solution to the problem lies ___ a thorough investigation.
explanation:
The preposition *in* is used to express the source or basis of something. Hence, "The solution to the problem lies **in** a thorough investigation." 
उदा. "समस्या का समाधान एक विस्तृत जांच में निहित है."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the correct alternative: "The proposal, ___ is pending approval, will be discussed tomorrow.
explanation:
A non-restrictive relative clause about an object uses *which*. Hence, "The proposal, **which** is pending approval, will be discussed tomorrow." 
उदा. "प्रस्ताव, जो अनुमोदन के लिए लंबित है, कल चर्चा की जाएगी."

questionText: Replace the underlined phrase with the most grammatically correct alternative: "Both the manager and the assistant, ___ had been working late, were exhausted.
explanation:
For people, the relative pronoun *who* is used. Hence, "Both the manager and the assistant, **who** had been working late, were exhausted." 
उदा. "दोनों प्रबंधक और सहायक, जो देर तक काम कर रहे थे, थक चुके थे."

questionText: Choose the idiom that best completes the sentence: The manager's reaction to the news was a …, she was completely shocked.
explanation:
The idiom "blue sky" means an unexpected or undesirable event. It signifies a sudden shock.
उदाहरण: जब उसने बताया कि कंपनी बंद हो रही है, तो उसके चेहरे पर "blue sky" का भाव दिखाई दिया।

questionText: Which phrase best conveys the meaning of ‘to work tirelessly’?
options: hit the nail on the head
let the cat out of the bag
explanation:
The phrase "burn the midnight oil" means to work late into the night, working hard and tirelessly.
उदाहरण: उसने अपनी परीक्षा की तैयारी के लिये "burn the midnight oil" किया।

questionText: to be very surprised
options: be in a state of shock
explanation:
"Be in a state of shock" is an idiom used to describe extreme surprise or disbelief.
उदाहरण: जब उसने यह खबर सुनी, तो वह "be in a state of shock" हो गया।

questionText: Fill in the blank: He kept his promises, but he was ________ when it came to taking responsibility.
options: a chip off the old block
a square peg in a round hole
explanation:
"A square peg in a round hole" means someone who is not suitable or appropriate for a situation. Here it indicates he was not responsible.
उदाहरण: वह अपनी जिम्मेदारी निभाने में "a square peg in a round hole" था।

questionText: to choose the most favorable option
options: make a mountain out of a molehill
explanation:
"Pick the high road" means to choose the best or most honorable option.
उदाहरण: उसने प्रतियोगिता में "pick the high road" का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: to make a sudden and strong impression
explanation:
"Make waves" means to create a strong impact or impression.
उदाहरण: उसकी प्रस्तुति ने सभी पर "make waves" किया।

questionText: Which idiom describes a situation that is very easy to handle?
explanation:
"A walk in the park" means an easy or effortless task.
उदाहरण: परीक्षा एक "walk in the park" थी, मैंने इसे आसानी से पास किया।

questionText: Which of the following idioms means that someone is acting very passive and is not taking initiative?
explanation:
The idiom "sit on the fence" means to remain undecided or passive.
उदा. वह हमेशा किसी भी मुद्दे पर फँसा रहता है ताकि वह किसी भी निर्णय से बच सके।

questionText: Which phrase best conveys that a person has reached the end of their patience?
options: At the end of one's rope
Bite off more than one can chew

questionText: Which of the following words is correctly spelled in American English?
explanation:
In American English, the correct spelling is 'judgment' with a single 'e'.

questionText: Identify the word that contains a spelling error
explanation: The correct spelling is ‘occasionally’ with two ‘s’ after ‘e’. Hindi: ‘कभी-कभी’ – गलत वर्तनी ‘Occassionally’ है।
grammarRule: Rule / Root: Double 's' after 'e' in adverbs ending with '-ally'

questionText: Segment : The team of scientists **has** collected data. Identify the error.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: The subject ‘team’ is singular, so the verb should be *has*. 
उदाहरण: टीम एकवचन है, अतः क्रिया ‘has’ ही होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : She said that the meeting will start at 10:00 AM, **but** we **shouldn't** arrive early. Identify the error.
explanation:
Contraction misuse: *shouldn't* is informal; in formal writing it should be *should not*. 
उदाहरण: औपचारिक लेखन में ‘should not’ का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : He **are** the best player of the team. Identify the error.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: ‘He’ is singular, so the verb should be *is*. 
उदाहरण: ‘He’ एकवचन है, अतः क्रिया ‘is’ होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : There was **many** reasons for the delay. Identify the error.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: ‘reasons’ is plural, so the verb should be *were*. 
उदाहरण: ‘reasons’ बहुवचन है, अतः क्रिया ‘were’ होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : The committee **have** decided to postpone the event. Identify the error.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: ‘committee’ is singular, so the verb should be *has*. 
उदाहरण: ‘committee’ एकवचन है, अतः क्रिया ‘has’ होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : I have **seen** him yesterday. Identify the error.
explanation:
Tense mismatch: ‘have seen’ is present perfect; with a specific past time (‘yesterday’) it should be simple past *saw*. 
उदाहरण: ‘yesterday’ के साथ ‘have seen’ गलत है; सही है ‘saw’।

questionText: Segment : Every one should bring **their** own lunch. Identify the error.
explanation:
Pronoun‑antecedent agreement: ‘Everyone’ is singular; the correct pronoun is *his or her* (or *their* in modern usage, but traditionally ‘his or her’ is preferred). 
उदाहरण: ‘Everyone’ एकवचन है, अतः ‘his or her’ प्रयोग करना चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : The news **was** that the company will be launching a new product next month. Identify the error.
explanation:
Correct construction: ‘news’ is uncountable, so the phrase should be *news that…* not *news was that…*. 
उदाहरण: ‘news’ अविभाज्य है, अतः ‘news that’ सही है।

questionText: Segment : Neither of the books **are** available. Identify the error.
explanation:
Subject–verb agreement: ‘neither’ is singular, so the verb should be *is*. 
उदाहरण: ‘neither’ एकवचन है, अतः क्रिया ‘is’ होनी चाहिए।

questionText: Segment : If I **will** go, I will stay. Identify the error.
explanation:
Conditional tense: In ‘if’ clauses, the simple present is used, not ‘will’. The correct form is *If I go*. 
उदाहरण: ‘if’ वाक्य में ‘will’ नहीं, ‘go’ ही प्रयोग होना चाहिए।

questionText: Choose the word correctly spelled
explanation:
Rule in English.
उदा. "separate" शब्द में 'a' और 'e' अलग-अलग होते हैं।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word from the options below
explanation:
'Necessary' contains a single 'c' and double 's'.
उदा. सही वर्तनी: necessary

questionText: In the following sentence, identify the correctly spelled word: "The scientist presented his findings at the conference, but some people thought the data was misinterpretated.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *misinterpreted*. The verb ‘interpret’ + the prefix ‘mis-’ + the suffix ‘-ed’ makes the past tense. 
उदा. वैज्ञानिक ने अपने निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत किए, पर कुछ लोगों को लगा कि आँकड़े गलत समझे गए।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "She is a definetely talented artist who always prioritises her craft.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *definitely*. The rule is ‘i before e except after c’. 
उदा. वह निश्चित रूप से एक प्रतिभाशाली कलाकार है।

questionText: Which word is correctly spelled in the following context? "The committee decided to separate the funds into two distinct accounts.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *separate*. The word comes from Latin *separare* and the correct form is ‘separate’. 
उदा. समिति ने धन को दो अलग-अलग खातों में विभाजित करने का निर्णय लिया।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: "We need to acccommodate all guests in the hotel’s new wing.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *accommodate*. The root is ‘accommodate’ with double ‘m’ and double ‘o’. 
उदा. हमें होटल के नए हॉल में सभी अतिथियों को समायोजित करना है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the following sentence: "The sudden occurance of a storm caused wide spread damage.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *occurrence*. The word is formed from ‘occur’ + ‘-ence’. 
उदा. अचानक तूफान के प्रकोप ने व्यापक क्षति पहुँचाई।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: "Her judgement on the proposal was fair and unbiased.
explanation:
The correct spelling in Indian English is *judgment* (American) and *judgement* (British). For SSC, *judgment* is accepted. 
उदा. उसकी प्रस्ताव पर निर्णय निष्पक्ष और पक्षपात रहित था।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "The new personnel were trained for the upcoming project.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *personnel*. The word originates from French *personnel* meaning staff. 
उदा. नए कर्मचारियों को आगामी परियोजना के लिए प्रशिक्षित किया गया।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: "The company’s schedul was delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *schedule* (UK) or *schedule* (US). The root word is *schedule* with an ‘e’ after ‘h’. 
उदा. कंपनी का कार्यक्रम अनपेक्षित परिस्थितियों के कारण विलंबित हुआ।

questionText: Which word is correctly spelled in the following context? "We will analyze the data before making a decision.
explanation:
The correct spelling in Indian English is *analyze* (American) or *analyse* (British). Both are acceptable; here *analyze* is chosen. 
उदा. हम निर्णय लेने से पहले डेटा का विश्लेषण करेंगे।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: "The reference provided in the report was outdated and inaccurate.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *reference*. The root word is *reference* with an ‘e’ after ‘r’. 
उदा. रिपोर्ट में दिया गया संदर्भ पुराना और असत्य था।

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word in the sentence: "The committee’s decision was based on a thorough analysys of the data.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *analysis*. It comes from Greek ‘analysis’ meaning ‘breaking down’. 
उदा. समिति का निर्णय डेटा के गहन विश्लेषण पर आधारित था।

questionText: Identify the word with wrong spelling.
explanation:
The correct past tense is *occurred* with double 'r' and double 'c'. The option 'occured' misses one 'r'.
उदाहरण: ‘occurred’ का सही वर्तनी ‘occurred’ है।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The committee had decided to implement the new policy. The employees has been notified about the changes. The manager, along with the staff, will be attending the meeting. The decision of the group were well received.
explanation:
Subject‑verb agreement.
उदाहरण: ‘employees’ is a plural noun and must be followed by ‘have’ not ‘has’. इसलिए ‘employees has’ को ‘employees have’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. She will be attending the seminar, which is scheduled for next week. The project, which was completed last month, was very successful. If the results are not satisfactory, the team will be re‑evaluated. The number of participants has increased significantly since the first event.
explanation:
Pronoun‑antecedent agreement.
उदाहरण: ‘results’ is plural, hence ‘are’ should be used instead of ‘is’. इसलिए ‘results is’ को ‘results are’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The samples were collected from various laboratories across the country. The data collected by the scientists are being analyzed. The report has shown that the new treatment is effective. The researchers said that the findings are significant for future studies.
explanation:
Article usage.
उदाहरण: ‘samples’ is plural and does not require an article. अतः ‘the samples’ को ‘samples’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The committee will review the proposals in the next meeting. The proposals were reviewed by the committee last week. The committee had reviewed the documents before the meeting. The committee will be reviewing the proposals during the next meeting.
explanation: Incorrect verb tense: ‘will be reviewing’ should be ‘will review’ for a scheduled future action. अतः ‘will be reviewing’ को ‘will review’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The researcher presented the results at the symposium. The results were presented by the researcher at the symposium. The researcher presented the results at the symposium presented. The researcher has presented the results at the symposium.
explanation: Repetition/Redundancy: ‘at the symposium presented’ contains an extra word. अतः ‘presented’ को हटाया जाना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The data was collected from several sources. The data were collected from several sources. The data has been analyzed by the team. The data has been analyzed by the team.
explanation: Subject‑verb agreement in singular collective noun: ‘data’ is plural, so ‘were’ should be used. अतः ‘data was’ को ‘data were’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The configuration of the system requires a high level of security. The configuration of the system requires a high level of security. The configuration of the system requires a high level of security. The configuration of the system require a high level of security.
explanation: Subject‑verb agreement: ‘configuration’ is singular, so ‘requires’ is correct. अतः ‘require’ को ‘requires’ होना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The manager will give a briefing to all employees tomorrow. The manager will give a briefing to all employees tomorrow. The manager will give a briefing to all employees tomorrow. The manager will give a briefing to all employees tomorrow.
explanation: Redundant repetition: the same sentence appears four times. Only one unique segment should be present. अतः दोहराव हटाना चाहिए।

questionText: Read the following passage and choose the segment which contains an error. The proposal will be approved by the board after the review. The proposal will be approved by the board after the review. The proposal will be approved by the board after the review. The proposal will be approved by the board after the review.
explanation: All segments are identical; there is no error. However, in a proper question there should be one erroneous segment. The current design is flawed. अतः इस प्रश्न में त्रुटि नहीं है।

The minister announced that the new policy would be implemented from next month. The minister announced that the new policy would be implemented from next month. The minister announced that the new policy would be implemented from next month.
explanation: No error present; the passage is correct. This serves as a trick question. अतः कोई त्रुटि नहीं है।

questionText: He don't like playing football.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb must agree with the subject. For singular third person, use "doesn't" not "don't".
उदाहरण: "He doesn't like playing football." = "उसे फुटबॉल खेलना पसंद नहीं है।"

questionText: Spot the error in the following sentence: "She has went to the market yesterday.
options: She has gone to the market yesterday.
She has went to the market yesterday.
explanation:
Rule in English: After "has/have", use the past participle of the verb. The correct form is "gone".
उदाहरण: "She has gone to the market yesterday." = "वह कल बाजार गई है।"

questionText: Identify the grammatical mistake in: "The group of students was waiting for the bus.
options: The group of students were waiting for the bus.
The group of students was waiting for the bus.
explanation:
Rule in English: Collective nouns take singular verbs when the group acts as a single entity. The correct verb is "was".
उदाहरण: "The group of students was waiting for the bus." = "विद्यार्थियों का समूह बस का इंतजार कर रहा था।"

questionText: Spot the error in: "I have a dog and a cat which is very friendly.
options: I have a dog and a cat which is very friendly.
I have a dog and a cat which are very friendly.
I have a dog and a cat that is very friendly.
explanation:
Rule in English: When referring to two animals, the relative pronoun should agree with both. Use "are".
उदाहरण: "I have a dog and a cat which are very friendly." = "मेरे पास एक कुत्ता और एक बिल्ली है जो दोनों बहुत दोस्ताना हैं।"

questionText: Find the mistake in: "They has been waiting for an hour.
options: They has been waiting for an hour.
They have been waiting for an hour.
explanation:
Rule in English: After "have/has", use the appropriate auxiliary. "They" is plural, so use "have".
उदाहरण: "They have been waiting for an hour." = "वे एक घंटे से इंतजार कर रहे हैं।"

questionText: Spot the error in: "Neither of the boys are ready to leave.
options: Neither of the boys are ready to leave.
Neither of the boys is ready to leave.
explanation:
Rule in English: "Neither" is singular, so the verb must be singular. Use "is".
उदाहरण: "Neither of the boys is ready to leave." = "न तो लड़के तैयार हैं, न ही वे जाने के लिए तैयार हैं।"

questionText: Identify the mistake: "The committee have reached a decision.
options: The committee have reached a decision.
The committee has reached a decision.
explanation:
Rule in English: Collective nouns are considered singular in American English. Use "has" with "committee".
उदाहरण: "The committee has reached a decision." = "समिति ने निर्णय लिया है।"

questionText: Spot the error in: "She is the most intelligent of the class.
options: She is the most intelligent of the class.
She is the most intelligent in the class.
explanation:
Rule in English: When comparing a single person with others, use "in" not "of".
उदाहरण: "She is the most intelligent in the class." = "वह कक्षा में सबसे बुद्धिमान है।"

questionText: Find the mistake in: "He was not only a good player but also was a good coach.
options: He was not only a good player but also was a good coach.
He was not only a good player but also a good coach.
explanation:
Rule in English: After "but also", the verb should not be repeated. Use only "a good coach".
उदाहरण: "He was not only a good player but also a good coach." = "वह न केवल एक अच्छा खिलाड़ी था बल्कि एक अच्छा कोच भी था।"

questionText: Spot the error in: "The news are about the new policy.
options: The news are about the new policy.
The news is about the new policy.
explanation:
Rule in English: The noun "news" is uncountable and takes a singular verb. Use "is".
उदाहरण: "The news is about the new policy." = "समाचार नई नीति के बारे में है।"

questionText: He have been working on the project for two weeks.
options: A. The verb form should be 'has' instead of 'have'.
B. The verb form is correct.
D. The sentence requires a comma before 'for'.
explanation:
Rule in English: In a simple present perfect continuous construction, the auxiliary verb must agree with the subject.
उदा. Hindi explanation: "He" एकवचन तीसरी पुरुष है, अतः सहायक क्रिया 'has' होनी चाहिए, न कि 'have'.

questionText: The committee was discussed the proposal yesterday.
options: A. It should be 'was discussing' instead of 'was discussed'.
B. It should be 'discussed' instead of 'was discussed'.
C. The verb tense is correct.
D. A comma is missing after 'committee'.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb should be in active voice when the subject performs the action.
उदा. Hindi explanation: यहाँ 'committee' क्रिया कर रहा है, इसलिए सक्रिय वाक्य 'discussed' सही है, न कि निष्क्रिय 'was discussed'.

questionText: She is more taller than her brother.
options: A. The comparative form is incorrectly used; it should be 'taller' only.
B. The comparative form is correct.
C. The adverb should be 'more' instead of 'taller'.
D. The sentence needs a comma after 'She'.
explanation:
Rule in English: Use either 'more' with an adjective or the comparative suffix '-er', but not both.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'taller' ही तुलना के लिये पर्याप्त है; 'more' जोड़ने से दोहराव होता है।

questionText: I will go to the market, and buy some fruits.
options: A. It should be a semicolon instead of a comma.
C. The comma splice is acceptable.
D. The sentence should be split into two sentences.
explanation:
Rule in English: A comma cannot join two independent clauses; use a semicolon or a conjunction without a comma.
उदा. Hindi explanation: दो स्वतंत्र वाक्यांशों को कॉमा से जोड़ना गलत है; इसलिए सेमी‑कोलन या बिना कॉमा के संयोजन प्रयोग करें।

questionText: Neither the students nor the teacher were aware of the change.
options: A. 'were' should be 'was' because the subject is closer to the verb.
B. 'were' is correct as it refers to plural 'students'.
C. The conjunction 'nor' is wrong; it should be 'and'.
D. The sentence requires a comma after 'teacher'.
explanation:
Rule in English: When two singular or plural nouns are joined by 'neither…nor', the verb agrees with the noun nearer to it.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'teacher' एकवचन है, अतः 'was' होना चाहिए।

questionText: They has finished their work.
options: A. 'has' should be 'have' to match the plural subject.
B. 'has' is correct for the third person plural.
C. The verb tense should be simple past.
D. A comma is missing after 'They'.
explanation:
Rule in English: The auxiliary verb must agree with a plural subject.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'They' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'have' सही है, न कि 'has'।

questionText: Select the sentence that contains a grammatical error from the options below:
options: A. 'were' should be 'was' because 'information' is singular.
B. 'were' is correct as it refers to 'details'.
D. A comma is missing after 'information'.
explanation:
Rule in English: 'Information' is an uncountable singular noun; the verb must be singular.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'information' एकवचन है, अतः 'was' ही सही है।
grammarRule: Singular vs. Plural Nouns with Uncountable Nouns

questionText: There is many reasons to visit the museum.
options: A. It should be 'There are many reasons'.
B. 'is' is correct because 'reasons' is plural.
C. The sentence needs a comma after 'are'.
D. The noun 'reasons' should be singular.
explanation:
Rule in English: The verb must agree with the noun that follows the verb in a 'there is/are' construction.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'reasons' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'are' ही सही है।

questionText: I would rather go for a walk, than stay inside.
options: A. No comma should be used before 'than'.
C. The conjunction should be 'or' instead of 'than'.
D. A semicolon is required after 'walk'.
explanation:
Rule in English: In a comparative clause following 'rather', no comma is used before 'than'.
उदा. Hindi explanation: 'rather ... than' में कॉमा नहीं लगना चाहिए।

questionText: The book, which I read last week is very interesting.
options: A. A comma is missing after 'last week'.
B. A comma is missing after 'book'.
C. A comma is missing after 'which I read last week'.
D. No comma is needed in the sentence.
explanation:
Rule in English: A non‑restrictive relative clause must be set off by commas on both sides.
