options: The results of the experiment has been analyzed by the team.
The results of the experiment have been analyzed by the team.
The results of the experiment has been analyzed by the team, and it was successful.
The results of the experiment were analyzed by the team.
explanation:
The subject *results* is plural, so the verb should be *have been*.
उदाहरण: प्रयोग के परिणामों का विश्लेषण टीम द्वारा किया गया है।

questionText: The manager, along with his staff, have been invited to the conference.
options: The manager, along with his staff, have been invited to the conference.
The manager, along with his staff, has been invited to the conference.
The manager and his staff have been invited to the conference.
The manager, along with his staff, were invited to the conference.
explanation:
When a singular noun is followed by a phrase with *along with*, the verb agrees with the singular noun: *has been*.
उदाहरण: प्रबंधक, अपने स्टाफ के साथ, सम्मेलन के लिए आमंत्रित किए गए हैं।
grammarRule: Verb Agreement with Singular Noun + 'along with'

questionText: Both John and his sister is going to the party.
options: Both John and his sister are going to the party.
Both John and his sister is going to the party.
Both John and his sister will going to the party.
Both John and his sister goes to the party.
explanation:
Compound subject *John and his sister* is plural, so the verb must be *are*.
उदाहरण: दोनों जॉन और उसकी बहन पार्टी में जा रहे हैं।

questionText: The company plans to launch the new product next month, and it will success.
options: The company plans to launch the new product next month, and it will succeed.
The company plans to launch the new product next month, and it will success.
The company plans to launch the new product next month, and it succeeds.
The company plans to launch the new product next month, and it will be success.
explanation:
Correct verb form: *succeed* (intransitive) not *success*.
उदाहरण: कंपनी अगले महीने नया उत्पाद लॉन्च करने की योजना बना रही है, और यह सफल होगा।

questionText: I have less money then you.
options: I have less money then you.
I have less money than you.
I have less money than you are.
explanation:
Use *than* for comparison, not *then*.
उदाहरण: मेरे पास आपके मुकाबले कम पैसा है।

questionText: She don't like coffee.
explanation:
Third‑person singular requires *doesn't*.
उदाहरण: उसे कॉफी पसंद नहीं है।

💡 **हिन्दी व्याख्या**: सही विकल्प 'She doesn't like coffee.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

questionText: The book that I had bought yesterday were very interesting.
options: The book that I had bought yesterday were very interesting.
The book that I had bought yesterday was very interesting.
The book that I had bought yesterday are very interesting.
The book that I had bought yesterday will be very interesting.
explanation:
Singular noun *book* requires singular verb *was*.
उदाहरण: वह पुस्तक, जिसे मैंने कल खरीदा था, बहुत रोचक थी।

questionText: After finishing the assignment, the students was excited.
options: After finishing the assignment, the students was excited.
After finishing the assignment, the students were excited.
After finishing the assignment, the students will be excited.
After finishing the assignment, the students have been excited.
explanation:
Plural noun *students* requires plural verb *were*.
उदाहरण: असाइनमेंट पूरा करने के बाद छात्र उत्साहित थे।

questionText: The analysis of the data was performed by the scientists, and it showed significant results.
options: The analysis of the data was performed by the scientists, and it showed significant results.
The analysis of the data was performed by the scientists, and it shows significant results.
The analysis of the data was performed by the scientists, and it will show significant results.
The analysis of the data was performed by the scientists, and it had showed significant results.
explanation:
The sentence is already correct; the verb tenses are consistent. No error present.
उदाहरण: डेटा का विश्लेषण वैज्ञानिकों द्वारा किया गया था, और यह महत्वपूर्ण परिणाम दिखाता है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
The word "scarce" means not plentiful or rare, which is the opposite of "abundant". 
उदाहरण: जब पानी दुर्लभ (scarce) होता है, तो वह प्रचुर (abundant) नहीं होता।

questionText: vague
explanation:
"Clear" means easy to understand, which is the opposite of "vague" (unclear). 
उदाहरण: एक स्पष्ट (clear) उत्तर अस्पष्ट (vague) उत्तर से बेहतर होता है।

questionText: diligent
explanation:
"Indolent" means lazy or unwilling to work, which is the opposite of "diligent". 
उदाहरण: एक परिश्रमी (diligent) कर्मचारी की तुलना में एक सुस्त (indolent) कर्मचारी कम उत्पादक होता है।

questionText: serene
explanation:
"Agitated" means restless or disturbed, which is the opposite of "serene" (calm). 
उदाहरण: एक शांत (serene) दृश्य के विपरीत, एक उथल-पुथल (agitated) दृश्य तनाव पैदा करता है।

questionText: stern
explanation:
"Lenient" means forgiving or tolerant, which is the opposite of "stern" (rigid). 
उदाहरण: एक सख्त (stern) शिक्षक के विपरीत, एक दयालु (lenient) शिक्षक अधिक सहानुभूति रखता है।

questionText: humble
explanation:
"Arrogant" means overly proud or disdainful, which is the opposite of "humble" (modest). 
उदाहरण: एक विनम्र (humble) व्यक्ति की तुलना में एक घमंडी (arrogant) व्यक्ति अहंकारी होता है।

questionText: mature
explanation:
"Immature" means not fully developed or childish, which is the opposite of "mature" (fully developed). 
उदाहरण: एक परिपक्व (mature) व्यक्ति के विपरीत, एक असंयमी (immature) व्यक्ति अपरिपक्व होता है।

questionText: transparent
explanation:
"Opaque" means not see-through, which is the opposite of "transparent". 
उदाहरण: एक पारदर्शी (transparent) काँच की तुलना में एक अपारदर्शी (opaque) कांच अंधेरा होता है।

questionText: The company's profits are _______, indicating a strong market presence.
explanation:
"Negligible" means too small to be considered, which is the opposite of "substantial" (large). 
उदाहरण: एक बड़ा (substantial) लाभ छोटा (negligible) लाभ से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण होता है।

questionText: permanent
explanation:
"Temporary" means lasting for a short time, which is the opposite of "permanent" (lasting forever). 
उदाहरण: एक स्थायी (permanent) समाधान अस्थायी (temporary) समाधान से बेहतर होता है।

questionText: Diligent
explanation:
A diligent person works carefully and regularly, while a negligent person is careless or indifferent.
उदाहरण: जो कड़ी मेहनत करता है उसे "सावधान" कहा जाता है, जबकि जो अनदेखी करता है वह "निष्काळजी" है।

questionText: Optimistic
explanation:
Optimistic means hopeful about the future, whereas pessimistic means expecting the worst.
उदाहरण: आशावादी सोच वाला व्यक्ति "आशावादी" है, जबकि निराशावादी सोच वाला व्यक्ति "निराशावादी" है।

questionText: Generous
explanation:
A generous person is willing to give; a stingy person is unwilling to give.
उदाहरण: उदार व्यक्ति "उदार" होता है, जबकि मितव्ययी व्यक्ति "छिपा" होता है।

questionText: Sincere
explanation:
Sincere means genuine; insincere means fake or deceitful.
उदाहरण: सच्चे व्यक्ति को "ईमानदार" कहा जाता है, जबकि झूठे व्यक्ति को "झूठा" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Humble
explanation:
Humble means modest; arrogant means overly proud.
उदाहरण: विनम्र व्यक्ति को "नम्र" कहा जाता है, जबकि घमंडी व्यक्ति को "अहंकारी" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Voluntary
explanation:
Voluntary means done of one's own free will; compulsory means forced or mandatory.
उदाहरण: स्वयंसेवी कार्य "स्वेच्छा" है, जबकि अनिवार्य कार्य "अनिवार्य" है।

questionText: Content
explanation:
Content means satisfied; discontent means dissatisfied.
उदाहरण: संतुष्ट व्यक्ति को "संतुष्ट" कहा जाता है, जबकि असंतुष्ट व्यक्ति को "असंतुष्ट" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Courageous
explanation:
Courageous means brave; cowardly means lacking courage.
उदाहरण: साहसी व्यक्ति को "साहसी" कहा जाता है, जबकि डरपोक व्यक्ति को "डरपोक" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Abundant
explanation:
Abundant means plentiful; scarce means rare or insufficient.
उदाहरण: प्रचुर मात्रा में "प्रचुर" है, जबकि कम मात्रा में "दुर्लभ" है।

questionText: Ambitious
explanation:
Ambitious means having a strong desire for success; unambitious means having no such desire.
उदाहरण: महत्वाकांक्षी व्यक्ति को "महत्वाकांक्षी" कहा जाता है, जबकि बिना महत्वाकांक्षा वाला व्यक्ति "निराशावादी" नहीं बल्कि "अमहत्वाकांक्षी" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Cooperative
explanation:
Cooperative means willing to work together; uncooperative means unwilling to cooperate.
उदाहरण: सहयोगी व्यक्ति को "सहयोगी" कहा जाता है, जबकि असहयोगी व्यक्ति को "असहयोगी" कहा जाता है।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word in the sentence: "The government has announced a new policy to promote small bussinesses.
explanation:
The word ‘businesses’ is correctly spelled. Plural of *business* takes the suffix ‘-es’ after the double ‘s’.
उदाहरण: businesses (सही) बनाम bussinesses (गलत)।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word: "She received an award for her exelent performance.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *excellent*. The word contains a double ‘l’ and a double ‘c’.
उदाहरण: excellent (सही) बनाम exelent (गलत)।

questionText: Find the misspelled word: "The scientist published his findings in a peer‑reviewed jounral.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *journal*. The word ends with ‘-al’ not ‘-el’.
उदाहरण: journal (सही) बनाम jounral (गलत)।

questionText: Which word is spelled incorrectly: "They went to the librery to borrow books.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *library*. The word contains the sequence ‘-ary’.
उदाहरण: library (सही) बनाम librery (गलत)।

questionText: Identify the misspelled word: "The instructions were written in a clear and concice manner.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *concise*. It contains a single ‘c’ after the ‘n’.
उदाहरण: concise (सही) बनाम concice (गलत)।

questionText: Find the incorrectly spelled word: "He is a knowledgeable person in the field of physics.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *knowledgeable*. The word contains ‘-ledge’ before the ‘able’ suffix.
उदाहरण: knowledgeable (सही) बनाम knowlegeable (गलत)।

questionText: Which word is misspelled: "The committee will convene tomorrow at 10:00 a.m.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *convene*. It is derived from Latin *convenire*.
उदाहरण: convene (सही) बनाम conveen (गलत)।

questionText: Identify the incorrectly spelled word: "She had a remarkable ability to interpet the data.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *interpret*. The word contains a ‘r’ after ‘t’.
उदाहरण: interpret (सही) बनाम interpet (गलत)।

questionText: Find the misspelled word: "The company announced its quarterly earnings for the fiscal year.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *quarterly* with the ‘a’ after the ‘t’.
उदाहरण: quarterly (सही) बनाम quaterly (गलत)।

questionText: Which word is incorrectly spelled: "The volunteers organized a clean up drive at the local park.
explanation:
In American English, the correct spelling is *organized* with a ‘z’. In British English, *organised* is acceptable.
उदाहरण: organized (सही) बनाम organied (गलत)।
grammarRule: American vs. British spelling of organized

questionText: Identify the misspelled word: "The proposal was met with sceptic response from the board.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *skeptic* with a ‘k’. The word means doubtful.
उदाहरण: skeptic (सही) बनाम sceptic (गलत)।

questionText: acquiesce
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym is a word that has a meaning similar to another word.
उदा. "acquiesce" means to accept or comply; the closest synonym in the options is "agree".

questionText: candid
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym is a word that expresses the same or nearly the same idea.
उदा. "candid" means being straightforward and honest; the closest synonym is "frank".

questionText: deferential
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words with comparable meanings.
उदा. "deferential" refers to showing respect; the best synonym is "respectful".

questionText: elucidate
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym shares a similar meaning with another word.
उदा. "elucidate" means to make clear or explain; the synonym in the list is "explain".

questionText: fastidious
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words that convey a similar notion.
उदा. "fastidious" means extremely attentive to detail; the closest synonym is "meticulous".

questionText: gregarious
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym has a meaning close to another word.
उदा. "gregarious" means fond of company; the best synonym is "sociable".

questionText: hinder
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms express comparable meanings.
उदा. "hinder" means to obstruct or impede; the correct synonym is "obstruct".

questionText: incessant
explanation:
Rule in English: A synonym shares a similar sense with another word.
उदा. "incessant" indicates something that continues without interruption; the closest synonym is "continuous".

questionText: juxtapose
explanation:
Rule in English: Synonyms are words that convey the same or nearly the same idea.
उदा. "juxtapose" means to place side by side for comparison; the best synonym is "compare".

questionText: elated
explanation:
The word "elated" means very happy or thrilled. The only option that conveys a similar positive emotion is "content".
उदा. "Elated" का समानार्थी शब्द "content" है।

questionText: fastidious
explanation:
"Fastidious" refers to being extremely careful or particular. The word "scrupulous" carries the same meaning.
उदा. "Fastidious" का समानार्थी "scrupulous" है।

questionText: abundant
explanation:
"Abundant" means existing in large quantities. "Plentiful" expresses the same idea.
उदाहरण: "Abundant" का समानार्थी "plentiful" है।

questionText: convoluted
explanation:
"Convoluted" means extremely complex or intricate. "Complex" matches that sense.
उदाहरण: "Convoluted" का समानार्थी "complex" है।

questionText: benevolent
explanation:
"Benevolent" implies a kind and generous nature. The word "kind" carries the same meaning.
उदाहरण: "Benevolent" का समानार्थी "kind" है।

questionText: incessant
explanation:
"Incessant" means continuing without pause. "Continuous" matches this meaning.
उदाहरण: "Incessant" का समानार्थी "continuous" है।

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: "We need to ___ the guests before they arrive.
explanation:
The word ‘accommodate’ has a double ‘m’ and double ‘c’. Rule: when a short vowel is followed by two consonants, both consonants are doubled after the vowel.
उदाहरण: सही वर्तनी - accommodate, गलत - accomodate

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled adjective in the sentence: "The hotel offers a ___ service to all guests.
explanation:
‘Complimentary’ means free of charge. The root is ‘compliment’ + ‘ary’. Rule: ‘-ary’ suffix follows a noun ending in ‘-ment’. 
उदाहरण: सही - complimentary, गलत - complementary

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: "He had an ___ feeling after the incident.
explanation:
The word is ‘embarrassment’ with double ‘r’ and double ‘s’. Rule: double consonants after a short vowel.
उदाहरण: सही - embarrassment, गलत - embarrashment

questionText: Select the correctly spelled verb: "Please ___ the documents before submitting them.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘receive’. Rule: ‘i’ before ‘e’ except after ‘c’. 
उदाहरण: सही - receive, गलत - recieve

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled adjective: "The package was ___ for quick delivery.
explanation:
The correct form is ‘ASAP’ (As Soon As Possible). It is usually written in capital letters without hyphens. 
उदाहरण: सही - ASAP, गलत - a-s-a-p

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled noun: "The city has a ___ population of 1.5 million.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘demographic’. The root ‘graph’ (write) + ‘-ic’ suffix. 
उदाहरण: सही - demographic, गलत - demograhic

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: "The report contains ___ errors that need correction.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘misprint’. Rule: ‘print’ is the root; ‘mis-’ is a prefix meaning wrong. 
उदाहरण: सही - misprint, गलत - misprit

questionText: Select the correctly spelled adjective: "The ___ policy was enacted last year.
explanation:
The correct spelling is ‘regulatory’. It comes from the Latin root ‘regula’ + ‘-tory’. Rule: Double ‘r’ after ‘g’ is retained.
उदाहरण: सही - regulatory, गलत - regulative

questionText: The students (who are studying) in the library should not make noise.
explanation:
Rule in English.
In relative clauses, present simple is used for general truths. "Who study" correctly expresses the habitual action of the students.
उदा. "जो पढ़ते हैं" का प्रयोग सामान्य क्रिया के लिये होता है।
grammarRule: Relative clause – Present Simple for habitual actions

questionText: He is the most (tallest) building in the city.
explanation:
Rule in English.
When using superlatives, the adjective itself is sufficient; adding "of all" or "one" is redundant.
उदाहरण: "सबसे ऊँचा इमारत" सही है।

questionText: The children (who were playing) in the park were late for school.
explanation:
Rule in English.
Relative clause referring to a past action uses simple past: "who play" for present tense. The sentence implies the children were playing earlier.
उदाहरण: "जो खेल रहे हैं" वर्तमान काल में है।
grammarRule: Relative clause – Simple Past for past actions

questionText: It is important that he (was sent) to the meeting on time.
explanation:
Rule in English.
In a clause after "important that", we use the subjunctive present: "sent".
उदाहरण: "यह ज़रूरी है कि वह बैठक पर समय पर पहुँचे"।
grammarRule: Subjunctive mood – Simple Present after important that

questionText: The book (which is about) physics is very interesting.
explanation:
Rule in English.
In a relative clause, the preposition precedes the relative pronoun: "about which".
उदाहरण: "वह किताब, जिसके बारे में है, बहुत रोचक है।"
grammarRule: Preposition in relative clause – Placement before pronoun

questionText: She will be the first (person) to finish the marathon.
explanation:
Rule in English.
No article is used before a noun in superlatives when it is preceded by "first".
उदाहरण: "पहला व्यक्ति" में article नहीं आता।
grammarRule: Articles – No article before noun in superlative

questionText: The lawyer (who is representing) the client will appear tomorrow.
explanation:
Rule in English.
The relative clause uses simple present for a current role: "who represents".
उदाहरण: "जो प्रतिनिधित्व करता है" वर्तमान काल में।
grammarRule: Relative clause – Simple Present for current role

questionText: The project (that is completed) by the team is ready for review.
explanation:
Rule in English.
A past participle is used after "which" to indicate completion: "which completed".
उदाहरण: "जो पूरा हो चुका है"।
grammarRule: Relative clause – Past participle after which

questionText: The teacher (was given) a new laptop by the school.
explanation:
Rule in English.
Passive voice: "was given" correctly expresses a past action.
उदाहरण: "उसे नई लैपटॉप दी गई थी।"
grammarRule: Passive voice – Past simple for completed action

questionText: The conference (which will be held) next month is expected to attract many delegates.
explanation:
Rule in English.
Future tense in a relative clause: "which will be held".
उदाहरण: "जो अगले महीने आयोजित होगा"।
grammarRule: Future tense in relative clause – will be + past participle

questionText: The mayor (who was elected) last year will visit the new park.
explanation:
Rule in English.
Past participle after "who" to denote an action completed before the main clause: "who elected".
उदाहरण: "जो चुना गया"।
grammarRule: Relative clause – Past participle for completed action

questionText: profuse
explanation:
Rule in English: Select the word that means abundant or copious.
उदा. "समृद्ध मात्रा में"

questionText: Abundant
explanation:
Rule in English: Look for a word that implies a large quantity.
उदा. "बहुतायत"

questionText: obstinate
explanation:
Rule in English: Choose a word that means unwilling to change.
उदा. "दृढ़ निश्चयी"

questionText: Candid
explanation:
Rule in English: Pick the word that conveys frankness and truthfulness.
उदा. "सच्चा"

questionText: evident
explanation:
Rule in English: Choose a word that means clear or obvious.

questionText: A. The committee had conducted the survey last month and found that the majority of respondents were satisfied. B. questionText: A. If I had known, I would have acted differently. B. If I had known, I would have acted differently. C. If I had known, I would have acted differently. D. If I had known, I would have acted differently.

questionText: She gave the book and the paper to him, and the girl was very happy.
options: She gave the book and the paper to him, and the girl was very happy.
She gave the book and the paper to him, and *she* was very happy.
She gave the book and the paper to him, and the girl were very happy.
explanation:
The pronoun referring to "She" must be used consistently. "She" should replace "the girl".
उदाहरण: He brought the tickets, and *he* was excited.

questionText: Both the students and the teacher was present at the meeting.
options: Both the students and the teacher was present at the meeting.
Both the students and the teacher were present at the meeting.
Both the students and the teacher is present at the meeting.
explanation:
When a compound subject is joined by "and", the verb is plural. Correct: "were".
उदाहरण: The cat and the dog *are* playing.

questionText: I went to the market, but I didn't bought any fruits.
options: I went to the market, but I didn't buy any fruits.
I went to the market, but I didn't bought any fruits.
I went to the market, but I didn't buying any fruits.
explanation:
After "didn't" the base form of the verb is used, not the past tense. Correct: "buy".
उदाहरण: She didn't *eat* the cake.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: The committee, along with the president, have decided to postpone the meeting.
The committee, along with the president, has decided to postpone the meeting.
The committee, along with the president, had decided to postpone the meeting.
The committee, along with the president, will decide to postpone the meeting.
explanation:
The main subject "The committee" is singular; the phrase "along with the president" is a prepositional phrase and does not change the subject. Correct: "has".
उदाहरण: The manager, together with his team, *has* approved the budget.

questionText: Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
options: If I will finish the work on time, I will inform my supervisor.
If I finish the work on time, I will inform my supervisor.
If I finished the work on time, I will inform my supervisor.
If I finish the work on time, I will informs my supervisor.
explanation:
In a conditional clause with "if", the simple present tense is used, not "will". Correct: "finish".
उदाहरण: If it rains, we will stay home.

questionText: The students were asked to submit their assignments, and their teachers were also given a dead line
options: The students were asked to submit their assignments, and *the* teachers were also given a deadline.
The students were asked to submit their assignments, and their teachers were also given a deadline.
The students were asked to submit their assignments, and their teachers were also given deadlines.
explanation:
Both nouns are plural, so the plural noun "deadlines" is appropriate. Correct: "deadlines".
उदाहरण: The clients and the partners were given *deadlines*.

questionText: He has a good knowledge of mathematics and physics.
options: He has a good knowledge of mathematics and physics.
explanation:
The noun "knowledge" is uncountable, so the article "a" should be omitted. Correct: "He has good knowledge of mathematics and physics."
उदाहरण: She has *good* knowledge of history.
grammarRule: Use of Articles with Uncountable Nouns

questionText: Every one in the class has to submit their home work by Monday.
options: Everyone in the class has to submit their homework by Monday.
Everyone in the class has to submit *his or her* homework by Monday.
Everyone in the class has to submit *their* homework by Monday.
explanation:
The singular pronoun "everyone" requires a singular possessive pronoun. The correct form is "his or her".
उदाहरण: Each student must bring *his or her* own bag.
grammarRule: Singular Pronoun with Singular Possessive Pronoun

explanation: The adjective "meticulous" describes someone who pays great attention to detail. In Hindi: "बारीकी से ध्यान देने वाला".

questionText: the act of remaining silent and not saying anything
explanation: "Silence" can be used as a noun to denote the state of not speaking. In Hindi: "चुप्पी".

questionText: someone who is not able to accept responsibility for one
explanation: "Irresponsible" means lacking a sense of duty or accountability. In Hindi: "बेपरवाह" या "अनुत्तरदायी".

questionText: some thing that is absolutely necessary or essential
explanation: "Essential" means absolutely necessary or indispensable. In Hindi: "आवश्यक" या "अनिवार्य".

questionText: the act of automatically repeating an action
explanation: "Habit" refers to a settled or regular tendency or practice. In Hindi: "आदत".

questionText: someone who is extremely enthusiastic about some thing
explanation: "Passionate" means having or showing intense emotion or enthusiasm. In Hindi: "उत्साही".

questionText: the quality of being extremely generous
explanation: "Magnanimous" means generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or less powerful person. In Hindi: "उदार" या "महानुभाव".

questionText: a person who is quick to understand or learn new things
explanation: "Apt" describes someone who is quick to learn or understand. In Hindi: "कुशल" या "तेज़ समझ वाला".

questionText: the state of being free from any problems or inconveniences
explanation: "Smooth" means without difficulties or complications. In Hindi: "समतल" या "सुव्यवस्थित".

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word: The new employee was very ________________ in his first week.
explanation:
The correct word is *inexperienced*. It is formed from the prefix *in-* + *experienced*. The other options contain misspellings of the root word.
उदाहरण: 'उसे काम का अनुभव नहीं था' – inexperienced.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: The scientist presented a ________________ theory about evolution.
explanation:
The correct spelling is *theory*. The word ends with the suffix *-y* but no extra letters. The other options add unnecessary letters.
उदाहरण: 'विज्ञान में एक सिद्धांत' – theory.

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: She has a very ________________ sense of humor.
explanation:
The adjective *eccentric* is spelled with *-ic* at the end. The others add extra letters or wrong suffixes.
उदाहरण: 'उसका हास्य विचित्र है' – eccentric.

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word: The ________________ of the building was damaged during the earthquake.
explanation:
The correct word is *structure*, ending with *-cture*. The other options misspell the ending.
उदाहरण: 'भवन की संरचना' – structure.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: The company will ________________ its new product next month.
explanation:
The verb *launch* is spelled with *-au* in the middle. The other options have misplaced letters.
उदाहरण: 'कंपनी नया उत्पाद लॉन्च करेगी' – launch.

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: He is known for his ________________ in public speaking.
explanation:
The adjective *confident* is used here. The noun *confidence* is also correct but the sentence requires an adjective. The other options are incorrect forms.
उदाहरण: 'वह सार्वजनिक भाषण में आत्मविश्वासी है' – confident.

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word: The ________________ of the novel was praised by critics.
explanation:
The noun *plot* is spelled with *-ot* at the end. The other options insert extra letters.
उदाहरण: 'उपन्यास की कहानी' – plot.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: The ________________ of the situation was obvious to every one.
explanation:
The noun *consequences* is plural and correctly spelled. The singular *consequence* is also correct but the sentence implies multiple effects. The other options contain misspellings.
उदाहरण: 'परिस्थिति के परिणाम' – consequences.

questionText: Identify the correctly spelled word: He gave a very ________________ present at i on on climate change.
explanation:
The adjective *insightful* ends with *-ful*. The other options double the last letter or misspell the root.
उदाहरण: 'वह एक अंतर्दृष्टिपूर्ण प्रस्तुति' – insightful.

questionText: Select the correctly spelled word: The ________________ of the city is known for its historic monuments.
explanation:
The noun *architecture* is spelled with *-ture* at the end. The other options drop or duplicate letters.
उदाहरण: 'शहर की वास्तुकला' – architecture.
